generation_method: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash draft with editorial corrections; actual .meta membership and types; Microsoft Learn reference descriptions. No event rows or incident labels.

AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs.description: Microsoft Entra authentication activity specifically for managed identities. Use it to determine which managed identity accessed which resource, from what IP address, and with what authentication result or conditional-access outcome. Pivot on ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceIdentity, CorrelationId and TimeGenerated. Choose AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs for other application service principals and user sign-in tables for user authentication.
AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs.description_zh: 专门记录 Microsoft Entra 托管标识的身份验证活动。用于调查哪个托管标识从何处访问了哪个资源，以及身份验证结果和条件访问结果；可通过 ServicePrincipalId、AppId、ResourceIdentity、CorrelationId 和 TimeGenerated 关联。其他应用服务主体的登录查 AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs，用户身份验证查用户登录表。

AppId.description: GUID of the application associated with the managed identity sign-in; pivot to group all sign-ins by the same application and spot unexpected or newly used application identifiers.
AppId.description_zh: 与托管标识登录关联的应用程序 GUID；可按同一应用聚合登录，发现异常或新出现的应用标识。

AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description: Authentication context references requested during this managed identity sign-in, indicating which access conditions applied; use to compare context enforcement against the resulting outcome.
AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录请求的身份验证上下文引用，表示适用的访问条件；可据此对比上下文强制与最终结果。

AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description: Details about the authentication processor handling this managed identity sign-in; inspect to understand which mechanism or flow processed the authentication when results are unexpected.
AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description_zh: 处理本次托管标识登录的身份验证处理器详情；当结果异常时，可据此了解处理身份验证的机制或流程。

Category.description: Category label of this managed identity sign-in record as emitted by the service; use to scope queries and filter record types, since categories may vary across rows.
Category.description_zh: 服务为本条托管标识登录记录打上的类别标签；用于限定查询范围并筛选记录类型，因为各类记录的类别可能不同。

ConditionalAccessPolicies.description: Details of conditional access policies applied to this managed identity sign-in; review the evaluated policies when assessing why the sign-in succeeded, failed, or was challenged.
ConditionalAccessPolicies.description_zh: 应用于本次托管标识登录的条件访问策略详情；评估登录成功、失败或被质询原因时可据此查看已评估策略。

ConditionalAccessPoliciesV2.description: Structured (dynamic) representation of conditional access policy details for this sign-in; name-derived interpretation, so inspect the JSON content to confirm fields and granularity before relying on it.
ConditionalAccessPoliciesV2.description_zh: 本次登录条件访问策略详情的有结构（动态）表示；此解释仅由字段名推断，使用前应检查 JSON 内容以确认字段与粒度。

ConditionalAccessStatus.description: Overall status of conditional access policies for this managed identity sign-in; use to separate sign-ins where access controls were satisfied from those blocked or not applied.
ConditionalAccessStatus.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录条件访问策略的总体状态；可用于区分访问控制已满足、被阻止或未应用的登录。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier linking this managed identity sign-in to related activity for trail reconstruction; join across records to trace a sequence of authentication and resource operations.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 将本次托管标识登录与相关活动关联的标识符，用于重建轨迹；可跨记录连接以追踪身份验证与资源操作序列。

DurationMs.description: Length of this managed identity sign-in operation in milliseconds; unusually long or short durations may warrant scrutiny alongside the result fields.
DurationMs.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录操作的时长（毫秒）；异常长或短的时长可结合结果字段一并审查。

FederatedCredentialId.description: Identifier of the federated identity credential used for this managed identity sign-in, when applicable; helps determine whether workload federation rather than a stored secret was used.
FederatedCredentialId.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录所用联合身份凭据的标识符（如适用）；有助于判断是使用工作负载联合身份还是存储的密钥。

IPAddress.description: IP address of the client that initiated this managed identity sign-in; pivot to detect sign-ins from unfamiliar networks or geographies, but confirm attribution via other evidence.
IPAddress.description_zh: 发起本次托管标识登录的客户端 IP 地址；可用于发现来自陌生网络或地域的登录，但应结合其他证据确认归属。

Id.description: Unique identifier of this managed identity sign-in activity record; use for exact reference, deduplication, or joining when correlating the same event across data sources.
Id.description_zh: 本条托管标识登录活动记录的唯一标识符；用于精确引用、去重或在跨数据源关联同一事件时连接。

Identity.description: Identity from the token presented when the request was made (may be a user account, system account, or service principal); inspect the actual value and context rather than assuming a type.
Identity.description_zh: 发出请求时所提供令牌中的身份（可能是用户账户、系统账户或服务主体）；应检查实际取值与上下文，而非假定类型。

Level.description: Severity level assigned to this managed identity sign-in record by the service; useful for prioritizing records that the platform itself flagged as noteworthy.
Level.description_zh: 服务为本次托管标识登录记录分配的严重性级别；可用于优先处理平台自身标记为值得注意的记录。

Location.description: Region of the resource emitting this managed identity sign-in event; use to filter by reporting region, not to be confused with the sign-in's geographic origin.
Location.description_zh: 发出本次托管标识登录事件所在的资源区域；用于按上报区域过滤，勿与登录的地理来源混淆。

LocationDetails.description: Details about the sign-in location for this managed identity event; interpret the structured content carefully and corroborate before attributing a physical origin.
LocationDetails.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录的位置详情；应谨慎解读其结构化内容，并在归因实际来源前加以佐证。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation recorded for this managed identity event, documented as sign-in activity; use to scope the table to authentication records when querying.
OperationName.description_zh: 本次托管标识事件记录的操作名称，文档说明为登录活动；查询时可用于将表范围限定为身份验证记录。

OperationVersion.description: REST API version requested by the client for this managed identity sign-in; shows which API surface produced the request and can help distinguish client behaviors over time.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录中客户端请求的 REST API 版本；反映产生请求的 API 接口，并可帮助区分不同时间的客户端行为。

ResourceDisplayName.description: Display name of the resource that the service principal signed into for this managed identity event; pivot to see which resources a given identity accesses.
ResourceDisplayName.description_zh: 本次托管标识事件中服务主体登录目标资源的显示名称；可用于查看某身份访问了哪些资源。

ResourceGroup.description: Resource group associated with the logs for this managed identity sign-in; use for scoping queries to a deployment grouping rather than as a security attribute.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 与本次托管标识登录日志关联的资源组；用于按部署分组限定查询范围，而非作为安全属性使用。

ResourceIdentity.description: Identifier of the resource that the service principal signed into; use to correlate the target resource across sign-ins and to join with resource-side activity.
ResourceIdentity.description_zh: 服务主体登录目标资源的标识符；可用于跨登录关联目标资源，并与资源侧活动连接。

ResourceServicePrincipalId.description: Service principal identifier of the target resource in this managed identity sign-in; distinguish it from the signing-in identity when scoping who accessed what.
ResourceServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录中目标资源的服务主体标识符；在界定访问关系时应注意与发起登录的身份区分。

ResultDescription.description: Error description for this managed identity sign-in operation when it did not succeed; read the actual text to understand failure reasons and drive follow-up queries.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录操作未成功时的错误描述；请阅读实际文本以了解失败原因并开展后续查询。

ResultSignature.description: Error code, if any, for this managed identity sign-in operation; use codes to group and triage failures, and validate meanings against the actual values observed.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 本次托管标识登录操作的错误代码（如有）；可按代码分组并分流失败情况，并对照实际取值核验其含义。

ResultType.description: Sign-in outcome for this managed identity authentication attempt, typically success or failure status. Use it to filter failed authentications and pivot to error context in ResultDescription or ResultSignature.
ResultType.description_zh: 本次托管标识身份验证的登录结果，通常为成功或失败状态。可用其筛选失败的身份验证，并结合 ResultDescription 或 ResultSignature 查看错误上下文。

ServicePrincipalCredentialKeyId.description: Key identifier of the credential (certificate or key) the service principal used when initiating this sign-in. Helps correlate authentication failures or spikes to a specific credential; absence may indicate secret-based or federated flow.
ServicePrincipalCredentialKeyId.description_zh: 服务主体在发起本次登录时所用凭据（证书或密钥）的密钥标识符。可将身份验证失败或异常激增关联到特定凭据；该字段为空可能表示使用密钥凭据或联合凭据流程。

ServicePrincipalCredentialThumbprint.description: Thumbprint of the credential the service principal presented for this sign-in, identifying the specific certificate instance. Use with ServicePrincipalCredentialKeyId to track which credential material authenticated and to spot unexpected or rotated certificates.
ServicePrincipalCredentialThumbprint.description_zh: 服务主体在本次登录中出示凭据的指纹，用于标识具体证书实例。结合 ServicePrincipalCredentialKeyId 可追踪哪份凭据材料完成了身份验证，并发现异常或已轮换的证书。

ServicePrincipalId.description: Object ID of the service principal that initiated this managed identity sign-in. Primary pivot for grouping authentication activity by workload identity and attributing failures or unusual source IPs to one principal.
ServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 发起本次托管标识登录的服务主体的对象 ID。这是按工作负载标识聚合身份验证活动、并将失败或异常来源 IP 归因到某个主体的主要关联字段。

ServicePrincipalName.description: Display name of the service principal that initiated this sign-in, useful when the object ID is unfamiliar. Pivot by name to review all authentication activity of a given workload identity across time and resources.
ServicePrincipalName.description_zh: 发起本次登录的服务主体的显示名称，在对象 ID 不熟悉时很有用。可按名称关联，回顾某一工作负载标识在不同时间与资源上的全部身份验证活动。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or pipeline that collected this record, such as Azure Diagnostics or a Log Analytics agent. Use it to understand ingestion origin and to separate records collected through different monitoring paths, not as evidence about the identity itself.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集该记录的代理或管道，例如 Azure 诊断或 Log Analytics 代理。可用于了解采集来源，并区分经由不同监控路径收集的记录，但不代表标识本身的属性。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this record, per documented semantics. Use it to scope queries to one workspace; do not treat it as the Microsoft Entra directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID（按文档语义）。可用于将查询限定到单个工作区；不要将其视为 Microsoft Entra 目录租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time the event was generated, marking when this managed identity sign-in occurred. Use for time-window filtering, ordering authentication sequences, and correlating with resource or network activity.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 事件生成时的 UTC 日期和时间，表示本次托管标识登录发生的时间。可用于时间窗口过滤、对身份验证序列排序，以及与资源或网络活动关联。

Type.description: Name of the table that stored this record. Useful in union queries across multiple log tables to identify the source schema; it is constant for rows from this table.
Type.description_zh: 存储该记录的表的名称。在跨多个日志表的联合查询中可用于标识来源架构；对于本表的行，该值恒定。

UniqueTokenIdentifier.description: Unique identifier for the token request associated with this sign-in event. Use to correlate the authentication record with token issuance or downstream resource access activity, and to deduplicate related entries.
UniqueTokenIdentifier.description_zh: 与本次登录事件相关联的令牌请求的唯一标识符。可用于将该身份验证记录与令牌颁发或下游资源访问活动关联，并对相关条目去重。

AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs.description: Stores non-interactive Microsoft Entra ID user sign-in events, such as token refreshes, background service and client activity. Each row is one sign-in attempt with result, app, authentication, conditional access, device, and risk context. Use it to answer questions about silent or automated sign-ins, app access patterns, MFA and CA outcomes, and risky sign-ins. Pivot on UserPrincipalName, AppId, IPAddress, CorrelationId. Because rows are non-interactive only, interactive human sign-ins belong in the interactive sign-in table, not here.
AADNonInteractiveUserSignInLogs.description_zh: 存储非交互式 Microsoft Entra ID 用户登录事件，例如令牌刷新、后台服务和客户端活动。每行是一次登录尝试，包含结果、应用、身份验证、条件访问、设备和风险上下文。用于分析静默或自动化登录、应用访问模式、MFA 和条件访问结果以及风险登录。可基于 UserPrincipalName、AppId、IPAddress、CorrelationId 进行关联。由于仅包含非交互式行，人工交互式登录应查看交互式登录表，而非此表。

AlternateSignInName.description: Alternate sign-in identifier recorded for this non-interactive sign-in, often an on-premises UPN or phone number. Compare with UserPrincipalName to spot alternate-identity use or mismatched identity forms during investigation.
AlternateSignInName.description_zh: 此非交互式登录记录的备用登录标识，通常是本地 UPN 或电话号码。调查时与 UserPrincipalName 对比，可发现备用身份使用或身份形式不一致。

AppDisplayName.description: Human-readable name of the application or resource targeted by this non-interactive sign-in. Use it to see which apps generate silent token activity and to group unusual app access.
AppDisplayName.description_zh: 此非交互式登录所面向应用或资源的可读名称。用于查看哪些应用产生静默令牌活动，并对异常应用访问进行分组。

AppId.description: GUID of the application involved in this sign-in. Use it to pivot reliably across sign-ins, correlate with service principals, and group activity when display names are ambiguous or missing.
AppId.description_zh: 此登录所涉及应用的 GUID。当显示名称含糊或缺失时，可用其可靠地关联登录、与服务主体对应并对活动分组。

AppliedEventListeners.description: Name-derived structured data about authentication event listeners triggered during this sign-in. Interpretation is not fully documented; inspect it together with authentication details and the resource context rather than assuming fixed semantics.
AppliedEventListeners.description_zh: 名称推断的、关于此登录期间触发的身份验证事件监听器的结构化数据。其语义未完全文档化，应结合身份验证详情和资源上下文查看，勿假定固定含义。

AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description: Authentication context references applied to this non-interactive sign-in, tying it to conditional access authentication context definitions. Use to verify which protected-resource context governed the token request.
AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description_zh: 应用于此非交互式登录的身份验证上下文引用，关联条件访问身份验证上下文定义。用于核实哪一受保护资源上下文管理了该令牌请求。

AuthenticationDetails.description: Structured record of each authentication step performed for this non-interactive sign-in. Use it to see how the token was obtained and whether any interactive or MFA steps occurred unexpectedly.
AuthenticationDetails.description_zh: 此非交互式登录所执行每步身份验证的结构化记录。用于了解令牌如何获取，以及是否意外出现交互或 MFA 步骤。

AuthenticationMethodsUsed.description: Lists authentication methods used during this sign-in. Compare with AuthenticationRequirement to check whether required MFA or method constraints were satisfied for the non-interactive request.
AuthenticationMethodsUsed.description_zh: 列出此登录期间使用的身份验证方法。与 AuthenticationRequirement 对比，可检查该非交互式请求是否满足所需 MFA 或方法约束。

AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description: Details from the authentication processor handling this sign-in. Use as supporting evidence when a sign-in fails or shows unexpected handling, alongside ResultType and ResultDescription rather than alone.
AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description_zh: 处理此登录的身份验证处理器所提供的详情。当登录失败或出现异常处理时，作为 ResultType 和 ResultDescription 的辅助证据，而非单独依据。

AuthenticationProtocol.description: Protocol or grant type used in this non-interactive authentication. Use it to distinguish token flows, such as client-credential-like or resource-owner flows, when reviewing how automated sign-ins succeed or fail.
AuthenticationProtocol.description_zh: 此非交互式身份验证使用的协议或授权类型。审查自动化登录成功或失败方式时，用于区分令牌流，如客户端凭据类或资源所有者流。

AuthenticationRequirement.description: Indicates whether this sign-in required single-factor or multi-factor authentication. Use it to verify whether MFA was expected for a non-interactive request and whether that requirement was actually met.
AuthenticationRequirement.description_zh: 指示此登录要求单因素还是多因素身份验证。用于核实非交互式请求是否预期需要 MFA，以及该要求是否实际满足。

AuthenticationRequirementPolicies.description: Set of conditional access and per-user policies that imposed authentication requirements on this sign-in. Use to attribute an MFA or policy requirement to a specific policy name.
AuthenticationRequirementPolicies.description_zh: 对此登录施加身份验证要求的条件访问和每用户策略集合。用于将 MFA 或策略要求归因到具体策略名称。

AutonomousSystemNumber.description: Autonomous system number associated with the network of the client IP for this sign-in. Use with IPAddress to characterize source network and hosting or ISP origin during investigation.
AutonomousSystemNumber.description_zh: 与此登录客户端 IP 网络关联的自治系统号。调查时可与 IPAddress 结合，刻画来源网络及托管或 ISP 属性。

Category.description: Category of this non-interactive sign-in event within the Azure Monitor diagnostic stream. Use to scope queries and separate this activity class from other categories in the same workspace.
Category.description_zh: 此非交互式登录事件在 Azure Monitor 诊断流中的类别。用于限定查询范围，并区分同一工作区中的其他类别活动。

ClientAppUsed.description: Identifies the client application or auth style used for this non-interactive sign-in, such as modern versus legacy clients. Use to spot legacy or unusual client activity associated with automated access.
ClientAppUsed.description_zh: 标识此非交互式登录所用的客户端应用或身份验证方式，如新式与旧式客户端。用于发现与自动化访问相关的旧式或异常客户端活动。

ConditionalAccessPolicies.description: Details of conditional access policies applied to this sign-in, as recorded in this earlier-format field. Use to determine which policies evaluated the request, especially where V2 data is absent.
ConditionalAccessPolicies.description_zh: 此登录所应用条件访问策略的详情，记录于该较早格式字段中。用于确定评估了哪些策略，尤其在缺失 V2 数据时。

ConditionalAccessPoliciesV2.description: Name-derived newer structured conditional access policy data for this sign-in; exact schema is not fully documented. Inspect it with the sign-in and policy context rather than assuming fields.
ConditionalAccessPoliciesV2.description_zh: 名称推断的、此登录较新的结构化条件访问策略数据；确切结构未完全文档化。应结合登录和策略上下文查看，勿假定字段。

ConditionalAccessStatus.description: Overall outcome of conditional access evaluation for this sign-in, such as success, failure, or not applied. Use to quickly filter sign-ins blocked or challenged by policy.
ConditionalAccessStatus.description_zh: 此登录条件访问评估的总体结果，如成功、失败或未应用。用于快速筛选被策略阻止或质询的登录。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier used to trace this non-interactive sign-in across related activity and logs. Use to correlate sign-ins, app events, and downstream audit records during an investigation.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 用于跨相关活动和日志追踪此非交互式登录的标识符。调查时可关联登录、应用事件及下游审核记录。

CreatedDateTime.description: Timestamp when this non-interactive sign-in occurred, from the source event. Use for sequencing activity, correlating with other telemetry, and comparing against TimeGenerated for ingestion delay.
CreatedDateTime.description_zh: 此非交互式登录发生时的源事件时间戳。用于排列活动顺序、与其他遥测关联，并与 TimeGenerated 对比以判断摄取延迟。

CrossTenantAccessType.description: Describes whether and how this sign-in crossed tenant boundaries, such as B2B collaboration or direct connect. Use with home and resource tenant fields to analyze cross-tenant automated access.
CrossTenantAccessType.description_zh: 描述此登录是否及如何跨租户边界，如 B2B 协作或直连。可与本租户和资源租户字段结合，分析跨租户自动化访问。

DeviceDetail.description: Details about the device associated with this non-interactive sign-in. Because silent sign-ins often lack device context, treat populated values carefully and corroborate with device inventory sources.
DeviceDetail.description_zh: 与此非交互式登录关联的设备详情。由于静默登录常缺少设备上下文，应谨慎对待有值的记录，并与设备清单来源相互印证。

DurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds of the recorded sign-in operation for this event. Use as a performance signal when comparing operation timing across apps or users, not as an identity attribute.
DurationMs.description_zh: 此事件所记录登录操作的持续时间（毫秒）。用于比较应用或用户间的操作耗时，作为性能信号，而非身份属性。

HomeTenantId.description: Home tenant identifier for cross-tenant scenarios involving this non-interactive sign-in. Use with resource tenant fields to identify the user's originating tenant versus the accessed resource tenant.
HomeTenantId.description_zh: 涉及此非交互式登录的跨租户场景中的本租户标识符。可与资源租户字段结合，区分用户来源租户与所访问资源租户。

IPAddress.description: IP address of the client for this non-interactive sign-in. Use with AutonomousSystemNumber and location fields to assess source network, reuse, and anomalous origins.
IPAddress.description_zh: 此非交互式登录客户端的 IP 地址。可与 AutonomousSystemNumber 和位置字段结合，评估来源网络、重复使用及异常来源。

Id.description: Unique identifier assigned by Entra ID to this sign-in activity record; use it to reference or deduplicate an individual authentication event. Not an export row number, so do not join on it as a sequence counter.
Id.description_zh: Entra ID 为此登录活动记录分配的唯一标识符；用于引用或去重单个身份验证事件。它不是导出行号，因此不要将其作为序列计数器进行连接。

Identity.description: Identity string from the token presented when the log was generated; may represent a user account, system account, or service principal. Name-derived interpretation: inspect the token context rather than assuming a human user.
Identity.description_zh: 生成日志时提供的令牌中的身份字符串；可能代表用户账户、系统账户或服务主体。基于名称的推测：应检查令牌上下文，不要假定为人类用户。

IsInteractive.description: Boolean indicating whether this authentication was interactive; non-interactive records are relevant because they often represent background token acquisition rather than direct user action. Use it to separate silent flows from session activity.
IsInteractive.description_zh: 布尔值，指示此身份验证是否为交互式；非交互式记录很重要，因为它们通常代表后台令牌获取而不是直接用户操作。用它来区分静默流与会话活动。

IsRisky.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Entra ID assessed this sign-in as risky at the time of the event. A true value is detection evidence, not proof of compromise; corroborate with risk detail and additional logs.
IsRisky.description_zh: 布尔标记，指示 Entra ID 在事件发生时是否将此登录评估为有风险。true 是检测证据，并非入侵证明；需结合风险详情和其他日志佐证。

Level.description: Severity level assigned to the log record itself, useful for filtering noisy or high-severity entries during triage. Interpret alongside ResultType rather than as a definitive authentication outcome.
Level.description_zh: 分配给日志记录本身的严重性级别，用于在分类过程中过滤噪声或高严重性条目。应结合 ResultType 解释，而不是将其视为确定性的身份验证结果。

Location.description: Region of the resource that emitted the log entry, typically the workspace region. It is not the user's physical sign-in location; use LocationDetails for that purpose.
Location.description_zh: 发出日志条目的资源区域，通常是工作区区域。它不是用户的实际登录位置；请使用 LocationDetails 获取该信息。

LocationDetails.description: Structured details about the sign-in location, such as city, country, and geo-coordinates derived from the client IP. Name-derived interpretation: inspect its category/resource context before asserting specific subfields.
LocationDetails.description_zh: 关于登录位置的结构化详情，例如从客户端 IP 推导出的城市、国家和地理坐标。基于名称的推测：在断言具体子字段之前，请检查其类别/资源上下文。

MfaDetail.description: Details about multi-factor authentication performed for this sign-in, if any. Use it to determine whether MFA succeeded, which method was used, and to support investigations of authentication strength or bypass.
MfaDetail.description_zh: 有关此登录执行的多重身份验证的详细信息（如有）。用于确定 MFA 是否成功、使用了哪种方法，并支持身份验证强度或绕过的调查。

NetworkLocationDetails.description: Provides details associated with the authentication processor for this sign-in, which can help distinguish network or processor context. Interpretation is name-derived; inspect resource and category fields before relying on specific values.
NetworkLocationDetails.description_zh: 提供与此登录身份验证处理器相关的详细信息，有助于区分网络或处理器上下文。解释基于名称推测；在依赖具体值之前，请检查资源和类别字段。

OperationName.description: Operation associated with the log record; for sign-in entries this is expected to be a sign-in activity value. Use it to filter sign-in events within this table and to scope other operation types.
OperationName.description_zh: 与日志记录关联的操作；对于登录条目，预期为登录活动值。用于筛选此表中的登录事件，并限定其他操作类型的范围。

OperationVersion.description: REST API version requested by the client for this authentication, indicating protocol version used. Useful for compatibility and baseline checks but not an authentication outcome by itself.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 客户端为此身份验证请求的 REST API 版本，指示所用协议版本。可用于兼容性和基线检查，但本身不是身份验证结果。

OriginalRequestId.description: Request ID of the first request in the authentication sequence, enabling chaining of related sign-in steps across the same flow. Use it to group events that belong to one logical authentication attempt.
OriginalRequestId.description_zh: 身份验证序列中第一个请求的请求 ID，可串联同一流程中相关的登录步骤。用它来分组属于同一次逻辑身份验证尝试的事件。

ProcessingTimeInMs.description: Request processing time in milliseconds within the authentication service, reported as a string. Use for performance or anomaly analysis; convert carefully and scope by resource and time.
ProcessingTimeInMs.description_zh: 身份验证服务内请求处理时间（毫秒），以字符串形式报告。用于性能或异常分析；需谨慎转换，并按资源和时间限定范围。

ResourceDisplayName.description: Friendly name of the resource or service the user signed into, such as an application or API. Use it to map which downstream systems were accessed during non-interactive authentication.
ResourceDisplayName.description_zh: 用户登录的资源或服务的友好名称，例如应用程序或 API。用于映射非交互式身份验证期间访问了哪些下游系统。

ResourceGroup.description: Resource group associated with the logs, reflecting the Azure Monitor ingestion context rather than the sign-in target. Use for scoping queries by workspace deployment but not for identity investigation.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 与日志关联的资源组，反映 Azure Monitor 摄取上下文而非登录目标。用于按工作区部署限定查询范围，不用于身份调查。

ResourceIdentity.description: Identifier of the resource that the user signed into, typically the service principal or application ID of the target. Use it to correlate sign-ins to a specific protected resource in investigations.
ResourceIdentity.description_zh: 用户登录的资源的标识符，通常是目标的服务主体或应用程序 ID。用于在调查中将登录与特定受保护资源关联。

ResourceServicePrincipalId.description: Service principal ID of the resource being accessed, identifying the application or service in Entra ID. Use it to pivot to service principal configuration, permissions, and related sign-ins.
ResourceServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 被访问资源的服务主体 ID，在 Entra ID 中标识应用程序或服务。用于透视到服务主体配置、权限及相关登录。

ResourceTenantId.description: Tenant ID of the resource for cross-tenant scenarios, distinct from the home tenant. Use it to detect and investigate cross-tenant access in non-interactive authentication flows.
ResourceTenantId.description_zh: 跨租户场景中资源的租户 ID，与本地租户不同。用于检测和调查非交互式身份验证流中的跨租户访问。

ResultDescription.description: Human-readable description of the sign-in result, including error explanations when authentication fails. Use it to triage causes of failures and to differentiate policy blocks from credential issues.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 登录结果的人类可读描述，包括身份验证失败时的错误说明。用于分类失败原因，并区分策略阻止与凭据问题。

ResultSignature.description: Contains the error code for the sign-in operation, if any, providing a concise status signal. Use it for filtering or grouping failures by error type across authentication attempts.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 包含登录操作的错误代码（如有），提供简洁的状态信号。用于按错误类型筛选或分组身份验证尝试中的失败。

ResultType.description: Overall result of the sign-in operation, typically Success or Failure. Use it as the primary outcome filter when hunting for failed non-interactive authentications or verifying successful token issuance.
ResultType.description_zh: 登录操作的整体结果，通常为 Success 或 Failure。在搜寻失败的非交互式身份验证或验证令牌成功签发时，将其用作主要结果筛选条件。

RiskDetail.description: Provides details about the risky user state associated with this sign-in, explaining why risk was assigned or remediated. Use with risk level and state fields; risk evidence alone does not prove compromise.
RiskDetail.description_zh: 提供与此登录相关的风险用户状态的详细信息，解释为何分配或修正风险。与风险级别和状态字段一起使用；仅风险证据不能证明入侵。

RiskEventTypes.description: List of risk event types associated with the sign-in, as legacy string representation. Use it to identify which detections fired; treat as detection telemetry, not confirmed compromise.
RiskEventTypes.description_zh: 与此登录关联的风险事件类型列表，采用旧版字符串表示。用于识别触发了哪些检测；应将其视为检测遥测，而非确认的入侵。

RiskEventTypes_V2.description: List of risk event types associated with the sign-in in the updated string format. Use it alongside RiskEventTypes when correlating detections; prefer this version where populated.
RiskEventTypes_V2.description_zh: 采用更新字符串格式的与此登录关联的风险事件类型列表。在关联检测时与 RiskEventTypes 一起使用；在有值时应优先使用此版本。

RiskLevelAggregated.description: Aggregated Microsoft Entra ID Protection risk level attributed to this non-interactive sign-in or user. Elevated values warrant checking RiskDetail, RiskState and related sign-ins before concluding compromise.
RiskLevelAggregated.description_zh: Microsoft Entra ID Protection 归因于该非交互式登录或用户的聚合风险级别。值升高时，应在断定遭到入侵前检查 RiskDetail、RiskState 及相关登录。

RiskLevelDuringSignIn.description: Risk level evaluated at the moment of this non-interactive sign-in. Compare with RiskLevelAggregated to see whether risk was known real-time or only found later.
RiskLevelDuringSignIn.description_zh: 该非交互式登录发生当下评估的风险级别。与 RiskLevelAggregated 对比，可判断风险是实时发现的还是事后才检测到的。

RiskState.description: Risk detection state for the user or sign-in, such as whether risk was remediated, dismissed or still present. Use with the risk level and detail fields to judge outstanding exposure.
RiskState.description_zh: 用户或此登录的风险检测状态，例如风险已修正、已忽略还是仍然存在。与风险级别和详情字段结合使用，判断尚未处置的暴露。

ServicePrincipalId.description: Identifier of the service principal that initiated this sign-in, when the initiating identity is an application rather than a user. Use it to attribute non-interactive authentication to a specific workload or app registration.
ServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 当发起身份是应用而非用户时，此登录由该服务主体发起。用它将非交互式身份验证归因于特定的工作负载或应用注册。

SessionLifetimePolicies.description: Session lifetime policies and settings that applied to this sign-in, governing token/session duration or revocation. Useful when explaining unusually long-lived or forcibly terminated sessions seen in investigations.
SessionLifetimePolicies.description_zh: 应用于此登录的会话生存期策略与设置，决定令牌/会话时长或吊销。用于解释调查中出现的异常长寿命或被强制终止的会话。

SignInEventTypes.description: Types associated with this non-interactive sign-in, such as refresh token or managed identity flows. Helps place the event in the authentication lifecycle and distinguish token refreshes from other sign-in forms.
SignInEventTypes.description_zh: 与此非交互式登录关联的类型，例如刷新令牌或托管标识流。有助于将事件定位到身份验证生命周期中，并区分令牌刷新与其他登录形式。

SignInIdentifierType.description: Category of the sign-in identifier used, such as user principal name or phone number (name-derived; confirm against category context). Indicates which identifier form was presented during authentication.
SignInIdentifierType.description_zh: 所用登录标识符的类别，例如用户主体名称或电话号码（依据名称推断，需结合类别上下文确认）。指示身份验证时提交的是哪种标识符形式。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or pipeline that collected this row, for example Azure diagnostics or a Windows agent. Useful for confirming ingestion path and scoping queries when data arrives from multiple collectors.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集此行的代理或管道，例如 Azure 诊断或 Windows 代理。在数据来自多个收集器时，用于确认引入路径并限定查询范围。

Status.description: Details of the sign-in outcome for this event, typically including an error code when authentication failed. Central for separating successful token acquisition from blocked or failed attempts.
Status.description_zh: 此事件的登录结果详情，身份验证失败时通常包含错误代码。是区分成功获取令牌与被阻止或失败尝试的关键字段。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier that stores this sign-in record, not a directory tenant ID. Use it to scope queries across workspaces when correlating the same identity elsewhere.
TenantId.description_zh: 存储该登录记录的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符，并非目录租户 ID。在工作区之间关联同一身份时，用它限定查询范围。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when this non-interactive sign-in event was generated and ingested. Primary axis for time-windowing, sequencing and correlating with other telemetry around the attempt.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 此非交互式登录事件生成并引入的 UTC 日期时间。是按时间窗口筛选、排序以及与该尝试前后其他遥测关联的主要轴。

TokenIssuerName.description: Name of the identity provider that issued the token in this sign-in, such as a Microsoft security token service. Use it to confirm which authority authenticated the request.
TokenIssuerName.description_zh: 在此登录中签发令牌的身份提供程序名称，例如 Microsoft 安全令牌服务。用其确认是哪个颁发机构完成了该请求的身份验证。

TokenIssuerType.description: Type of identity provider backing this non-interactive sign-in, such as cloud directory or federation service. Helps detect unexpected federation paths for a given user or app.
TokenIssuerType.description_zh: 支持此非交互式登录的身份提供程序类型，例如云目录或联合身份验证服务。用于检测特定用户或应用出现意外联合路径的情况。

Type.description: Name of the table that supplied this row. Useful in cross-table union queries to keep non-interactive sign-in events separable from other log sources.
Type.description_zh: 提供此行的表名。在跨表联合查询中，用于将非交互式登录事件与其他日志源区分开。

UniqueTokenIdentifier.description: Identifier uniquely associated with the token in this request. Use it to correlate token issuance or reuse across related sign-ins and diagnose suspicious token replay.
UniqueTokenIdentifier.description_zh: 与此请求中令牌唯一关联的标识符。用于关联相关登录之间的令牌签发或重用，并诊断可疑的令牌重放。

UserAgent.description: Client user agent string presented during this non-interactive sign-in. Helps fingerprint the client library, script or tooling acquiring tokens, including anomalous or legacy clients.
UserAgent.description_zh: 此非交互式登录中呈现的客户端用户代理字符串。有助于刻画获取令牌的客户端库、脚本或工具，包括异常或旧版客户端。

UserDisplayName.description: Display name of the user whose sign-in this row records. Convenient for readable reporting, but prefer UserId or UserPrincipalName for reliable joins and pivots.
UserDisplayName.description_zh: 该行记录其登录的用户的显示名称。便于可读的报告，但可靠关联和透视应优先使用 UserId 或 UserPrincipalName。

UserId.description: Object identifier of the user that initiated this non-interactive sign-in. Stable key for joining to directory objects and correlating this identity's activity across logs.
UserId.description_zh: 发起此非交互式登录的用户的 object identifier。是加入目录对象并跨日志关联该身份活动的稳定键值。

UserPrincipalName.description: User principal name of the identity that initiated this non-interactive sign-in. Primary human-readable pivot for grouping a user's token activity across apps and IPs.
UserPrincipalName.description_zh: 发起此非交互式登录的身份的用户主体名称。是按用户跨应用和 IP 分组其令牌活动的主要可读透视字段。

UserType.description: Whether the sign-in identity is a member or guest in the tenant (with an unknown future value possibility). Guest sign-ins into sensitive resources deserve additional scrutiny.
UserType.description_zh: 登录身份在租户中是成员还是来宾（可能存在未知的将来值）。来宾登录敏感资源应受到额外审查。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

AADProvisioningLogs.description: Identity provisioning operations between source and target systems, including affected identities, modified properties, processing steps and results. Use it to explain account synchronization or provisioning failures and determine what changed for a target identity. Pivot on JobId, CycleId, ChangeId and CorrelationId. Unlike AuditLogs, it focuses on provisioning workflows rather than general directory administration; it does not describe user sign-ins.
AADProvisioningLogs.description_zh: 记录源系统与目标系统之间的身份预配操作，包括相关身份、属性修改、处理步骤和结果。用于调查账户同步、预配失败，以及目标身份发生了什么变化；可通过 JobId、CycleId、ChangeId 和 CorrelationId 串联。与通用目录管理审计 AuditLogs 相比，本表聚焦身份预配流程，不记录用户登录过程。

AADTenantId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure AD tenant whose provisioning activity produced this row. Use it to scope investigations to one directory tenant and separate activity from other tenants or workspaces.
AADTenantId.description_zh: 产生此行预配活动的 Azure AD 租户的唯一标识符。用于将调查限定到单个目录租户，并区分其他租户或工作区的活动。

Action.description: Name-derived field not documented for this table. Treat as a provisioning action label; inspect the row's OperationName, ProvisioningAction, and Category context before relying on it for filtering.
Action.description_zh: 该字段无官方说明，解释基于名称。可视为预配操作标签；在用于筛选前，请检查该行的 OperationName、ProvisioningAction 和 Category 上下文。

Category.description: Event category for this provisioning row, indicating the type of provisioning activity logged. Use it to filter or group the heterogeneous stream before analyzing results.
Category.description_zh: 此预配行的事件类别，指示记录的预配活动类型。用于在分析结果前筛选或分组异构流。

ChangeId.description: Unique identifier of this change within the provisioning cycle. Use together with CycleId and JobId to drill into the exact change and correlate related provisioning steps.
ChangeId.description_zh: 此变更在预配周期内的唯一标识符。与 CycleId 和 JobId 一起使用，可深入查看具体变更并关联相关预配步骤。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier that ties related provisioning events into a trail. Use it to reconstruct the sequence of operations for one provisioning flow across source and target systems.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 将相关预配事件串联成轨迹的标识符。用于重建一个预配流在源系统和目标系统上的操作顺序。

CycleId.description: Unique identifier for one iteration of a provisioning job. Use with JobId to examine repeat runs, distinguish cycles, and compare outcomes across iterations.
CycleId.description_zh: 预配作业一次迭代的唯一标识符。与 JobId 一起使用，可检查重复运行、区分周期并比较不同迭代的结果。

DurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds of this provisioning action. Use to find slow or stalled provisioning operations and compare performance across jobs, cycles, or target systems.
DurationMs.description_zh: 此预配操作的持续时间（毫秒）。用于查找缓慢或停滞的预配操作，并比较不同作业、周期或目标系统的性能。

Id.description: Unique identifier for this provisioning activity record. Use it to reference or deduplicate individual rows when correlating with other log sources.
Id.description_zh: 此预配活动记录的唯一标识符。在与其他日志源关联时，用于引用或去重单个行。

InitiatedBy.description: Details of who or what initiated this provisioning operation. Parse it to attribute provisioning activity to a user, application, or service principal, and to distinguish automatic sync from manual action.
InitiatedBy.description_zh: 发起此预配操作的人员或主体的详细信息。解析它以将预配活动归因于用户、应用程序或服务主体，并区分自动同步与手动操作。

JobId.description: Unique identifier for the overall provisioning job. Use it to group all changes and cycles belonging to one synchronization job and to follow the job's outcome over time.
JobId.description_zh: 整个预配作业的唯一标识符。用于将属于同一同步作业的所有变更和周期分组，并跟踪该作业随时间的结果。

ModifiedProperties.description: Details of each property changed by this provisioning action on the affected object. Use it to identify what attribute was updated and to detect unexpected or sensitive modifications.
ModifiedProperties.description_zh: 此预配操作对受影响对象更改的每个属性的详细信息。用于识别更新了哪个属性并检测意外或敏感修改。

OperationName.description: Name of the provisioning operation recorded for this row. Use it to classify operations, filter by action type, and compare behavior across provisioning runs.
OperationName.description_zh: 为此行记录的预配操作名称。用于对操作分类、按操作类型筛选，并比较不同预配运行的行为。

OperationVersion.description: REST API version requested by the client for this provisioning operation. Use it to identify client API versions involved and to diagnose version-related failures.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 客户端为此预配操作请求的 REST API 版本。用于识别涉及的客户端 API 版本并诊断与版本相关的故障。

ProvisioningAction.description: Activity or operation name for this provisioning step. Use it to identify the specific action performed, such as creating, updating, or deleting an object, when analyzing outcomes.
ProvisioningAction.description_zh: 此预配步骤的活动或操作名称。用于在分析结果时识别执行的具体操作，例如创建、更新或删除对象。

ProvisioningStatusInfo.description: Details of the provisioning status for this action. Use it to enrich success or failure analysis and understand why a provisioning operation reached its result.
ProvisioningStatusInfo.description_zh: 此操作预配状态的详细信息。用于丰富成功或失败分析，并理解预配操作为何达到该结果。

ProvisioningSteps.description: Details of each step performed during this provisioning action. Use it to trace granular progress and locate the exact stage where an operation failed or stalled.
ProvisioningSteps.description_zh: 此预配操作期间执行的每个步骤的详细信息。用于跟踪细粒度进度并定位操作失败或停滞的确切阶段。

ResultDescription.description: Error description for the provisioning operation when available. Use it to understand failures in detail and to search for recurring error messages across jobs or targets.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 预配操作可用时的错误描述。用于详细了解失败原因，并在不同作业或目标中搜索重复出现的错误消息。

ResultSignature.description: Error code, if any, returned by the provisioning operation. Use it to classify failures, group similar errors, and compare error patterns across cycles or target systems.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 预配操作返回的错误代码（如有）。用于对故障分类、归并类似错误，并比较不同周期或目标系统的错误模式。

ResultType.description: Result of the provisioning operation, such as Success, Failure, or Skipped. Use it to filter outcomes, measure failure rates, and identify skipped provisioning activity worth review.
ResultType.description_zh: 预配操作的结果，例如 Success、Failure 或 Skipped。用于筛选结果、衡量失败率，并识别值得审查的已跳过预配活动。

ServicePrincipal.description: Service principal used for this provisioning operation. Use it to attribute activity to the provisioning connector or application identity acting on the target system.
ServicePrincipal.description_zh: 用于此预配操作的服务主体。用于将活动归因于在目标系统上操作的预配连接器或应用程序身份。

SourceIdentity.description: Details of the source object being provisioned in this operation. Use it to identify which user, group, or object was read from the source system and to trace its provisioning history.
SourceIdentity.description_zh: 此操作中正在预配的源对象的详细信息。用于识别从源系统读取的用户、组或对象，并追溯其预配历史。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent that collected the event, for example OpsManager, Linux, or Azure. Use it to distinguish collection pipelines and filter rows by originating monitoring system.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集事件的代理类型，例如 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure。用于区分收集管道并按来源监控系统筛选行。

StatusInfo.description: Name-derived field without official description. Treat as additional provisioning status detail; inspect alongside ResultType, ResultSignature, and ProvisioningStatusInfo before drawing conclusions.
StatusInfo.description_zh: 无官方说明、解释基于名称的字段。可视为额外的预配状态详细信息；在得出结论前，请与 ResultType、ResultSignature 和 ProvisioningStatusInfo 一起检查。

TargetIdentity.description: Details of the target object being provisioned in this operation. Use it to identify which user, group, or object was written to the target system and to verify propagation.
TargetIdentity.description_zh: 此操作中正在预配的目标对象的详细信息。用于识别写入目标系统的用户、组或对象，并验证传播情况。

TargetSystem.description: Identifies the destination system or application receiving the provisioned object, such as a SaaS app or directory. Use with TargetIdentity to scope which connector target an action affected and to compare failures across targets.
TargetSystem.description_zh: 标识接收预配对象的目标系统或应用（如 SaaS 应用或目录）。可与 TargetIdentity 搭配，限定操作影响的连接器目标，并比较不同目标的失败情况。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID hosting this record. Use it to scope queries to a workspace; it is not the directory tenant identifier, which appears separately as AADTenantId.
TenantId.description_zh: 承载此记录的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。用于将查询限定到某个工作区；它并非目录租户标识，目录租户另由 AADTenantId 表示。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when the provisioning event was logged. Use for time-window filtering, ordering steps within a cycle, and correlating provisioning activity with related sign-in or audit events.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 预配事件记录的 UTC 日期和时间。可用于时间范围过滤、对同一周期内的步骤排序，以及将预配活动与相关登录或审核事件关联。

Type.description: Name of the table supplying the record; here it identifies AADProvisioningLogs rows. Use to filter or union this provisioning data with other Azure Monitor tables.
Type.description_zh: 提供该记录的表的名称；此处标识 AADProvisioningLogs 的行。用于筛选或将此预配数据与其它 Azure Monitor 表联合查询。

AADRiskyUsers.description: User-level Identity Protection risk assessments and their recorded updates. Use it to identify accounts with elevated risk, inspect RiskLevel, RiskState and RiskDetail, and follow changes using RiskLastUpdatedDateTime and TimeGenerated. Pivot on Id or UserPrincipalName. These are recorded account risk states, not proof of compromise or a complete login history; use AADUserRiskEvents for individual detections and SigninLogs for user sign-ins.
AADRiskyUsers.description_zh: 记录 Identity Protection 对用户账户的风险评估及其更新。用于筛选高风险账户，查看 RiskLevel、RiskState、RiskDetail，并按 RiskLastUpdatedDateTime 和 TimeGenerated 跟踪变化；可按 Id 或 UserPrincipalName 关联。这里是日志记录时的账户风险状态，不能单独证明失陷，也不是完整登录历史；具体风险检测查 AADUserRiskEvents，用户登录查 SigninLogs。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier linking this risky-user record to related Log Analytics events across tables. Use it to correlate the risk state with sign-in or audit activity that may explain how the risk arose.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 用于将本条风险用户记录与其他表中的 Log Analytics 事件关联的标识符。可用它把风险状态与可能解释风险来源的登录或审计活动关联起来。

Id.description: Unique identifier of the risky user object as reported by Identity Protection, typically the directory object ID. Use it to join to other identity tables or to track the same account across updates.
Id.description_zh: Identity Protection 所报告的该风险用户对象的唯一标识符，通常是目录对象 ID。可用它与其他身份表关联，或跨多次更新追踪同一账户。

IsDeleted.description: Whether the risky user account is marked deleted in the directory. A true value means the risk record may refer to a removed account, so verify account status before acting on the risk.
IsDeleted.description_zh: 该风险用户账户是否在目录中被标记为已删除。为 true 表示风险记录可能指向已移除账户，处置风险前应先确认账户状态。

IsProcessing.description: Whether the backend is still processing this user's risky state. When true, the risk level or state may change shortly, so treat the current values as provisional.
IsProcessing.description_zh: 后端是否仍在处理该用户的风险状态。为 true 时风险级别或状态可能即将变化，因此当前取值应视为暂定。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation that produced or updated this risky-user record, as supplied by the source. Use it to distinguish record-producing actions; inspect the source context to interpret service-specific values.
OperationName.description_zh: 产生或更新本条风险用户记录的操作名称，由来源提供。可用它区分不同记录产生动作；具体取值需结合来源上下文解读。

RiskDetail.description: Detail explaining the detected risk or its resolution for this user, such as admin-confirmed compromise or a password change. Use it to understand why the risk level and state currently stand.
RiskDetail.description_zh: 说明该用户风险检测或处置情况的细节，例如管理员确认已入侵或用户已修改密码。可用它理解当前风险级别与状态的成因。

RiskLastUpdatedDateTime.description: UTC timestamp when the risky-user record was last updated by the identity protection service. Compare with TimeGenerated to see how fresh the risk assessment is for this account.
RiskLastUpdatedDateTime.description_zh: 身份保护服务最后一次更新该风险用户记录的 UTC 时间戳。可与 TimeGenerated 比较，判断该账户风险评估的新鲜程度。

RiskLevel.description: Severity level of the detected risk for this user, such as low, medium, or high. Use it to prioritize accounts for investigation, remembering that a level alone does not prove compromise.
RiskLevel.description_zh: 该用户被检测到的风险严重级别，如 low、medium 或 high。可用它确定账户调查优先级，但仅凭级别不能证明已遭入侵。

RiskState.description: Current state of the user's risk, for example atRisk, remediated, dismissed, or confirmedCompromised. Use it to find accounts needing action versus those already resolved by an admin or user.
RiskState.description_zh: 该用户风险的当前状态，例如 atRisk、remediated、dismissed 或 confirmedCompromised。可用它区分需要处置的账户与已被管理员或用户解决的账户。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection system that delivered this record into Log Analytics. Use it to confirm ingestion path and filter records when multiple sources write to the same workspace.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 将该记录送入 Log Analytics 的代理或采集系统。可用它确认采集路径，并在多个来源写入同一工作区时过滤记录。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this record, per the documented schema. It identifies the workspace, not the directory tenant, so do not treat it as a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档架构，这是与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。它标识工作区而非目录租户，因此不应将其视为目录租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the record was generated into the workspace. Use it for time-window filtering and to order risk-state changes relative to other identity events.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该记录生成进入工作区的 UTC 时间戳。可用它做时间窗口过滤，并相对其他身份事件排序风险状态变化。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, useful in unions or when confirming which dataset produced a row. It is constant for these risky-user records.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属表的名称，在联合查询或确认某行来自哪个数据集时有用。对于这些风险用户记录，该值为常量。

UserDisplayName.description: Display name of the risky user account. Use it alongside the principal name to help analysts recognize the account, but verify because display names are not unique.
UserDisplayName.description_zh: 该风险用户账户的显示名称。可与用户主体名称一起帮助分析人员识别账户，但显示名称并不唯一，应加以核实。

UserPrincipalName.description: User principal name (sign-in identifier) of the risky account. Use it to pivot to sign-in, audit, or other identity tables for the same account.
UserPrincipalName.description_zh: 该风险账户的用户主体名称（登录标识符）。可用它关联到同一账户的登录、审计或其他身份表。

AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs.description: Microsoft Entra application service-principal authentication records. Use it to investigate non-user application access, credential or federated-credential identifiers, target resources, source IPs and sign-in outcomes. Pivot on ServicePrincipalId, AppId, ResourceServicePrincipalId, CorrelationId and TimeGenerated. Managed-identity sign-ins have the separate AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs table; these records describe authentication, not the subsequent application operations.
AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Entra 应用服务主体的身份验证。用于调查非用户应用访问、凭据或联合凭据标识、目标资源、来源 IP 和登录结果；可通过 ServicePrincipalId、AppId、ResourceServicePrincipalId、CorrelationId 和 TimeGenerated 关联。托管标识登录另查 AADManagedIdentitySignInLogs；本表反映身份验证，不直接记录应用登录后的具体操作。

AppId.description: GUID of the application whose service principal is signing in. Identifies which workload's identity attempted this resource sign-in. Use to group many sign-in rows to one app and to link to app registration or enterprise app context.
AppId.description_zh: 正在登录的服务主体所属应用程序的 GUID。用于确定哪个工作负载的标识尝试了此次资源登录。可用于将多条登录记录归组到同一应用，并与应用注册或企业应用上下文关联。

AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description: Authentication context values required for and satisfied by this service principal sign-in. Use to check whether a sensitive resource enforced a higher authentication context and whether the workload met it.
AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录所要求并满足的身份验证上下文值。用于检查敏感资源是否强制要求了更高等级的身份验证上下文，以及该工作负载是否满足该要求。

AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description: Details about how authentication was processed for this sign-in, such as credential type or policy evaluation notes. Use to understand why a service principal sign-in succeeded or failed at the authentication stage.
AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description_zh: 关于此次登录如何进行身份验证处理的详细信息，例如凭据类型或策略评估备注。用于理解服务主体登录在身份验证阶段成功或失败的原因。

Category.description: Sign-in event category for this service principal record, distinguishing non-interactive types. Use to scope the table before querying, since not every column is populated for every category.
Category.description_zh: 此服务主体记录的登录事件类别，用于区分非交互式类型。使用前应先按类别限定范围，因为并非每个类别都会填充所有列。

ConditionalAccessPolicies.description: Details of conditional access policies evaluated for this service principal sign-in. Use to see which policies applied and their outcome when investigating whether a workload sign-in was blocked or allowed.
ConditionalAccessPolicies.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录所评估的条件访问策略详情。用于在调查工作负载登录是否被阻止或允许时，查看应用了哪些策略及其结果。

ConditionalAccessPoliciesV2.description: Structured dynamic representation of conditional access policies applied to this sign-in. Name-derived interpretation; inspect actual dynamic content per row, as shape may vary and is not documented here. Use for detailed policy outcome analysis.
ConditionalAccessPoliciesV2.description_zh: 应用于此次登录的条件访问策略的结构化动态表示。该解释基于列名推断；需逐行检查实际动态内容，其结构可能不同且此处无文档说明。用于详细分析策略结果。

ConditionalAccessStatus.description: Overall status of conditional access policies for this service principal sign-in, such as success, failure, or not applied. Use to quickly filter sign-ins blocked or challenged by policy rather than by credential errors.
ConditionalAccessStatus.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录的条件访问策略总体状态，例如成功、失败或未应用。用于快速筛选被策略阻止或质询、而非因凭据错误而失败的登录。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier linking this sign-in to related sign-in and audit events across the tenant. Use to build a trail from a service principal sign-in to downstream resource access or configuration changes.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 将此登录与租户内相关登录和审核事件关联的标识符。用于从服务主体登录追溯到下游资源访问或配置更改的完整链条。

DurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds of this sign-in operation for the service principal. Use to detect unusually slow authentication or token issuance that may indicate throttling, latency, or abnormal backend behavior.
DurationMs.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录操作的持续时间，以毫秒为单位。用于检测可能表明限流、延迟或后端异常行为的异常缓慢的身份验证或令牌颁发。

FederatedCredentialId.description: Identifier of the application federated identity credential used if this sign-in relied on workload identity federation. Use to confirm which federated credential authenticated and to investigate misconfigured or suspicious federation.
FederatedCredentialId.description_zh: 若此次登录使用了工作负载标识联合，则表示所用应用程序联合标识凭据的标识符。用于确认哪个联合凭据完成了身份验证，并调查配置错误或可疑的联合。

IPAddress.description: Client IP address from which this service principal sign-in originated. Use to detect unexpected source networks for a workload, compare against known egress ranges, and correlate with other sign-ins from the same address.
IPAddress.description_zh: 发起此次服务主体登录的客户端 IP 地址。用于检测工作负载出现意外来源网络、与已知出站范围进行比较，以及关联来自同一地址的其他登录。

Id.description: Unique identifier for this specific service principal sign-in activity record. Use to deduplicate or directly reference one sign-in row when correlating with other tables or reporting.
Id.description_zh: 此特定服务主体登录活动记录的唯一标识符。用于在与其他表关联或报告时去重或直接引用单条登录记录。

Identity.description: Identity from the token presented when this sign-in record was generated, which may be a user account, system account, or service principal. Use to understand the caller context behind the logged event.
Identity.description_zh: 生成此登录记录时所呈现令牌中的标识，可能是用户账户、系统账户或服务主体。用于理解所记录事件背后的调用方上下文。

Level.description: Severity level associated with this service principal sign-in event. Use to prioritize triage among many rows, focusing on higher-severity entries when investigating authentication anomalies.
Level.description_zh: 与此服务主体登录事件关联的严重性级别。用于在大量记录中确定排查优先级，调查身份验证异常时重点关注较高严重性的条目。

Location.description: Azure region of the resource emitting this service principal sign-in log record. Use for geographic scoping and to distinguish where log data was produced from where the sign-in client was located.
Location.description_zh: 发出此服务主体登录日志记录的资源所在的 Azure 区域。用于地理范围限定，并区分日志数据产生位置与登录客户端所在位置。

LocationDetails.description: Details about the sign-in location derived for this service principal sign-in, typically including city, country, or geo coordinates. Use to assess anomalous geography and compare against expected workload regions.
LocationDetails.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录所解析出的登录位置详情，通常包括城市、国家或地理坐标。用于评估地理位置异常，并与预期工作负载区域进行比较。

OperationName.description: Operation recorded for this service principal sign-in row; for sign-ins this is documented as Sign-in activity. Use as a filter to isolate sign-in activity records from other operation types in the table.
OperationName.description_zh: 此服务主体登录记录所记录的操作；对于登录，文档说明其值为 Sign-in activity。可用作筛选条件，从表中的其他操作类型中隔离出登录活动记录。

OperationVersion.description: REST API version requested by the client during this service principal sign-in. Use to identify outdated clients or protocol versions that may correlate with failures or security policy gaps.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录期间客户端请求的 REST API 版本。用于识别可能与故障或安全策略缺口相关的过时客户端或协议版本。

ResourceDisplayName.description: Display name of the resource that the service principal signed into for this event. Use to identify the target service or API a workload accessed and to pivot across sign-ins to the same resource.
ResourceDisplayName.description_zh: 此事件中服务主体登录的目标资源的显示名称。用于识别工作负载访问的目标服务或 API，并在针对同一资源的多条登录记录间进行关联。

ResourceGroup.description: Resource group associated with the logs for this service principal sign-in record. Use for Azure resource scoping and to filter sign-in data to a particular deployment or workload boundary.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 与此服务主体登录记录的日志关联的资源组。用于 Azure 资源范围限定，并将登录数据筛选到特定部署或工作负载边界。

ResourceIdentity.description: Identifier of the resource that the service principal signed into. Use to precisely reference the target resource in queries and to join with resource inventory or configuration data.
ResourceIdentity.description_zh: 服务主体所登录目标资源的标识符。用于在查询中精确引用目标资源，并与资源清单或配置数据关联。

ResourceServicePrincipalId.description: Service principal ID of the resource that was signed into. Use to distinguish the resource-side identity from the calling service principal and to investigate access to specific target applications.
ResourceServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 被登录目标资源的服务主体 ID。用于区分资源侧标识与调用方服务主体，并调查对特定目标应用程序的访问。

ResultDescription.description: Error description for this service principal sign-in operation when it did not succeed. Use to understand failure reasons such as invalid credentials, blocked policy, or expired secret.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录操作未成功时的错误描述。用于理解失败原因，例如凭据无效、策略阻止或机密过期。

ResultSignature.description: Error code, if any, for this service principal sign-in operation. Use to group and filter failures by specific error code and to compare against known authentication error patterns.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 此次服务主体登录操作的错误代码（如有）。用于按特定错误代码对失败进行分组和筛选，并与已知身份验证错误模式进行比较。

ResultType.description: Outcome code of this service principal token request, typically Success or Failure. Filter on it to isolate failed workload authentications for triage.
ResultType.description_zh: 本次服务主体令牌请求的结果代码，通常为成功或失败。可用它筛出失败的工作负载身份验证以便排查。

ServicePrincipalCredentialKeyId.description: Key ID of the credential the initiating service principal used for this sign-in. Track it to see which app credential was exercised, rotated, or reused across events.
ServicePrincipalCredentialKeyId.description_zh: 发起登录的服务主体所用凭据的密钥 ID。可据此判断是哪个应用凭据被使用、轮换或在多个事件中复用。

ServicePrincipalCredentialThumbprint.description: Certificate thumbprint of the credential presented by the initiating service principal in this sign-in. Pair with key ID to identify the exact certificate material used.
ServicePrincipalCredentialThumbprint.description_zh: 本次登录中发起服务主体所出示凭据的证书指纹。可与密钥 ID 配合确定所使用的具体证书材料。

ServicePrincipalId.description: Object ID of the service principal that initiated this sign-in. Use to link the event to one workload identity when correlating activity across apps.
ServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 发起本次登录的服务主体的对象 ID。在跨应用关联活动时，可用它将事件对应到具体的工作负载身份。

ServicePrincipalName.description: Display name of the service principal that initiated this sign-in. Useful for human-readable grouping of authentication activity by application or automation account.
ServicePrincipalName.description_zh: 发起本次登录的服务主体的显示名称。便于按应用或自动化账户对身份验证活动进行可读分组。

SourceSystem.description: Monitoring agent or pipeline that collected this record, such as Azure. Helps confirm ingestion path and compare coverage across collection methods.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集此记录的监视代理或管道，例如 Azure。可用于确认摄取路径并比较不同收集方式的覆盖范围。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID where this sign-in record is stored, per schema. Do not treat it as a directory tenant identifier; use it for workspace scoping.
TenantId.description_zh: 按架构定义，这是存储该登录记录的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。不要将其视为目录租户标识；应将其用于工作区范围限定。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time the sign-in event occurred. Use as the primary time axis for timelines and for joining with other sign-in tables.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 登录事件发生的 UTC 日期和时间。可作为时间线的主要时间轴，并用于与其他登录表关联。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, here the service principal sign-in log table. Use in unions to keep provenance across combined queries.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属表的名称，此处为服务主体登录日志表。在联合查询中可用于保留数据来源。

UniqueTokenIdentifier.description: Unique identifier for the token request in this sign-in event, per documentation. Use to correlate or deduplicate related token issuance records.
UniqueTokenIdentifier.description_zh: 按文档说明，这是本次登录事件中令牌请求的唯一标识符。可用于关联或去重相关的令牌颁发记录。

AADUserRiskEvents.description: Individual Identity Protection risk detections associated with user accounts. Use it to understand the detected activity, detection timing, risk type, level and state, and the associated user or IP. Compare ActivityDateTime with DetectedDateTime before building a timeline; pivot on UserId, UserPrincipalName, CorrelationId or RequestId when populated. AADRiskyUsers provides account risk states, while sign-in tables provide authentication records.
AADUserRiskEvents.description_zh: 记录 Identity Protection 针对用户账户产生的具体风险检测。用于查看被检测活动、检测时间、风险类型、等级和状态，以及关联用户或 IP。构建时间线时需区分 ActivityDateTime 与 DetectedDateTime；可通过有值的 UserId、UserPrincipalName、CorrelationId 或 RequestId 关联。账户整体风险状态查 AADRiskyUsers，身份验证过程查登录表。

Activity.description: The activity category the detected user risk is linked to, typically signin or user. Use it to filter and pivot risk events by activity context when investigating which user action triggered the detection.
Activity.description_zh: 检测到的用户风险所关联的活动类别，通常为 signin 或 user。在调查中可用于按活动上下文筛选和透视风险事件，以确定触发检测的用户操作。

ActivityDateTime.description: UTC time when the risky user activity actually occurred, which may precede DetectedDateTime. Use it to establish the activity timeline, correlate with other logs, and assess detection latency.
ActivityDateTime.description_zh: 风险用户活动实际发生的 UTC 时间，可能早于 DetectedDateTime。可用于建立活动时间线、与其他日志关联并评估检测延迟。

AdditionalInfo.description: Dynamic JSON carrying extra context about the risk event, such as evidence, source details, or user agent. Name-derived: inspect key-value content per event to extract investigative details, as schema is not fixed.
AdditionalInfo.description_zh: 动态 JSON，包含风险事件的额外上下文，如证据、来源详情或用户代理。基于名称推断：由于架构不固定，需逐事件检查键值内容以提取调查细节。

CorrelationId.description: Correlation ID of the sign-in related to this risk detection, null when not sign-in associated. Use it to link the risk event to sign-in logs for deeper investigation of the authentication flow.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 与此风险检测相关的登录关联 ID，未关联登录时为 null。可用于将风险事件关联到登录日志，以深入调查认证流程。

DetectedDateTime.description: UTC time the risk was detected by Identity Protection, which may lag ActivityDateTime. Use it to measure detection timing, prioritize recent alerts, and align with DetectionTimingType for real-time versus offline analysis.
DetectedDateTime.description_zh: Identity Protection 检测到风险的 UTC 时间，可能晚于 ActivityDateTime。可用于衡量检测时机、优先处理近期警报，并结合 DetectionTimingType 进行实时与离线分析。

DetectionTimingType.description: Timing category of the detection, such as realtime, nearRealtime, or offline. Use it to separate immediate detections from batch-processed ones and to prioritize response based on detection latency.
DetectionTimingType.description_zh: 检测的时机类别，如 realtime、nearRealtime 或 offline。可用于区分即时检测与批处理检测，并根据检测延迟确定响应优先级。

Id.description: Unique ID of the risk event. Use it to deduplicate events, reference specific detections across queries, and correlate with external systems or reports for the same risk instance.
Id.description_zh: 风险事件的唯一 ID。可用于去重事件、在查询中引用特定检测，并与外部系统或报告中的同一风险实例进行关联。

IpAddress.description: Client IP address from which the risky activity originated. Use it to geolocate or pivot to other events from the same address and assess whether the IP is anomalous for the user.
IpAddress.description_zh: 风险活动来源的客户端 IP 地址。可用于地理定位或转向同一地址的其他事件，并评估该 IP 对用户而言是否异常。

LastUpdatedDateTime.description: UTC time when the risk detection was last modified, for example after remediation or state change. Use it to track investigation updates and see when a risk event's status changed.
LastUpdatedDateTime.description_zh: 风险检测最后修改的 UTC 时间，例如在补救或状态变更后。可用于跟踪调查更新，并查看风险事件状态何时发生变化。

Location.description: Dynamic JSON describing the sign-in location, such as city, country, or coordinates. Name-derived: inspect the object structure to extract geographic details for assessing impossible travel or unfamiliar sign-in locations.
Location.description_zh: 描述登录位置的动态 JSON，如城市、国家或坐标。基于名称推断：需检查对象结构以提取地理细节，用于评估不可能旅行或陌生登录位置。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation associated with the risk event, such as a user action or detection operation. Use it to categorize event types and filter for specific operational contexts during investigation.
OperationName.description_zh: 与风险事件相关的操作名称，如用户操作或检测操作。可用于对事件类型进行分类，并在调查中筛选特定操作上下文。

RequestId.description: Request ID of the sign-in tied to this risk detection, null when not sign-in associated. Use it to correlate with sign-in logs and trace the specific authentication request that triggered the risk.
RequestId.description_zh: 与此风险检测关联的登录请求 ID，未关联登录时为 null。可用于关联登录日志，并追踪触发风险的具体认证请求。

RiskDetail.description: Detail about how the risk was handled or resolved, such as adminConfirmedUserCompromised or userPerformedSecuredPasswordChange. Use it to understand remediation actions and whether the risk was confirmed, dismissed, or self-remediated.
RiskDetail.description_zh: 风险处理或解决方式的详情，如 adminConfirmedUserCompromised 或 userPerformedSecuredPasswordChange。可用于了解补救措施，以及风险是被确认、驳回还是自行补救。

RiskEventType.description: The type of risk event detected, such as leakedCredentials or atypicalTravel. Use it to classify and prioritize detections, and to filter for specific threat patterns during user risk investigations.
RiskEventType.description_zh: 检测到的风险事件类型，如 leakedCredentials 或 atypicalTravel。可用于分类和优先处理检测，并在用户风险调查中筛选特定威胁模式。

RiskLevel.description: Severity level of the detected risk, such as low, medium, or high. Use it to triage events, focus on high-risk user activity first, and support risk-based access decisions in investigations.
RiskLevel.description_zh: 检测到的风险严重级别，如 low、medium 或 high。可用于分级事件、优先关注高风险用户活动，并在调查中支持基于风险的访问决策。

RiskState.description: Current state of the detected risk, such as atRisk, remediated, or confirmedCompromised. Use it to track the lifecycle of a risk event and determine which risks still require attention or have been resolved.
RiskState.description_zh: 检测到的风险的当前状态，如 atRisk、remediated 或 confirmedCompromised。可用于跟踪风险事件的生命周期，并确定哪些风险仍需关注或已解决。

Source.description: Source that generated the risk detection, for example activeDirectory. Use it to identify which system or detector flagged the event and to assess detection coverage across identity sources.
Source.description_zh: 生成风险检测的来源，例如 activeDirectory。可用于识别标记事件的系统或检测器，并评估跨身份来源的检测覆盖范围。

SourceSystem.description: The type of agent that collected the event, such as Azure for Azure Diagnostics. Use it to understand ingestion origin and ensure you are querying the correct data pipeline for identity risk events.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集事件的代理类型，如 Azure Diagnostics 对应的 Azure。可用于了解摄取来源，并确保查询的是身份风险事件的正确数据管道。

TenantId.description: The Log Analytics workspace ID where this event is stored, per schema documentation. Do not treat it as a directory tenant ID; use it to scope queries to the correct workspace during investigations.
TenantId.description_zh: 根据架构文档，此事件存储所在的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。请勿将其视为目录租户 ID；调查时可用于将查询范围限定到正确的工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the event was ingested into the log. Use it to filter recent risk events, build timelines, and join with other tables based on event arrival time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 事件被摄取到日志中的 UTC 时间戳。可用于筛选近期风险事件、构建时间线，并基于事件到达时间与其他表进行联接。

TokenIssuerType.description: Type of token issuer for the detected sign-in risk, such as AzureAD or ADFederationServices. Use it to distinguish between cloud and federated identity scenarios when investigating authentication-related risk events.
TokenIssuerType.description_zh: 检测到的登录风险的令牌颁发者类型，如 AzureAD 或 ADFederationServices。在调查与认证相关的风险事件时，可用于区分云身份与联合身份场景。

Type.description: The name of the log table, always AADUserRiskEvents for this dataset. Use it to confirm you are querying the correct table and to filter in union or cross-table queries.
Type.description_zh: 日志表的名称，本数据集始终为 AADUserRiskEvents。可用于确认查询的是正确的表，并在联合或跨表查询中进行筛选。

UserDisplayName.description: Display name of the user associated with the risk event. Use it for human-readable identification and reporting, while relying on UserId or UserPrincipalName for precise joins.
UserDisplayName.description_zh: 与风险事件关联的用户的显示名称。可用于人类可读的标识和报告，同时依靠 UserId 或 UserPrincipalName 进行精确联接。

UserId.description: Unique identifier of the user associated with the risk detection. Use it to correlate risk events with user activity across other tables and to track a single user's risk history reliably.
UserId.description_zh: 与风险检测关联的用户的唯一标识符。可用于将风险事件与其他表中的用户活动关联，并可靠地跟踪单个用户的风险历史。

UserPrincipalName.description: UPN of the identity this risk detection concerns; identifies which user the risky activity was attributed to. Use it to pivot from the flag to that user's sign-in and audit activity.
UserPrincipalName.description_zh: 该风险检测所涉及身份的 UPN，用于标识高风险活动被归属到哪个用户。可据此从该标记转向该用户的登录和审核活动。

AZFWApplicationRule.description: Azure Firewall application-rule log entries emitted from the data plane, one row per request matched against an Application rule collection. Rows record the source, destination FQDN or URL, protocol and port plus the policy, rule collection group, rule collection and rule that handled the traffic, the resulting action and any action reason, and inspection/category attributes. Use it to see which application requests were allowed or denied, by whom, against which rule, and to pivot on policy hierarchy, web category or FQDN. It covers Layer 7 application traffic; network-rule and NAT traffic appears in other firewall tables, and AzureDiagnostics may hold the same data in legacy form.
AZFWApplicationRule.description_zh: Azure 防火墙应用规则日志条目，来自数据平面，每条记录对应一次与应用程序规则集合匹配的请求。记录内容包括源地址、目标 FQDN 或 URL、协议与端口，以及处理该流量的策略、规则集合组、规则集合和规则、最终操作与操作原因，还有检查状态与 Web 分类属性。可用于查看哪些应用请求被允许或拒绝、由谁发起、命中哪条规则，并按策略层级、Web 分类或 FQDN 进行下钻。该表覆盖七层应用流量；网络规则与 NAT 流量出现在其他防火墙表中，AzureDiagnostics 中也可能以旧格式保存相同数据。

Action.description: Outcome the firewall applied to this application request (for example allow or deny as logged). Group by it to measure permitted versus blocked application traffic and to trace which rule produced the verdict.
Action.description_zh: 防火墙对此应用请求执行的结果（日志中记录的允许或拒绝等）。可按其分组统计放行与拦截的应用流量，并追溯是哪条规则给出的判定。

ActionReason.description: Explanation recorded when the request was not matched by an explicit rule, e.g. default action drop. Use it to distinguish policy-driven denies from implicit default handling, never as proof of malicious intent.
ActionReason.description_zh: 当请求未被显式规则匹配时记录的原因说明，例如默认操作丢弃。可用于区分策略导致的拒绝与隐式默认处理，但不能作为恶意意图的证据。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port of the request as seen by the firewall. Combine with Protocol and Fqdn to identify the service contacted and to spot unusual ports reached from a given source.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 防火墙观察到的请求目标端口。结合 Protocol 与 Fqdn 可判断所访问的服务，并发现某来源访问的异常端口。

Fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name that the request targeted, when resolved. Pivot on it to find all clients reaching a domain, or to correlate a host's outbound destinations over time.
Fqdn.description_zh: 请求所针对的完全限定域名（若已解析）。可据此查找访问某域名的所有客户端，或关联某主机一段时间内的外联目标。

IsExplicitProxyRequest.description: Indicates whether the request arrived on an explicit proxy port rather than being transparently intercepted. Useful to separate proxy-configured client behaviour from other traffic when triaging.
IsExplicitProxyRequest.description_zh: 表示该请求是否通过显式代理端口到达，而非被透明拦截。排查时可用它区分配置了代理的客户端行为与其他流量。

IsTlsInspected.description: Indicates whether the connection was subject to TLS inspection. Check it before relying on URL or category fields, since uninspected traffic may lack that detail.
IsTlsInspected.description_zh: 表示该连接是否经过 TLS 检查。在依赖 URL 或分类字段前应先确认，因为未检查的流量可能缺少这些细节。

Policy.description: Name of the firewall policy containing the rule that handled this request. Use it to attribute activity to a policy and to scope rule and collection analysis to the correct configuration.
Policy.description_zh: 处理此请求的规则所属防火墙策略名称。可用它将活动归属到具体策略，并在正确配置范围内分析规则与规则集合。

Protocol.description: Network protocol of the request, such as HTTP or HTTPS. Pair it with DestinationPort and Fqdn to characterize the application flow and to filter to the traffic type under investigation.
Protocol.description_zh: 请求使用的网络协议，如 HTTP 或 HTTPS。可结合 DestinationPort 与 Fqdn 刻画应用流特征，并筛选出正在调查的流量类型。

Rule.description: Name of the application rule that matched this request. Use it to confirm which rule permitted or blocked traffic and to review whether that rule's intent fits the observed destination.
Rule.description_zh: 匹配此请求的应用程序规则名称。可用它确认是哪条规则放行或拦截了流量，并评估该规则意图是否与观察到的目标相符。

RuleCollection.description: Name of the rule collection containing the matched rule. Useful for grouping related rules and understanding which collection's evaluation produced the observed action.
RuleCollection.description_zh: 包含所匹配规则的规则集合名称。可用于按相关规则分组，并理解是哪一集合的评估产生了观察到的操作。

RuleCollectionGroup.description: Name of the rule collection group in which the matched rule resides. Use it to trace the policy hierarchy above the rule and to compare behaviour between groups.
RuleCollectionGroup.description_zh: 所匹配规则所在的规则集合组名称。可用它追溯规则之上的策略层级，并比较不同组之间的行为。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address of the request as recorded by the firewall. Pivot on it to profile a host's application destinations, or to find all clients contacting a given FQDN.
SourceIp.description_zh: 防火墙记录的请求来源 IP 地址。可据此刻画某主机的应用访问目标，或查找访问某 FQDN 的所有客户端。

SourcePort.description: Source port used by the client for this request. Interpret together with SourceIp and timestamp, since ports are reused; it helps distinguish concurrent sessions from one host.
SourcePort.description_zh: 客户端用于此请求的源端口。需结合 SourceIp 与时间戳解读，因为端口会被复用；它有助于区分同一主机的并发会话。

SourceSystem.description: Identifies the agent or collection channel that delivered the record, such as Azure Diagnostics. Use it to understand ingestion path and to detect duplicate records arriving via different channels.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 标识交付该记录的代理或采集通道，例如 Azure Diagnostics。可用它了解摄取路径，并识别经不同通道到达的重复记录。

TargetUrl.description: URL targeted by the request, populated for HTTP or TLS-inspected HTTPS traffic. Use it for deeper path-level analysis than Fqdn allows, remembering it may be absent for uninspected sessions.
TargetUrl.description_zh: 请求访问的目标 URL，仅对 HTTP 或经 TLS 检查的 HTTPS 流量填充。可用于比 Fqdn 更细的路径级分析，但需注意未检查会话可能缺失此值。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with the record, per documentation. Scope queries by it to a workspace; do not treat it as a directory or Entra tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档说明为与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。可用它将查询限定到某工作区；不要将其视为目录或 Entra 租户标识。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the data plane log record was created. Use it to bound investigations, order a host's request sequence, and correlate firewall activity with other log sources.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 数据平面日志记录创建时的 UTC 时间戳。可用它限定调查时间范围、排列某主机的请求顺序，并将防火墙活动与其他日志源关联。

Type.description: Name of the table that stores the record. Use it to scope queries to this application-rule table and to separate these rows from other firewall or diagnostics tables in the same workspace.
Type.description_zh: 存储该记录的表名称。可用它将查询限定到此应用规则表，并与同一工作区中的其他防火墙或诊断表区分开。

WebCategory.description: Web category assigned to the requested FQDN or URL, when available; empty if classification is not present. Treat it as a classification aid for triage, not as evidence of maliciousness.
WebCategory.description_zh: 为请求的 FQDN 或 URL 分配的 Web 分类（若可用）；无法分类时为空。应将其视为排查用的分类辅助信息，而非恶意证据。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource that produced the record, typically the firewall. Use it to scope queries to a specific firewall instance when several report into the same workspace.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 产生该记录的 Azure 资源唯一标识符，通常为防火墙。当多个防火墙向同一工作区上报时，可用它将查询限定到特定防火墙实例。

AZFWApplicationRuleAggregation.description: Aggregated Azure Firewall application rule log rows produced for Policy Analytics: each row summarizes many similar application-rule matches over a period, grouped by rule/policy path and request attributes, rather than one event per connection. Use it for trend and rule-utilization analysis (which policy, collection group, collection or rule fired, allow/deny volume, top FQDN, URL, source IP, protocol and destination port), pivoting via Policy, RuleCollectionGroup, RuleCollection, Rule and SourceIp. For individual, per-request firewall events use the non-aggregated AZFWApplicationRule table.
AZFWApplicationRuleAggregation.description_zh: 该表是 Azure 防火墙为 Policy Analytics 生成的应用程序规则聚合日志：每行按规则/策略路径和请求属性分组，汇总一段时间内的多起相似应用程序规则匹配，而非一次连接一行。适合趋势和规则使用分析（哪个策略、规则集合组、规则集合或规则命中，允许/拒绝量，按 FQDN、URL、源 IP、协议和目的端口的 Top 排名），可通过 Policy、RuleCollectionGroup、RuleCollection、Rule 和 SourceIp 下钻。若需逐条请求的防火墙事件，请使用非聚合的 AZFWApplicationRule 表。

Action.description: Firewall action applied to the aggregated application rule hits (for example allow or deny). Use with ApplicationRuleCount to quantify blocked versus permitted traffic per rule.
Action.description_zh: 防火墙对此聚合应用程序规则匹配所执行的操作（例如允许或拒绝）。结合 ApplicationRuleCount 可量化每条规则的阻断与放行流量。

ActionReason.description: Reason the firewall performed the action when no rule triggered for the request. Name-derived: values are not enumerated here; use it to explain implicit or default dispositions in aggregated traffic.
ActionReason.description_zh: 当请求未触发任何规则时，防火墙执行该操作的原因。基于名称推断：具体取值未在此列出；可用于解释聚合流量中的隐式或默认处置。

ApplicationRuleCount.description: Aggregated number of application rule hits represented by this row. Use it to weight counts, rank top rules, FQDNs or source IPs, and compare allow versus deny volumes.
ApplicationRuleCount.description_zh: 该行所代表的应用程序规则命中次数聚合计数。可用它对计数加权、对主要规则、FQDN 或源 IP 排名，并比较允许与拒绝量。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port of the aggregated requests, typically 443 or 80 for web traffic. Combine with Protocol and Fqdn to profile which services aggregated application traffic targets.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 聚合请求的目的端口，Web 流量通常为 443 或 80。与 Protocol 和 Fqdn 结合，可刻画聚合应用程序流量所指向的服务。

Fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name targeted by the aggregated requests. Use it to identify which external destinations dominate allowed or denied application traffic per rule.
Fqdn.description_zh: 聚合请求所指向的完全限定域名。可用于确定每条规则下允许或拒绝的应用程序流量中哪些外部目标占主导。

Policy.description: Name of the Azure Firewall policy containing the triggered rule. Use it to scope rule-utilization and allow/deny analytics when multiple policies feed the workspace.
Policy.description_zh: 包含所触发规则的 Azure 防火墙策略名称。当多个策略向工作区发送数据时，可用它限定规则使用和允许/拒绝分析的适用范围。

Protocol.description: Network protocol of the aggregated requests, such as HTTP or HTTPS. Use with DestinationPort and Fqdn to characterize application traffic patterns and rule coverage.
Protocol.description_zh: 聚合请求的网络协议，如 HTTP 或 HTTPS。与 DestinationPort 和 Fqdn 结合，可刻画应用程序流量特征和规则覆盖情况。

Rule.description: Name of the application rule that matched the aggregated requests. Pivot here to see which rules are heavily used and their allow/deny proportions.
Rule.description_zh: 匹配这些聚合请求的应用程序规则名称。以此为枢纽，可查看哪些规则被大量使用及其允许/拒绝比例。

RuleCollection.description: Rule collection containing the triggered rule, within its collection group. Use it to aggregate application traffic at collection level and compare sibling collections.
RuleCollection.description_zh: 包含所触发规则的规则集合（位于其集合组内）。可用它在集合级别聚合应用程序流量并比较同级集合。

RuleCollectionGroup.description: Rule collection group containing the triggered rule. Use it to attribute aggregated application traffic to the group structure of the firewall policy.
RuleCollectionGroup.description_zh: 包含所触发规则的规则集合组。可用它将聚合的应用程序流量归因到防火墙策略的组结构中。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address of the aggregated requests, typically a workload or internal client. Use it to see which senders generate the most allowed or denied application traffic.
SourceIp.description_zh: 聚合请求的源 IP 地址，通常是工作负载或内部客户端。可用它查看哪些发送方产生最多允许或拒绝的应用程序流量。

SourceSystem.description: Collection agent or channel that produced the record, for example Azure for Azure Diagnostics. Use it to confirm ingestion path; it says nothing about the request's own source.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成该记录的收集代理或通道，例如 Azure 表示 Azure Diagnostics。可用于确认数据引入路径；它并不说明请求本身的来源。

TargetUrl.description: Target URL of the aggregated requests, present only for HTTP or TLS-inspected HTTPS traffic. Use it to examine specific paths or query strings behind allowed or denied hits.
TargetUrl.description_zh: 聚合请求的目标 URL，仅对 HTTP 或经 TLS 检查的 HTTPS 流量存在。可用于检查允许或拒绝命中背后的具体路径或查询字符串。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record; this is a workspace identifier, not a directory tenant ID. Use it to scope queries when multiple workspaces are in play.
