TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；这是工作区标识符，不是目录租户 ID。当涉及多个工作区时，可用它限定查询范围。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the data plane log was created, marking the aggregated interval's record. Use it for time-binning trends and ordering aggregation buckets, not as exact event time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 数据平面日志创建时的 UTC 时间戳，标记该聚合区间的记录。可用于按时间分箱趋势和排序聚合桶，但并非精确事件时间。

Type.description: Name of the table that stored the record. Use it in union queries to identify which source table a row came from when combining application and network rule aggregations.
Type.description_zh: 存储该记录的表名。在联合查询中合并应用程序与网络规则聚合数据时，可用它识别某行的来源表。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure Firewall resource the record is associated with. Use it to attribute aggregated application traffic to a specific firewall instance or hub.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Azure 防火墙资源的唯一标识符。可用它将聚合的应用程序流量归因到具体的防火墙实例或中枢。

AZFWDnsQuery.description: Azure Firewall DNS proxy query logs, one row per DNS query handled by the firewall on behalf of a client, sourced from the firewall's data plane. Use it to investigate outbound name resolution: which internal SourceIp queried which QueryName and QueryType, over which Protocol, how the resolver responded (ResponseCode, ResponseFlags), and how large/slow the exchange was. Key pivots are SourceIp plus TimeGenerated, QueryName, and ResponseCode. Distinguish from Azure Firewall network/application rule logs (traffic flows, not name resolution) and from DNS server or VM-level logs.
AZFWDnsQuery.description_zh: Azure 防火墙 DNS 代理查询日志，每一行代表防火墙代客户端处理的一次 DNS 查询，来源为防火墙数据平面。可用于调查出站域名解析：哪个内部 SourceIp 查询了哪个 QueryName 和 QueryType、使用何种 Protocol、解析器的响应情况（ResponseCode、ResponseFlags）以及请求大小与耗时。主要分析维度为 SourceIp 配合 TimeGenerated、QueryName 和 ResponseCode。注意与 Azure 防火墙网络/应用规则日志（记录流量而非域名解析）以及 DNS 服务器或虚拟机级日志区分。

DnssecOkBit.description: Boolean flag from the client query indicating the sender signalled DNSSEC support in its request. Useful when triaging resolution failures: if set, validation-aware clients may fail on unsigned or tampered answers.
DnssecOkBit.description_zh: 客户端查询中的布尔标志，表示发送方声明支持 DNSSEC。排查解析故障时有用：若为真，具备校验能力的客户端可能因应答未签名或被篡改而失败。

EDNS0BufferSize.description: Client-declared maximum response packet size in bytes for this query. Large values on many queries from one SourceIp can support unusual resolver behavior or oversized-response exposure hypotheses; compare with ResponseSize.
EDNS0BufferSize.description_zh: 该查询中客户端声明的最大响应包大小（字节）。同一 SourceIp 大量查询出现大值，可支持解析器行为异常或超大响应暴露的假设；可与 ResponseSize 比较。

ErrorMessage.description: Text description of the error the firewall resolver returned to this client for this query; empty on success. Pivot on non-empty values with SourceIp, QueryName and TimeGenerated to explain failed lookups.
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 防火墙解析器就此查询返回给客户端的错误描述文本；成功时为空。结合 SourceIp、QueryName 与 TimeGenerated 筛选非空值，可解释解析失败原因。

ErrorNumber.description: Numeric error code the resolver returned for this query; relates to ResponseCode but is a number, not the DNS mnemonic. Use with ErrorMessage and ResponseCode to classify why a client's lookup failed.
ErrorNumber.description_zh: 解析器就此查询返回的数字错误码；与 ResponseCode 相关，但为数字而非 DNS 助记符。结合 ErrorMessage 与 ResponseCode 可归类客户端查询失败的原因。

Protocol.description: Transport protocol this client used to send the DNS query, such as TCP or UDP. Flagging non-UDP or unusual protocol mixes by SourceIp can surface tunneling or fallback behavior worth checking.
Protocol.description_zh: 该客户端发送 DNS 查询所用的传输协议，如 TCP 或 UDP。按 SourceIp 统计非 UDP 或异常协议组合，可发现值得核查的隧道或回退行为。

QueryClass.description: The DNS query class requested by this client, normally indicating internet-class records. Odd class values on internal SourceIp hosts, grouped with QueryName, may indicate nonstandard or crafted queries.
QueryClass.description_zh: 该客户端请求的 DNS 查询类别，通常为互联网类记录。内部 SourceIp 主机上出现异常类别值（配合 QueryName 分组）可能表示非标准或构造的查询。

QueryId.description: Numeric DNS transaction identifier the client assigned to this query. Only meaningful within short time windows for a SourceIp and SourcePort; use it to pair a query with its response rather than as a global identifier.
QueryId.description_zh: 客户端为本次查询分配的数字 DNS 事务标识。仅在特定 SourceIp 与 SourcePort 的短时间窗口内有意义；应用它将查询与响应配对，而非当作全局标识。

QueryName.description: The domain name this client asked the firewall resolver to resolve. Central pivot for spotting beaconing patterns, DGA-style names or access to suspicious domains from a given SourceIp over TimeGenerated.
QueryName.description_zh: 该客户端请求防火墙解析器解析的域名。核心分析字段，可结合 SourceIp 与 TimeGenerated 发现信标模式、DGA 风格域名或对可疑域名的访问。

QueryType.description: DNS record type requested in this query, such as A, AAAA, TXT or MX. Aggregating unusual or high volumes of TXT/MX lookups by SourceIp helps target possible data-staging or C2-finding behavior.
QueryType.description_zh: 本次查询请求的 DNS 记录类型，如 A、AAAA、TXT 或 MX。按 SourceIp 汇总异常或大量的 TXT/MX 查询，有助于锁定可能的数据暂存或 C2 探测行为。

RequestDurationSecs.description: Elapsed time in seconds between the firewall receiving this client's query and sending the response back. Slow or timed-out lookups by SourceIp and QueryName can support availability or exfiltration-via-resolution hypotheses.
RequestDurationSecs.description_zh: 防火墙收到该客户端查询到返回响应之间的耗时秒数。按 SourceIp 与 QueryName 观察缓慢或超时查询，可支持可用性问题或通过解析外传数据的假设。

RequestSize.description: Size in bytes of this client's DNS request as seen by the firewall. Abnormally large requests from a SourceIp, compared with ResponseSize and QueryType, may indicate oversized or malformed query payloads.
RequestSize.description_zh: 防火墙所见该客户端 DNS 请求的字节大小。某 SourceIp 的请求异常大，结合 ResponseSize 与 QueryType 比较，可能表示超长或畸形查询载荷。

ResponseCode.description: DNS response code the firewall resolver returned for this query, such as NOERROR or NXDOMAIN. High NXDOMAIN rates for a SourceIp or QueryName family can point to DGA activity or misconfigured resolution.
ResponseCode.description_zh: 防火墙解析器就本次查询返回的 DNS 响应码，如 NOERROR 或 NXDOMAIN。某 SourceIp 或域名族 NXDOMAIN 比例高，可能指向 DGA 活动或解析配置错误。

ResponseFlags.description: Comma-separated DNS response flags the resolver set for this query, such as authoritative or truncated markers. Parse them to explain unusual answers, truncation-driven TCP retries, or cache behavior for a QueryName.
ResponseFlags.description_zh: 解析器为本次查询设置的 DNS 响应标志，以逗号分隔，如权威或截断标志。解析它们可解释特定 QueryName 的异常应答、因截断转用 TCP 重试或缓存行为。

ResponseSize.description: Size in bytes of the DNS response the firewall sent back to this client. Comparing with RequestSize and EDNS0BufferSize by SourceIp can reveal oversized or truncated answer patterns worth investigating.
ResponseSize.description_zh: 防火墙返回给该客户端的 DNS 响应字节大小。按 SourceIp 与 RequestSize、EDNS0BufferSize 比较，可揭示值得排查的超大或被截断应答模式。

SourceIp.description: IP address of the client that sent this DNS query to the firewall resolver. Primary pivot for attributing resolution activity to an internal host; combine with TimeGenerated and QueryName, and treat as device-scoped.
SourceIp.description_zh: 向防火墙解析器发送本次 DNS 查询的客户端 IP 地址。将解析活动归属到内部主机的主要分析字段；结合 TimeGenerated 与 QueryName 使用，并按设备范围理解。

SourcePort.description: Source port the client used for this DNS query. Together with SourceIp, Protocol and QueryId it helps pair a query with its response and spot hosts using many concurrent or unusual source ports.
SourcePort.description_zh: 客户端用于本次 DNS 查询的源端口。结合 SourceIp、Protocol 与 QueryId，有助于将查询与响应配对，并发现使用大量并发或异常源端口的主机。

SourceSystem.description: Collector or agent that delivered this record to the workspace. Useful for confirming the ingestion path and filtering records when correlating firewall DNS logs with other Azure or agent-sourced telemetry.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 将该记录投递到工作区的收集器或代理。用于确认数据接入路径，并在将防火墙 DNS 日志与其他 Azure 或代理来源遥测关联时过滤记录。

TenantId.description: The Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this record. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace when multiple workspaces feed the same environment; it is not a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。当多个工作区向同一环境供数时，用它限定查询范围；它并非目录租户标识。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when this DNS query log record was created. Primary time axis for ordering lookups, building timelines around a host's resolution activity and correlating with other logs.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该 DNS 查询日志记录创建时的 UTC 时间戳。用于排序查询、围绕主机解析活动构建时间线并与其他日志关联的主要时间轴。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, used to confirm the log source in union or cross-table queries. It identifies AZFWDnsQuery records as firewall DNS proxy queries rather than other telemetry.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属表的名称，用于在联合或跨表查询中确认日志来源。它将 AZFWDnsQuery 记录标识为防火墙 DNS 代理查询，而非其他遥测。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource that emitted this record, typically the firewall instance. Use it to attribute queries to a specific firewall when multiple instances report into the same workspace.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 发出该记录的 Azure 资源的唯一标识符，通常为防火墙实例。当多个实例向同一工作区上报时，用它把查询归属到特定防火墙。

AZFWFlowTrace.description: Azure Firewall flow-trace diagnostics with source and destination endpoints, protocol, flags, action and reason. Use it to troubleshoot connection establishment, packet handling and termination behavior, scoped by _ResourceId and TimeGenerated. It supplies lower-level flow context but no named policy or rule columns in this schema; use AZFWNetworkRule or AZFWApplicationRule when the investigation needs the matched rule hierarchy.
AZFWFlowTrace.description_zh: 记录 Azure Firewall 流跟踪诊断，包括源和目标端点、协议、标志位、操作及原因。用于排查连接建立、报文处理和终止过程，需用 _ResourceId 和 TimeGenerated 限定范围。本表提供较底层的流上下文，但当前架构不含具名策略或规则字段；需要匹配规则层级时，应查 AZFWNetworkRule 或 AZFWApplicationRule。

Action.description: Firewall action taken on this flow, such as allow or deny; name-derived, since enum values are not schema-listed. Use with ActionReason to distinguish permitted traffic from blocked attempts during investigation.
Action.description_zh: 防火墙对该流执行的操作（如允许或拒绝）；此为名称推断，schema 未列出枚举值。结合 ActionReason 可区分被放行流量与被阻止尝试。

ActionReason.description: Human-readable reason explaining why the firewall logged or acted on this flow, for example additional logging conditions. Correlate with Action and resource context to understand logging triggers versus enforcement decisions.
ActionReason.description_zh: 解释防火墙为何记录或处理该流的可读原因，例如附加日志条件。需结合 Action 与资源上下文，以区分日志触发条件与实际执行决策。

DestinationIp.description: IP address of the flow's destination endpoint. Pivot to identify repeated internal or external targets, suspicious infrastructure, or data exfiltration destinations; always interpret together with DestinationPort and TimeGenerated.
DestinationIp.description_zh: 该流目标端点的 IP 地址。可用于发现被重复访问的内部或外部目标、可疑基础设施或数据外泄目的地；应结合 DestinationPort 与 TimeGenerated 解读。

DestinationPort.description: Numeric destination port of the flow. Use to profile service targeting, detect uncommon or administrative port access, and pair with DestinationIp and Protocol when reconstructing connection attempts.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 该流的目标端口数值。可用于分析服务被访问情况、发现非常用或管理端口访问，并与 DestinationIp、Protocol 配合还原连接尝试。

Flag.description: TCP flags observed in the connection, such as SYN, FIN, RST, or INVALID; name-derived from documentation examples. Use to detect scan patterns, resets, or malformed traffic within a scoped time window.
Flag.description_zh: 连接中观测到的 TCP 标志，如 SYN、FIN、RST 或 INVALID；依据文档示例推断。可在限定时段内识别扫描模式、连接重置或畸形流量。

Protocol.description: Network protocol carried by this flow, for example TCP or UDP; values are name-derived from documentation examples. Use with ports to characterize traffic type and filter non-service protocols during investigations.
Protocol.description_zh: 该流使用的网络协议，例如 TCP 或 UDP；取值依据文档示例推断。结合端口可刻画流量类型，并在调查中过滤非服务协议。

SourceIp.description: IP address of the flow's originating endpoint. Pivot to track a host's outbound activity, spot internal sources, repeated failed connections, or unexpected external initiators; scope with TimeGenerated.
SourceIp.description_zh: 该流发起端点的 IP 地址。可用于追踪主机外联活动、发现内部源、重复失败连接或意外外部发起方；应结合 TimeGenerated 限定。

SourcePort.description: Numeric source port of the flow, typically ephemeral on the initiator. Use with SourceIp and TimeGenerated to group related connections from one host, but avoid relying on it as a stable identity.
SourcePort.description_zh: 该流的源端口数值，发起方通常为临时端口。可结合 SourceIp 与 TimeGenerated 归并同一主机的相关连接，但不宜将其视为稳定标识。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that produced the record, per documentation examples such as Azure for Azure Diagnostics. Use to confirm ingestion path and filter records during cross-source correlation, not to indicate attack origin.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成该记录的代理或采集通道，文档示例包括 Azure Diagnostics 的 Azure。用于确认采集路径并在跨源关联时筛选记录，不代表攻击来源。

TenantId.description: Documented as the Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record. Use to scope queries to the correct workspace; do not treat it as an Azure directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 文档说明为与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。用于将查询限定到正确工作区；不应将其视为 Azure 目录租户标识。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the data plane log was created for this flow. Use as the primary time filter and for ordering flow sequences, establishing connection timelines, and measuring activity around specific investigation windows.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该流数据平面日志创建时的 UTC 时间戳。可作为主要时间过滤条件，用于排序流序列、建立连接时间线并衡量特定调查窗口内的活动。

Type.description: Schema field naming the table that holds the record, here AZFWFlowTrace. Use during union or cross-table queries to distinguish flow trace rows from other Azure Firewall or diagnostic tables.
Type.description_zh: 记录所属表的 schema 字段，此处为 AZFWFlowTrace。在联合或跨表查询中用于区分流跟踪行与其他 Azure 防火墙或诊断表。

_ResourceId.description: Unique Azure resource identifier of the firewall instance associated with this flow record. Use to scope investigation to a specific firewall and attribute traffic to the correct resource across environments.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该流记录关联的防火墙实例的 Azure 资源唯一标识符。可将调查限定到特定防火墙，并在多环境中将流量归属到正确资源。

AZFWIdpsSignature.description: Azure Firewall IDPS signature-hit records: one row per data-plane packet matched against one or more intrusion detection/prevention signatures on an Azure Firewall resource. Use it to triage which signatures fired, their severity and category, and the source/destination endpoints involved, and to pivot on resource, IP, port, protocol or signature ID. It is not a general firewall network rule or application rule log, and it does not contain payloads or full session context.
AZFWIdpsSignature.description_zh: Azure 防火墙 IDPS 签名命中记录：每行对应一个在 Azure 防火墙资源上被一个或多个入侵检测/防御签名匹配的数据平面数据包。可用于研判触发了哪些签名、其严重性与类别，以及涉及的源/目标端点，并按资源、IP、端口、协议或签名 ID 进行关联分析。它不是通用的防火墙网络规则或应用规则日志，也不包含负载内容或完整会话上下文。

Action.description: Action the firewall took after this packet matched an IDPS signature, such as allow/alert/deny depending on configured mode; use it to tell detected-only events from actually blocked traffic.
Action.description_zh: 数据包命中 IDPS 签名后防火墙采取的处理动作（如允许/告警/阻止，取决于配置模式）；用于区分仅检测到的事件与被实际阻断的流量。

Category.description: Category label of the matched IDPS signature in this packet record, grouping the detection by threat type; useful for aggregating hits across signatures during triage.
Category.description_zh: 该数据包记录中所命中 IDPS 签名的类别标签，按威胁类型对检测进行分组；便于在研判时跨签名汇总命中情况。

Description.description: Human-readable description of the matched IDPS signature for this hit, explaining what the signature detects; use alongside SignatureId to understand the alert, not as proof of compromise.
Description.description_zh: 该次命中对应 IDPS 签名的人类可读描述，说明该签名检测的内容；应与 SignatureId 一起理解告警，但不能作为已遭入侵的证据。

DestinationIp.description: Destination IP address of the packet that triggered the IDPS signature; pivot here to see which internal or external hosts received traffic matching a given signature.
DestinationIp.description_zh: 触发 IDPS 签名的数据包的目标 IP 地址；可据此排查哪些内网或外部主机接收了匹配某签名的流量。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port of the flagged packet, identifying the service or listener targeted on DestinationIp; combine with Protocol and Action to characterize the attempted activity.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 被标记数据包的目标端口，标识 DestinationIp 上被访问的服务或监听端口；结合 Protocol 与 Action 可刻画所尝试的活动。

Protocol.description: Network protocol of the packet that matched the IDPS signature, such as TCP or UDP; helps separate scanning or exploit traffic patterns by transport.
Protocol.description_zh: 命中 IDPS 签名的数据包所用网络协议，如 TCP 或 UDP；有助于按传输层区分扫描或漏洞利用类流量模式。

Severity.description: Severity rating assigned to the matched IDPS signature; use to prioritize which signature hits warrant investigation first, remembering severity is signature-assigned, not confirmed impact.
Severity.description_zh: 所命中 IDPS 签名被赋予的严重性等级；用于确定优先排查哪些签名命中，但注意该等级由签名给定，并不代表已确认的影响。

SignatureId.description: Identifier of the IDPS signature that matched this packet; use to correlate repeated hits, track a specific detection across sources and destinations, and look up signature context.
SignatureId.description_zh: 匹配到该数据包的 IDPS 签名标识符；可用于关联重复命中、跨源与目标追踪特定检测，并查询该签名的上下文信息。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address of the packet that matched an IDPS signature, typically the originator or external peer; pivot to identify which hosts generated flagged traffic.
SourceIp.description_zh: 命中 IDPS 签名的数据包的源 IP 地址，通常是发起方或外部对端；可据此识别哪些主机产生了被标记的流量。

SourcePort.description: Source port of the flagged packet, usually an ephemeral client port; useful with SourceIp and TimeGenerated to group packets belonging to the same short-lived connection.
SourcePort.description_zh: 被标记数据包的源端口，通常为临时客户端端口；结合 SourceIp 与 TimeGenerated 可将同一短连接的数据包归为一组。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or ingestion channel that produced this record (for example Azure diagnostics-style collection); use to confirm how the log arrived, not to identify the firewall or attacker.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 产生该记录的代理或采集通道（例如 Azure 诊断类采集）；用于确认日志的接入方式，而非识别防火墙或攻击者。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID documented for this record; use to scope queries to the correct workspace rather than as an Entra directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 该记录所属的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；用于将查询限定到正确的工作区，而不是作为 Entra 目录租户标识使用。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the firewall data plane log record was created; use for time-bounding queries, sequencing hits, and correlating with other logs from the same period.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 防火墙数据平面日志记录创建时的 UTC 时间戳；用于限定查询时间范围、排列命中顺序，并与同期其他日志进行关联。

Type.description: Name of the log table this record belongs to; useful for filtering or unioning across tables, not for describing the detection itself.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属日志表的名称；用于过滤或跨表合并查询，而非描述检测本身。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource associated with this record, typically the firewall that logged the hit; pivot to compare IDPS activity across firewall resources.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Azure 资源的唯一标识，通常为记录该命中的防火墙；可据此比较不同防火墙资源的 IDPS 活动。

AZFWNatRule.description: Azure Firewall destination-NAT rule matches, recording the original destination and translated destination alongside the source and policy hierarchy. Use it to trace which published address or port forwarded traffic to which internal endpoint and which rule handled that translation. Pivot on SourceIp, DestinationIp, TranslatedIp, ports and _ResourceId. This schema has no Action field; a NAT match alone does not establish application-level success.
AZFWNatRule.description_zh: 记录 Azure Firewall 目标 NAT 规则匹配，包含原始目标、转换后的目标、来源及策略层级。用于追踪某个发布地址或端口将流量转发到了哪个内部端点，以及由哪条规则完成转换；可通过 SourceIp、DestinationIp、TranslatedIp、端口和 _ResourceId 关联。本架构没有 Action 字段，NAT 匹配本身也不能证明应用访问成功。

DestinationIp.description: Packet destination IP as seen by the firewall before DNAT translation. Compare with TranslatedIp to confirm which internal backend an inbound connection reached.
DestinationIp.description_zh: DNAT 转换前防火墙看到的数据包目标 IP。与 TranslatedIp 对比可确认入站连接实际到达的内部后端。

DestinationPort.description: Pre-translation destination port of the matched packet, typically the published inbound port on the firewall. Pair with TranslatedPort to verify the inbound-to-backend port mapping.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 匹配数据包转换前的目标端口，通常为防火墙上对外发布的入站端口。与 TranslatedPort 配合可核对入站到后端的端口映射。

Policy.description: Name of the Azure Firewall policy whose DNAT rule was triggered by this packet. Use it to scope investigations to a specific policy configuration.
Policy.description_zh: 触发该数据包 DNAT 规则所在的 Azure 防火墙策略名称。可用于将调查范围限定到特定策略配置。

Protocol.description: Network protocol of the matched packet, for example UDP or TCP. Helps filter DNAT activity by transport when reviewing exposed inbound services.
Protocol.description_zh: 匹配数据包的网络协议，例如 UDP 或 TCP。在审查暴露的入站服务时可用于按传输层过滤 DNAT 活动。

Rule.description: Name of the specific DNAT rule that matched this packet. Identify which rule permitted the translated inbound flow during investigation.
Rule.description_zh: 匹配该数据包的具体 DNAT 规则名称。调查时可据此判断是哪条规则放行了该转换后的入站流量。

RuleCollection.description: Name of the rule collection containing the triggered DNAT rule. Groups related rules, helping narrow which collection authorized the translated connection.
RuleCollection.description_zh: 触发 DNAT 规则所属的规则集合名称。用于按规则分组缩小范围，判断是哪个集合授权了该转换连接。

RuleCollectionGroup.description: Name of the rule collection group containing the triggered rule. Use it to map the flow to a higher-level grouping within the firewall policy.
RuleCollectionGroup.description_zh: 触发规则所属的规则集合组名称。可用于将流量映射到防火墙策略中的更高层级分组。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address of the packet initiating the inbound connection. Pivot here to identify external or internal hosts reaching published DNAT endpoints.
SourceIp.description_zh: 发起入站连接的数据包源 IP 地址。可据此排查访问已发布 DNAT 端点的外部或内部主机。

SourcePort.description: Source port of the inbound packet's originating connection. Combine with SourceIp and TimeGenerated to distinguish separate inbound connection attempts.
SourcePort.description_zh: 入站数据包发起连接的源端口。与 SourceIp 和 TimeGenerated 结合可区分不同的入站连接尝试。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection source that produced this record, for example Azure Diagnostics. Indicates how the firewall log reached the workspace.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成该记录的代理或采集来源，例如 Azure Diagnostics。用于指示防火墙日志如何进入工作区。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this record, per the documented schema. It is a workspace identifier, not a directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档说明，该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。它是工作区标识，而非目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the firewall data-plane log entry was created. Use it as the primary time filter and for ordering DNAT flow activity.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 防火墙数据平面日志条目创建时的 UTC 时间戳。可作为主要时间过滤条件并用于对 DNAT 流活动排序。

TranslatedIp.description: IP address that replaces the original destination after DNAT. Reveals the internal backend target of the translated inbound packet; compare with DestinationIp.
TranslatedIp.description_zh: DNAT 后替换原始目标地址的 IP 地址。可揭示转换后入站数据包指向的内部后端目标；与 DestinationIp 对比使用。

TranslatedPort.description: Port that replaces the original destination port after DNAT. Shows the backend service port receiving the translated inbound connection.
TranslatedPort.description_zh: DNAT 后替换原始目标端口的端口号。显示接收转换后入站连接的后端服务端口。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, here AZFWNatRule. Confirms the row is a firewall DNAT event rather than another log type.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属表的名称，此处为 AZFWNatRule。用于确认该行为防火墙 DNAT 事件而非其他日志类型。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure Firewall resource associated with this record. Use it to scope DNAT analysis to a specific firewall instance.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Azure 防火墙资源的唯一标识符。可用于将 DNAT 分析限定到具体防火墙实例。

AZFWNatRuleAggregation.description: Aggregated Azure Firewall NAT rule usage for Policy Analytics. Use NatRuleCount to compare matched traffic volumes by source, translated destination, protocol and policy hierarchy, scoped to _ResourceId and time. TranslatedIp and TranslatedPort describe the translated destination. This schema omits the original destination columns and individual-flow detail; use AZFWNatRule to investigate a specific destination translation.
AZFWNatRuleAggregation.description_zh: 记录供 Policy Analytics 使用的 Azure Firewall NAT 规则使用汇总。可用 NatRuleCount 比较不同来源、转换后目标、协议和策略层级的匹配量，并按 _ResourceId 和时间限定范围。TranslatedIp 和 TranslatedPort 表示转换后的目标。本架构不含原始目标字段和逐流明细；调查一次具体的目标地址转换应查 AZFWNatRule。

NatRuleCount.description: Aggregated number of NAT rule matches represented by this row. Use it to gauge how heavily a given rule, collection, or source is exercised, rather than counting rows.
NatRuleCount.description_zh: 该行所代表的 NAT 规则匹配的聚合数量。可用于衡量某规则、集合或来源的使用强度，而不是简单地统计行数。

Policy.description: Name of the firewall policy containing the triggered NAT rule. Use it to attribute aggregated traffic to a specific policy when several are deployed.
Policy.description_zh: 包含所触发 NAT 规则的防火墙策略名称。当部署了多个策略时，可用于将聚合流量归属到具体策略。

Protocol.description: Network protocol of the aggregated packets, such as TCP or UDP. Filter by it to separate protocol-specific NAT usage and compare translation behavior.
Protocol.description_zh: 被聚合数据包的网络协议，例如 TCP 或 UDP。可据此筛选，区分不同协议的 NAT 使用情况并比较转换行为。

Rule.description: Name of the NAT rule that matched the aggregated traffic. Pivot on it to find which rules are active and how much traffic each attracts.
Rule.description_zh: 匹配该聚合流量的 NAT 规则名称。以此为重点可发现哪些规则处于活动状态以及各自吸引的流量规模。

RuleCollection.description: Name of the rule collection containing the matched NAT rule. Use it to see traffic distribution across collections within a policy.
RuleCollection.description_zh: 包含所匹配 NAT 规则的规则集合名称。可用于查看策略内各集合之间的流量分布。

RuleCollectionGroup.description: Name of the rule collection group containing the matched rule. Helps trace which policy hierarchy level a NAT rule belongs to during analysis.
RuleCollectionGroup.description_zh: 包含所匹配规则的规则集合组名称。有助于在分析时追溯某条 NAT 规则所属的策略层级。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address of the aggregated packets. Use it to identify which client or network generates NAT-matched traffic and to group translations by origin.
SourceIp.description_zh: 被聚合数据包的源 IP 地址。可用于识别哪个客户端或网络产生了匹配 NAT 的流量，并按来源对转换记录进行分组。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that produced the record, such as Azure or Operations Manager. Use it to distinguish ingestion paths when correlating with other logs.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 产生该记录的代理或采集通道，例如 Azure 或 Operations Manager。在与其他日志关联时，可用于区分不同的数据接入路径。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace; it is not a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。用于将查询限定到正确的工作区；它不是目录租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the data plane log was created for this aggregate. Use it for time-window filtering and trending NAT activity over periods.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该聚合对应的数据平面日志创建时间（UTC）。可用于按时间窗口筛选以及分析 NAT 活动的时间趋势。

TranslatedIp.description: Address that replaces the packet's original destination IP during NAT. Use it to confirm the translation endpoint reached by traffic matching a rule.
TranslatedIp.description_zh: NAT 过程中替换数据包原始目标 IP 的地址。可用于确认匹配某规则的流量最终到达的转换端点。

TranslatedPort.description: Port that replaces the packet's original destination port during NAT. Combine with TranslatedIp to verify the translation target for aggregated flows.
TranslatedPort.description_zh: NAT 过程中替换数据包原始目标端口的端口。可结合 TranslatedIp 验证聚合流量的转换目标。

Type.description: Name of the table the record belongs to. Use it when unioning multiple firewall tables to keep their provenance distinguishable.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属表的名称。在合并多个防火墙表时，可用于保持来源可区分。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the resource the record is associated with, typically the firewall. Use it to scope the table to one firewall resource.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 该记录所关联资源的唯一标识符，通常是防火墙。可用于将表数据限定到某个防火墙资源。

AZFWNetworkRule.description: Azure Firewall network-rule decisions with source and destination IPs, ports, protocol, action and policy hierarchy. Use it to determine whether traffic was allowed or denied and which rule or recorded action reason explains the decision. Pivot on the endpoint tuple, _ResourceId and TimeGenerated. Choose AZFWApplicationRule for FQDN or URL rules, AZFWNatRule for destination translation, and AZFWNetworkRuleAggregation for summarized counts.
AZFWNetworkRule.description_zh: 记录 Azure Firewall 网络规则决策，包含源和目标 IP、端口、协议、操作及策略层级。用于判断流量是否被允许或拒绝，并定位对应规则或日志中的操作原因；可按端点组合、_ResourceId 和 TimeGenerated 关联。FQDN 或 URL 规则查 AZFWApplicationRule，目标地址转换查 AZFWNatRule，汇总计数查 AZFWNetworkRuleAggregation。

Action.description: Action the firewall applied to the packet after matching this network rule, typically allow or deny. Use it to separate permitted traffic from blocked traffic and to correlate denies with the rule that caused them.
Action.description_zh: 防火墙在数据包匹配该网络规则后对其执行的动作，通常为允许或拒绝。可用于区分被放行的流量与被阻止的流量，并将拒绝事件与其对应规则关联。

ActionReason.description: Reason reported for the firewall's action when no rule was triggered for the packet, such as a default drop. Investigate it on rows lacking a matched rule name to confirm implicit default deny behaviour.
ActionReason.description_zh: 当数据包未触发任何规则时，防火墙执行该动作的原因，例如默认丢弃。可在缺少命中规则名称的行上检查该字段，以确认隐式默认拒绝行为。

DestinationIp.description: Destination IP address of the logged packet, identifying the target host or address the connection was sent to. Pivot on it to find all sources that tried to reach a given destination.
DestinationIp.description_zh: 所记录数据包的目标 IP 地址，标识连接被发送到的目标主机或地址。可按该字段聚合，查找所有尝试访问某个目标地址的源。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port of the logged packet, indicating the target service or listener on the destination address. Use with Protocol to characterise attempted services and to spot scans across many ports.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 所记录数据包的目标端口，指示目标地址上的目标服务或监听端口。可与 Protocol 配合描述尝试访问的服务，并发现跨多个端口的扫描行为。

Policy.description: Name of the Azure Firewall policy that contains the triggered network rule. Use it to attribute allowed or denied traffic to a specific policy when multiple policies are deployed.
Policy.description_zh: 包含所触发网络规则的 Azure 防火墙策略名称。在部署多个策略时，可用它将允许或拒绝的流量归属到具体策略。

Protocol.description: Network protocol of the logged packet, such as TCP or UDP, as recorded by the firewall for this network rule match. Combine with destination port to identify the service being contacted.
Protocol.description_zh: 所记录数据包的网络协议，例如 TCP 或 UDP，由防火墙在此次网络规则匹配中记录。可与目标端口组合，判断正在访问的服务。

Rule.description: Name of the network rule that was triggered by the packet. Use it to confirm which rule allowed or denied specific traffic and to audit a rule's actual observed usage.
Rule.description_zh: 数据包所触发的网络规则名称。可用于确认是哪条规则允许或拒绝了特定流量，并审计某条规则在实际环境中的使用情况。

RuleCollection.description: Name of the rule collection within the policy that contains the triggered network rule. Use it to trace a match up the rule hierarchy between the collection group and the individual rule.
RuleCollection.description_zh: 包含所触触发网络规则的规则集合名称（位于策略之内）。可用于在规则层级中，于规则集合组与单条规则之间追溯匹配来源。

RuleCollectionGroup.description: Name of the rule collection group in which the triggered network rule resides. Use it to attribute traffic to a logical grouping of rule collections and to compare behaviour across groups.
RuleCollectionGroup.description_zh: 所触发网络规则所属的规则集合组名称。可用它将流量归属到某个规则集合的逻辑分组，并比较不同分组之间的行为。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address of the logged packet, identifying the originator of the connection attempt. Pivot on it to profile a host's outbound attempts and to find sources repeatedly hitting denied rules.
SourceIp.description_zh: 所记录数据包的源 IP 地址，标识发起该连接尝试的来源。可按该字段聚合，刻画某主机的出站尝试，并找出反复命中拒绝规则的来源。

SourcePort.description: Source port of the logged packet, indicating the originating port used by the sender. Treat it as ephemeral client-side context and always interpret it together with SourceIp and TimeGenerated.
SourcePort.description_zh: 所记录数据包的源端口，指示发送方使用的发起端口。应将其视为客户端临时端口上下文，并始终结合 SourceIp 与 TimeGenerated 一起解读。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or pipeline that collected the record, indicating how the firewall log reached the workspace. Use it to gauge collection path consistency rather than as an indicator of malicious activity.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集该记录的代理或管道，指示防火墙日志通过何种方式进入工作区。可用它评估采集路径的一致性，而不是将其作为恶意活动的指标。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with the record. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace; it identifies the workspace, not an Entra directory tenant.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。可用它将查询限定到正确的工作区；它标识的是工作区，而非 Entra 目录租户。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the data-plane log entry was created for this network rule match. Use it for time-window filtering and to order events before correlating with other log sources.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该网络规则匹配的数据平面日志条目创建时的 UTC 时间戳。可用于时间窗口过滤，并在与其他日志源关联之前确定事件顺序。

Type.description: Name of the table that holds the record, used to scope queries to this network rule log. It is a fixed table marker, not an attribute of the observed traffic itself.
Type.description_zh: 存放该记录的表名称，用于将查询限定到本网络规则日志表。它是固定的表标识，并非所观察流量本身的属性。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource the record is associated with, typically the firewall instance that produced the log. Use it to isolate logs from one firewall across multiple deployments.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Azure 资源唯一标识符，通常是产生该日志的防火墙实例。可用它在多个部署中隔离某一防火墙的日志。

AZFWNetworkRuleAggregation.description: Policy Analytics aggregated Network rule log data for Azure Firewall. Each row summarizes a counted set of firewall network sessions matching one rule decision per source, destination, port, and protocol, not individual packets. Use it to quantify allow/deny volume by rule, source, or destination, and to see which policy, collection group, collection, and rule fired. Pivots: SourceIp, DestinationIp, DestinationPort, Action, Rule. Boundary: unlike per-session network log tables, rows here are aggregated via NetworkRuleCount, so counts must be summed rather than treated as single events.
AZFWNetworkRuleAggregation.description_zh: Azure 防火墙 Policy Analytics 聚合网络规则日志数据。每行按源、目标、端口和协议汇总一次规则决策所匹配的网络会话计数，而非单个数据包。可用于按规则、源或目标量化允许/拒绝流量，并查看命中的策略、规则集合组、规则集合和规则。关键维度：SourceIp、DestinationIp、DestinationPort、Action、Rule。边界：与逐会话网络日志表不同，本表通过 NetworkRuleCount 聚合，计数需累加而不能视为单条事件。

Action.description: Decision the firewall applied to the aggregated sessions matching this Network rule, typically allow or deny; use it to split permitted versus blocked traffic and audit rule effectiveness.
Action.description_zh: 防火墙对匹配此网络规则的聚合会话所做的决策，通常为允许或拒绝；用于区分放行与阻断流量并审查规则有效性。

ActionReason.description: Reason recorded when the action came from a fallback rather than an explicit rule match, for example a default drop; use it to explain sessions no rule matched.
ActionReason.description_zh: 当动作来自回退而非显式规则匹配时记录的原因，例如默认丢弃；用于解释没有规则匹配的会话。

DestinationIp.description: Destination IP address shared by the aggregated sessions in this row; pivot on it to find which firewall rules and sources target a given host or subnet.
DestinationIp.description_zh: 本行聚合会话共用的目标 IP 地址；可据此查找哪些防火墙规则和源访问特定主机或子网。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port shared by the aggregated sessions, distinguishing services such as web or remote access; combine with Protocol when profiling outbound or inbound traffic.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 聚合会话共用的目标端口，用于区分 Web、远程访问等服务；分析出入站流量时应与协议结合。

IsDefaultRule.description: Boolean marking rows where no network rule matched and a default action was applied; use it to separate policy gaps from explicit rule decisions in aggregated counts.
IsDefaultRule.description_zh: 布尔值，标记没有网络规则匹配而应用默认动作的行；用于在聚合计数中区分策略缺口与显式规则决策。

NetworkRuleCount.description: Number of network sessions aggregated into this row under the same rule and tuple; sum it to size traffic volume and never treat a row as one single event.
NetworkRuleCount.description_zh: 在相同规则与元组下聚合到本行的网络会话数量；应求和以衡量流量规模，切勿将单行视为单个事件。

Policy.description: Name of the firewall policy containing the triggered rule; use it to attribute aggregated decisions to a policy and compare behaviour across policy deployments.
Policy.description_zh: 包含所触发规则的防火墙策略名称；用于将聚合决策归属到某策略并比较不同策略部署的行为。

Protocol.description: Network protocol shared by the aggregated sessions, for example TCP or UDP; filter on it with ports when narrowing which services or attack surfaces the counted traffic represents.
Protocol.description_zh: 聚合会话共用的网络协议，例如 TCP 或 UDP；可与端口一起筛选，以确定所计流量对应的服务或攻击面。

Rule.description: Name of the network rule that matched these aggregated sessions; pivot on it to see which sources, destinations and ports each rule governs in policy analytics.
Rule.description_zh: 匹配这些聚合会话的网络规则名称；可据此在策略分析中查看每条规则管控的源、目标和端口。

RuleCollection.description: Name of the rule collection containing the triggered rule; use it to group aggregated traffic by collection and compare counts between related rule sets.
RuleCollection.description_zh: 包含所触发规则的规则集合名称；用于按规则集合对聚合流量分组，并比较相关规则集之间的计数。

RuleCollectionGroup.description: Name of the rule collection group containing the triggered rule; useful for rolling aggregated network decisions up to the ordered policy hierarchy level.
RuleCollectionGroup.description_zh: 包含所触发规则的规则集合组名称；有助于将聚合网络决策汇总到策略层级中的有序分组层。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address shared by the aggregated sessions in this row; pivot on it to attribute counted traffic to a host or subnet and find its dominant rules and destinations.
SourceIp.description_zh: 本行聚合会话共用的源 IP 地址；可据此将计数流量归属到某主机或子网，并找出其主要规则和目标。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent or pipeline that collected the event, such as Azure for Azure diagnostics; use it to confirm collection provenance rather than as an indicator of security activity.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集事件的代理或管道类型，例如 Azure 诊断的 Azure；用于确认采集来源，而非作为安全活动的指标。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier documented for this record, not a directory tenant ID; use it when scoping queries to a workspace during cross-resource investigations.
TenantId.description_zh: 该记录文档标注的 Log Analytics 工作区标识，并非目录租户 ID；在跨资源调查中可用于将查询限定到某工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the aggregated data plane log record was created; use it for time-range filtering and trend analysis of counted network rule traffic over time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 聚合数据平面日志记录创建时的 UTC 时间戳；用于按时间范围过滤以及分析网络规则计数流量随时间的变化趋势。

Type.description: Name of the table the record belongs to; use it to confirm which log table returned the row when unioning firewall-related queries across the workspace.
Type.description_zh: 记录所属表的名称；在跨工作区联合查询防火墙相关日志时，用于确认返回该行的日志表。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource associated with the record, typically the firewall; use it to scope aggregated rule data to a specific firewall resource.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与记录关联的 Azure 资源唯一标识，通常为防火墙；用于将聚合规则数据限定到特定的防火墙资源。

AZFWThreatIntel.description: Azure Firewall traffic matches against threat-intelligence indicators, with observed endpoints, URL or FQDN, threat description and firewall action. Use it to identify clients communicating with flagged infrastructure and determine the recorded disposition. Pivot on SourceIp, DestinationIp, Fqdn, TargetUrl and time. It covers intelligence-triggered findings rather than all traffic; validate suspicious activity with network or endpoint evidence before concluding compromise.
AZFWThreatIntel.description_zh: 记录 Azure Firewall 流量与威胁情报指标的匹配，包含观测到的端点、URL 或 FQDN、威胁描述及防火墙操作。用于发现与被标记基础设施通信的客户端并核对处置结果；可通过 SourceIp、DestinationIp、Fqdn、TargetUrl 和时间关联。它不是全部流量记录，需结合网络或终端证据验证后才能判断是否失陷。

Action.description: Firewall action taken in response to the threat intelligence match, such as allow or deny. Central to triage: determine whether the suspicious flow was blocked or permitted, and prioritize permitted traffic for follow-up.
Action.description_zh: 防火墙针对威胁情报命中采取的动作，例如允许或拒绝。是研判核心：判断可疑流量是被阻断还是被放行，并优先跟进已放行的流量。

DestinationIp.description: Destination IP address of the packet that triggered the threat intelligence match. Use to identify contacted external infrastructure, enrich with reputation data, and pivot to other events targeting the same address.
DestinationIp.description_zh: 触发威胁情报命中的数据包目的 IP 地址。用于识别被联系的外部基础设施，结合信誉数据进行丰富，并关联其他指向同一地址的事件。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port of the matched packet. Helps distinguish service types (for example web, DNS, or custom ports) and supports scoping and identifying likely command-and-control or exfiltration channels.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 命中数据包的目的端口。有助于区分服务类型（如 Web、DNS 或自定义端口），并支持范围界定以及识别可能的命令控制或数据外传通道。

Fqdn.description: Fully qualified domain name requested in the matched flow, if resolvable. Use to identify malicious or suspicious domains contacted by internal hosts and to pivot on domain across other firewall and DNS telemetry.
Fqdn.description_zh: 命中流量中请求的完全限定域名（如可解析）。用于识别内部主机联系的可疑或恶意域名，并可按域名关联其他防火墙及 DNS 遥测数据。

IsTlsInspected.description: Indicates whether the connection was subject to TLS inspection. Relevant for interpreting URL visibility: without inspection, encrypted request details may be unavailable beyond the domain or endpoint.
IsTlsInspected.description_zh: 指示该连接是否经过 TLS 检查。对理解 URL 可见性很重要：未经检查时，加密请求的详细信息可能仅限于域名或端点。

Protocol.description: Network protocol of the matched packet, such as TCP or UDP. Use when scoping the flow type and deciding which downstream analysis or port-based interpretation applies.
Protocol.description_zh: 命中数据包的网络协议，如 TCP 或 UDP。用于界定流量类型，并决定适用何种后续分析或基于端口的解读。

SourceIp.description: Source IP address of the packet that triggered the threat intelligence match, typically an internal host or device. Primary pivot for identifying which asset attempted contact with known-malicious infrastructure.
SourceIp.description_zh: 触发威胁情报命中的数据包源 IP 地址，通常为内部主机或设备。用于识别哪个资产尝试联系已知恶意基础设施的主要关联字段。

SourcePort.description: Source port of the matched packet. Combined with SourceIp and time, helps correlate a specific client connection and distinguish concurrent sessions from the same host.
SourcePort.description_zh: 命中数据包的源端口。结合 SourceIp 和时间，有助于关联特定客户端连接，并区分同一主机的并发会话。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection path that produced the record, for example Azure Diagnostics. Use for data provenance when validating ingestion coverage of firewall threat intelligence events across resources.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 产生该记录的代理或采集路径，例如 Azure 诊断。用于在验证各资源防火墙威胁情报事件采集覆盖情况时确认数据来源。

TargetUrl.description: Requested target URL of the matched flow, available only for HTTP or TLS-inspected HTTPS requests. Use to pinpoint the exact resource path contacted, beyond the domain alone.
TargetUrl.description_zh: 命中流量的请求目标 URL，仅对 HTTP 或经 TLS 检查的 HTTPS 请求可用。用于在域名之外精确定位所联系的具体资源路径。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record, as documented for this table; not a directory tenant identifier. Use to scope queries to the correct workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID（本表文档如此定义），并非目录租户标识符。用于将查询限定到正确的工作区。

ThreatDescription.description: Description of the threat identified by the firewall for the matched flow. Use to understand why the entry was flagged and to prioritize triage, but treat it as feed evidence, not proof of compromise.
ThreatDescription.description_zh: 防火墙针对命中流量所识别威胁的描述。用于理解该条目的告警原因并确定研判优先级，但应视其为情报源证据，而非已遭入侵的证明。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the data plane log record was created. Use as the event time for timeline reconstruction, correlation windows, and ordering relative to other firewall or endpoint telemetry.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 数据平面日志记录创建时的 UTC 时间戳。用作事件时间，用于时间线重建、关联时间窗口以及与其他防火墙或端点遥测的相对排序。

Type.description: Name of the table the record belongs to. Useful for filtering within union queries across multiple log tables to isolate Azure Firewall threat intelligence entries.
Type.description_zh: 记录所属表的名称。用于跨多个日志表的联合查询中过滤，以隔离 Azure 防火墙威胁情报条目。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource associated with the record, typically the firewall. Use to scope analysis to a specific firewall instance and to attribute matches across multiple deployed firewalls.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与记录关联的 Azure 资源（通常为防火墙）的唯一标识符。用于将分析限定到特定防火墙实例，并在多个已部署防火墙之间归属命中记录。

Alert.description: Legacy monitoring and log-search alert records with triggering rules or queries, thresholds, monitored resources, lifecycle timestamps and remediation references. Use it to investigate why a monitoring alert fired, its status and resolution history. Pivot on AlertId, AlertRuleId, Computer or ResourceId. For Defender alert summaries use AlertInfo; for Sentinel security alerts and their entity or investigation metadata use SecurityAlert.
Alert.description_zh: 记录传统监控和日志搜索告警，包括触发规则或查询、阈值、受监控资源、生命周期时间及修复引用。用于调查监控告警为何触发、当前记录的状态和解决历史；可通过 AlertId、AlertRuleId、Computer 或 ResourceId 关联。Defender 告警摘要查 AlertInfo，Sentinel 安全告警及实体、调查元数据查 SecurityAlert。

AlertContext.description: XML-formatted details of the data item that triggered this alert. Use it to identify the specific monitored object or value behind the alert, and corroborate against the source record before drawing conclusions.
AlertContext.description_zh: 触发此警报的数据项的 XML 格式详情。用它识别警报背后的具体受监控对象或值，并在得出结论前与源记录相互印证。

AlertDescription.description: Human-readable explanation of what this alert means and why it fired. Useful for triage context, but treat it as generated text; verify the stated condition against the query and source data.
AlertDescription.description_zh: 关于此警报含义及其触发原因的可读解释。可用于分诊上下文，但应将其视为生成文本；请对照查询和源数据核实所述条件。

AlertError.description: Error text reported for this alert when its query or evaluation failed. Use to distinguish alerts that reflect real conditions from those generated during evaluation failures, which need separate handling.
AlertError.description_zh: 此警报的查询或评估失败时报告的错误文本。用它区分反映真实条件的警报和评估失败期间产生的警报，后者需单独处理。

AlertId.description: Identifier for this specific alert row. Use to join related records such as comments, remediation jobs, or ticket links, and to deduplicate repeated occurrences when correlating events.
AlertId.description_zh: 此特定警报行的标识符。用它联接相关记录（如评论、修复作业或工单链接），并在关联事件时对重复出现去重。

AlertName.description: Name of the alert as defined by the alert rule that produced this row. Use for grouping and filtering alert activity by rule intent during triage and reporting.
AlertName.description_zh: 产生此行记录的警报规则所定义的警报名称。用于在分诊和报告期间按规则意图对警报活动进行分组和筛选。

AlertPriority.description: Priority level assigned to this alert. Use to sort or filter alerts by operational urgency when triaging, and compare with AlertSeverity to understand how the rule classified this occurrence.
AlertPriority.description_zh: 分配给此警报的优先级。用于在分诊时按操作紧迫性排序或筛选警报，并与 AlertSeverity 比较以了解规则如何对此次发生进行分类。

AlertRuleId.description: Identifier of the alert rule that generated this row. Use to correlate multiple alert occurrences from the same rule and to review rule configuration when assessing whether alerting behaved as intended.
AlertRuleId.description_zh: 生成此行记录的警报规则的标识符。用于关联同一规则的多次警报发生，并在评估警报行为是否符合预期时审查规则配置。

AlertRuleInstanceId.description: Instance identifier for the alert rule execution associated with this row. Use to group alerts produced together by one rule evaluation, which helps separate repeated firings across different runs.
AlertRuleInstanceId.description_zh: 与此行记录关联的警报规则执行的实例标识符。用于将一次规则评估产生的警报分组，有助于区分不同运行中的重复触发。

AlertSeverity.description: Severity level assigned to this alert. Use to prioritize triage and to compare how the rule rated this occurrence relative to AlertPriority and the underlying condition.
AlertSeverity.description_zh: 分配给此警报的严重性级别。用于确定分诊优先级，并比较规则对此次发生的评级与 AlertPriority 及底层条件的关系。

AlertState.description: Latest resolution state of this alert, indicating whether it is still active or resolved. Use to filter current versus closed alerts and to track state transitions over time.
AlertState.description_zh: 此警报的最新解决状态，指示其仍处于活动状态还是已解决。用于筛选当前与已关闭警报，并跟踪随时间的状态转换。

AlertStatus.description: Numeric status code for this alert, complementing AlertState. Use for filtering or aggregating alert workflow states; confirm meaning against AlertState and StateType rather than assuming a fixed mapping.
AlertStatus.description_zh: 此警报的数值状态代码，是 AlertState 的补充。用于筛选或聚合警报工作流状态；应结合 AlertState 和 StateType 确认含义，而非假定固定映射。

AlertTypeDescription.description: Descriptive text for this alert's type as recorded by the alerting subsystem. Use to group similar alerts when the rule name alone is not enough to classify the detection category.
AlertTypeDescription.description_zh: 警报子系统记录的此警报类型的描述性文本。当仅凭规则名称不足以对检测类别进行分类时，用它分组相似警报。

AlertTypeNumber.description: Numeric code for this alert's type. Use with AlertTypeDescription to group or filter alerts by detection category during triage; treat the code meaning as legacy metadata to verify.
AlertTypeNumber.description_zh: 此警报类型的数值代码。在分诊期间与 AlertTypeDescription 一起按检测类别分组或筛选警报；该代码含义为遗留元数据，应加以核实。

AlertUniqueId.description: Name-derived identifier that appears to distinguish this alert record. Inspect alongside AlertId, resource and rule context to confirm what it uniquely identifies; do not assume uniqueness without checking data.
AlertUniqueId.description_zh: 名称派生的标识符，似乎用于区分此警报记录。应结合 AlertId、资源和规则上下文检查以确认其唯一标识的对象；未经数据检查不要假定其唯一性。

AlertValue.description: Numeric value associated with this alert, typically the measured result that met the rule threshold. Use with ThresholdValue and ThresholdOperator to understand why the condition evaluated true.
AlertValue.description_zh: 与此警报关联的数值，通常是满足规则阈值的测量结果。与 ThresholdValue 和 ThresholdOperator 一起使用，以了解条件为何评估为真。

Comments.description: Free-text comments recorded on this alert, often added during triage or resolution. Use to capture analyst decisions and handoff notes, and to see whether a resolution was justified.
Comments.description_zh: 记录在此警报上的自由文本评论，通常在分诊或解决期间添加。用于记录分析员决策和交接备注，并查看解决是否合理。

Computer.description: Computer name associated with this alert's monitored object or source. Use with HostName and time bounds to scope activity to a device; remember device attribution here does not by itself prove the device executed malicious action.
Computer.description_zh: 与此警报的受监控对象或源关联的计算机名称。与 HostName 和时间范围一起使用，将活动限定到某设备；注意此处设备归属本身并不能证明该设备执行了恶意操作。

Custom1.description: Administrator-defined custom field for this alert. Content depends on how the alert rule or management pack populated it; inspect surrounding rule and resource context before assuming what it represents.
Custom1.description_zh: 此警报的管理员定义自定义字段。其内容取决于警报规则或管理包填充方式；在假定其含义前应检查周围的规则和资源上下文。

Custom10.description: Administrator-defined custom field for this alert. Content depends on how the alert rule or management pack populated it; inspect surrounding rule and resource context before assuming what it represents.
Custom10.description_zh: 此警报的管理员定义自定义字段。其内容取决于警报规则或管理包填充方式；在假定其含义前应检查周围的规则和资源上下文。

Custom2.description: Administrator-defined custom field for this alert. Content depends on how the alert rule or management pack populated it; inspect surrounding rule and resource context before assuming what it represents.
Custom2.description_zh: 此警报的管理员定义自定义字段。其内容取决于警报规则或管理包填充方式；在假定其含义前应检查周围的规则和资源上下文。

Custom3.description: Administrator-defined custom field for this alert. Content depends on how the alert rule or management pack populated it; inspect surrounding rule and resource context before assuming what it represents.
Custom3.description_zh: 此警报的管理员定义自定义字段。其内容取决于警报规则或管理包填充方式；在假定其含义前应检查周围的规则和资源上下文。

Custom4.description: Administrator-defined custom field for this alert. Content depends on how the alert rule or management pack populated it; inspect surrounding rule and resource context before assuming what it represents.
Custom4.description_zh: 此警报的管理员定义自定义字段。其内容取决于警报规则或管理包填充方式；在假定其含义前应检查周围的规则和资源上下文。

Custom5.description: Administrator-defined custom field for this alert. Content depends on how the alert rule or management pack populated it; inspect surrounding rule and resource context before assuming what it represents.
Custom5.description_zh: 此警报的管理员定义自定义字段。其内容取决于警报规则或管理包填充方式；在假定其含义前应检查周围的规则和资源上下文。

Custom6.description: Administrator-defined custom field for this alert. Content depends on how the alert rule or management pack populated it; inspect surrounding rule and resource context before assuming what it represents.
Custom6.description_zh: 此警报的管理员定义自定义字段。其内容取决于警报规则或管理包填充方式；在假定其含义前应检查周围的规则和资源上下文。

Custom7.description: Seventh of ten generic custom string slots carried on this alert row; content is rule-defined, so treat the name-derived meaning cautiously and inspect the alert rule or surrounding Custom fields before relying on it.
Custom7.description_zh: 本警报行上十个通用自定义字符串槽位中的第七个；内容由规则定义，因此应谨慎对待这一据名称推断的含义，使用前先查看警报规则或相邻 Custom 字段。

Custom8.description: Eighth generic custom string slot on this alert row, populated only if the alert rule supplies it; inspect the related rule or category context to learn what this row actually stores here.
Custom8.description_zh: 本警报行上第八个通用自定义字符串槽位，仅当警报规则提供时才有值；应查看相关规则或类别上下文以确定本行实际存放的内容。

Custom9.description: Ninth generic custom string slot on this alert row; no documented semantics, so the value is name-derived only and should be validated against the originating alert rule before investigative use.
Custom9.description_zh: 本警报行上第九个通用自定义字符串槽位；无文档化语义，因此该值仅能据名称推断，调查使用前应结合来源警报规则验证。

Expression.description: Rule-side expression or condition stored on this legacy alert row, describing how the alert was evaluated; use it to reconstruct what logic produced this alert rather than as evidence about the affected resource itself.
Expression.description_zh: 存储在本旧版警报行上的规则侧表达式或条件，描述警报如何被评估；用它重建产生此警报的逻辑，而不是作为受影响资源本身的证据。

Flags.description: Integer bitfield on this alert row encoding alert-rule options set when the alert was raised; consult FlagsDescription and ValueFlags fields together to interpret bits, since individual bit meanings are not documented here.
Flags.description_zh: 本警报行上编码警报规则选项的整数位域，在警报触发时设置；由于此处未记录各个位的含义，应结合 FlagsDescription 与 ValueFlags 字段一起解读。

FlagsDescription.description: Human-readable text describing the alert Flags bits on this row; use it to translate the numeric flag value when triaging why this alert was configured or raised.
FlagsDescription.description_zh: 描述本行警报 Flags 位的人类可读文本；在分诊此警报为何被配置或触发时，用它将数值标志转换为可理解的含义。

HostName.description: Host name associated with this legacy alert, naming the monitored computer or endpoint; scope queries by host and time to correlate with device inventory, since it is not a unique object identifier.
HostName.description_zh: 与本旧版警报关联的主机名，指明被监控的计算机或端点；查询时按主机和时间限定，以便与设备清单关联，因为它并非唯一对象标识符。

LastModifiedBy.description: Name of the user who last modified this alert, as recorded for the alert object; useful for audit questions about who changed alert state, priority, or comments and when.
LastModifiedBy.description_zh: 最后修改此警报的用户的名称，记录在警报对象上；用于审计谁在何时更改了警报状态、优先级或注释等问题。

LinkToSearchResults.description: URL linking to the search results or query that triggered this legacy alert; pivot here to open the originating query context, remembering a link does not by itself prove any outcome occurred.
LinkToSearchResults.description_zh: 指向触发此旧版警报的搜索结果或查询的 URL；可借此跳转到来源查询上下文，但链接本身并不证明发生了任何结果。

MG.description: Abbreviated management-group value on this alert row; no official column description exists, so this is a name-derived interpretation only. Inspect management-group or category context before asserting what it represents.
MG.description_zh: 本警报行上缩写形式的管理组值；无官方列说明，因此仅属据名称推断的解读。断言其含义前请查看管理组或类别上下文。

ManagementGroupName.description: Name of the management group for System Center Operations Manager agents associated with this alert; use it to scope which monitored estate or collection produced the row.
ManagementGroupName.description_zh: 与此警报关联的 System Center Operations Manager 代理的管理组名称；用于限定该行来自哪个被监控环境或集合。

ObjectDisplayName.description: Display name of the monitored object this alert concerns, as shown for the alert target; use it with AlertUniqueId and time to identify what was alerted on, not as a durable resource identifier.
ObjectDisplayName.description_zh: 本警报所关注被监控对象的显示名称，即警报目标的展示名；结合 AlertUniqueId 与时间确定告警对象，但它不是持久资源标识符。

PriorityNumber.description: Numeric priority assigned to this alert row, distinct from textual AlertPriority; use it to sort or filter legacy alerts by urgency when triaging, and check AlertPriority for the matching label.
PriorityNumber.description_zh: 分配给本警报行的数值优先级，与文本型 AlertPriority 不同；分诊时可用它按紧急程度排序或筛选旧版警报，并对照 AlertPriority 获取对应标签。

Query.description: Log search query text stored on this legacy alert row, the query whose results triggered the alert; inspect it to understand detection logic, not as proof that malicious activity occurred.
Query.description_zh: 存储在本旧版警报行上的日志搜索查询文本，即结果触发警报的查询；查看它以理解检测逻辑，而非作为恶意活动已发生的证据。

QueryExecutionEndTime.description: Timestamp when evaluation of this alert rule's query finished; pair with QueryExecutionStartTime to measure search latency and to place the alert's detection window in time.
QueryExecutionEndTime.description_zh: 此警报规则查询评估结束的时间戳；与 QueryExecutionStartTime 配对可衡量搜索延迟，并将警报的检测窗口定位在时间线上。

QueryExecutionStartTime.description: Timestamp when evaluation of this alert rule's query began; combine with QueryExecutionEndTime to bound when the detection ran and to order legacy alert activity.
QueryExecutionStartTime.description_zh: 此警报规则查询评估开始的时间戳；与 QueryExecutionEndTime 结合可界定检测运行时间，并对旧版警报活动排序。

RemediationJobId.description: Identifier of the automation job invoked to remediate this alert; use it to trace whether and which automated response ran, remembering an id alone does not prove remediation succeeded.
RemediationJobId.description_zh: 为修正此警报而调用的自动化作业标识符；可用它追踪是否以及运行了哪个自动响应，但仅有该 ID 并不能证明修正成功。

RemediationRunbookName.description: Name of the runbook configured or executed as remediation for this alert row; inspect it to see which automation was supposed to respond, not as evidence of its outcome.
RemediationRunbookName.description_zh: 为本警报行配置或执行作为修正措施的 Runbook 名称；查看它以了解应执行哪个自动化，但不能作为其执行结果的证据。

RepeatCount.description: Number of times the same alert was generated for the same monitored object since being resolved; use it to gauge recurrence and noisy alerts, scoping by object and time.
RepeatCount.description_zh: 自解决以来同一被监控对象再次生成同一警报的次数；结合对象与时间限定，用它评估复发频率与噪声警报。

ResolvedBy.description: Name of the user who resolved this alert, per the alert object; empty when unresolved. Use with TimeResolved for audit accountability, noting it records the actor, not whether the issue was truly fixed.
ResolvedBy.description_zh: 解决此警报的用户的名称（记录于警报对象上）；未解决时为空。与 TimeResolved 一起用于审计问责，注意它记录的是操作者，并不代表问题真正修复。

ResourceId.description: Azure resource identifier of the resource this legacy alert targets; pivot here to join to resource inventory or other logs, but verify it is populated before assuming a specific resource.
ResourceId.description_zh: 此旧版警报所针对资源的 Azure 资源标识符；可借此关联资源清单或其他日志，但假设具体资源前应确认该字段确有值。

ResourceType.description: Type of the Azure resource associated with this alert row, naming the resource kind; use it to group or filter alerts by resource category when triaging across a mixed estate.
ResourceType.description_zh: 与本警报行关联的 Azure 资源类型，即资源种类名称；在混合环境中分诊时，用它按资源类别分组或筛选警报。

ResourceValue.description: Value extracted from the monitored resource or object that this legacy alert evaluated; meaning depends on the rule, so interpret it with the alert rule and object context, not standalone.
ResourceValue.description_zh: 本旧版警报所评估的被监控资源或对象中提取的值；其含义取决于规则，因此应结合警报规则与对象上下文解读，而非单独使用。

RootObjectName.description: Name of the root object associated with this alert, as recorded for the monitored hierarchy; use it to attribute the alert to a top-level object, distinct from the displayed target name.
RootObjectName.description_zh: 与此警报关联的根对象名称，记录于被监控层级中；用它把警报归因到顶层对象，区别于显示的目标名称。

ServiceDeskConnectionName.description: Name of the service-desk connector configured for this alert, indicating which external ticketing integration the alert was routed through. Use to see which connector handled legacy alerts; name-derived, verify in connector configuration.
ServiceDeskConnectionName.description_zh: 为该警报配置的服务台连接器名称，表示警报通过哪个外部工单集成发送。可用于查看哪些连接器处理了旧版警报；该解释基于字段名，需在连接器配置中核实。

ServiceDeskId.description: Identifier assigned by the connected service-desk system for the alert's work item on that platform. Use to join alert records back to external ticketing records; only populated when service-desk integration created an item.
ServiceDeskId.description_zh: 由所连接服务台系统为警报工单分配的标识符。可用于将警报记录关联回外部工单记录；仅当服务台集成创建了工单时才有值。

ServiceDeskWorkItemLink.description: URL linking to the service-desk work item created for this alert, letting investigators jump to the external ticket. Treat as a reference pointer, not proof of resolution.
ServiceDeskWorkItemLink.description_zh: 指向为该警报创建的服务台工单的链接 URL，便于调查人员跳转到外部工单。应视为引用指针，并不代表问题已解决。

ServiceDeskWorkItemType.description: Type of service-desk work item (for example incident or task) created for this alert in the integrated ticketing system. Use with TicketId and ServiceDeskId to classify how the alert was tracked externally.
ServiceDeskWorkItemType.description_zh: 在集成工单系统中为该警报创建的服务台工单类型（例如事件或任务）。可与 TicketId、ServiceDeskId 结合，判断警报在外部是如何跟踪的。

SourceDisplayName.description: Display name of the monitoring object that generated the alert, useful for quick identification of the affected component in a list. Prefer SourceFullName or ResourceId when you need a precise pivot.
SourceDisplayName.description_zh: 生成该警报的监控对象的显示名称，便于在列表中快速识别受影响组件。需要精确关联时应改用 SourceFullName 或 ResourceId。

SourceFullName.description: Full name of the monitoring object that generated the alert, typically more qualified than its display name. Use for disambiguating similarly named objects when tracing which monitored resource raised a legacy alert.
SourceFullName.description_zh: 生成该警报的监控对象的完整名称，通常比显示名称更具限定性。当需要区分同名对象、追踪哪个受监控资源触发旧版警报时使用。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent or collection channel that supplied the alert record, such as OpsManager, Linux, or Azure per documentation. Confirms which monitoring path originated the row before you compare records across environments.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 提供该警报记录的代理或采集通道类型，文档示例包括 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure。在跨环境比较记录前，可借此确认该行的来源监控路径。

StateType.description: Categorical state value describing the alert's lifecycle condition on this row (for example raised or resolved style states). Interpret alongside AlertState and StateType wording; value semantics are not exhaustively documented here.
StateType.description_zh: 描述该行警报生命周期状态的分类型取值（例如已触发或已解决类状态）。应结合 AlertState 及该字段用词理解；此处未穷尽记录其取值语义。

StatusDescription.description: Human-readable text describing the alert's status, complementing the numeric AlertStatus. Use when you need narrative context about why an alert sits in its current state.
StatusDescription.description_zh: 以可读文本描述警报状态，补充数字型 AlertStatus 字段。当需要了解警报为何处于当前状态的叙述性背景时使用。

TemplateId.description: Identifier of the alert rule template that defined this alert's logic. Use to group legacy alerts sharing the same detection template, separate from AlertRuleId instances; template semantics are environment-specific.
TemplateId.description_zh: 定义该警报逻辑的警报规则模板标识符。可用于将使用同一检测模板的旧版警报归组，与 AlertRuleId 实例区分；模板语义依环境而异。

TenantId.description: Workspace identifier for the Log Analytics workspace holding this alert row, per this schema's documented usage. It is not a directory tenant ID; use it to scope queries to the correct workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 按本架构文档用法，该字段是保存此警报行的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符，并非目录租户 ID；用于将查询限定到正确的工作区。

ThresholdOperator.description: Comparison operator applied to the monitored value when the alert rule's threshold was evaluated. Read with ThresholdValue and AlertValue to reconstruct why the legacy rule fired.
ThresholdOperator.description_zh: 评估警报规则阈值时对监控值采用的比较运算符。与 ThresholdValue、AlertValue 一起阅读，可还原旧版规则为何触发。

ThresholdValue.description: Numeric threshold the rule compared against during evaluation. Combine with ThresholdOperator, AlertValue, and the rule query to understand the firing condition; units depend on the rule definition, so inspect the rule.
ThresholdValue.description_zh: 规则评估时所比较的数值阈值。结合 ThresholdOperator、AlertValue 与规则查询可理解触发条件；单位取决于规则定义，需查看该规则。

TicketId.description: Ticket identifier assigned when the surrounding management environment is integrated with a ticketing process for alerts; empty when no ticket was assigned. Use to correlate legacy alerts with external ticket workflows.
TicketId.description_zh: 当所在管理环境集成了警报工单流程时分配的工单标识符；未分配工单时为空。可用于将旧版警报与外部工单流程关联。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time this alert record was created, i.e. when the row was ingested. Use as the primary time filter for this table, and compare with TimeRaised to gauge ingestion delay.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该警报记录创建（即该行被引入）的日期和时间。可作为本表的主要时间过滤条件，并与 TimeRaised 比较以评估引入延迟。

TimeLastModified.description: Date and time the alert was last changed, such as a state update. Compare with TimeGenerated and TimeResolved to see whether the record was touched after creation.
TimeLastModified.description_zh: 警报最后一次被更改（如状态更新）的日期和时间。与 TimeGenerated、TimeResolved 比较，可判断记录在创建后是否被修改过。

TimeRaised.description: Date and time the alert was actually generated by the rule. Use for true alert chronology and dwell-time calculations against TimeResolved; may differ from TimeGenerated ingestion time.
TimeRaised.description_zh: 警报由规则实际生成的日期和时间。可用于真实警报时序及与 TimeResolved 计算驻留时间；可能与 TimeGenerated 的引入时间不同。

TimeResolved.description: Date and time the alert was resolved; empty when the alert has not been resolved. Use with TimeRaised to compute alert duration and to filter still-open legacy alerts.
TimeResolved.description_zh: 警报被解决的日期和时间；警报尚未解决时为空。可与 TimeRaised 一起计算警报持续时间，并筛选仍处于打开状态的旧版警报。

TriggerId.description: Identifier of the trigger instance associated with this alert's firing. Name-derived meaning; use to group alerts possibly originating from the same trigger evaluation, and verify semantics in your monitoring environment.
TriggerId.description_zh: 与该警报触发关联的触发器实例标识符。含义由字段名推断；可用于归组可能源自同一次触发器评估的警报，并需在自身监控环境中核实其语义。

Type.description: Name of the table this row belongs to, i.e. the alert table value. Use to confirm the row came from the legacy Alert table when unioning across multiple Log Analytics tables.
Type.description_zh: 该行所属表的名称，即警报表取值。当跨多个 Log Analytics 表进行联合查询时，可用该字段确认此行来自旧版 Alert 表。

Url.description: URL reference associated with the alert row, typically a link to related alert details or search results. Treat as a navigation pointer; do not infer that following it proves the underlying condition.
Url.description_zh: 与该警报行关联的 URL 引用，通常是相关警报详情或搜索结果的链接。应视为导航指针；不要推断访问该链接即可证明底层条件成立。

ValueDescription.description: Readable description of the value that triggered the alert, explaining what AlertValue represents for this row. Use together with AlertValue and the rule definition to interpret the metric or count involved.
ValueDescription.description_zh: 对触发警报的取值的可读描述，说明本行 AlertValue 代表什么。可与 AlertValue 及规则定义结合，解释所涉指标或计数的含义。

ValueFlags.description: Numeric bitmask-style flags associated with the alert's value, whose meaning is not documented in this schema. Compare with ValueFlagsDescription and the originating rule; treat the numeric encoding as rule-specific.
ValueFlags.description_zh: 与警报取值关联的数字标志位，其含义在本架构中未记录。可与 ValueFlagsDescription 及来源规则对照；该数字编码应视为规则特定。

ValueFlagsDescription.description: Text explanation of the flags encoded in ValueFlags for this alert row. Use it to decode flag bits instead of guessing; content is rule-specific and may be empty.
ValueFlagsDescription.description_zh: 对 ValueFlags 中标志位的文本说明。用它来解读标志位而不要猜测；内容依规则而定，可能为空。

_ResourceId.description: Azure resource identifier of the resource this legacy alert record is tied to. Use it to scope alerts to a specific resource when correlating with resource-scoped data; it may be empty for workspace-only alerts.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 此遗留警报记录所关联资源的 Azure 资源标识符。在与资源范围数据关联时可用它限定具体资源；纯工作区警报该值可能为空。

AlertEvidence.description: AlertEvidence stores one row per entity linked to a security alert: files, IPs, URLs, users, devices, processes or mail items. Rows carry the parent AlertId, so you can pivot from an alert to all associated evidence and enrichment. Use it to answer which users, devices, IPs or files an alert references, and to group alerts by technique or detection source. It is not the alert header table and not raw telemetry; entities are contextual evidence, not proof of compromise.
AlertEvidence.description_zh: AlertEvidence 每一行代表与某个安全警报关联的一个实体：文件、IP、URL、用户、设备、进程或邮件。行中带有父级 AlertId，因此可以从警报下钻到所有关联证据与补充信息。可用于回答某警报涉及哪些用户、设备、IP 或文件，并按技术或检测来源对警报分组。它不是警报头部表，也不是原始遥测数据；这些实体属于上下文证据，并不证明已遭入侵。

AccountDomain.description: Domain portion of the account named in this evidence row, such as a NetBIOS or DNS domain. Scope it with AccountName when the same username exists in multiple domains before treating the account as one identity.
AccountDomain.description_zh: 本证据行所涉账户的域部分，例如 NetBIOS 或 DNS 域。当同名用户存在于多个域时，需与 AccountName 一起限定，才能将其视为同一身份。

AccountName.description: Username of the account this evidence row describes. It is the account associated with the alert entity, not necessarily the process initiator; pair it with SID, UPN or domain to resolve the correct identity.
AccountName.description_zh: 本证据行所描述账户的用户名。它是与警报实体关联的账户，未必是进程发起者；应结合 SID、UPN 或域来解析正确身份。

AccountObjectId.description: Directory object identifier for the account named in this evidence row, useful for correlating the same identity across services and alerts. It identifies the account as an entity, not the actor who triggered the alert.
AccountObjectId.description_zh: 本证据行所涉账户的目录对象标识符，可用于跨服务、跨警报关联同一身份。它标识的是作为实体的账户，而非触发警报的操作者。

AccountSid.description: Windows security identifier of the account in this evidence row. Use it to distinguish same-named accounts across domains or machines; combine with a device or time scope before assuming the SID maps to one consistent identity.
AccountSid.description_zh: 本证据行中账户的 Windows 安全标识符。可用它区分不同域或主机上的同名账户；在假定该 SID 对应同一身份前，应结合设备或时间范围限定。

AccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account this evidence row references, typically the sign-in form user@domain. Useful for pivoting to identity and sign-in data, but its presence in alert evidence does not itself prove a successful sign-in or compromise.
AccountUpn.description_zh: 本证据行所引用账户的用户主体名称，通常为 user@domain 登录形式。可用于转向身份与登录数据，但其出现在警报证据中本身并不证明登录成功或已遭入侵。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic JSON bag of extra evidence attributes not modeled as columns. Its keys and structure are undocumented and row-dependent; inspect it to discover enrichment, but treat name-derived interpretations as unconfirmed.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 存放未建模为列的额外证据属性的动态 JSON 集合。其键名与结构未记录且因行而异；可检查以发现补充信息，但由名称推测的含义应视为未确认。

AlertId.description: Identifier of the parent alert these evidence rows belong to. Group by it to see all entities for one alert, and join it to alert tables for severity, status and investigation context; it is not an event identifier.
AlertId.description_zh: 这些证据行所属父级警报的标识符。按它分组可查看单个警报的全部实体，并连接警报表获取严重性、状态与调查上下文；它不是事件标识符。

Application.description: Display name of the application associated with the recorded evidence activity, such as the client or service involved. Use it to see which apps appear around an alert; it is distinct from ApplicationId and from OAuthApplicationId.
Application.description_zh: 与所记录证据活动关联的应用程序显示名称，例如涉及的客户端或服务。可用于查看警报周边出现了哪些应用；它不同于 ApplicationId，也不同于 OAuthApplicationId。

ApplicationId.description: Integer identifier of the application tied to this evidence row. Treat it as a service-specific numeric reference; correlate with Application or other tables rather than assuming it denotes a Microsoft Entra application.
ApplicationId.description_zh: 与本证据行相关应用程序的整数标识符。应将其视为服务特定的数字引用；应结合 Application 或其他表进行关联，而不要假定它表示 Microsoft Entra 应用。

AttackTechniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques attributed to the activity that triggered the alert for this evidence row. They are analyst-facing mappings, not proof of adversary action; use them to group and prioritize alerts, and verify against underlying telemetry.
AttackTechniques.description_zh: 归因于本证据行所属警报触发活动的 MITRE ATT&CK 技术。它们是面向分析师的映射，并非攻击者行为的证明；可用于对警报分组和排优先级，并应与底层遥测核实。

Categories.description: JSON array listing the categories this evidence information belongs to, such as alert classification groupings. Use it to filter or group evidence by category; values are service-defined, so inspect actual content rather than assuming a fixed taxonomy.
Categories.description_zh: 以 JSON 数组列出本证据信息所属的类别，例如警报分类分组。可用于按类别筛选或分组证据；取值由服务定义，应检查实际内容，而不要假定固定分类体系。

DetectionSource.description: Detection technology or sensor that identified the notable component or activity behind this evidence. Use it to see which control surfaced the alert and to compare coverage; it names the detector, not the compromised asset.
DetectionSource.description_zh: 发现本证据背后显著组件或活动的检测技术或传感器。可用于查看哪个防护措施触发了警报并比较覆盖情况；它标识的是检测器，而非被入侵资产。

DeviceId.description: Service-specific identifier for the device referenced by this evidence row. Scope it with DeviceName and time, and use it to pivot to device inventory, timeline or network data; it is not a hostname or IP.
DeviceId.description_zh: 本证据行所引用设备在服务中的标识符。应与 DeviceName 和时间一起限定，并可用其转向设备清单、时间线或网络数据；它不是主机名或 IP。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the machine referenced by this evidence row. Use it as a human-readable device pivot, but resolve it with DeviceId and time range because names can be reused or reassigned across assets.
DeviceName.description_zh: 本证据行所引用计算机的完全限定域名。可用作便于阅读的设备转向点，但应结合 DeviceId 和时间范围解析，因为名称可能在不同资产间被复用或重新分配。

EmailSubject.description: Subject line of the email item linked to this evidence row, typically for mail-borne alerts. Use it to locate the message via NetworkMessageId; an email appearing as evidence does not show whether a recipient opened or clicked anything.
EmailSubject.description_zh: 与本证据行关联的邮件项的标题行，通常用于邮件类警报。可用其通过 NetworkMessageId 定位该邮件；邮件作为证据出现并不表明收件人是否打开或点击了任何内容。

EntityType.description: Type of object this evidence row represents, such as file, process, device, user or IP. It determines which of the other evidence columns are meaningful, so filter on it before interpreting entity-specific fields.
EntityType.description_zh: 本证据行所代表对象的类型，例如文件、进程、设备、用户或 IP。它决定其余证据列中哪些有意义，因此应先按它筛选，再解读实体相关字段。

EvidenceDirection.description: Indicates whether the entity in this evidence row acts as source or destination of a network connection. Use it to orient traffic evidence; it describes connection direction, not whether the activity succeeded.
EvidenceDirection.description_zh: 指示本证据行中的实体是网络连接的源还是目标。可用于确定流量证据方向；它描述的是连接方向，而非活动是否成功。

EvidenceRole.description: Describes how the entity is involved in the alert, for example whether it is impacted or merely related. Use it to separate truly affected assets from contextual ones and avoid over-scoping an investigation.
EvidenceRole.description_zh: 描述该实体在警报中的参与方式，例如是受影响还是仅相关。可用于区分真正受影响的资产与上下文实体，避免调查范围过度扩大。

FileName.description: Name of the file that the recorded evidence action applied to. Treat it as a file entity attribute and pivot using SHA256 or FolderPath; the name alone does not show execution or maliciousness.
FileName.description_zh: 所记录证据操作作用的文件名。应将其视为文件实体属性，并使用 SHA256 或 FolderPath 进行转向；仅凭名称不能说明其被执行或具恶意性。

FileSize.description: Size in bytes of the file referenced by this evidence row. Useful for comparing hashes or spotting anomalies, but it is descriptive metadata and not an indicator of malicious content by itself.
FileSize.description_zh: 本证据行所引用文件的大小，单位为字节。可用于比较哈希或发现异常，但它只是描述性元数据，本身不是恶意内容的指标。

FolderPath.description: Directory containing the file that the recorded evidence action applied to. Use it to infer location context such as temp or startup directories, and pivot with FileName and hashes; it is not proof of execution.
FolderPath.description_zh: 所记录证据操作作用文件所在目录。可用于推断位置上下文，如临时或启动目录，并配合 FileName 与哈希进行转向；它不证明文件被执行。

LocalIP.description: IP address assigned to the local device used during the communication recorded in this evidence row. Use it with DeviceId and time to attribute network activity; it may be private or reused, so scope before relying on it.
LocalIP.description_zh: 本证据行所记录通信中本地设备使用的 IP 地址。应结合 DeviceId 和时间来归因网络活动；它可能是私有地址或被复用，依赖前应限定范围。

NetworkMessageId.description: Office 365-generated unique identifier for the email item this evidence row references. Use it to join email and mail-trace data; its presence links the message to the alert but does not establish user interaction.
NetworkMessageId.description_zh: 本证据行所引用邮件项的 Office 365 生成唯一标识符。可用其连接邮件与邮件跟踪数据；它的存在将邮件与警报关联，但不证明用户交互。

OAuthApplicationId.description: Identifier of the third-party OAuth application referenced in this evidence row. Use it to investigate consent or token-based access involving that app; keep it distinct from ApplicationId, which is a numeric service field.
OAuthApplicationId.description_zh: 本证据行所引用第三方 OAuth 应用的标识符。可用其调查涉及该应用的同意授权或基于令牌的访问；应与 ApplicationId 区分开，后者是服务中的数字字段。

ProcessCommandLine.description: Command line that created or launched the process entity flagged in this evidence row. Use to understand execution intent and arguments; correlate with DeviceId and TimeGenerated, and distinguish from unrelated processes on the same host.
ProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 创建或启动本证据行所标记进程实体的命令行。用于了解执行意图与参数；需结合 DeviceId 和 TimeGenerated 关联，并与同一主机上其他进程区分。

RegistryKey.description: Registry key path the recorded action targeted, populated on registry-related evidence rows for the alerted device. Pair with RegistryValueName and RegistryValueData to reconstruct persistence or configuration changes.
RegistryKey.description_zh: 被记录操作所针对的注册表键路径，仅在注册表相关证据行上填充，属于被警报设备的对象。与 RegistryValueName、RegistryValueData 配合可还原持久化或配置更改。

RegistryValueData.description: Data stored in the registry value involved in this evidence row, tied to the alerted device and action time. Inspect alongside the key and value name to assess persistence payloads or tampering.
RegistryValueData.description_zh: 本证据行所涉注册表值中存储的数据，关联被警报设备与操作时间。需结合键路径和值名称检查，以评估持久化载荷或篡改。

RegistryValueName.description: Name of the registry value the recorded action applied to, present on registry-type evidence rows. Qualify with RegistryKey and DeviceId before treating it as the involved value.
RegistryValueName.description_zh: 被记录操作所作用的注册表值名称，出现在注册表类证据行上。须结合 RegistryKey 和 DeviceId 限定后，再视为涉案值。

RemoteIP.description: Remote IP address the alerted entity connected to in this evidence row, describing a network counterpart rather than this device's own address. Use DeviceId or LocalIP to identify the internal endpoint.
RemoteIP.description_zh: 本证据行中被警报实体连接的对端 IP 地址，描述的是网络对端而非本机地址。可用 DeviceId 或 LocalIP 确定内部端点。

RemoteUrl.description: URL or FQDN that the alerted entity connected to, recorded on network or email evidence rows. Interpret with EvidenceDirection and TimeGenerated; URL presence alone does not prove a user interacted with it.
RemoteUrl.description_zh: 被警报实体连接的 URL 或 FQDN，记录于网络或邮件类证据行。需结合 EvidenceDirection 与 TimeGenerated 解读；URL 出现本身并不证明用户与其交互。

SHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the file the recorded action applied to in this evidence row. Use as the primary file pivot across alerts; treat co-occurrence as correlation, not proof of compromise.
SHA1.description_zh: 本证据行中被记录操作所作用文件的 SHA-1 哈希。可作为跨警报的主要文件锚点；同时出现只能视为关联，不能证明系统已被入侵。

SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the file involved in this evidence row. Prefer SHA1 when present, as this column is often unpopulated; do not assume it is absent because the file is benign.
SHA256.description_zh: 本证据行所涉文件的 SHA-256 哈希。若有 SHA1 应优先使用，因为该列常未填充；不要因文件良性就假定它必然为空。

ServiceSource.description: Product or service that provided the alert information for this evidence row, indicating which detection workload the entity came from. Use to scope queries and explain why entity-specific columns vary across rows.
ServiceSource.description_zh: 为本证据行提供警报信息的产品或服务，表明实体来自哪个检测工作负载。用于限定查询范围，并解释为何具体实体列在不同行间不一致。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that ingested the record, such as OpsManager, Linux, or Azure. Indicates collection plumbing rather than detection product; combine with ServiceSource when interpreting origin.
