SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集该记录的代理或采集通道，如 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure。反映的是采集链路而非检测产品；解读来源时应与 ServiceSource 结合。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this evidence record, as documented. It is the workspace identifier, not the directory tenant ID; use to scope queries to a workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 与这条证据记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID，如文档所述。它是工作区标识符，而非目录租户 ID；用于将查询限定到某个工作区。

ThreatFamily.description: Malware family classification assigned to the suspicious file or process in this evidence row. Indicates a detection label, not confirmation of infection; verify against other evidence before concluding impact.
ThreatFamily.description_zh: 本证据行中可疑文件或进程被归入的恶意软件家族。它表示检测标签，并非感染确认；下结论前应与其他证据核实。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when this evidence record was generated. Use as the primary event-time filter and for sequencing evidence around an alert; note it is record creation, not necessarily the underlying action time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 本条证据记录生成的 UTC 日期时间。可作为主要的事件时间过滤条件，并用于围绕警报对证据排序；注意它是记录生成时间，未必等于底层操作时间。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Title.description: Title of the alert associated with this evidence row, giving a human-readable summary of the detection. Useful for grouping and triage, but scope by AlertId since titles may repeat across alerts.
Title.description_zh: 与本证据行关联的警报标题，提供检测的可读摘要。便于分组和初筛，但因标题可能在多个警报间重复，应按 AlertId 限定范围。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, identifying the schema as AlertEvidence. Use in union queries to filter table origin; it carries no entity or time semantics.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属表的名称，表明其模式为 AlertEvidence。可在联合查询中用于筛选表来源；它不承载实体或时间语义。

AlertInfo.description: Alert records surfaced by Microsoft Defender services (Defender for Endpoint, Office 365, Cloud App Security, Defender for Identity), one row per alert occurrence with severity and MITRE categorization. Use it to enumerate, triage and summarize alerts, pivot by AlertId to related event tables, and group by ServiceSource, DetectionSource, Category or Severity. Boundaries: it holds alert metadata only, not raw telemetry or device/process detail. TenantId is the workspace ID, not a directory tenant ID.
AlertInfo.description_zh: 由 Microsoft Defender 系列服务（Defender for Endpoint、Office 365、Cloud App Security、Defender for Identity）生成的警报记录，每个警报事件一行，包含严重性与 MITRE 分类信息。可用于枚举、分诊和汇总警报，通过 AlertId 关联到相关事件表，并按 ServiceSource、DetectionSource、Category 或 Severity 分组。边界：该表仅保存警报元数据，不含原始遥测或设备/进程详情。TenantId 是工作区 ID，而非目录租户 ID。

AlertId.description: Identifier assigned to this alert record; join on it to correlate the alert with related events or duplicate alerts across services. Uniqueness is not guaranteed by schema.
AlertId.description_zh: 分配给该警报记录的标识符；可用于关联警报与相关事件，或跨服务关联重复警报。架构未保证其唯一性。

AttackTechniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique references attributed to the activity behind this alert, useful for mapping detections to adversary tactics when prioritizing and grouping incidents.
AttackTechniques.description_zh: 归因于触发该警报活动的 MITRE ATT&CK 技术编号，可用于将检测映射到攻击者战术，辅助事件优先级排序和分组。

Category.description: Threat or breach activity type this alert identifies, such as the kind of suspicious behavior detected; use it to bucket and trend alerts across services.
Category.description_zh: 该警报标识的威胁或入侵活动类型，即检测到的可疑行为类别；可用于跨服务对警报进行分类和趋势分析。

DetectionSource.description: Detection technology or sensor that flagged the notable activity for this alert; helps distinguish which detection plane produced the finding during triage.
DetectionSource.description_zh: 为该警报标记可疑活动的检测技术或传感器；有助于在分诊时区分是哪类检测层面产生的发现。

ServiceSource.description: Microsoft product or service that supplied this alert, such as an endpoint, email or identity defender workload; use it to scope alerts by originating security service.
ServiceSource.description_zh: 提供该警报的 Microsoft 产品或服务，例如终端、邮件或身份 Defender 工作负载；可用于按来源安全服务筛选警报。

Severity.description: Impact level (high, medium, low) assessed for this alert's threat or breach activity; use it to filter and prioritize which alerts to investigate first.
Severity.description_zh: 对该警报威胁或入侵活动评估的影响等级（高、中、低）；可用于筛选并确定优先调查哪些警报。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that ingested this alert row, for example an operations manager or Azure Diagnostics path; reflects ingestion plumbing rather than the threat itself.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 摄入该警报行的代理或采集通道，例如运维管理器或 Azure Diagnostics 路径；反映的是摄入管道而非威胁本身。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier for this alert record; used to scope queries to one workspace. Per documentation it is the workspace ID, not a directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 该警报记录的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符；用于将查询限定到单个工作区。根据文档，它是工作区 ID，而非目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when this alert record was generated; use it for time-range filtering, timelines and correlation with event tables at alert creation time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该警报记录生成的 UTC 日期和时间；可用于时间范围过滤、时间线构建，以及与事件表在警报产生时刻的关联。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Title.description: Human-readable title of this alert describing the detected threat; useful for quick triage, grouping similar alerts and searching by keyword across services.
Title.description_zh: 该警报的可读标题，描述检测到的威胁；可用于快速分诊、归并相似警报以及跨服务按关键字搜索。

Type.description: Name of the table this alert row belongs to; in this schema it identifies AlertInfo rows, useful to disambiguate when unioning alert data across multiple tables.
Type.description_zh: 该警报行所属表的名称；在此架构中标识 AlertInfo 行，当跨多个表联合查询警报数据时可用于区分来源。

Anomalies.description: Rows record anomalies generated by active Microsoft Sentinel anomaly analytics rules, one row per rule-produced anomaly finding with its own lifetime, score, and template metadata. Use it to triage unusual behavior, review which rule or template fired, and pivot into contributing entities, devices, IPs, users, and linked source data. StartTime/EndTime bound the anomaly window; Score and AnomalyReasons support prioritization. Neighboring security alert tables store alerts, not ML-scored anomalies.
Anomalies.description_zh: 此表的每一行记录由 Microsoft Sentinel 中的活动异常分析规则所生成的异常，每条规则产生的异常对应一行，包含其生命周期、评分和模板元数据。可用于研判异常行为、查看触发的规则或模板，并进一步关联涉及的实体、设备、IP、用户及链接的源数据。StartTime/EndTime 界定异常发生的时间窗口，Score 与 AnomalyReasons 可用于优先级排序。与该表相邻的安全警报表存储的是警报，而非机器学习评分的异常。

ActivityInsights.description: Dynamic JSON with insights about the activities that triggered this anomaly, helping analysts understand what behavior the rule found unusual. Interpretation of keys is name-derived; inspect the JSON structure in context.
ActivityInsights.description_zh: 动态 JSON，包含触发该异常的活动的洞察信息，帮助分析人员理解规则判定的异常行为。其键的含义基于字段名称推断，应在具体上下文中检查 JSON 结构后再做判断。

AnomalyDetails.description: Dynamic JSON with general information about the rule and algorithm that produced this anomaly plus explanatory detail. Use it to understand detection logic and as supporting context during triage.
AnomalyDetails.description_zh: 动态 JSON，包含生成该异常的规则与算法的总体信息及解释性细节。可用于理解检测逻辑，并在研判过程中作为辅助上下文。

AnomalyReasons.description: Dynamic JSON holding the detailed explanation of why this anomaly was generated. Use it to justify or challenge the finding; the exact schema is name-derived and should be inspected case by case.
AnomalyReasons.description_zh: 动态 JSON，记录该异常被判定为异常的详细原因。可用于佐证或质疑该发现；具体结构基于字段名称推断，需逐案检查。

AnomalyTemplateId.description: String identifier of the anomaly template that generated this row. Group or join by it to compare anomalies produced by the same template across users, devices, or time periods.
AnomalyTemplateId.description_zh: 生成该行的异常模板的字符串标识符。可据此分组或关联，以比较同一模板在不同用户、设备或时间段产生的异常。

AnomalyTemplateName.description: Human-readable name of the anomaly template behind this row. Useful for reporting and filtering by detection scenario when investigating which kind of anomaly occurred.
AnomalyTemplateName.description_zh: 该行对应异常模板的可读名称。在调查发生了哪类异常时，可用于报告和按检测场景过滤。

AnomalyTemplateVersion.description: String version of the anomaly template that generated this row. Compare versions over time to detect changes in detection behavior or scoring for the same template.
AnomalyTemplateVersion.description_zh: 生成该行的异常模板的字符串版本号。通过比较不同时间的版本，可发现同一模板在检测行为或评分上的变化。

Description.description: Free-text description of this generated anomaly. Use it as an at-a-glance summary during triage; treat its wording as rule-authored content, not verified incident facts.
Description.description_zh: 对该生成异常的自由文本描述。可在研判时作为快速概览使用；其内容由规则生成，不应视为已核实的事件事实。

DestinationDevice.description: Name of the destination device the anomaly concerns in this row. Use with SourceDevice and time fields to scope device-directed investigations; identity semantics are name-derived.
DestinationDevice.description_zh: 该行异常所涉及的源设备的名称。可与 DestinationDevice 及时间字段配合，限定针对设备的调查范围；标识含义基于字段名称推断。

DestinationIpAddress.description: Destination IP address associated with this anomaly. Use it to pivot into network connection telemetry; it identifies a target IP for this row, not proof of malicious traffic.
DestinationIpAddress.description_zh: 与该异常关联的目标 IP 地址。可据此关联网络连接遥测数据；它仅表示该行的目标 IP，并不证明流量具有恶意性。

DestinationLocation.description: Dynamic JSON describing the destination location associated with this anomaly. Treat the structure as name-derived; inspect keys before drawing geographic conclusions about the destination.
DestinationLocation.description_zh: 动态 JSON，描述与该异常关联的目标位置信息。其结构基于字段名称推断；在得出关于目标地理位置的结论前，应先检查其键。

DeviceInsights.description: Dynamic JSON with insights about the devices involved in this anomaly. Use to understand device-related contributing factors; key meanings are name-derived and should be checked in context.
DeviceInsights.description_zh: 动态 JSON，包含与该异常相关的设备的洞察信息。可用于理解设备方面的促成因素；其键的含义基于字段名称推断，应在具体上下文中核对。

EndTime.description: UTC time when this anomaly ended. Pair with StartTime to bound the anomaly window and to sequence activity relative to other events during investigation.
EndTime.description_zh: 该异常结束的 UTC 时间。可与 StartTime 配合界定异常时间窗口，并在调查中将活动相对于其他事件进行排序。

Entities.description: Dynamic JSON with all entities involved in this generated anomaly, such as accounts, hosts, or addresses. Use it to pivot from the anomaly to related telemetry; verify entity types per row.
Entities.description_zh: 动态 JSON，包含该生成异常涉及的全部实体，如账户、主机或地址等。可据此从异常转向相关遥测数据进行关联；应逐行核实实体类型。

ExtendedLinks.description: Dynamic list of links pointing to the data that generated this anomaly. Use it to open or query the underlying records; link targets are environment-specific, so validate before relying on them.
ExtendedLinks.description_zh: 动态列表，指向生成该异常的数据的链接。可用于打开或查询底层记录；链接目标因环境而异，依赖前应先验证。

ExtendedProperties.description: Dynamic JSON object of additional key-value pairs about this anomaly. Useful for rule-supplied context during triage; interpret keys cautiously as their semantics are name-derived, not documented here.
ExtendedProperties.description_zh: 动态 JSON 对象，包含有关该异常的额外键值对。可在研判时用作规则提供的上下文；其键的语义基于字段名称推断且此处未记录，解释时应谨慎。

Id.description: String identifier of this generated anomaly row. Use to reference, deduplicate, or join a specific anomaly across queries and workflows; uniqueness is asserted by the source, not guaranteed here.
Id.description_zh: 该生成异常行的字符串标识符。可用于在查询和工作流中引用、去重或关联某条特定异常；其唯一性由数据源声明，此处不作保证。

RuleConfigVersion.description: Configuration version string of the anomaly analytics rule that produced this row. Compare across rows to see whether rule configuration changed when anomaly behavior shifted.
RuleConfigVersion.description_zh: 生成该行的异常分析规则的配置版本字符串。可在不同行之间比较，以判断异常行为变化时规则配置是否发生了改变。

RuleId.description: Identifier of the anomaly analytics rule that generated this row. Group by it to compare anomalies from the same rule and to check rule behavior over time.
RuleId.description_zh: 生成该行的异常分析规则的标识符。可据此分组，以比较同一规则产生的异常并检查规则在不同时间段的行为。

RuleName.description: Human-readable name of the anomaly analytics rule that generated this row. Use for filtering, reporting, and communicating which detection produced the anomaly during investigation.
RuleName.description_zh: 生成该行的异常分析规则的可读名称。可用于过滤、报告，并在调查中说明是哪项检测产生了该异常。

RuleStatus.description: Status of the anomaly analytics rule that generated this row, such as flighting or production. Use it to judge rule maturity; the value set is rule-specific and should be verified in data.
RuleStatus.description_zh: 生成该行的异常分析规则的状态，如试运行或生产。可用于判断规则的成熟度；具体取值集合由规则定义，应在数据中核实。

Score.description: Numeric score assigned to this anomaly, used to rank or prioritize findings. Higher or lower meaning depends on the rule; treat the score as a relative signal, not proof of compromise.
Score.description_zh: 赋予该异常的数值评分，用于对发现进行排序或优先级划分。分值高低的含义取决于具体规则；应将评分视为相对信号，而非已确认遭到入侵的证据。

SourceDevice.description: Name of the source device the anomaly concerns in this row. Use with DestinationDevice and time fields to scope device-focused investigation; identity semantics are name-derived.
SourceDevice.description_zh: 该行异常所涉及的源设备的名称。可与 DestinationDevice 及时间字段配合，限定针对设备的调查范围；标识含义基于字段名称推断。

SourceIpAddress.description: Source IP address associated with this anomaly. Pivot into network and logon telemetry to see what acted from it; an IP alone does not establish attribution or malicious intent.
SourceIpAddress.description_zh: 与该异常关联的源 IP 地址。可据此关联网络和登录遥测数据，查看从中发起的活动；仅凭 IP 不能确定归属或恶意意图。

SourceLocation.description: Dynamic JSON describing the source location associated with this anomaly. Structure is name-derived; inspect keys before making geographic or network-origin conclusions.
SourceLocation.description_zh: 动态 JSON，描述与该异常关联的源位置信息。其结构基于字段名称推断；在得出地理位置或网络来源方面的结论前，应先检查其键。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that produced the anomaly record, such as Azure or Operations Manager. Use to scope anomalies by ingestion path and filter out unrelated collection pipelines.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成该异常记录的代理或采集通道，例如 Azure 或 Operations Manager。可用于按采集路径筛选异常，并排除无关的采集管道。

StartTime.description: UTC time when the anomaly window began, as determined by the generating rule. Use with EndTime to establish the detection interval and align underlying log queries.
StartTime.description_zh: 异常窗口按生成规则判定的 UTC 开始时间。与 EndTime 配合可确定检测区间，并对齐底层日志查询。

Tactics.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactics mapped to this anomaly by the rule, typically as string values. Use to group or prioritize anomalies by adversary objective during triage.
Tactics.description_zh: 规则为该异常映射的 MITRE ATT&CK 战术，通常以字符串形式给出。可用于在分诊时按攻击目标对异常进行分组或排序。

Techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques the generating rule associated with this anomaly. Use alongside Tactics to understand the modeled adversary behavior and guide investigation.
Techniques.description_zh: 生成规则与该异常关联的 MITRE ATT&CK 技术。可与 Tactics 配合，理解所建模的攻击行为并指导调查。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID that owns this anomaly record, per the documented schema. Treat as workspace scoping, not an Azure AD directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档模式，本字段为拥有该异常记录的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。应视为工作区范围限定，而非 Azure AD 目录租户标识。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the anomaly record was generated in the workspace. Use for time-bounded queries and to order detections; may differ from StartTime and EndTime.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该异常记录在工作区中生成的 UTC 时间戳。用于按时间范围查询并按顺序排列检测结果；可能与 StartTime 和 EndTime 不同。

Type.description: Table name value stamped on the record, expected to identify the Anomalies table. Use to confirm table provenance when querying across multiple Sentinel tables.
Type.description_zh: 记录上标注的表名称值，通常用于标识 Anomalies 表。可在跨多个 Sentinel 表查询时用于确认表的来源。

UserInsights.description: Dynamic JSON with insights about users associated with this generated anomaly. Name-derived interpretation: inspect its contents in context; do not assume fixed fields or that it proves user compromise.
UserInsights.description_zh: 与本条生成异常相关用户的洞察信息，以动态 JSON 存储。属基于名称的解读：应在具体上下文中查看其内容，不要假设字段固定，也不要据此断定用户已遭入侵。

UserName.description: Username for which the anomaly was generated, as reported by the rule. Use to pivot to that account's activity; resolve identity through other tables rather than trusting it alone.
UserName.description_zh: 按规则报告，生成本异常所针对的用户名。可用其关联该账户活动；应通过其他表解析身份，而不要仅依赖此字段。

UserPrincipalName.description: UPN of the user for which the anomaly was generated. Use to join to identity and sign-in data; correlate with UserName and validate before drawing conclusions.
UserPrincipalName.description_zh: 生成本异常所针对用户的 UPN。可用于关联身份和登录数据；应与 UserName 相互印证，在得出结论前进行验证。

VendorName.description: Name of the vendor that generated this anomaly, per documentation. Use to distinguish anomaly producers and filter to a specific detection source when triaging.
VendorName.description_zh: 按文档说明，生成该异常的厂商名称。可用于区分异常生成方，并在分诊时筛选特定检测来源。

WorkspaceId.description: ID of the Sentinel workspace associated with this anomaly record. Use to scope anomalies to a workspace; interpret as workspace scoping, not a directory tenant identifier.
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 与该异常记录关联的 Sentinel 工作区 ID。可用于将异常限定到某一工作区；应理解为工作区范围限定，而非目录租户标识。

AuditLogs.description: Audit logs from Microsoft Entra ID directory activity, recording who performed a directory operation, on which target objects, and whether it succeeded. Each row corresponds to one audit event such as user/group management, application changes, or role assignment. Use it to answer questions about directory change history, actor attribution, affected principals, and operation outcomes. Pivots include operation name, category, service, actor identity, target resources, and correlation ID. This table covers Entra ID directory audit records; sign-in, provisioning, network and device tables address different event scopes.
AuditLogs.description_zh: 来自 Microsoft Entra ID 目录活动的审核日志，记录谁执行了目录操作、操作作用于哪些目标对象以及操作是否成功。每行对应一条审核事件，例如用户/组管理、应用程序更改或角色分配。可用它回答目录更改历史、操作者归因、受影响主体及操作结果等问题。可用于操作名称、类别、服务、操作者身份、目标资源和关联 ID 等维度进行透视。该表覆盖 Entra ID 目录审核记录；登录、预配、网络和设备等表则针对不同的事件范围。

AADOperationType.description: Operation type of the Entra ID activity. Official values are Add, Update, Delete, and Other. Use it to group or filter directory changes by action class for a user, group, or application.
AADOperationType.description_zh: Entra ID 活动的操作类型。官方取值有 Add、Update、Delete 和 Other。可用于按操作类别对某个用户、组或应用程序的目录变更进行分组或过滤。

AADTenantId.description: Identifier of the Entra ID tenant where the audited directory activity occurred. Use it to scope investigations to a specific Entra ID tenant; this is distinct from the workspace TenantId in the schema.
AADTenantId.description_zh: 发生所审核目录活动的 Entra ID 租户的标识符。可用于将调查限定到特定 Entra ID 租户；它与架构中的工作区 TenantId 不同。

ActivityDateTime.description: UTC date and time when the audited directory activity was performed. Use it for time-bounding event searches, correlating directory changes with other logs, and reconstructing activity sequences around a change.
ActivityDateTime.description_zh: 执行所审核目录活动的 UTC 日期和时间。可用于按时间限制事件搜索、将目录变更与其他日志关联，以及还原某次变更前后的活动序列。

ActivityDisplayName.description: Human-readable activity or operation name for the directory event, such as creating a user or adding a group member. Use it to identify the specific directory action during investigations and to pivot across events of the same activity.
ActivityDisplayName.description_zh: 目录事件的可读活动或操作名称，例如创建用户或向组添加成员。可在调查中用于识别具体目录操作，并跨同活动的多个事件进行透视。

AdditionalDetails.description: Dynamic object holding supplementary details about the audited activity. Inspect its keys and values in the relevant resource or category context to find extra fields not surfaced as top-level columns.
AdditionalDetails.description_zh: 保存所审核活动补充详细信息的动态对象。请在相关资源或类别上下文中检查其键和值，以查找未作为顶层列呈现的额外字段。

Category.description: Category of the audit record; official documentation lists Audit as the currently supported value. Use it to confirm the record type when querying AuditLogs and when distinguishing directory audit entries from other log categories.
Category.description_zh: 审核记录的类别；官方文档指出当前支持的取值为 Audit。可在查询 AuditLogs 时用于确认记录类型，并区分目录审核条目与其他日志类别。

CorrelationId.description: Optional GUID passed by the client to correlate client-side operations with server-side operations. Use it to track related directory activity spanning multiple services or steps within one logical operation.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 客户端传入的可选 GUID，用于将客户端操作与服务器端操作关联。可用于跟踪同一逻辑操作内跨越多个服务或步骤的相关目录活动。

DurationMs.description: Duration field on the audit record. Official documentation states this property is not used and can be ignored; do not rely on it for timing or performance analysis in this table.
DurationMs.description_zh: 审核记录上的持续时间字段。官方文档说明该属性未被使用，可以忽略；不要在本表中依赖它进行计时或性能分析。

Id.description: GUID that uniquely identifies the audited directory activity. Use it to reference, deduplicate, or pivot a single audit event when correlating with other datasets or following up on a specific record.
Id.description_zh: 唯一标识所审核目录活动的 GUID。可在与其他数据集关联或跟进特定记录时，用于引用、去重或透视单条审核事件。

Identity.description: Identity from the token presented when the request was made; can be a user account, system account, or service principal. Use it to attribute directory activity to an actor, alongside InitiatedBy.
Identity.description_zh: 发出请求时所出示令牌中的身份，可以是用户帐户、系统帐户或服务主体。可与 InitiatedBy 一起将目录活动归因到操作者。

InitiatedBy.description: Dynamic object describing the user or application that initiated the directory activity. Inspect its keys in resource context to determine whether the actor was a user or app, then attribute changes accordingly.
InitiatedBy.description_zh: 描述发起目录活动的用户或应用程序的动态对象。请在资源上下文中检查其键，判断操作者是用户还是应用，并据此归因变更。

Level.description: Message type of the audit record; official documentation states this is currently always Informational. Use it mainly to confirm record severity level rather than to filter meaningful failures.
Level.description_zh: 审核记录的消息类型；官方文档指出当前始终为 Informational。它主要用于确认记录严重级别，而不是用于筛选有意义的失败。

Location.description: Datacenter location associated with the audited activity. Interpreted from the field name and official description; use it for coarse geographic context, not as precise actor location in directory investigations.
Location.description_zh: 与所审核活动关联的数据中心位置。依据字段名和官方描述解释；可用于粗略的地理上下文，不宜作为目录调查中精确的操作者位置。

LoggedByService.description: Service that initiated or logged the directory activity, such as Core Directory, Self-service Password Management, or Privileged Identity Management. Use it to segment activity by originating Entra service.
LoggedByService.description_zh: 发起或记录该目录活动的服务，例如核心目录、自助密码管理或特权身份管理。可用于按发起该活动的 Entra 服务对活动进行切分。

OperationName.description: Name of the directory operation recorded on the row. Use it with ResultType to filter specific operations and to assess whether that operation succeeded for actors or target resources.
OperationName.description_zh: 该行记录的目录操作名称。可与 ResultType 一起过滤特定操作，并评估该操作对操作者或目标资源是否成功。

OperationVersion.description: REST API version requested by the client when performing the directory operation. Use it as context for the client or tooling that generated the audit event, not as an indicator of security outcome.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 客户端执行目录操作时请求的 REST API 版本。可用作生成该审核事件的客户端或工具的上下文，而非安全结果的指标。

Resource.description: Resource value associated with the audit record. The .meta schema provides no description; treat its interpretation as name-derived and inspect the record context rather than assuming specific semantics.
Resource.description_zh: .meta 架构中该字段没有描述；应将对其含义的解释视为基于名称推导，并检查记录上下文，而不要假设具体语义。

ResourceGroup.description: Resource group value present on the audit record. The .meta schema provides no description; treat the interpretation as name-derived and confirm against the row's resource context before relying on it.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: .meta 架构中该字段没有描述；应将其解释视为基于名称推导，并在依赖它之前结合该行的资源上下文进行确认。

ResourceId.description: Resource identifier value on the audit record. The .meta schema provides no description; treat its interpretation as name-derived and verify the referenced resource from the row's other context fields.
ResourceId.description_zh: .meta 架构中该字段没有描述；应将其解释视为基于名称推导，并结合该行的其他上下文字段核实所引用的资源。

ResourceProvider.description: Resource provider value present on the audit record. The .meta schema provides no description; treat its interpretation as name-derived and confirm against the resource or category context.
ResourceProvider.description_zh: .meta 架构中该字段没有描述；应将其解释视为基于名称推导，并结合资源或类别上下文进行确认。

Result.description: Outcome of the directory activity. Official values are success, failure, timeout, and unknownFutureValue. Use it alongside ActivityDisplayName or OperationName to find failed or timed-out directory changes.
Result.description_zh: 目录活动的结果。官方取值为 success、failure、timeout 和 unknownFutureValue。可与 ActivityDisplayName 或 OperationName 配合，查找失败或超时的目录变更。

ResultDescription.description: Additional description of the result of the directory activity. Use it as supporting narrative when a result is failure or timeout, helping explain what occurred for the audited operation.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 对目录活动结果的附加描述。当结果为 failure 或 timeout 时，可用作辅助说明，帮助解释所审核操作发生的情况。

ResultReason.description: Describes the cause of failure or timeout results for the directory activity. Use it to distinguish the underlying reason when a Result value indicates failure or timeout during investigations.
ResultReason.description_zh: 描述目录活动失败或超时结果的原因。在调查中当 Result 值表示 failure 或 timeout 时，可用它区分底层原因。

ResultSignature.description: Secondary result field on the audit record. Official documentation states this property is not used and can be ignored; do not rely on it for determining whether a directory activity succeeded.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 审核记录上的次要结果字段。官方文档说明该属性未被使用，可以忽略；不要依赖它判断目录活动是否成功。

ResultType.description: Outcome of the audited Entra operation in this row; distinguishes successful activity from failures and is a primary filter when hunting for denied or errored administrative changes.
ResultType.description_zh: 该行所记录 Entra 审核操作的结果；用于区分成功活动与失败，是排查被拒绝或报错的管理变更时的首要筛选条件。

SourceSystem.description: Identifies the collection agent or source pipeline that produced the row (for example Azure diagnostics or a direct connector); helps confirm ingestion path rather than user or directory semantics.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 标识产生该行的收集代理或来源管道（如 Azure 诊断或直连连接器）；用于确认数据接入路径，而非用户或目录语义。

TargetResources.description: Dynamic payload describing resources changed by the audited activity, such as modified user, group, app, role or policy objects; parse to link an operation to its affected identity or object.
TargetResources.description_zh: 描述被审核活动更改的资源的动态载荷，例如被修改的用户、组、应用、角色或策略对象；解析后可将操作关联到受影响的身份或对象。

TenantId.description: Documented as the Log Analytics workspace identifier on the record, used for workspace scoping and cross-table joins; this is not the Microsoft Entra directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 文档中标注为记录所属的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符，用于工作区范围限定和跨表关联；它不是 Microsoft Entra 目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: Datetime the record was created in the log/export pipeline; use for time-range filters but compare with ActivityDateTime to understand ingestion lag versus actual event time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 记录在日志/导出管道中创建的时间；可用于时间范围过滤，但应与 ActivityDateTime 比较，以区分摄入延迟与实际事件时间。

Type.description: Name of the table the record belongs to; in this table it confirms the row came from AuditLogs and helps scope queries when several tables are unioned.
Type.description_zh: 记录所属表的名称；在此表中用于确认该行来自 AuditLogs，并在联合多表查询时帮助限定范围。

AzureDiagnostics.description: Heterogeneous Azure resource log table collecting diagnostics from services using Azure Diagnostics mode; one row per resource-emitted log event or aggregate report. Category, ResourceProvider and Resource must be scoped before any query since columns are sparse per service and not all coexist. Use for storage, key vault, firewall, APIM, PostgreSQL and other diagnostic events. For service-specific schemas or resource-specific mode resources, use dedicated tables instead.
AzureDiagnostics.description_zh: 异构的 Azure 资源日志表，通过 Azure Diagnostics 模式从各服务采集诊断日志；每行代表资源发出的一条日志事件或聚合报告。由于列按服务稀疏存在且并非每行共有，查询前必须先用 Category、ResourceProvider 和 Resource 限定范围。适用于存储、密钥保管库、防火墙、APIM、PostgreSQL 等诊断事件。若需服务专属架构或资源专属模式数据，应改用对应的专用表。

AdditionalFields.description: Additional resource-log properties stored in a dynamic property bag when they are not represented as dedicated columns. Inspect the available keys within the selected resource and Category before extracting values.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 以动态属性包保存未表示为独立列的资源日志属性。提取值之前，应先在选定资源与 Category 范围内检查实际存在的键。

Age_DatFrozenxid_d.description: Numeric age metric for a PostgreSQL database's frozen transaction ID horizon, surfaced from statistics or maintenance telemetry. Interpretation is name-derived; confirm meaning by inspecting ResourceProvider, Category and resource context before using.
Age_DatFrozenxid_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 数据库冻结事务 ID 上限的数值年龄指标，来自统计或维护遥测。该含义由名称推断；使用前请结合 ResourceProvider、Category 和资源上下文确认。

Age_DatMinmxid_d.description: Numeric age metric for a PostgreSQL database's minimum multixact ID horizon, surfaced from statistics or maintenance telemetry. Interpretation is name-derived; confirm meaning against ResourceProvider, Category and resource context.
Age_DatMinmxid_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 数据库最小多重事务 ID 上限的数值年龄指标，来自统计或维护遥测。该含义由名称推断；请结合 ResourceProvider、Category 和资源上下文确认。

Analyze_count_d.description: Numeric counter of manual analyze operations for a PostgreSQL table, from statistics collection events. Interpretation is name-derived; verify via ResourceProvider, Category and resource context before relying on it.
Analyze_count_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 表手动 analyze 操作的数值计数，来自统计收集事件。该含义由名称推断；依赖前请通过 ResourceProvider、Category 和资源上下文核实。

AppImage_s.description: String naming an application image associated with a logged event, reported by the emitting resource. Interpretation is name-derived; inspect ResourceProvider and Category to identify which service produced it and what image means there.
AppImage_s.description_zh: 与所记录事件关联的应用程序镜像名称字符串，由发出日志的资源上报。该含义由名称推断；请检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category，确定来源服务及此处的镜像含义。

AppType_s.description: String describing the application or client type tied to a logged event, reported by the emitting resource. Interpretation is name-derived; inspect ResourceProvider and Category before treating it as a specific application taxonomy.
AppType_s.description_zh: 描述与所记录事件相关的应用或客户端类型的字符串，由发出日志的资源上报。该含义由名称推断；在将其视为特定应用分类前请检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category。

AppVersion_s.description: String giving the version of an application or client associated with a logged event. Interpretation is name-derived; confirm through ResourceProvider and Category whether it refers to the emitting service or a connecting client.
AppVersion_s.description_zh: 与所记录事件相关的应用或客户端版本字符串。该含义由名称推断；请通过 ResourceProvider 和 Category 确认其指向的是发出日志的服务还是连接的客户端。

Application_name_s.description: String naming the client application that opened a database connection, typically from PostgreSQL or similar connection logs. Interpretation is name-derived; correlate with Client_addr_s, Pid_d and state columns under the matching Category.
Application_name_s.description_zh: 打开数据库连接的客户端应用名称字符串，通常来自 PostgreSQL 或类似连接日志。该含义由名称推断；应在对应 Category 下与 Client_addr_s、Pid_d 及状态列关联分析。

AssetIdentity_g.description: String identifier tying a logged event to an asset identity as reported by the emitting resource. Interpretation is name-derived; inspect ResourceProvider and Category to learn what asset type and identifier format this service uses.
AssetIdentity_g.description_zh: 将所记录事件与资产身份关联的字符串标识符，由发出日志的资源上报。该含义由名称推断；请检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category，了解该服务使用的资产类型与标识符格式。

AttackVectors_s.description: String summarizing attack vectors observed in a security report event, likely from DDoS or WAF telemetry. Interpretation is name-derived; inspect Category and ResourceProvider, and treat presence as observed traffic, not proof of successful compromise.
AttackVectors_s.description_zh: 安全报告事件中观察到的攻击向量摘要字符串，可能来自 DDoS 或 WAF 遥测。该含义由名称推断；请检查 Category 和 ResourceProvider，其存在仅表示观察到流量，不能证明系统已被攻陷。

Autoanalyze_count_d.description: Numeric counter of automatic analyze operations for a PostgreSQL table, from statistics collection events. Interpretation is name-derived; verify via ResourceProvider, Category and resource context before relying on it.
Autoanalyze_count_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 表自动 analyze 操作的数值计数，来自统计收集事件。该含义由名称推断；依赖前请通过 ResourceProvider、Category 和资源上下文核实。

Autovacuum_count_d.description: Numeric counter of autovacuum executions for a PostgreSQL table, from statistics collection events. Interpretation is name-derived; confirm via ResourceProvider, Category and resource context before using for maintenance analysis.
Autovacuum_count_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 表 autovacuum 执行次数的数值计数，来自统计收集事件。该含义由名称推断；用于维护分析前请通过 ResourceProvider、Category 和资源上下文确认。

Autovacuum_freeze_max_age_d.description: Numeric PostgreSQL setting for the maximum age before autovacuum is forced to freeze, from configuration or statistics events. Interpretation is name-derived; confirm via ResourceProvider, Category and resource context.
Autovacuum_freeze_max_age_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 中强制 autovacuum 执行冻结前的最大年龄配置数值，来自配置或统计事件。该含义由名称推断；请通过 ResourceProvider、Category 和资源上下文确认。

Autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age_d.description: Numeric PostgreSQL setting for the maximum multixact age before forced autovacuum freeze, from configuration or statistics events. Interpretation is name-derived; confirm via ResourceProvider, Category and resource context.
Autovacuum_multixact_freeze_max_age_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 中强制 autovacuum 冻结前的最大多重事务年龄配置数值，来自配置或统计事件。该含义由名称推断；请通过 ResourceProvider、Category 和资源上下文确认。

Backend_start_t.description: Timestamp when a database backend process started, from PostgreSQL session or activity logs. Interpretation is name-derived; pair with Pid_d, Client_addr_s and state columns under the same Category to trace session lifetime.
Backend_start_t.description_zh: 数据库后端进程启动时间戳，来自 PostgreSQL 会话或活动日志。该含义由名称推断；应在同一 Category 下与 Pid_d、Client_addr_s 及状态列配对，追踪会话生命周期。

Backend_type_s.description: String classifying the backend process type reported in database activity logs, such as client or background worker. Interpretation is name-derived; confirm allowed values against ResourceProvider and Category context rather than assuming a taxonomy.
Backend_type_s.description_zh: 数据库活动日志中后端进程类型分类字符串，如客户端或后台工作进程。该含义由名称推断；请结合 ResourceProvider 和 Category 上下文确认取值，不要预设分类。

Backend_xid_d.description: Numeric transaction ID for a backend session, from PostgreSQL activity events. Interpretation is name-derived; use with Pid_d and Database_name_s under a database Category to correlate concurrent activity.
Backend_xid_d.description_zh: 后端会话的事务 ID 数值，来自 PostgreSQL 活动事件。该含义由名称推断；可在数据库 Category 下与 Pid_d、Database_name_s 一起关联并发活动。

Backend_xid_s.description: String form of a backend session's transaction ID, from PostgreSQL activity events. Interpretation is name-derived; compare with Backend_xid_d and scope by Category, Database_name_s and Pid_d when correlating sessions.
Backend_xid_s.description_zh: 后端会话事务 ID 的字符串形式，来自 PostgreSQL 活动事件。该含义由名称推断；关联会话时请与 Backend_xid_d 比较，并用 Category、Database_name_s 和 Pid_d 限定范围。

Backend_xmin_d.description: Numeric minimum transaction ID horizon for a backend session, from PostgreSQL activity events. Interpretation is name-derived; use with Pid_d and Category context to assess transaction visibility, not as a security verdict.
Backend_xmin_d.description_zh: 后端会话的最小事务 ID 上限数值，来自 PostgreSQL 活动事件。该含义由名称推断；可结合 Pid_d 和 Category 上下文评估事务可见性，不可作为安全结论。

Backend_xmin_s.description: String form of a backend session's minimum transaction ID horizon, from PostgreSQL activity events. Interpretation is name-derived; compare with Backend_xmin_d and scope by Category, Pid_d and database columns.
Backend_xmin_s.description_zh: 后端会话最小事务 ID 上限的字符串形式，来自 PostgreSQL 活动事件。该含义由名称推断；请与 Backend_xmin_d 比较，并用 Category、Pid_d 和数据库列限定范围。

CallerIPAddress.description: IP address of the caller that initiated the operation recorded in the row. Use for source attribution and access review; combine with Caller_s, OperationName and TimeGenerated, and remember it is not the target resource's address.
CallerIPAddress.description_zh: 发起该行所记录操作调用方的 IP 地址。用于来源归因和访问审查；可结合 Caller_s、OperationName 和 TimeGenerated 使用，注意它并非目标资源地址。

Caller_s.description: String identity of the caller that initiated the logged operation, as reported by the emitting resource. Use with CallerIPAddress, OperationName and ResultType for attribution; scope by ResourceProvider and Category to know the identity format.
Caller_s.description_zh: 发起所记录操作调用方的标识字符串，由发出日志的资源上报。可与 CallerIPAddress、OperationName 和 ResultType 配合做归因；用 ResourceProvider 和 Category 限定范围以确定标识格式。

Category.description: Log category of the emitted record, defining which service-specific column set is populated on a row. Always filter by Category before querying service columns; values are resource/provider dependent and not globally enumerated here.
Category.description_zh: 所发出日志记录的类别，决定该行填充哪一组服务专属列。查询服务列前务必先按 Category 过滤；取值依赖资源/提供程序，此处不逐一枚举。

Client_addr_s.description: Network address of the client connecting to a database backend, from PostgreSQL connection or activity logs. Interpretation is name-derived; use with Application_name_s, Pid_d and Category to attribute sessions.
Client_addr_s.description_zh: 连接数据库后端的客户端网络地址，来自 PostgreSQL 连接或活动日志。该含义由名称推断；可与 Application_name_s、Pid_d 及 Category 配合归因会话。

Collection_time_t.description: Name-derived: timestamp when a monitoring or database metric row was collected by the pipeline, useful for ordering snapshots and comparing with TimeGenerated; verify service context before relying on it.
Collection_time_t.description_zh: 名称推断：监控或数据库指标行的采集时间，可用于对快照排序并与 TimeGenerated 对比，使用前建议先确认对应服务上下文。

Computer.description: Name-derived: hostname of the machine that produced the record. Use to scope events by device and correlate with logons or process activity; populated only by agents/services that report a computer.
Computer.description_zh: 名称推断：产生该记录的计算机主机名。可按设备限定事件并与登录或进程活动关联；仅由会上报计算机名的代理或服务填充。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier correlating related operations across services or sub-operations. Pivot to trace a request chain across rows; scope with ResourceId and time because values are provider-assigned and not global.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 用于跨服务或跨子操作关联相关操作的标识符。可据此串联同一请求链的多行；需结合 ResourceId 与时间限定范围，因取值由各服务分配而非全局唯一。

DNSLatencyMicroseconds_s.description: Name-derived: DNS resolution latency in microseconds reported by front door or similar edge logs. Use to investigate resolution slowness; the unit and meaning are name-inferred, so verify service context.
DNSLatencyMicroseconds_s.description_zh: 名称推断：由 Front Door 或类似边缘日志上报的 DNS 解析延迟（微秒）。可用于排查解析缓慢；单位与含义来自名称推断，使用前请确认服务上下文。

DatConnLimit_d.description: Name-derived PostgreSQL database connection limit for the database identified by Datid or Database_name. Use to interpret connection saturation against active session counts; confirm the database context on the row.
DatConnLimit_d.description_zh: 名称推断：由 Datid 或 Database_name 标识的 PostgreSQL 数据库连接数上限。可结合活动会话数判断连接饱和；使用前确认该行所属数据库上下文。

DatFrozenxid_d.description: Name-derived PostgreSQL frozen transaction ID for the database. Use with age metrics to assess transaction ID wraparound risk; meanings and units are inferred from the name and PostgreSQL context.
DatFrozenxid_d.description_zh: 名称推断：PostgreSQL 数据库的冻结事务 ID。可结合年龄指标评估事务 ID 回卷风险；含义与单位根据名称和 PostgreSQL 上下文推断。

DatMinmxid_d.description: Name-derived PostgreSQL minimum multi-transaction ID for the database. Use alongside other MXID counters and ages to gauge multixact wraparound exposure; verify database context before analysis.
DatMinmxid_d.description_zh: 名称推断：PostgreSQL 数据库的最小多事务 ID。可结合其他 MXID 计数与年龄指标评估多事务回卷风险；分析前确认数据库上下文。

DatabaseName_s.description: Database name for database-service log rows. Use to scope activity to a specific database and to join query or audit events across rows; absent for non-database resources.
DatabaseName_s.description_zh: 数据库服务日志中的数据库名。可将活动限定到特定数据库并跨行关联查询或审计事件；非数据库资源行通常为空。

Database_name_s.description: Name-derived PostgreSQL database name from statistics or session views. Use to scope backend, vacuum and query-stat rows to one database; may differ in casing from DatabaseName_s, which is a separate column.
Database_name_s.description_zh: 名称推断：来自统计或会话视图的 PostgreSQL 数据库名。可将后端、vacuum 与查询统计行限定到单个数据库；与 DatabaseName_s 为不同列，大小写可能不同。

Datdba_d.description: Name-derived PostgreSQL database owner identifier for the relevant database. Use to relate ownership to activity; it is a database property rather than the acting caller, so do not treat it as user identity.
Datdba_d.description_zh: 名称推断：相关 PostgreSQL 数据库的所有者标识。可用于关联归属与活动；该字段是数据库属性而非执行操作的调用者，勿当作用户身份。

Datid_d.description: Numeric database identifier for the PostgreSQL database in the row. Use to join statistics or session rows when names are unavailable; pair with database name columns for readability.
Datid_d.description_zh: 该行 PostgreSQL 数据库的数字标识。名称不可用时可用其关联统计或会话行；可配合数据库名列提升可读性。

Datid_s.description: String form of the PostgreSQL database identifier for the row. Use to correlate with Datid_d or database name columns; compare types explicitly because this is text, not numeric.
Datid_s.description_zh: 该行 PostgreSQL 数据库标识的字符串形式。可与 Datid_d 或数据库名列关联；因类型为文本，比较时需显式处理类型转换。

DeploymentVersion_s.description: Name-derived version of the deployed configuration or software for the emitting resource. Use to compare behavior across deployments; resource-specific meaning varies, so inspect resource type context.
DeploymentVersion_s.description_zh: 名称推断：发送日志资源所用部署配置或软件的版本。可用于比较不同部署版本的行为；含义随资源而异，建议结合资源类型上下文判断。

DropReasons_s.description: Name-derived reasons traffic was dropped, emitted by DDoS or network security reports. Use to classify denial or dropped packets; the value format is service-specific and should be inspected in context.
DropReasons_s.description_zh: 名称推断：由 DDoS 或网络安全报告给出的流量丢弃原因。可用于分类拒绝或丢弃的数据包；取值格式因服务而异，需结合上下文查看。

DurationMs.description: Operation duration in milliseconds for the logged activity. Use to compare latency across operations or resources and to surface outliers; availability and precise semantics depend on the emitting service.
DurationMs.description_zh: 所记录操作的耗时（毫秒）。可用于比较不同操作或资源的延迟并发现异常值；其可用性与确切语义取决于发送日志的服务。

ElasticPoolName_s.description: Name of the Azure SQL elastic pool associated with the database event. Use to scope database activity and performance rows to one pool; absent for non-elastic-pool resources.
ElasticPoolName_s.description_zh: 与数据库事件关联的 Azure SQL 弹性池名称。可将数据库活动与性能行限定到某个池；非弹性池资源行通常为空。

ErrorInfo_s.description: Name-derived error detail for a failed or degraded request or connection. Use to classify failure causes during triage; message structure is service-specific, so inspect the emitting resource context.
ErrorInfo_s.description_zh: 名称推断：请求或连接失败或降级时的错误详情。可用于排查时归类失败原因；消息结构因服务而异，需结合发送方资源上下文查看。

EventName_s.description: Name-derived name of the event recorded by the resource. Use to filter specific activity types before pivoting to caller or resource; its taxonomy is defined by the emitting service.
EventName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：资源所记录事件的名称。可先筛选特定活动类型再关联调用者或资源；其分类体系由发送日志的服务定义。

IPAddress.description: Name-derived IP address associated with the logged activity, emitted by certain network, DDoS or firewall services. Confirm whether it is source, destination or reporting address from the resource and category context.
IPAddress.description_zh: 名称推断：与所记录活动相关的 IP 地址，见于网络、DDoS 或防火墙类服务。需依据资源与 Category 上下文确认其为来源、目标还是上报地址。

Idx_scan_d.description: Name-derived count of index scans for the PostgreSQL table in the row. Use for index-usage and workload analysis; numeric form of Idx_scan, which is a separate string column.
Idx_scan_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该行 PostgreSQL 表的索引扫描次数。可用于索引使用与负载分析；与字符串列 Idx_scan 为不同字段。

Idx_scan_s.description: Name-derived string form of index scan count for the PostgreSQL table. Use when the service reports it as text; compare numerically with Idx_scan_d after casting.
Idx_scan_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该 PostgreSQL 表索引扫描次数的字符串形式。当服务以文本上报时使用；与 Idx_scan_d 比较前需先转换数值类型。

Idx_tup_fetch_d.description: Name-derived count of table rows fetched via index for the PostgreSQL table. Use to assess index efficiency; numeric counterpart of Idx_tup_fetch, which is a separate string column.
Idx_tup_fetch_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该 PostgreSQL 表通过索引读取的数据行数。可用于评估索引效率；与字符串列 Idx_tup_fetch 为不同字段。

Idx_tup_fetch_s.description: Name-derived string form of index-fetched row count for the PostgreSQL table. Use when reported as text; cast before comparing with Idx_tup_fetch_d.
Idx_tup_fetch_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该 PostgreSQL 表索引读取行数的字符串形式。当以文本上报时使用；与 Idx_tup_fetch_d 比较前需先转换。

JobId_g.description: Name-derived identifier of the job related to the row, such as an Automation runbook job. Use to group activity under one job and track its lifecycle; inspect resource and category context before assuming job type.
JobId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：与该行相关的作业标识（如自动化 Runbook 作业）。可用于按作业聚合活动并跟踪其生命周期；使用前请结合资源与 Category 判断作业类型。

Level.description: Severity or verbosity label of the emitting resource's event in this table; use with ResourceProvider and Category to filter serious conditions, since its value vocabulary is provider-specific and not fixed.
Level.description_zh: 本表中发出资源事件的严重性或详细级别标签；需结合 ResourceProvider 和 Category 过滤重要事件，其取值词汇因提供程序而异，并非固定。

Level_d.description: Name-derived numeric severity level for some resource's event; interpretation is name-derived, so inspect resource/category context before comparing or thresholding, and do not assume a shared scale across providers.
Level_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数值严重性级别；解释来自名称，比较或设阈值前需检查资源/类别上下文，不要假定各提供程序共享同一量纲。

LogicalServerName_s.description: Logical server name for database-related events in this table, identifying whose server an operation acted on; pivot with DatabaseName_s and clientIP_s when investigating database access or configuration changes.
LogicalServerName_s.description_zh: 本表中数据库相关事件的逻辑服务器名，标识操作作用于谁的服务器；调查数据库访问或配置变更时与 DatabaseName_s、clientIP_s 联动透视。

MG.description: Name-derived management group reference for an event; interpretation is name-derived, so inspect resource/provider context and do not treat it as a directory tenant identifier or as unique per row.
MG.description_zh: 名称推导的管理组引用；解释来自名称，需检查资源/提供程序上下文，不要将其视为目录租户标识或每行唯一。

ManagementGroupName.description: Name-derived management group name associated with an event's resource; interpretation is name-derived, so verify against resource and category context and avoid assuming it identifies a directory tenant.
ManagementGroupName.description_zh: 名称推导的与事件资源关联的管理组名；解释来自名称，需对照资源与类别上下文核实，不要假定其标识目录租户。

Message.description: Free-text message emitted within a resource's event, often carrying error or status detail; use it for keyword triage after scoping by ResourceProvider and Category, and treat content as provider-specific.
Message.description_zh: 资源事件中发出的自由文本消息，常含错误或状态细节；先用 ResourceProvider 和 Category 限定范围，再做关键词排查，内容因提供程序而异。

MitigationPeriodEnd_t.description: Name-derived end time of an event's mitigation period, likely for network-protection reports; interpretation is name-derived, so correlate with MitigationPeriodStart_t and inspect category before making duration claims.
MitigationPeriodEnd_t.description_zh: 名称推导的事件缓解期结束时间，可能用于网络防护报告；解释来自名称，需结合 MitigationPeriodStart_t 并检查类别后再推断时长。

MitigationPeriodStart_t.description: Name-derived start time of an event's mitigation period; interpretation is name-derived, so pair with MitigationPeriodEnd_t and provider context rather than assuming it marks a confirmed attack window.
MitigationPeriodStart_t.description_zh: 名称推导的事件缓解期开始时间；解释来自名称，需与 MitigationPeriodEnd_t 及提供程序上下文配合，不要假定其标记已确认的攻击窗口。

N_dead_tup_d.description: Name-derived count of dead tuples in a database statistics event; interpretation is name-derived, so confirm the metric's snapshot semantics and scope by server/database before using it to diagnose table bloat.
N_dead_tup_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库统计事件中死元组数量；解释来自名称，使用前需确认指标快照语义并按服务器/数据库限定范围，以诊断表膨胀。

N_live_tup_d.description: Name-derived count of live tuples in a database statistics event; interpretation is name-derived, so verify snapshot semantics and scope by server/database, using it to reason about table size rather than user activity.
N_live_tup_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库统计事件中活动元组数量；解释来自名称，需确认快照语义并按服务器/数据库限定范围，用于推断表大小而非用户活动。

N_mod_since_analyze_d.description: Name-derived count of row modifications since the last analyze for a database statistics event; interpretation is name-derived, so confirm scope and snapshot semantics before using it to assess statistics staleness.
N_mod_since_analyze_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库统计事件中自上次分析以来的行修改数；解释来自名称，使用前需确认范围与快照语义，以评估统计信息陈旧程度。

N_tup_del_d.description: Name-derived count of deleted tuples in a database statistics event; interpretation is name-derived, so confirm metric scope and snapshot timing before using it to explain data-volume changes.
N_tup_del_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库统计事件中删除元组数量；解释来自名称，使用前需确认指标范围与快照时点，以解释数据量变化。

N_tup_hot_upd_d.description: Name-derived count of heap-only tuple updates in a database statistics event; interpretation is name-derived, so verify scope and snapshot semantics before drawing performance conclusions from it.
N_tup_hot_upd_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库统计事件中仅堆元组更新数量；解释来自名称，得出性能结论前需核实范围与快照语义。

N_tup_ins_d.description: Name-derived count of inserted tuples in a database statistics event; interpretation is name-derived, so confirm the metric's scope and snapshot timing before using it to characterize write activity.
N_tup_ins_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库统计事件中插入元组数量；解释来自名称，使用前需确认指标范围与快照时点，以刻画写入活动。

N_tup_upd_d.description: Name-derived count of updated tuples in a database statistics event; interpretation is name-derived, so confirm scope and snapshot semantics and avoid treating it as a security action count.
N_tup_upd_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库统计事件中更新元组数量；解释来自名称，需确认范围与快照语义，不要将其视为安全操作计数。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation the emitting resource reports for this event, such as a read, write, or rule evaluation; use with ResourceProvider, Category, and ResultType to reconstruct what happened.
OperationName.description_zh: 发出资源为本事件报告的操作名称，如读取、写入或规则评估；结合 ResourceProvider、Category 和 ResultType 重建发生了什么。

OperationVersion.description: Version of the API or operation that produced this event, as reported by the emitting resource; compare across events to spot protocol or client-version differences during investigation.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 产生本事件的 API 或操作版本，由发出资源报告；调查中跨事件比较可发现协议或客户端版本差异。

OriginalPrimaryServerName_s.description: Name-derived original primary server name for database replication events; interpretation is name-derived, so inspect ReplicaRole_s and server context before concluding a failover occurred.
OriginalPrimaryServerName_s.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库复制事件中原主服务器名；解释来自名称，推断发生故障转移前需检查 ReplicaRole_s 与服务器上下文。

POP_s.description: Name-derived point-of-presence identifier for an event, likely for edge or gateway logs; interpretation is name-derived, so inspect resource and category context before using it for geolocation reasoning.
POP_s.description_zh: 名称推导的事件入网点标识符，可能用于边缘或网关日志；解释来自名称，用于地理定位推断前需检查资源与类别上下文。

Pid_d.description: Name-derived numeric process identifier reported in a database event; interpretation is name-derived, so scope by device, server, and time before joining sessions or attributing activity to a process.
Pid_d.description_zh: 名称推导的数据库事件中报告的数值进程标识符；解释来自名称，关联会话或归因进程前需按设备、服务器和时间限定范围。

Protocols_s.description: Name-derived protocol list associated with an event, likely for network-protection reports; interpretation is name-derived, so inspect category and resource context before drawing traffic conclusions.
Protocols_s.description_zh: 名称推导的与事件关联的协议列表，可能用于网络防护报告；解释来自名称，得出流量结论前需检查类别与资源上下文。

Query_start_s.description: Name-derived string start time of a database query in some events; interpretation is name-derived, so prefer Query_start_t where present and verify parsing before ordering or computing durations.
Query_start_s.description_zh: 名称推导的某些事件中数据库查询的字符串开始时间；解释来自名称，存在 Query_start_t 时优先使用，排序或计算时长前需验证解析。

Query_start_t.description: Typed start time of a database query reported in this event; use with Pid_d, Database_name_s, and Collection_time_t to order sessions and compute elapsed query time.
Query_start_t.description_zh: 本事件报告的数据库查询的带类型开始时间；结合 Pid_d、Database_name_s 和 Collection_time_t 可排序会话并计算查询耗时。

RawData.description: Unparsed original payload for an event, holding provider-specific content not exposed as typed columns; use it as a fallback for keyword or JSON inspection after scoping by resource and category.
RawData.description_zh: 事件的未解析原始负载，保存未以类型化列暴露的提供程序专属内容；按资源与类别限定范围后，可作为关键词或 JSON 检查的后备手段。

Region_s.description: Name-derived: Azure region string for the logged resource in service-specific rows. Use to scope regional activity or correlate deployments; confirm meaning via resource/category context.
Region_s.description_zh: 名称推断：服务专属行中所记录资源的 Azure 区域字符串。可用于按区域限定活动或关联部署；需结合 resource/category 上下文确认含义。

Remaining_mxids_till_emergency_autovacuu.description: Name-derived: numeric headroom of multixact IDs before emergency autovacuum for this row's database. Interpret only within a PostgreSQL-like category; verify against the resource/provider.
Remaining_mxids_till_emergency_autovacuu.description_zh: 名称推断：该行对应数据库在多事务 ID 达到紧急 autovacuum 前剩余的数量。仅在类 PostgreSQL 的类别中解读，并对照资源/提供程序确认。

Remaining_mxids_till_wraparound_d.description: Name-derived: numeric multixact IDs remaining before wraparound for this row's database. Use only with matching category/resource scoping; semantics are name-derived, not officially documented.
Remaining_mxids_till_wraparound_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该行对应数据库在多事务 ID 回卷前剩余的数量。仅在匹配的类别/资源范围内使用；语义来自名称推断，并非官方文档。

Remaining_xids_till_emergency_autovacuum.description: Name-derived: numeric transaction IDs remaining before emergency autovacuum. Use in database-health style analysis within the same resource/category; interpretation is name-derived, not official.
Remaining_xids_till_emergency_autovacuum.description_zh: 名称推断：在触发紧急 autovacuum 前剩余的事务 ID 数量。可在同一资源/类别内用于数据库健康类分析；解读来自名称推断，非官方。

Remaining_xids_till_wraparound_d.description: Name-derived: numeric transaction IDs remaining before wraparound for this database row. Investigate only after confirming category/resource; semantics are name-derived, not documented.
Remaining_xids_till_wraparound_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该数据库行在事务 ID 回卷前剩余的数量。须先确认类别/资源后再分析；语义来自名称推断，无官方文档。

ReplicaRole_s.description: Name-derived: role of a database replica (primary/standby-like) for the logged resource. Useful for topology questions; confirm exact values with resource/category context, as semantics are not officially documented.
ReplicaRole_s.description_zh: 名称推断：所记录资源的数据库副本角色（类似 primary/standby）。可用于拓扑问题；因语义无官方文档，请结合资源/类别上下文确认具体取值。

ReportType_s.description: Name-derived: type of report represented by the row (for example a periodic or summary report). Use to filter report-style events; exact values are service-specific and must be confirmed from context.
ReportType_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该行所代表的报告类型（例如周期报告或汇总报告）。可用于过滤报告类事件；具体取值由服务定义，需从上下文确认。

Resource.description: Resource name or identifier associated with the log record. Pivot to group activity by individual Azure resource; combine with ResourceProvider/Category since naming varies by service.
Resource.description_zh: 与该日志记录关联的资源名称或标识符。可按单个 Azure 资源聚合活动；因各服务命名不同，需与 ResourceProvider/Category 结合使用。

ResourceGroup.description: Azure resource group owning the logged resource. Use for scoping investigations to a deployment boundary and joining to other Azure activity tables by resource group.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 拥有所记录资源的 Azure 资源组。可用于将调查限定到部署边界，并按资源组与其他 Azure 活动表关联。

ResourceId.description: Fully qualified Azure resource identifier for the source of the log row. Key pivot for isolating one resource across categories and correlating with configuration or activity logs.
ResourceId.description_zh: 产生该日志行的 Azure 资源完整标识符。是隔离单个资源跨类别分析、并与配置或活动日志关联的关键关联键。

ResourceProvider.description: Azure resource provider namespace that emitted the row (for example a service namespace). Essential first filter because AzureDiagnostics is heterogeneous and columns differ between providers.
ResourceProvider.description_zh: 发出该行的 Azure 资源提供程序命名空间。作为首要过滤条件至关重要，因为 AzureDiagnostics 为异构表，不同提供程序的列各不相同。

ResourceType.description: Azure resource type of the logged resource. Use with ResourceProvider to scope schema expectations and to find activity for a specific resource kind.
ResourceType.description_zh: 所记录资源的 Azure 资源类型。与 ResourceProvider 一起用于限定字段结构预期，并查找特定资源类型的活动。

ResultDescription.description: Human-readable description of the operation outcome for this resource row. Useful for explaining failures or policy decisions; content is service-specific, so inspect OperationName and Category alongside it.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 该资源行操作结果的可读描述。可用于解释失败或策略判定；内容因服务而异，应同时查看 OperationName 与 Category。

ResultSignature.description: Short result signature or status code string for the logged operation. Use to compare outcomes across operations; exact format depends on the emitting service and should be validated in context.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 所记录操作的简短结果签名或状态码字符串。可用于跨操作比较结果；具体格式取决于发出服务，应在上下文中验证。

ResultType.description: Outcome classification of the operation for this row (for example success or failure style values). Central for filtering failed activity, but confirm allowed values per service/category rather than assuming.
ResultType.description_zh: 该行操作的结果分类（例如成功或失败类取值）。是筛选失败活动的核心字段，但应按服务/类别确认取值，不要臆断。

RunOn_s.description: Name-derived: target or host where an automation run executed, in automation-related rows. Use to locate execution endpoints; verify semantics against the RunbookName/JobId context of the same provider.
RunOn_s.description_zh: 名称推断：自动化相关行中执行运行的目标或主机。可用于定位执行端点；请结合同一提供程序的 RunbookName/JobId 上下文核实语义。

RunbookName_s.description: Name-derived: name of the automation runbook associated with the row. Pivot for investigating automation executions and correlating with job identifiers from the same provider.
RunbookName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：与该行关联的自动化 Runbook 名称。可用于调查自动化执行，并与同一提供程序的作业标识符关联。

Schemaname_s.description: Name-derived: database schema name for the logged database object. Use to scope table/statistics activity; interpretation is name-derived and requires database-category context.
Schemaname_s.description_zh: 名称推断：所记录数据库对象的架构名。可用于限定表/统计信息类活动；解读来自名称推断，需数据库类别的上下文。

Seq_scan_d.description: Name-derived: count of sequential scans on the referenced database object. Investigate performance-relevant activity; numbers and period are not documented, so confirm via category/resource context.
Seq_scan_d.description_zh: 名称推断：所引用数据库对象上的顺序扫描次数。可用于性能相关调查；数值与统计周期无官方文档，请通过类别/资源上下文确认。

Seq_tup_read_d.description: Name-derived: number of tuples read by sequential scans for the referenced object. Use alongside Seq_scan_d for database workload analysis; semantics are name-derived and not documented.
Seq_tup_read_d.description_zh: 名称推断：顺序扫描为所引用对象读取的元组数。可与 Seq_scan_d 一起用于数据库负载分析；语义来自名称推断，无官方文档。

ServerLocation_s.description: Name-derived: location or region string of the database server for the row. Use for regional scoping; confirm meaning against resource/category, as semantics are not officially documented.
ServerLocation_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该行数据库服务器的位置或区域字符串。可用于区域限定；因语义无官方文档，请结合资源/类别确认含义。

ServerType_s.description: Name-derived: type or edition classification of the database server emitting the row. Use to distinguish server variants; exact values are service-specific and should be validated in context.
ServerType_s.description_zh: 名称推断：发出该行的数据库服务器的类型或版本分类。可用于区分服务器变体；具体取值由服务定义，应在上下文中验证。

ServerVersion_s.description: Name-derived: version string of the database server for this row. Useful for version-specific analysis or identifying outdated servers; interpretation is name-derived, not documented.
ServerVersion_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该行数据库服务器的版本字符串。可用于版本相关分析或识别过时服务器；解读来自名称推断，无官方文档。

Session_duration_s.description: Name-derived: duration of a database session expressed as a string. Use for long-session investigation, but confirm units and derivation from category/resource context, as semantics are not documented.
Session_duration_s.description_zh: 名称推断：以字符串表示的数据库会话持续时间。可用于调查长会话，但单位与计算方式无官方文档，请结合类别/资源上下文确认。

Sku_s.description: Name-derived: service SKU/tier string reported by the emitting resource in this event, useful for narrowing which Azure resource configuration generated the log; verify against resource/provider context.
Sku_s.description_zh: 名称推断：本事件中发出资源上报的服务 SKU/层级字符串，可用于缩小是哪种资源配置产生该日志；需结合资源/提供商上下文核实。

SourceContinents_s.description: Name-derived: aggregated source-continent summary attached to this report, likely from a network-security or DDoS report event; treat as report metadata, not per-packet geography.
SourceContinents_s.description_zh: 名称推断：附着在该报告上的来源大洲汇总，可能来自网络安全或 DDoS 报告事件；应视为报告元数据，而非逐包地理信息。

SourceSystem.description: Log ingestion source system marker that records which collection channel delivered this row; use it to validate pipeline provenance before relying on the event content in investigations.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 日志摄取来源系统标记，记录哪条采集通道交付了该行；调查中在依赖事件内容前，用它校验数据来源链路是否可信。

State_change_s.description: String timestamp of a session/backend state transition for the database or service that logged this event; use with State_s to reconstruct connection lifetime changes in time order.
State_change_s.description_zh: 记录该数据库或服务会话/后端状态迁移的字符串时间戳；与 State_s 配合可按时间顺序重建连接生命周期变化。

State_change_t.description: Typed datetime version of the session state-transition time for this logged backend event; use it for precise time comparisons and joining with other typed timestamps rather than the string form.
State_change_t.description_zh: 本后端事件会话状态迁移时间的 datetime 版本；用于精确时间比较和与其他 datetime 字段关联，而非使用字符串形式。

State_s.description: Name-derived: current state label of the logged session or backend described by this row; inspect service/category context to interpret values, and pair with State_change times for lifecycle analysis.
State_s.description_zh: 名称推断：本行所描述的会话或后端当前状态标签；需检查服务/类别上下文来解读取值，并配合状态变更时间做生命周期分析。

StreamType_s.description: Name-derived: output stream type for the automation or job event that produced this row, indicating which log channel emitted it; use to separate informational, warning, or error output streams.
StreamType_s.description_zh: 名称推断：产生本行的自动化或作业事件的输出流类型，标识由哪个日志通道发出；可用于区分信息、警告或错误输出流。

SubscriptionId.description: Azure subscription GUID that owns the resource which emitted this log event; scope queries by it to isolate one tenant subscription's activity and to rule out cross-subscription noise.
SubscriptionId.description_zh: 发出该日志事件的资源所属 Azure 订阅 GUID；用它限定查询以隔离单一订阅活动，并排除跨订阅噪声。

Tables_analyzed_d.description: Name-derived count of tables analyzed in this database statistics snapshot event; a cumulative maintenance counter, not a security signal, useful for database maintenance baselining.
Tables_analyzed_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该数据库统计快照事件中被分析的表的数量；属累积维护计数器而非安全信号，可用于数据库维护基线分析。

Tables_autoanalyzed_d.description: Name-derived count of tables auto-analyzed for this database statistics event; indicates automatic maintenance volume and helps distinguish routine autovacuum/analyze activity from anomalous database work.
Tables_autoanalyzed_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该数据库统计事件中自动分析的表数量；反映自动维护量，有助于区分例行自动清理/分析与异常数据库活动。

Tables_autovacuumed_d.description: Name-derived count of tables autovacuumed in this database statistics snapshot; a routine maintenance metric best used for performance baselining rather than security detection.
Tables_autovacuumed_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该数据库统计快照中执行自动清理的表数量；属例行维护指标，更适合性能基线分析而非安全检测。

Tables_counter_d.description: Name-derived cumulative counter of table-events in this database statistics snapshot; inspect the emission resource and category to determine exactly which table activity it counts.
Tables_counter_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该数据库统计快照中表相关事件的累积计数器；需检查发出资源与类别以确定其具体统计何种表活动。

Tables_vacuumed_d.description: Name-derived count of tables vacuumed in this database statistics snapshot; indicates maintenance work performed in the reporting interval, not authorization or access activity.
Tables_vacuumed_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该数据库统计快照中执行清理的表数量；反映报告周期内的维护工作量，并非授权或访问活动。

TenantId.description: Documented workspace identifier for the Log Analytics workspace receiving this log; do not treat as Azure AD directory tenant ID, and use for workspace-scoped correlation and access boundaries.
TenantId.description_zh: 文档定义为接收该日志的 Log Analytics 工作区标识；切勿当作 Azure AD 目录租户 ID，可用于工作区范围关联与访问边界。

Tenant_g.description: Name-derived GUID tenant identifier carried by the emitting service in this event; inspect the resource/provider context to determine which tenant concept it represents before correlating identities.
Tenant_g.description_zh: 名称推断：本事件中发出服务携带的 GUID 租户标识；在关联身份前需检查资源/提供商上下文以确定其代表哪种租户概念。

Tenant_s.description: Name-derived string tenant value supplied by the logging service for this event; inspect category and resource context to decide whether it denotes a directory, service, or resource tenant.
Tenant_s.description_zh: 名称推断：日志服务为本事件提供的字符串租户值；需检查类别与资源上下文，判断其指目录租户、服务租户还是资源租户。

TimeGenerated.description: Datetime when Azure Monitor ingested this event into the workspace; primary time filter for all queries, though small ingestion delay means it may differ slightly from the resource's own event time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: Azure Monitor 将该事件摄取到工作区的 datetime；是所有查询的主要时间过滤字段，但摄取可能存在小延迟，故可能与资源自身事件时间略有差异。

TopSourceASNs_s.description: Name-derived aggregated list of top source autonomous-system numbers in this network report event; report-level summary rather than per-connection attribution, so treat as context, not proof of origin.
TopSourceASNs_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该网络报告事件中来源自治系统号前列的聚合列表；属报告级汇总而非逐连接归属，应作为背景信息而非来源证明。

TopSourceCountriesForDroppedPackets_s.description: Name-derived summary of top source countries for dropped packets in this network-security report; indicates where mitigation dropped traffic and should not be read as confirmed attacker geography.
TopSourceCountriesForDroppedPackets_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该网络安全报告中丢弃报文的来源国家前列汇总；表示缓解措施在哪些国家丢包，不应解读为已确认的攻击者地理位置。

TopSourceCountries_s.description: Name-derived aggregated top source countries observed in this report event; report-period summary used for situational awareness, not per-flow geographic proof of any single connection.
TopSourceCountries_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该报告事件中观测到的来源国家前列汇总；属报告期概况，用于态势感知，不能作为任一连接的逐流地理证明。

Total_remaining_mxids_d.description: Name-derived count of remaining multixact IDs before wraparound for this PostgreSQL-related event; a database health risk indicator, useful for maintenance monitoring rather than intrusion detection.
Total_remaining_mxids_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该 PostgreSQL 相关事件中环绕前剩余多事务 ID 数量；属数据库健康风险指标，适合维护监控而非入侵检测。

Total_remaining_xids_d.description: Name-derived count of remaining transaction IDs before wraparound in this database statistics event; indicates database exhaustion risk and is a capacity warning, not an access or security control.
Total_remaining_xids_d.description_zh: 名称推断：该数据库统计事件中环绕前剩余事务 ID 数量；表示数据库耗尽风险，是容量告警而非访问或安全控制信号。

TrafficOverview_s.description: Name-derived textual traffic-overview summary attached to this network-security report event; provides aggregate context about observed traffic patterns, not raw per-flow evidence.
TrafficOverview_s.description_zh: 名称推断：附着于该网络安全报告事件的文本流量概况摘要；提供观测流量模式的汇总背景，而非原始逐流证据。

Type.description: Table name marker identifying which workspace table this row belongs to, always AzureDiagnostics here; use it in unions and joins to distinguish diagnostics-mode rows from resource-specific tables.
Type.description_zh: 表名标记，标识该行所属工作区表，此处始终为 AzureDiagnostics；在联合与关联查询中用它区分诊断模式行与资源专属表。

Usesysid_d.description: Numeric PostgreSQL session user identifier reported by the database resource, describing which user owned the activity; name-derived, scope by DatabaseName_s/instance before correlating. Numeric variant of Usesysid_s.
Usesysid_d.description_zh: 由数据库资源上报的 PostgreSQL 会话用户数字标识，描述活动所属用户；该解释由字段名推导，关联前先按 DatabaseName_s/实例限定范围。是 Usesysid_s 的数字形式。

Usesysid_s.description: String rendering of the PostgreSQL session user identifier for the database session; name-derived, pair with Datid_s and instance context to attribute activity. String counterpart of Usesysid_d.
Usesysid_s.description_zh: 数据库会话 PostgreSQL 用户标识的字符串形式；由字段名推导，需结合 Datid_s 与实例上下文归属活动。是 Usesysid_d 的字符串对应项。

Vacuum_count_d.description: Numeric count of manual vacuum operations for the database from PostgreSQL activity metrics; name-derived. Compare against Autovacuum_count_d to see maintenance behavior on the resource.
Vacuum_count_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 活动指标中该数据库手动 vacuum 操作的数值计数；由字段名推导。可与 Autovacuum_count_d 比较，观察资源上的维护行为。

Vacuum_freeze_min_age_d.description: Numeric threshold used by vacuum to decide freezing of row versions in the PostgreSQL database; name-derived. Use with DatFrozenxid_d and remaining-xid fields when reasoning about transaction wraparound risk for the instance.
Vacuum_freeze_min_age_d.description_zh: PostgreSQL 数据库中 vacuum 决定冻结行版本所用的数值阈值；由字段名推导。分析实例事务回绕风险时，可与 DatFrozenxid_d 及剩余 xid 字段配合使用。

Vacuum_multixact_freeze_min_age_d.description: Numeric threshold at which manual vacuum freezes multi-transaction identifiers in the database; name-derived. Combine with Remaining_mxids_till_wraparound_d when assessing multi-xid wraparound proximity.
Vacuum_multixact_freeze_min_age_d.description_zh: 数据库中手动 vacuum 冻结多事务标识的数值阈值；由字段名推导。评估多 xid 回绕临近程度时，可与 Remaining_mxids_till_wraparound_d 结合。

WAFEvaluationTime_s.description: String duration for the web application firewall evaluating a request against its rules; name-derived and unit not documented. Scope by ResourceId/Category and correlate with ruleId_s and action_s to profile blocked traffic.
WAFEvaluationTime_s.description_zh: Web 应用防火墙将请求与其规则进行匹配评估所用的字符串时长；由字段名推导，单位未记录。按 ResourceId/Category 限定，并与 ruleId_s、action_s 关联以分析被拦截流量。

WAFMode_s.description: String mode of the web application firewall writing the record, indicating detection or prevention behavior; name-derived and value set must be inspected. Interpret alongside WAFPolicyID_s to explain whether a rule would block or only log.
WAFMode_s.description_zh: 写入该记录的 Web 应用防火墙字符串模式，指示检测或阻止行为；由字段名推导，取值集合需检查。结合 WAFPolicyID_s 判断规则会阻止还是仅记录。

WAFPolicyID_s.description: String identifier of the web application firewall policy that produced the log record; name-derived, resource-derived. Use to group records by policy and compare rule behavior across applications behind the same policy.
WAFPolicyID_s.description_zh: 产生该日志记录的 Web 应用防火墙策略字符串标识；由字段名推导，来源于资源。可按策略分组记录，比较同一策略下不同应用的规则行为。

Wait_event_s.description: String wait event describing what a PostgreSQL backend is waiting on at sample time; name-derived. Pair with Wait_event_type_s, State_s and Pid_d to diagnose blocking, lock contention or I/O stalls on the instance.
Wait_event_s.description_zh: PostgreSQL 后端在采样时等待的字符串事件；由字段名推导。与 Wait_event_type_s、State_s、Pid_d 配合，诊断实例上的阻塞、锁竞争或 I/O 停顿。

Wait_event_type_s.description: String category of the PostgreSQL wait event for the sampled session; name-derived. Group by this with State_s to separate lock, IO and client waits when investigating performance issues.
Wait_event_type_s.description_zh: 采样会话 PostgreSQL 等待事件的字符串类别；由字段名推导。与 State_s 一起分组，调查性能问题时区分锁、IO 与客户端等待。

Xact_start_s.description: String start time of the current transaction for the PostgreSQL session; name-derived, timestamp in string form. Compare with Query_start_s and State_s to find long-running transactions holding locks.
Xact_start_s.description_zh: PostgreSQL 会话当前事务的字符串开始时间；由字段名推导，为字符串形式时间戳。与 Query_start_s、State_s 比较，找出长时间运行并持有锁的事务。

Xact_start_t.description: Typed datetime start of the current transaction for the PostgreSQL session; name-derived. Use for time-window filtering and comparing transaction age against Query_start_t and State_change_t.
Xact_start_t.description_zh: PostgreSQL 会话当前事务的类型化日期时间开始值；由字段名推导。用于时间段过滤，并将事务时长与 Query_start_t、State_change_t 对比。

_ResourceId.description: Documented unique identifier of the Azure resource the record is associated with. Use to scope ambiguous AzureDiagnostics rows to one resource and join with ResourceId when pivoting by provider or category.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 官方记录的、该记录所关联 Azure 资源的唯一标识。用于将含糊的 AzureDiagnostics 行限定到单个资源，并在按提供程序或类别透视时与 ResourceId 关联。

_schema_s.description: String indicating the schema or column layout the record was written under; name-derived. Useful to separate records emitted by different service schemas within the heterogeneous AzureDiagnostics table.
_schema_s.description_zh: 表示写入该记录所用架构或列布局的字符串；由字段名推导。可用于在异构 AzureDiagnostics 表中区分不同服务架构写入的记录。

actionCount_d.description: Numeric count of actions associated with the logged event, often policy or firewall activity; name-derived and unit/meaning not documented. Treat as an aggregate indicator requiring Category and ResourceProvider context.
actionCount_d.description_zh: 与所记录事件关联的操作数值计数，常为策略或防火墙活动；由字段名推导，单位/含义未记录。应作为聚合指标，需结合 Category 与 ResourceProvider 上下文。

action_s.description: String action taken by the resource for the logged event, such as allow or block for firewall records; value set is service-specific. Scope by ResourceProvider/Category before interpreting, since semantics differ across services.
action_s.description_zh: 资源对所记录事件执行的字符串操作，例如防火墙记录的允许或阻止；取值集合因服务而异。解释前按 ResourceProvider/Category 限定，因为不同服务语义不同。

addedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g.description: String object identifier of the principal granted an access policy on a key vault or similar resource; name-derived. Pair with addedAccessPolicy_TenantId_g to identify who received access in the logged change.
addedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g.description_zh: 被授予密钥保管库或类似资源访问策略的主体字符串对象标识；由字段名推导。与 addedAccessPolicy_TenantId_g 配合，识别所记录变更中获得访问权限的主体。

addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_certificat.description: String permission set for certificates added in the access policy change; name-derived. Review with the other addedAccessPolicy permission fields to assess least-privilege violations on the resource.
addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_certificat.description_zh: 访问策略变更中新增的证书字符串权限集；由字段名推导。与其他 addedAccessPolicy 权限字段一起审查，评估资源上的最小权限违规。

addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_keys_s.description: String permission set for keys added in the access policy change; name-derived. Combine with addedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g to see who gained key operations and whether that is risky.
addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_keys_s.description_zh: 访问策略变更中新增的密钥字符串权限集；由字段名推导。与 addedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g 结合，查看谁获得了密钥操作权限以及是否具有风险。

addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_secrets_s.description: String permission set for secrets added in the access policy change; name-derived. Use with the object and tenant identifiers to audit new secret read or write grants on the resource.
addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_secrets_s.description_zh: 访问策略变更中新增的机密字符串权限集；由字段名推导。与对象和租户标识配合，审计资源上新增的机密读取或写入授权。

addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_storage_s.description: String permission set for storage operations added in the access policy change; name-derived, applicable to storage-related resources. Evaluate together with the added principal identifiers in the same record.
addedAccessPolicy_Permissions_storage_s.description_zh: 访问策略变更中新增的存储操作字符串权限集；由字段名推导，适用于存储相关资源。与同一条记录中新增的主体标识一起评估。

addedAccessPolicy_TenantId_g.description: String tenant identifier of the principal added in the access policy change, as recorded by the resource; name-derived, distinct from the workspace TenantId column. Use with addedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g for cross-tenant access review.
addedAccessPolicy_TenantId_g.description_zh: 访问策略变更中新增主体由资源记录的字符串租户标识；由字段名推导，不同于工作区 TenantId 列。与 addedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g 一起用于跨租户访问审查。

addrAuthType_s.description: String describing how the client address was authenticated for the connection; name-derived, service-specific. Scope by ResourceProvider/Category and correlate with sourcePublicIpAddress_s to interpret access control decisions.
addrAuthType_s.description_zh: 描述连接中客户端地址如何通过认证的字符串；由字段名推导，因服务而异。按 ResourceProvider/Category 限定，并与 sourcePublicIpAddress_s 关联以解释访问控制决策。

apiId_s.description: String identifier of the API definition handling the request in API Management-style records; name-derived. Group by it with operationId_s and responseCode_d to profile per-API traffic and failures.
apiId_s.description_zh: API Management 类记录中处理请求的 API 定义字符串标识；由字段名推导。可按其分组，并结合 operationId_s 与 responseCode_d 分析每个 API 的流量与失败。

apiRevision_s.description: Name-derived: API revision label associated with an API Management request or resource event. Inspect API Management category context to confirm meaning; useful for narrowing which API revision generated the log.
apiRevision_s.description_zh: 名称推断：与 API 管理请求或资源事件关联的 API 修订版本标签。需结合 API 管理类别上下文确认含义；可用于缩小产生日志的 API 修订范围。

apimSubscriptionId_s.description: Name-derived: subscription identifier used by API Management for a request, not an Azure subscription. Inspect API Management resource/category context; useful to attribute API calls to a client subscription key.
apimSubscriptionId_s.description_zh: 名称推断：API 管理用于请求的订阅标识，并非 Azure 订阅。需结合 API 管理资源或类别上下文；可用于将 API 调用归因到客户端订阅密钥。

appliedAssignmentId_g.description: Name-derived: identifier of the assignment applied in an authorization evaluation. Inspect resource and operation context to confirm policy semantics; useful when tracing which assignment allowed or denied an action.
appliedAssignmentId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：授权评估中应用的分配标识。需结合资源与操作上下文确认策略语义；可用于追踪是哪个分配允许或拒绝了操作。

backendMethod_s.description: Name-derived: HTTP method sent to a backend during request processing. Inspect API Management or Front Door category context; useful to compare frontend and backend request methods for a failing call.
backendMethod_s.description_zh: 名称推断：请求处理期间发往后端的 HTTP 方法。需结合 API 管理或 Front Door 类别上下文；可用于对比前端与后端请求方法以排查失败调用。

backendPoolName_s.description: Name-derived: name of the backend pool selected for a load-balanced request. Inspect load balancer or Application Gateway category context; useful to attribute traffic to a specific backend pool.
backendPoolName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：负载均衡请求所选后端池的名称。需结合负载均衡器或 Application Gateway 类别上下文；可用于将流量归因到特定后端池。

backendProtocol_s.description: Name-derived: protocol used between the gateway and a backend origin. Inspect resource/category context to confirm allowed values; useful when diagnosing TLS or protocol mismatches on backend connections.
backendProtocol_s.description_zh: 名称推断：网关与后端源之间使用的协议。需结合资源或类别上下文确认取值；可用于诊断后端连接上的 TLS 或协议不匹配问题。

backendResponseCode_d.description: Name-derived numeric code returned by a backend service. Inspect the category context to know the code system; useful to separate backend failures from gateway-generated errors.
backendResponseCode_d.description_zh: 名称推断：后端服务返回的数字代码。需结合类别上下文确认代码体系；可用于区分后端失败与网关自身产生的错误。

backendSettingName_s.description: Name-derived: name of the backend setting applied to a request. Inspect Application Gateway or Front Door category context; useful to tie routing behavior to a configured backend setting.
backendSettingName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：应用于请求的后端设置名称。需结合 Application Gateway 或 Front Door 类别上下文；可用于将路由行为关联到已配置的后端设置。

backendTime_d.description: Name-derived numeric latency spent by a backend processing a request. Units are unit-not-documented; inspect category context. Useful to compare backend latency against total request latency.
backendTime_d.description_zh: 名称推断：后端处理请求所耗数字延迟，单位未在文档中说明，需结合类别上下文。可用于将后端延迟与请求总延迟比较。
