backendUrl_s.description: Name-derived: URL of the backend target contacted for a request. Inspect resource/category context; useful to identify the origin behind a failing or suspicious request path.
backendUrl_s.description_zh: 名称推断：请求所联系的后端目标 URL。需结合资源或类别上下文；可用于识别失败或可疑请求路径背后的源站。

cacheStatus_s.description: Name-derived: cache outcome for a request, such as hit or miss. Values are service-specific and not documented here; inspect category context. Useful to explain response latency differences.
cacheStatus_s.description_zh: 名称推断：请求的缓存结果（如命中或未命中）。取值取决于具体服务且此处未记录，需结合类别上下文；可用于解释响应延迟差异。

cacheTime_d.description: Name-derived numeric time associated with cache processing of a request. Units are not documented; inspect category context. Useful alongside cacheStatus for latency analysis.
cacheTime_d.description_zh: 名称推断：与请求缓存处理相关的数字时间，单位未记录，需结合类别上下文。可与 cacheStatus 一起用于延迟分析。

cache_s.description: Name-derived: cache-related value or indicator for a request. Semantics vary by service and are not documented; inspect resource/category context before interpreting. Useful as a secondary cache pivot.
cache_s.description_zh: 名称推断：请求的缓存相关取值或指示。语义因服务而异且未记录，解释前需结合资源或类别上下文；可作为辅助缓存维度。

certificatePolicyProperties_secretProper.description: Name-derived: type of secret associated with a certificate policy configuration. Inspect Key Vault style resource/category context; useful when reviewing certificate policy changes rather than runtime traffic.
certificatePolicyProperties_secretProper.description_zh: 名称推断：与证书策略配置关联的机密类型。需结合 Key Vault 类资源或类别上下文；适用于审查证书策略变更而非运行时流量。

certificateProperties_attributes_enabled.description: Name-derived boolean indicating whether a certificate's attributes mark it enabled. Inspect resource and operation context; useful when checking certificate state after management-plane changes.
certificateProperties_attributes_enabled.description_zh: 名称推断布尔值：表示证书属性是否标记为启用。需结合资源与操作上下文；可用于检查管理面变更后的证书状态。

certificateProperties_exp_t.description: Name-derived datetime for certificate expiration. Inspect Key Vault style resource/category context to confirm semantics; useful to find certificates nearing or past expiry.
certificateProperties_exp_t.description_zh: 名称推断日期时间：证书到期时间。需结合 Key Vault 类资源或类别上下文确认语义；可用于查找临近或已过期的证书。

certificateProperties_nbf_t.description: Name-derived datetime for the certificate not-before validity start. Inspect resource/category context to confirm; useful to determine whether a certificate was valid at event time.
certificateProperties_nbf_t.description_zh: 名称推断日期时间：证书生效起始时间（not-before）。需结合资源或类别上下文确认；可用于判断事件发生时证书是否有效。

certificateProperties_sha1_s.description: Name-derived SHA-1 thumbprint of a certificate. Inspect Key Vault style resource/category context; useful to correlate a logged certificate with inventory by thumbprint.
certificateProperties_sha1_s.description_zh: 名称推断：证书的 SHA-1 指纹。需结合 Key Vault 类资源或类别上下文；可用于按指纹将日志中的证书与清单关联。

certificateProperties_sha256_s.description: Name-derived SHA-256 thumbprint of a certificate. Inspect resource/category context to confirm; useful for precise certificate correlation where SHA-1 is ambiguous.
certificateProperties_sha256_s.description_zh: 名称推断：证书的 SHA-256 指纹。需结合资源或类别上下文确认；可用于在 SHA-1 存在歧义时精确关联证书。

certificateProperties_subject_s.description: Name-derived certificate subject distinguished name. Inspect Key Vault style resource/category context; useful to identify which certificate entity an operation or event concerns.
certificateProperties_subject_s.description_zh: 名称推断：证书主题可分辨名称。需结合 Key Vault 类资源或类别上下文；可用于识别操作或事件涉及的证书实体。

clientCountry_s.description: Name-derived country associated with the client of a request. Value origin is not documented; inspect category context. Useful for geographic pivots on edge or gateway traffic.
clientCountry_s.description_zh: 名称推断：请求客户端关联的国家或地区。取值来源未记录，需结合类别上下文；可用于边缘或网关流量的地理维度分析。

clientIP_s.description: IP address of the client that made the logged request. Scoping depends on the service and event, and the address may be a proxy or NAT egress; use with TimeGenerated and resource context, not as proof of user identity.
clientIP_s.description_zh: 发起所记录请求的客户端 IP 地址。作用域取决于服务和事件，且可能是代理或 NAT 出口地址；需结合 TimeGenerated 与资源上下文使用，不能作为用户身份的证明。

clientInfo_AppId_g.description: Name-derived application ID reported by the calling client. Inspect resource/category and identity context; useful to attribute requests to an application registration without treating it as verified user identity.
clientInfo_AppId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：调用客户端报告的应用程序 ID。需结合资源、类别与身份上下文；可用于将请求归因到应用注册，但不能视为已验证的用户身份。

clientInfo_ClientRequestId_g.description: Name-derived client-supplied request correlation identifier. Inspect resource/category context to confirm; useful to trace a single client request across multiple logged operations.
clientInfo_ClientRequestId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：客户端提供的请求关联标识。需结合资源或类别上下文确认；可用于跨多条日志操作追踪同一客户端请求。

clientInfo_IpAddress_s.description: Name-derived from clientInfo nested property: source IP address of the client that made the request, as recorded by the emitting service. Inspect the row's ResourceProvider and Category to confirm which service populated it, then use it for source-IP pivoting and correlation with CallerIPAddress or clientIp_s.
clientInfo_IpAddress_s.description_zh: 由 clientInfo 嵌套属性名推断：发起请求的客户端源 IP 地址，由生成日志的服务记录。需结合该行的 ResourceProvider 和 Category 判断具体由哪个服务写入，再用于源 IP 关联分析，可与 CallerIPAddress 或 clientIp_s 互相印证。

clientInfo_Issuer_s.description: Name-derived from clientInfo nested property: token issuer of the authenticated client, typically a security token service identifier. Use with clientInfo_ObjectId_g and clientInfo_TenantId_g when tracing caller identity, and confirm the emitting service via ResourceProvider and Category before relying on it.
clientInfo_Issuer_s.description_zh: 由 clientInfo 嵌套属性名推断：已认证客户端的令牌颁发者，通常是安全令牌服务标识。追踪调用方身份时可与 clientInfo_ObjectId_g、clientInfo_TenantId_g 配合使用，使用前应通过 ResourceProvider 和 Category 确认具体服务上下文。

clientInfo_ObjectId_g.description: Name-derived from clientInfo nested property: object identifier of the calling principal, such as a user, service principal, or managed identity. Best used to pivot to a specific caller's activity, but confirm the emitting service and category because the identifier's meaning depends on the provider.
clientInfo_ObjectId_g.description_zh: 由 clientInfo 嵌套属性名推断：调用主体（用户、服务主体或托管标识）的对象标识符。最适合用于定位某一调用方的活动，但其含义依赖于具体服务，需确认写入日志的服务和类别后再使用。

clientInfo_PrincipalName_s.description: Name-derived from clientInfo nested property: user principal name or principal display name of the caller. Use it to identify the acting account in identity or access events, and pair it with clientInfo_ObjectId_g and clientInfo_TenantId_g for a fuller caller picture.
clientInfo_PrincipalName_s.description_zh: 由 clientInfo 嵌套属性名推断：调用方的用户主体名称或主体显示名。可用于在身份或访问事件中识别操作账号，建议与 clientInfo_ObjectId_g、clientInfo_TenantId_g 联用，以较完整还原调用方信息。

clientInfo_TenantId_g.description: Name-derived from clientInfo nested property: tenant identifier of the calling principal in the service's own identity context. Do not equate it with the workspace-scoped TenantId column; use it to group activity by caller tenant and validate with the emitting service's documented schema.
clientInfo_TenantId_g.description_zh: 由 clientInfo 嵌套属性名推断：调用主体在服务自身身份上下文中的租户标识符。不要将其等同于工作区范围的 TenantId 列；可用于按调用方租户聚合活动，并需结合该服务官方文档核实其语义。

clientInfo_s.description: Service-emitted structured client information, often serialized JSON or delimited text describing the caller. For services that populate the clientInfo_* sibling columns, prefer those; otherwise parse this field carefully and verify against the row's ResourceProvider and Category.
clientInfo_s.description_zh: 服务写入的结构化客户端信息，通常为序列化 JSON 或分隔文本，描述调用方。若同一服务已生成 clientInfo_* 系列列，应优先使用这些列；否则需谨慎解析本字段，并结合该行 ResourceProvider 和 Category 核实其含义。

clientIp_s.description: Source IP address of the client associated with the event. Useful for tracking external or internal callers across Azure resources, correlating with CallerIPAddress, and feeding IP-based threat intelligence, while remembering that IP alone does not prove which account acted.
clientIp_s.description_zh: 与该事件关联的客户端源 IP 地址。可用于跨 Azure 资源追踪外部或内部调用方，与 CallerIPAddress 关联，并接入基于 IP 的情报匹配；但需注意仅凭 IP 不能证明具体是哪个账号在操作。

clientPort_d.description: Client-side source port number for the connection as a numeric value. Use it with client IP and backend or destination address to distinguish parallel connections from the same host when reconstructing session activity in network or database logs.
clientPort_d.description_zh: 连接的客户端源端口号，数值类型。在网络或数据库日志中重建会话时，可与客户端 IP 及后端或目标地址配合，区分同一主机的多条并发连接。

clientPort_s.description: Name-derived: client-side source port expressed as text, likely from services that log connection metadata as strings. Inspect the emitting ResourceProvider and Category to confirm it means the caller's port, and cast to a number if numeric comparison is needed.
clientPort_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：以文本形式记录的客户端源端口，可能来自以字符串记录连接元数据的服务。需查看生成日志的 ResourceProvider 和 Category，确认其含义为调用方端口，如需数值比较应先转换类型。

clientProtocol_s.description: Name-derived: protocol used by the client connection, such as a transport or application protocol label from the emitting service. Verify which service and category wrote it, then use it to compare or filter client-facing protocol usage across connection events.
clientProtocol_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：客户端连接使用的协议，可能是生成服务记录的一种传输层或应用层协议标签。需确认由哪个服务和类别写入，再用于在连接事件中对比或筛选客户端侧协议使用情况。

clientResponseTime_d.description: Name-derived: time measurement related to the client side of a request, likely client-observed latency or wait in service-defined units. Confirm units and meaning via the emitting service's documentation before using it for performance comparisons or timeouts.
clientResponseTime_d.description_zh: 由名称推断：与请求客户端侧相关的时间度量，可能是客户端观测到的延迟或等待时间，单位由服务定义。用于性能比较或超时分析前，应查阅对应服务文档确认单位和含义。

clientTime_d.description: Name-derived: time measurement attributed to client processing, in units defined by the emitting service, not necessarily milliseconds. Treat as a numeric performance metric and validate its unit and semantics against service documentation before thresholding or trending.
clientTime_d.description_zh: 由名称推断：归属于客户端处理的时间度量，单位由生成服务定义，不一定是毫秒。应将其视为数值性能指标，在设置阈值或做趋势分析前查阅服务文档确认单位与语义。

clientTlsVersion_s.description: Name-derived: TLS or SSL protocol version negotiated for the client connection, useful for spotting deprecated or weak transport security. Confirm the emitting service via ResourceProvider and Category, and compare against service-specific TLS fields before concluding policy violations.
clientTlsVersion_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：客户端连接协商使用的 TLS 或 SSL 协议版本，可用于发现过时或弱传输安全。应通过 ResourceProvider 和 Category 确认生成服务，并与该服务其他 TLS 字段对比后再判定策略违规。

code_s.description: Service-defined status or result code for the logged operation, often numeric or short string. Interpret only in the context of the emitting ResourceProvider and Category, since identical code values mean different things across Azure services; pair with ResultType or status fields.
code_s.description_zh: 服务定义的日志操作状态或结果代码，常为数字或短字符串。必须结合该行 ResourceProvider 和 Category 解释，不同 Azure 服务的相同代码含义可能不同；可配合 ResultType 或状态字段一起使用。

conditions_None_s.description: Name-derived: condition component indicating no match or absent condition in a rule evaluation record. Interpret within the emitting service's rule schema, alongside source IP, destination IP, and port condition fields, before drawing conclusions about rule behavior.
conditions_None_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：规则评估记录中表示无匹配或不存在的条件成分。应在生成服务的规则结构内，结合源 IP、目标 IP 和端口条件字段一起解释，再对规则行为作出结论。

conditions_destinationIP_s.description: Name-derived: destination IP address used as a condition in a network rule evaluation. Useful for reproducing which flows a rule matched, but confirm the emitting service and pair it with conditions_sourceIP_s, destination port, and protocol conditions for full context.
conditions_destinationIP_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：网络规则评估中作为条件使用的目标 IP 地址。可用于还原规则匹配了哪些流量，但需确认生成服务，并配合 conditions_sourceIP_s、目标端口和协议条件字段以获得完整上下文。

conditions_destinationPortRange_s.description: Name-derived: destination port range specified as a rule condition, usually text such as a range or wildcard. Use with source IP, destination IP, and protocol conditions to understand which traffic matched; verify the service's range formatting before parsing.
conditions_destinationPortRange_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：规则条件中指定的目标端口范围，通常为范围或通配符文本。可结合源 IP、目标 IP 和协议条件判断哪些流量发生匹配；解析前应先确认该服务的范围书写格式。

conditions_protocols_s.description: Name-derived: network protocols specified in a rule condition, often a small set of labels like TCP or UDP. Use it with source and destination IP and port conditions to reconstruct the evaluated flow; confirm labeling conventions in the emitting service's documentation.
conditions_protocols_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：规则条件中指定的网络协议，常为 TCP、UDP 等少量标签。可与源/目标 IP 及端口条件联用，还原被评估的流量；其标签约定需查阅生成服务文档确认。

conditions_sourceIP_s.description: Name-derived: source IP address used as a condition in a network rule evaluation. Useful for identifying which allowed or denied rule covers a given origin, but interpret alongside destination conditions and the service-specific rule identifier fields.
conditions_sourceIP_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：网络规则评估中作为条件使用的源 IP 地址。可用于判断某来源命中哪条允许或拒绝规则，但应结合目标条件及该服务特有的规则标识字段一起解释。

conditions_sourcePortRange_s.description: Name-derived: source port range specified as a rule condition, typically text with ranges or wildcards. Combine with source IP, destination IP, and protocol conditions to reconstruct matched flows; validate the service's formatting before filtering or parsing.
conditions_sourcePortRange_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：规则条件中指定的源端口范围，通常为带范围或通配符的文本。可与源 IP、目标 IP 和协议条件结合，还原匹配的流量；筛选或解析前应先确认该服务的格式约定。

connectionLatencyMilliseconds_s.description: Name-derived: latency of connection establishment expressed as text in milliseconds, likely from a front-door or gateway style service. Use for performance triage of connection setup versus total request latency, confirming the emitting service via ResourceProvider and Category.
connectionLatencyMilliseconds_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：连接建立延迟，以毫秒为单位的文本值，可能来自前端网关类服务。可用于区分连接建立开销与整体请求延迟，判断性能问题；使用前应通过 ResourceProvider 和 Category 确认生成服务。

connectionSerialNumber_d.description: Name-derived: numeric serial or sequence number assigned to a connection by the emitting service. Useful for ordering or grouping related connection records within the same service log; verify the service's semantics because global uniqueness is not guaranteed.
connectionSerialNumber_d.description_zh: 由名称推断：生成服务为连接分配的数值序号或序列号。可用于在同一服务日志内排序或分组相关连接记录；其语义需按服务确认，无法保证全局唯一。

contentType_s.description: Name-derived: media or content type of a request or payload, such as an HTTP content type header value. Use it when analyzing API or storage traffic to distinguish payload formats, and confirm the field's origin via the row's ResourceProvider and Category.
contentType_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：请求或负载的媒体/内容类型，例如 HTTP 内容类型头。分析 API 或存储流量时可用于区分负载格式；应通过该行 ResourceProvider 和 Category 确认字段来源。

correlation_actionTrackingId_g.description: Name-derived: correlation identifier for a tracked operation or action, used to link related events across records from the same service. Pair it with CorrelationId and other tracking IDs to reconstruct an operation chain, confirming the emitting service first.
correlation_actionTrackingId_g.description_zh: 由名称推断：用于某个被跟踪操作或动作的关联标识符，可链接同一服务产生的相关事件。可与 CorrelationId 及其他跟踪 ID 配合重建操作链；使用前应先确认生成服务。

correlation_clientTrackingId_s.description: Client-supplied tracking identifier for correlating a request across services; name-derived and service-specific, so inspect ResourceProvider/Category to confirm the emitting service before relying on it.
correlation_clientTrackingId_s.description_zh: 调用方提供的跟踪标识，用于跨服务关联请求；该含义由字段名推断且因服务而异，使用前应结合 ResourceProvider/Category 确认发出日志的服务。

destPort_s.description: Name-derived destination port for a network flow described by a resource log; scope by ResourceProvider and Category because different services populate destination port differently. Not proof of a connection.
destPort_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的网络流目标端口；不同服务填充方式不同，应按 ResourceProvider 和 Category 限定。不能据此证明连接已建立。

destPublicIpAddress_s.description: Name-derived public destination IP for a network flow event; inspect the resource and category context to determine direction and the emitting service. Presence alone does not prove traffic was allowed.
destPublicIpAddress_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的网络流目标公网 IP；需结合资源与类别上下文判断方向及发出服务。仅出现该值不代表流量已被允许。

detail_log_s.description: Name-derived detailed log text from the emitting resource; service-specific content varies, so inspect Category and ResourceProvider before interpreting. Useful for reading full operation context.
detail_log_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的详细日志文本；内容因服务而异，解释前应检查 Category 和 ResourceProvider。适合读取操作的完整上下文。

details_data_s.description: Name-derived structured or textual detail payload associated with a service event; likely populated by specific providers such as WAF, so confirm Category before treating it as request or rule data.
details_data_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的与服务事件关联的详细数据载荷；可能仅由特定提供程序填写，例如 WAF，应先确认 Category 再将其视为请求或规则数据。

details_file_s.description: Name-derived file identifier referenced in service detail output, often for inspection or matching rules; confirm the emitting resource and category before using it in file-related investigations.
details_file_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的服务详情中引用的文件标识，通常用于检查或匹配规则；用于文件相关调查前应确认发出资源和类别。

details_line_s.description: Name-derived line number or line reference within a file for service detail output; meaningful only with the associated detail context, so inspect the resource and category before relying on it.
details_line_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的文件内行号或行引用；只有结合相关详情上下文才有意义，依赖前应检查资源与类别。

details_matches_s.description: Name-derived list or summary of rule matches from services such as WAF; matches indicate detection, not compromise. Confirm category and resource before drawing conclusions.
details_matches_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的规则匹配列表或摘要，常见于 WAF 等服务；匹配表示检测到，而非已遭入侵。下结论前应确认类别与资源。

details_message_s.description: Name-derived human-readable detail message from the emitting service; content varies by provider and category, so use it for context after scoping the resource rather than as a normalized field.
details_message_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的服务可读详情消息；内容因提供程序和类别而异，应先限定资源再作为上下文使用，而非当作规范化字段。

details_msg_s.description: Name-derived detail message from the emitting service, similar in role to other detail message columns; inspect ResourceProvider and Category to know what the message describes for this row.
details_msg_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的服务详情消息，作用与其他详情消息列类似；应检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category 以了解该行描述的具体内容。

direction_s.description: Name-derived direction for a network flow event, such as inbound or outbound; the allowed values are service-specific, so inspect ResourceProvider and Category before filtering on it.
direction_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的网络流方向，例如入站或出站；取值范围因服务而异，过滤前应检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category。

domain_s.description: Name-derived domain name associated with the logged request or resource; confirm the emitting service and category before treating it as the request host, origin, or tenant domain.
domain_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的与所记录请求或资源关联的域名；应确认发出服务和类别，再判断其表示请求主机、源站还是租户域。

endTime_t.description: End timestamp for an operation, window, or mitigation described by the row; use with TimeGenerated and startTime_t to bound duration, scoping the resource and category first.
endTime_t.description_zh: 该行描述的操作、时间窗口或缓解措施的结束时间；应与 TimeGenerated 和 startTime_t 配合计算持续时间，并先限定资源与类别。

endpoint_s.description: Name-derived endpoint identifier for a service request or resource log; meaning depends on the emitting service, so inspect ResourceProvider and Category before correlating it with requests or rules.
endpoint_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的服务请求或资源日志端点标识；含义取决于发出服务，应检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category 后再与请求或规则关联。

engine_s.description: Name-derived engine identifier for the emitting service, such as a rule engine version; service-specific, so confirm ResourceProvider and Category before using it to compare or filter events.
engine_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的发出服务引擎标识，例如规则引擎版本；因服务而异，用于比较或过滤事件前应确认 ResourceProvider 和 Category。

errorInfo_s.description: Name-derived error information associated with the logged operation; format varies by service. Inspect Category and ResourceProvider and treat it as diagnostic context, not proof of compromise.
errorInfo_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的所记录操作的错误信息；格式因服务而异。应检查 Category 和 ResourceProvider，并将其作为诊断上下文，而非入侵证据。

errorLevel_s.description: Name-derived severity or error level for the event; values are service-specific, so confirm the emitting resource and category before using thresholds to filter or prioritize events.
errorLevel_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的事件严重性或错误级别；取值因服务而异，使用阈值过滤或排序事件前应确认发出资源与类别。

error_code_s.description: Name-derived error code returned by the emitting service; codes are service-specific and should be interpreted with ResourceProvider, Category and OperationName rather than assumed universal.
error_code_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的发出服务返回错误码；错误码因服务而异，应结合 ResourceProvider、Category 和 OperationName 解释，不应视为通用。

error_info_s.description: Name-derived error information for a service event; may differ from errorInfo_s in source and format. Confirm Category and ResourceProvider before treating it as normalized error detail.
error_info_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的服务事件错误信息；来源和格式可能与 errorInfo_s 不同。作为规范化错误详情使用前应确认 Category 和 ResourceProvider。

error_message_s.description: Name-derived human-readable error message from the emitting service; content varies and may duplicate other error fields. Use for diagnostics after scoping resource and category.
error_message_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的发出服务可读错误消息；内容各异，可能与其他错误字段重复。应在限定资源和类别后用于诊断。

event_s.description: Name-derived event identifier or event name for a service log; exact semantics depend on the emitting service, so inspect ResourceProvider and Category before correlating or filtering on it.
event_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的服务日志事件标识或事件名称；确切语义取决于发出服务，关联或过滤前应检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category。

executionClusterType_s.description: Name-derived execution cluster type where the operation ran; likely emitted by specific services, so confirm ResourceProvider and Category before using it to compare execution environments.
executionClusterType_s.description_zh: 由字段名推断的操作执行群集类型；可能仅由特定服务发出，用于比较执行环境前应确认 ResourceProvider 和 Category。

fired_b.description: Name-derived boolean indicating whether an alert, rule or action fired for this event; detection is not proof of compromise, so confirm resource and category before interpreting.
fired_b.description_zh: 由字段名推断的布尔值，表示该事件是否触发警报、规则或动作；检测结果不代表已遭入侵，解释前应确认资源与类别。

healthProbeId_g.description: Name-derived identifier for a load balancer health probe associated with the event; likely emitted by networking services, so inspect ResourceProvider and Category before correlating probe results.
healthProbeId_g.description_zh: 由字段名推断的与事件关联的负载均衡器运行状况探测标识；可能由网络服务发出，关联探测结果前应检查 ResourceProvider 和 Category。

hint_s.description: Name-derived: likely a service-provided hint or annotation attached to the log event. Without official documentation, treat as opaque and inspect ResourceProvider and Category context before relying on it in investigations.
hint_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：可能是服务附加的提示或注解信息。官方未说明其含义，应视为不透明字段，调查前先结合 ResourceProvider 和 Category 判断其上下文。

hostName_s.description: Name-derived: likely the host name associated with the logged request or event. Because multiple Azure services write this table, confirm the provider and Category before interpreting whose host this identifies.
hostName_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：可能是与所记录请求或事件关联的主机名。由于该表由多种 Azure 服务写入，解读其归属前应先确认资源提供程序和 Category。

host_s.description: Name-derived: likely the host associated with the logged event, such as a client, server, or proxy host. Interpretation depends on the emitting service and resource context; inspect Category and ResourceProvider alongside it.
host_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：可能是与所记录事件关联的主机，例如客户端、服务器或代理主机。具体含义取决于发出日志的服务和资源上下文，应结合 Category 与 ResourceProvider 一并查看。

hostname_s.description: Name-derived: likely the hostname carried in the event, potentially distinct from host_s in some services. Treat as service-specific; inspect Category and ResourceProvider context before asserting whose hostname it represents.
hostname_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：可能是事件中携带的主机名，在某些服务中与 host_s 并不相同。该字段含义因服务而异，断言其代表哪台主机前应先查看 Category 与 ResourceProvider 上下文。

httpMethod_s.description: HTTP method (for example GET or POST) of the request recorded in this row, as reported by the emitting service. Use it to distinguish read versus write style operations when grouping or filtering requests.
httpMethod_s.description_zh: 该行所记录请求的 HTTP 方法（如 GET 或 POST），由发出日志的服务上报。可按其分组或筛选，以区分读取类与写入类操作。

httpStatusCode_d.description: Numeric HTTP response status code for the request described by this row. Use it to separate successful from failed requests; combine with ResourceId and OperationName to scope to a specific resource operation.
httpStatusCode_d.description_zh: 该行所描述请求的数值型 HTTP 响应状态码。可用于区分成功与失败请求，并应与 ResourceId、OperationName 组合以限定到具体资源操作。

httpStatusCode_s.description: HTTP status code recorded as text for the request described by this row; some services emit codes as strings. Compare only within the same provider and Category to avoid cross-service misinterpretation.
httpStatusCode_s.description_zh: 以文本形式记录的该行请求 HTTP 状态码，部分服务以字符串形式发出状态码。仅应在相同资源提供程序和 Category 内比较，以免跨服务误读。

httpStatusDetails_s.description: Name-derived: likely additional detail or reason text accompanying an HTTP status, such as a status description. Treat as service-specific and inspect Category and ResourceProvider context before relying on its content.
httpStatusDetails_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：可能是伴随 HTTP 状态码的附加说明或原因文本（如状态描述）。该字段含义因服务而异，依赖其内容前应先查看 Category 与 ResourceProvider 上下文。

httpStatus_d.description: Numeric HTTP status value for the request described by this row, as reported by the emitting service. Use it with OperationName and ResourceId to assess request outcomes; semantics can vary slightly by service.
httpStatus_d.description_zh: 该行所描述请求的数值型 HTTP 状态值，由发出日志的服务上报。可结合 OperationName 与 ResourceId 判断请求结果；不同服务的具体语义可能略有差异。

httpVerb_s.description: Name-derived: likely the HTTP verb used by the request recorded in this row, such as GET or PUT. Because the meaning is not officially documented here, confirm against the emitting service.
httpVerb_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：可能是该行所记录请求使用的 HTTP 动词（如 GET 或 PUT）。此处官方未给出明确说明，应结合发出日志的服务加以确认。

httpVersion_s.description: HTTP protocol version (for example 1.1 or 2) of the request recorded in this row. Useful when comparing client behavior across services; interpret together with Category and client fields.
httpVersion_s.description_zh: 该行所记录请求的 HTTP 协议版本（如 1.1 或 2）。在比较不同服务的客户端行为时有用，应与 Category 及客户端相关字段一起解读。

id_s.description: Name-derived: identifier of the specific item described by this row, such as a request, policy, or resource record. Its exact scope depends on the emitting service; inspect Category and ResourceProvider before using it as a join key.
id_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：该行所描述具体对象的标识符，例如请求、策略或资源记录。其确切范围取决于发出日志的服务，用作关联键前应先查看 Category 与 ResourceProvider。

identity_claim_amr_s.description: Name-derived: token claim listing authentication methods (amr) for the identity behind the operation. Do not treat it as proof of compromise; verify against authentication logs for the same actor and time.
identity_claim_amr_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：令牌声明中的认证方法（amr）列表，描述操作背后身份的认证方式。不可据此断定账户被入侵，应与同一操作者、同一时间的身份验证日志相互印证。

identity_claim_appid_g.description: Application (client) ID claim identifying the application that acquired the token used in the operation. Use it to attribute actions to an app registration; it does not by itself prove which human user acted.
identity_claim_appid_g.description_zh: 应用程序（客户端）ID 声明，标识获取该操作所用令牌的应用程序。可用于将操作归属到某个应用注册；但仅凭它无法证明具体是哪个用户所为。

identity_claim_appidacr_s.description: Name-derived: token claim describing the authentication context reference class of the application. Interpret cautiously as service-specific token metadata; it is not evidence of malicious activity by itself.
identity_claim_appidacr_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：描述应用程序认证上下文引用类别的令牌声明。应谨慎解读，属于服务特有的令牌元数据，其本身不能作为恶意活动的证据。

identity_claim_http_schemas_microsoft_co.description: Name-derived: claim enumerating authentication method references for the signing-in identity, similar to amr. Use only as supporting context for identity investigation, never as proof of account compromise.
identity_claim_http_schemas_microsoft_co.description_zh: 由名称推断：列出登录身份所用认证方法引用的声明，作用类似 amr。仅可作身份调查的辅助背景，不能作为账户被入侵的证明。

identity_claim_http_schemas_microsoft_co.description: Name-derived: object identifier (OID) claim for the identity performing the logged operation, tied to an Azure AD principal. Use to correlate the same principal across events; confirm principal type before attribution.
identity_claim_http_schemas_microsoft_co.description_zh: 由名称推断：执行所记录操作身份的 objectidentifier（OID）声明，对应某个 Azure AD 主体。可用以跨事件关联同一主体；归属前需确认主体类型。

identity_claim_http_schemas_microsoft_co.description: Name-derived: scope claim indicating delegated permissions or scopes granted to the token. Useful to see what the caller was authorized to do; unauthorized-looking scope is not itself proof of misuse.
identity_claim_http_schemas_microsoft_co.description_zh: 由名称推断：scope 声明，表示授予该令牌的委派权限或作用域。可用于了解调用方被授权做什么；出现可疑作用域本身并不等于被滥用。

identity_claim_http_schemas_xmlsoap_org_.description: Name-derived: name claim of the identity associated with the operation, often a display or user name. Attribute actions carefully and corroborate with other identity fields for the same request.
identity_claim_http_schemas_xmlsoap_org_.description_zh: 由名称推断：与操作关联身份的名称声明，通常为显示名或用户名。归属操作时应谨慎，并与其他身份字段相互印证。

identity_claim_http_schemas_xmlsoap_org_.description: Name-derived: user principal name (UPN) claim for the identity that performed the operation. Use it to attribute activity to an account, while remembering claims reflect the token presented, not verified intent.
identity_claim_http_schemas_xmlsoap_org_.description_zh: 由名称推断：执行该操作身份的 user principal name（UPN）声明。可用于将活动归属到某个账户；但声明反映的是所出示令牌，并不代表经过验证的真实意图。

identity_claim_idtyp_s.description: Name-derived: claim describing the type of identity token, such as user versus application. Interpret with appid and oid claims to distinguish actor types behind the logged operation.
identity_claim_idtyp_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：描述身份令牌类型的声明，例如用户令牌还是应用令牌。可结合 appid 与 oid 声明，区分所记录操作背后的主体类型。

identity_claim_ipaddr_s.description: IP address claim embedded in the identity token associated with the operation. Useful as a correlation pivot; it reflects the token payload and may not match the observed CallerIPAddress on the row.
identity_claim_ipaddr_s.description_zh: 与操作关联的身份令牌中嵌入的 IP 地址声明。可作为关联分析的线索；它反映令牌内容，未必与该行的 CallerIPAddress 一致。

identity_claim_oid_g.description: Name-derived: object identifier (OID) claim for the identity behind the operation, typically a user, group, or service principal. Use it to correlate that principal across events and resources.
identity_claim_oid_g.description_zh: 由名称推断：操作背后身份的 objectidentifier（OID）声明，通常对应用户、组或服务主体。可用于跨事件和资源关联该主体。

identity_claim_scp_s.description: Name-derived: scope (scp) claim listing delegated scopes in the presented token. Use to gauge what the caller could access; scope presence alone does not establish malicious use.
identity_claim_scp_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：scope（scp）声明，列出所出示令牌中的委派作用域。可用于评估调用方可能访问的范围；仅凭作用域存在并不能认定存在恶意使用。

identity_claim_unique_name_s.description: Name-derived: unique name in the token identity claim of the caller/principal that performed the logged action. Compare with UPN during identity investigation, but inspect resource/category context to confirm claim semantics.
identity_claim_unique_name_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：执行所记录操作的调用方/主体令牌身份声明中的唯一名称。身份调查时可与UPN比对，但需结合资源/类别上下文确认声明含义。

identity_claim_upn_s.description: Name-derived: User Principal Name claim of the authenticated principal tied to this event. Use to attribute an operation to a specific user, scoping by resource and time; not proof the user intended the action.
identity_claim_upn_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：与该事件关联的已认证主体的用户主体名称(UPN)声明。可用于按资源和时间将操作归因到具体用户，但不能证明用户有意执行该操作。

identity_claim_xms_az_nwperimid_s.description: Name-derived: token claim carrying an Azure network perimeter identifier of the caller. Relevant for network-perimeter scoped access events; inspect resource/category to confirm it applies, and do not treat as network connection evidence.
identity_claim_xms_az_nwperimid_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：令牌声明中携带调用方的Azure网络边界标识符。适用于网络边界范围的访问事件；需检查资源/类别确认是否适用，不可当作网络连接证据。

identity_claim_xms_az_tm_s.description: Name-derived: token claim likely indicating an Azure tenant or management context marker. Treat as name-derived; verify against resource/category before using to scope or attribute activity.
identity_claim_xms_az_tm_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：令牌声明，可能表示Azure租户或管理上下文标记。属于名称推断，使用前应结合资源/类别核实，再进行范围限定或活动归因。

identity_claim_xms_mirid_s.description: Name-derived: managed identity resource identifier claim of the principal performing the action. Useful to distinguish managed-identity operations from user operations; inspect resource/category to confirm applicability.
identity_claim_xms_mirid_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：执行操作主体的托管标识资源标识符声明。可用于区分托管标识操作与用户操作；需检查资源/类别确认适用性。

instanceId_s.description: Identifies the specific instance of the emitting resource that produced this log row, letting you separate replicas or nodes under the same ResourceId. Inspect resource/category context to confirm what an instance means for that service.
instanceId_s.description_zh: 标识产生该日志行的发出资源的具体实例，可将同一ResourceId下的副本或节点区分开。需结合资源/类别上下文确认该服务的实例含义。

isAccessPolicyMatch_b.description: Boolean indicating whether the event matched an access policy, as emitted by the logging resource. Use with rule/policy fields to see if policy evaluation was involved; a match alone does not prove unauthorized or malicious access.
isAccessPolicyMatch_b.description_zh: 布尔值，表示该事件是否匹配某访问策略，由记录日志的资源发出。可结合规则/策略字段判断是否涉及策略评估；仅匹配并不证明未授权或恶意访问。

isAddressAuthorized_b.description: Name-derived: boolean indicating whether the caller address was authorized for the logged operation. Interpret with resource/category context; false does not by itself prove compromise or an attack.
isAddressAuthorized_b.description_zh: 由名称推断：布尔值，表示调用方地址是否对记录的操作获得授权。需结合资源/类别上下文解释；为false本身并不证明失陷或攻击。

isRbacAuthorized_b.description: Name-derived: boolean indicating whether role-based access control authorized the operation for this event. Use to triage access denials, then confirm via resource/category; an authorization outcome is not evidence of intent.
isRbacAuthorized_b.description_zh: 由名称推断：布尔值，表示该事件的操作是否通过基于角色的访问控制授权。可用于初筛访问拒绝，再结合资源/类别确认；授权结果不是意图证据。

isRequestSuccess_b.description: Name-derived: boolean indicating whether the logged request succeeded as reported by the emitting service. Useful as a quick success filter alongside ResultType; inspect resource/category to confirm meaning per service.
isRequestSuccess_b.description_zh: 由名称推断：布尔值，表示发出服务报告的请求是否成功。可与ResultType一起作为快速成功筛选条件；需结合资源/类别确认各服务的含义。

isV2Threshold_b.description: Name-derived: boolean flag likely relating to a version-2 threshold evaluation emitted with the log. Interpretation is name-derived; inspect resource and category context before relying on it in investigation.
isV2Threshold_b.description_zh: 由名称推断：布尔标志，可能与日志附带的v2阈值评估有关。解释属于名称推断；在调查中依赖前应检查资源与类别上下文。

keyProperties_attributes_enabled_b.description: Name-derived: boolean indicating whether a key's attributes are enabled, as reported for key-vault related events. Use to assess key configuration state; confirm resource/category context before drawing conclusions.
keyProperties_attributes_enabled_b.description_zh: 由名称推断：布尔值，表示密钥属性是否启用，见于密钥保管库相关事件。可用于评估密钥配置状态；得出结论前需确认资源/类别上下文。

keyProperties_attributes_exportable_b.description: Name-derived: boolean indicating whether a key was marked exportable in key-management events. Security-relevant configuration signal for key material exposure risk; inspect resource/category to confirm.
keyProperties_attributes_exportable_b.description_zh: 由名称推断：布尔值，表示密钥管理事件中密钥是否标记为可导出。这是密钥材料暴露风险的安全相关配置信号；需检查资源/类别确认。

keyProperties_attributes_hsmPlatform_s.description: Name-derived: text naming the HSM platform associated with a key in key-vault operations. Compare across events to detect platform changes; confirm meaning via resource/category context.
keyProperties_attributes_hsmPlatform_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：密钥保管库操作中与密钥关联的HSM平台名称文本。可跨事件比较以发现平台变更；需通过资源/类别上下文确认含义。

keyProperties_curve_s.description: Name-derived: text naming the cryptographic curve of a key in key-management events. Use to characterize key strength or detect unexpected curves; interpretation is name-derived, so verify resource/category.
keyProperties_curve_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：密钥管理事件中密钥的密码学曲线名称文本。可用于描述密钥强度或发现异常曲线；解释属名称推断，需核实资源/类别。

keyProperties_operations_s.description: Name-derived: text listing permitted operations for a key in key-vault related events. Compare with observed operations to detect policy drift; confirm applicability through resource/category context.
keyProperties_operations_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：密钥保管库相关事件中该密钥允许的操作列表文本。可与实际观察到的操作比较以发现策略漂移；需通过资源/类别上下文确认适用性。

keyProperties_size_d.description: Name-derived: numeric size of a key in key-management events, units not documented in the schema. Use comparatively; do not assume a unit or treat size alone as secure.
keyProperties_size_d.description_zh: 由名称推断：密钥管理事件中密钥的数值大小，架构未记录单位。宜作相对比较；不要假定单位，也不应仅凭大小判断安全性。

keyProperties_type_s.description: Name-derived: text naming the type of a key involved in key-vault events. Useful for grouping key operations; inspect resource/category context to confirm the value semantics.
keyProperties_type_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：密钥保管库事件中涉及的密钥类型名称文本。可用于对密钥操作分组；需检查资源/类别上下文确认取值含义。

lastError_elapsed_d.description: Name-derived: numeric duration associated with the last error recorded in this event, units undocumented. Use to characterize retry or processing delay; confirm resource/category context before interpreting.
lastError_elapsed_d.description_zh: 由名称推断：与该事件中最后一条错误相关的数值时长，单位未记录。可用于描述重试或处理延迟；解释前需确认资源/类别上下文。

lastError_message_s.description: Name-derived: text of the last error message reported with the event. Use to identify failure causes and signatures; scope by resource, operation and time, and do not treat it as proof of malicious activity.
lastError_message_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：事件中报告的最后一条错误消息文本。可用于识别失败原因和特征；应按资源、操作和时间限定范围，不能当作恶意活动证据。

lastError_reason_s.description: Name-derived: text giving the reason for the last error in the event. Helps group failures by cause; verify through resource/category context and avoid assuming undefined enumerations.
lastError_reason_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：事件中最后一条错误的原因文本。有助于按原因对失败分组；需通过资源/类别上下文核实，避免假定未定义的枚举值。

lastError_section_s.description: Name-derived: text naming the section or component where the last error occurred. Use to localize failure within a service workflow; interpretation is name-derived and resource/category dependent.
lastError_section_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：最后一条错误发生的部分或组件名称文本。可用于在服务工作流中定位失败位置；解释属名称推断并依赖资源/类别。

lastError_source_s.description: Name-derived: text naming the source of the last error reported in the event. Use with error message and resource context to trace failure origin; do not assume a service-specific enumeration.
lastError_source_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：事件中报告的最后一条错误的来源名称文本。可与错误消息和资源上下文一起追踪失败来源；不要假定特定服务的枚举值。

listenerName_s.description: Name-derived: name of the listener associated with the logged event, as emitted by networking or gateway resources. Use to map activity to a listener; inspect resource/category to confirm what a listener means there.
listenerName_s.description_zh: 由名称推断：与所记录事件关联的侦听器名称，由网络或网关资源发出。可用于将活动映射到侦听器；需检查资源/类别确认其含义。

location_s.description: Name-derived Azure region string for the emitting resource's log event; scope by ResourceProvider, Category, and ResourceId before comparing regions across resources.
location_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示发出日志事件资源的 Azure 区域字符串；跨资源比较区域前，应按 ResourceProvider、Category 与 ResourceId 限定范围。

macAddress_s.description: MAC address associated with the network resource event, such as a network interface or virtual appliance; interpret together with subnet and instance identifiers in the same row.
macAddress_s.description_zh: 与网络资源事件关联的 MAC 地址，如网络接口或虚拟设备；应结合同一行中的子网与实例标识一起解读。

matchedConnections_d.description: Count of connections matched by a network security rule during the reporting window; use with rule and port conditions to judge whether policy actually applied.
matchedConnections_d.description_zh: 报告窗口内被网络安全规则匹配的连接数；结合规则与端口条件判断策略是否真正生效。

metadataOverflowContentLength_d.description: Name-derived size in bytes of overflowed metadata when a log entry exceeded metadata limits; treat as data-volume indicator, not a security verdict, and confirm against provider context.
metadataOverflowContentLength_d.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示日志条目超出元数据限制时溢出元数据的字节大小；应作为数据量指标而非安全结论，并结合提供程序上下文确认。

method_s.description: HTTP method recorded for a request handled by the Azure resource in this row; pivot with url_s, status, and caller to reconstruct API or proxy activity.
method_s.description_zh: 本行中 Azure 资源所处理请求记录的 HTTP 方法；可结合 url_s、状态与调用方重建 API 或代理活动。

msg_s.description: Message text emitted by the reporting service for this event; search within a scoped provider and category to surface errors, rule hits, or diagnostic notes.
msg_s.description_zh: 报告服务为本事件发出的消息文本；在限定提供程序与类别后搜索，用于发现错误、规则命中或诊断说明。

noOfConnectionRequests_d.description: Name-derived count of connection requests observed in the reporting interval, likely from a gateway or proxy; correlate with matched connections and client addresses before drawing conclusions.
noOfConnectionRequests_d.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示报告时间段内观察到的连接请求数，可能来自网关或代理；得出结论前应与匹配连接数和客户端地址关联。

operationId_s.description: Identifier for a discrete operation or request within the service; use with CorrelationId and ResourceId to correlate related rows belonging to the same activity.
operationId_s.description_zh: 服务内单次操作或请求的标识符；可结合 CorrelationId 与 ResourceId 关联属于同一活动的相关行。

originCryptProtocol_s.description: Name-derived cryptographic protocol negotiated between a front-end and an origin or backend; inspect resource/provider context to confirm whether it represents origin TLS.
originCryptProtocol_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示前端与源站或后端之间协商的加密协议；应检查资源与提供程序上下文，确认其是否代表源站 TLS。

originIP_s.description: Name-derived IP address of an origin or backend server for front-door, proxy, or gateway traffic; compare with originIp_s and routing fields in the same row.
originIP_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示前门、代理或网关流量的源站或后端服务器 IP 地址；应与同一行中的 originIp_s 与路由字段比较。

originIp_s.description: Name-derived origin or backend IP address variant for proxy or delivery traffic; verify which spelling the emitting service populates before joining or filtering.
originIp_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示代理或分发流量的源站或后端 IP 地址变体；在连接或筛选前，应先确认发出服务填充的是哪种拼写。

originName_s.description: Name-derived label of the origin or backend target configured for the front-end resource; pivot with origin IP and URL to map traffic paths.
originName_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示为前端资源配置的源站或后端目标标签；可与源站 IP 与 URL 一起分析流量路径。

originUrl_s.description: Name-derived URL of the origin or backend target involved in this request; use with front-end URL fields to compare requested and forwarded destinations.
originUrl_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示本次请求涉及的源站或后端目标 URL；可结合前端 URL 字段比较请求目标与转发目标。

originalHost_s.description: Name-derived original Host header value before front-end rewriting; inspect resource context to interpret, useful for tracing proxy or gateway request routing.
originalHost_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示前端重写前的原始 Host 头值；需结合资源上下文解读，常用于追踪代理或网关请求路由。

originalRequestUriWithArgs_s.description: Name-derived full original request URI including query arguments before normalization; helps reconstruct parameters passed to web or API front-end resources.
originalRequestUriWithArgs_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示规范化前包含查询参数的完整原始请求 URI；有助于重建传递给 Web 或 API 前端资源的参数。

policyId_s.description: Name-derived identifier of the policy associated with this event, such as WAF or firewall policy; group rows by it to compare policy behavior across resources.
policyId_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示与本事件关联的策略标识符，如 WAF 或防火墙策略；可按其分组，比较跨资源的策略行为。

policyMode_s.description: Mode in which the associated policy operated, commonly detection or prevention for WAF-like resources; treat values as service-specific and inspect category before relying on them.
policyMode_s.description_zh: 关联策略的运行模式，对类 WAF 资源通常为检测或阻止；应为服务特定值，依赖前应检查类别。

policyScopeName_s.description: Name-derived friendly name of the scope where the policy applies, such as a listener or endpoint; use with policyId_s to locate the governed resource context.
policyScopeName_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示策略适用范围（如侦听器或终结点）的友好名称；可结合 policyId_s 定位受管资源上下文。

policyScope_s.description: Name-derived scope qualifier indicating where the policy is attached; inspect resource and provider context to determine whether it is global, listener, or path scope.
policyScope_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示策略挂接范围的限定符；应检查资源与提供程序上下文，判断其为全局、侦听器还是路径范围。

policy_s.description: Policy name or definition associated with the emitting resource event; interpret within provider and category context to distinguish WAF, firewall, or access policies.
policy_s.description_zh: 与发出资源事件关联的策略名称或定义；应在提供程序与类别上下文中解读，以区分 WAF、防火墙或访问策略。

pop_s.description: Name-derived point-of-presence or edge location code that handled the request; useful for geographic traffic analysis, but confirm the emitting service defines it that way.
pop_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示处理请求的接入点或边缘位置代码；有助于地理流量分析，但应确认发出服务确为此定义。

primaryIPv4Address_s.description: Primary IPv4 address assigned to the network resource described by the row, such as an interface or appliance; treat as resource configuration, and scope by subnet and instance.
primaryIPv4Address_s.description_zh: 本行所述网络资源（如接口或设备）分配的主 IPv4 地址；应视为资源配置，并按子网与实例限定范围。

priority_d.description: Numeric priority of the rule or policy evaluated for this event; lower values usually mean earlier evaluation, but confirm service conventions before ranking rules.
priority_d.description_zh: 本事件所评估规则或策略的数值优先级；通常数值越低越先评估，但排序规则前应确认服务约定。

probeURL_s.description: Name-derived URL probed by a health or availability monitor for the resource; use to distinguish synthetic probe traffic from real client requests in the same rows.
probeURL_s.description_zh: 由名称推断，表示资源健康或可用性监视器探测的 URL；可用于区分同一行中的合成探测流量与真实客户端请求。

probeUrl_s.description: Name-derived: URL probed by an endpoint health probe or similar monitored request in gateway/probe rows. Scope by ResourceProvider and Category, then inspect surrounding resource context; do not assume it proves service availability.
probeUrl_s.description_zh: 名称推断：网关/探测类行中由终结点健康探测或类似受监控请求访问的 URL。应结合 ResourceProvider 与 Category 限定范围并检查周边资源上下文，不能据此认定服务可用。

processId_d.description: Operating-system or service process identifier for whatever workload emitted this row. Interpretation is name-derived and provider-specific; always scope by Computer or ResourceId and TimeGenerated before comparing or correlating processes.
processId_d.description_zh: 发出该行的工作负载所对应的操作系统或服务进程标识。该解读由名称推断且因提供程序而异；比较或关联进程前必须按 Computer 或 ResourceId 及 TimeGenerated 限定范围。

properties_enableRbacAuthorization_b.description: Name-derived configuration flag indicating whether role-based access control authorization is enabled for the resource described in this row. Inspect Resource/ResourceType context; a true value is posture evidence, not proof of who accessed the resource.
properties_enableRbacAuthorization_b.description_zh: 名称推断的配置标志，表示该行所描述资源是否启用了基于角色的访问控制授权。应结合 Resource/ResourceType 上下文判断；true 只反映配置状态，不能证明何人访问过该资源。

properties_enableSoftDelete_b.description: Name-derived configuration flag showing whether soft delete (recoverable deletion) is enabled for the resource in this row. Use with ResourceId and TimeGenerated when auditing data-protection posture; it is configuration evidence, not deletion activity.
properties_enableSoftDelete_b.description_zh: 名称推断的配置标志，表示该行资源是否启用软删除（可恢复删除）。审计数据保护配置时可结合 ResourceId 与 TimeGenerated 使用；它属于配置证据，并非删除操作记录。

properties_enabledForDeployment_b.description: Name-derived key-vault-style configuration flag indicating whether the key or secret is enabled for deployment operations. Confirm meaning against the emitting ResourceProvider and Category before using it in access or exposure assessments.
properties_enabledForDeployment_b.description_zh: 名称推断的密钥保管库类配置标志，表示密钥或机密是否可用于部署操作。在用于访问或暴露面评估前，应结合发出该行的 ResourceProvider 与 Category 确认其含义。

properties_enabledForDiskEncryption_b.description: Name-derived key-vault-style flag indicating whether the key is enabled for disk encryption use. Scope by ResourceId and Category; enabled status supports configuration review but does not prove encryption occurred or that a key was used.
properties_enabledForDiskEncryption_b.description_zh: 名称推断的密钥保管库类标志，表示该密钥是否可用于磁盘加密。按 ResourceId 与 Category 限定范围；启用状态可用于配置审查，但不能证明实际发生加密或密钥被使用。

properties_enabledForTemplateDeployment_.description: Name-derived key-vault-style flag indicating whether the key or secret is enabled for ARM template deployment use. Validate against ResourceProvider context; it describes intended capability, not whether a deployment actually consumed the key.
properties_enabledForTemplateDeployment_.description_zh: 名称推断的密钥保管库类标志，表示密钥或机密是否可用于 ARM 模板部署。应结合 ResourceProvider 上下文核实；它描述预期能力，不能说明部署实际使用了该密钥。

properties_networkAcls_bypass_s.description: Name-derived storage-style network ACL setting describing which traffic (for example trusted services) may bypass network rules. Interpretation is provider-specific; inspect ResourceType and neighboring network ACL fields before drawing firewall conclusions.
properties_networkAcls_bypass_s.description_zh: 名称推断的存储类网络 ACL 设置，描述哪类流量（如受信任服务）可绕过网络规则。其含义因提供程序而异；在得出防火墙结论前应检查 ResourceType 及相邻网络 ACL 字段。

properties_networkAcls_defaultAction_s.description: Name-derived storage-style setting for the default action applied by network ACLs when no rule matches. Treat the value as provider-dependent configuration; correlate with ResourceType and related ACL columns rather than assuming allow or deny semantics.
properties_networkAcls_defaultAction_s.description_zh: 名称推断的存储类设置，表示网络 ACL 在无规则匹配时应用的默认操作。该值取决于提供程序配置；应与 ResourceType 及相关 ACL 字段关联判断，勿直接假定允许或拒绝语义。

properties_s.description: Semi-structured property bag carrying resource-specific configuration or metadata for the emitting resource. Name-derived and provider-specific; parse it cautiously alongside ResourceProvider and Category, and expect it to be absent on most heterogeneous rows.
properties_s.description_zh: 半结构化属性包，承载发出资源的相关配置或元数据。该解读由名称推断且因提供程序而异；应结合 ResourceProvider 与 Category 谨慎解析，并注意多数异构行中该字段为空。

properties_sku_Family_s.description: Name-derived SKU family of the resource in this row, such as a storage or service tier grouping. Use with ResourceId and ResourceType for inventory and posture comparison; the exact family naming depends on the emitting service.
properties_sku_Family_s.description_zh: 名称推断的该行资源 SKU 系列（如存储或服务层级分组）。可与 ResourceId、ResourceType 一起用于资产清单与配置对比；具体系列命名取决于发出日志的服务。

properties_sku_Name_s.description: Name-derived SKU name describing the service tier or plan of the resource in this row. Useful for grouping resources by tier during inventory review; validate meaning against ResourceType since naming varies by provider.
properties_sku_Name_s.description_zh: 名称推断的 SKU 名称，描述该行资源的服务层级或计划。适合在资产盘点时按层级分组；由于命名因提供程序而异，应结合 ResourceType 核实含义。

properties_softDeleteRetentionInDays_d.description: Name-derived retention period, in days, for soft-deleted objects of the resource in this row. Treat the unit as named but provider-dependent; use with ResourceId for data-protection configuration review, not as deletion evidence.
properties_softDeleteRetentionInDays_d.description_zh: 名称推断的保留期（天），适用于该行资源被软删除的对象。单位虽由名称体现但仍取决于提供程序；应与 ResourceId 配合用于数据保护配置审查，而非删除证据。

properties_tenantId_g.description: Name-derived tenant GUID reported inside the resource's properties object, distinct from the workspace-scoped TenantId column. Inspect ResourceProvider and Category context; do not treat it as the Log Analytics workspace identifier.
properties_tenantId_g.description_zh: 名称推断的、资源 properties 对象中报告的租户 GUID，与工作区范围的 TenantId 列不同。应结合 ResourceProvider 与 Category 上下文解读，勿将其视为 Log Analytics 工作区标识。

protocol_s.description: Name-derived network or application protocol associated with the connection or request in this row, such as TCP, TLS or HTTP. Scope by ResourceProvider and Category; values are service-specific and should not be assumed uniform across rows.
protocol_s.description_zh: 名称推断的该行连接或请求所用的网络或应用协议（如 TCP、TLS 或 HTTP）。应按 ResourceProvider 与 Category 限定范围；取值因服务而异，不可假定各行一致。

publicIpAddress_s.description: Name-derived public IP address attributed to the resource or traffic in this row. Its role (source, destination or owned address) depends on the service; confirm with ResourceProvider, Category and neighboring IP columns.
publicIpAddress_s.description_zh: 名称推断的归属于该行资源或流量的公网 IP 地址。其角色（源、目的或自有地址）取决于服务，应结合 ResourceProvider、Category 及相邻 IP 字段确认。

query_hash_s.description: Name-derived hash identifying a normalized query text executed against a database resource. Use with DatabaseName_s or resource identifiers to group repeated statements during investigation; identical hashes do not reveal the caller.
query_hash_s.description_zh: 名称推断的哈希值，用于标识对数据库资源执行的规范化查询文本。调查时可结合 DatabaseName_s 或资源标识对重复语句分组；哈希相同并不能揭示调用者身份。

receivedBytes_d.description: Name-derived count of bytes received by the service for the request or connection in this row. Use with sentBytes_d for traffic profiling; the unit follows the column name and should be confirmed against the emitting service.
receivedBytes_d.description_zh: 名称推断的该行请求或连接中服务接收的字节数。可与 sentBytes_d 配合进行流量画像；单位依列名推断，应结合发出日志的服务确认。

referer_s.description: Name-derived HTTP Referer header value supplied by the client for the request in this row. Useful for tracing link origins in web or gateway logs, but it is client-controlled and can be spoofed or absent.
referer_s.description_zh: 名称推断的客户端为该行请求提供的 HTTP Referer 头值。可用于在 Web 或网关日志中追踪链接来源，但该值由客户端控制，可能被伪造或缺失。

removedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g.description: Name-derived object identifier of the principal whose access policy was removed from the resource in this row, typically a key-vault-style operation. Correlate with Caller_s or identity claims to identify who performed the removal.
removedAccessPolicy_ObjectId_g.description_zh: 名称推断的主体对象标识，其访问策略在该行中被从资源移除，通常属于密钥保管库类操作。可结合 Caller_s 或身份声明确定执行移除操作的主体。

removedAccessPolicy_Permissions_certific.description: Name-derived certificate permissions that were removed in this access-policy change event. Read alongside the other removed permission fields to see the full privilege reduction; it records the change, not the actor's identity.
removedAccessPolicy_Permissions_certific.description_zh: 名称推断的本次访问策略变更中被移除的证书权限。应与其他被移除权限字段一并查看以了解完整权限缩减；它记录变更内容，而非操作者身份。

removedAccessPolicy_Permissions_keys_s.description: Name-derived key permissions removed in this access-policy change event. Combine with secrets and certificates counterparts to gauge lost key-management capabilities; pair with the removed ObjectId and caller information.
removedAccessPolicy_Permissions_keys_s.description_zh: 名称推断的本次访问策略变更中被移除的密钥权限。应与机密、证书对应字段结合以评估丢失的密钥管理能力，并与被移除的 ObjectId 及调用者信息配合分析。

removedAccessPolicy_Permissions_secrets_.description: Name-derived secret permissions removed in this access-policy change event, indicating which secret operations the principal lost. Use with the other removed permission columns and the event time to reconstruct the policy modification.
removedAccessPolicy_Permissions_secrets_.description_zh: 名称推断的本次访问策略变更中被移除的机密权限，表示该主体失去了哪些机密操作权限。应与其他被移除权限列及事件时间配合，还原策略修改过程。

removedAccessPolicy_TenantId_g.description: Name-derived tenant GUID of the principal whose access policy was removed in this row. TenantId documented as workspace ID must not be called directory tenant ID; still, this field claims a tenant context for the removed principal.
removedAccessPolicy_TenantId_g.description_zh: 名称推断的主体租户 GUID，其访问策略在该行中被移除。文档中的 TenantId 是工作区 ID，不能称为目录租户 ID；不过此字段声称提供被移除主体的租户上下文。

requestBytes_s.description: Name-derived: string field likely reporting the size of an inbound request for proxy, gateway, or front-door style services; scope by ResourceProvider, Category, and ResourceId before trusting the unit or meaning.
requestBytes_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串字段，可能记录代理、网关类服务的入站请求大小；使用前须按 ResourceProvider、Category、ResourceId 限定，单位与含义未经官方说明。

requestProtocol_s.description: Name-derived: string field likely identifying the protocol of an inbound request for the logging resource; confirm against ResourceProvider, Category, and neighboring request fields rather than assuming a fixed vocabulary.
requestProtocol_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串字段，可能标识所记录资源的入站请求协议；应与 ResourceProvider、Category 及相邻请求字段交叉确认，不要预设取值集合。

requestQuery_s.description: String holding the query string portion of a request URL for services emitting request telemetry; useful for spotting injected payloads or unusual parameters when scoped to one resource and category.
requestQuery_s.description_zh: 字符串，保存请求 URL 的查询字符串部分，见于发出请求遥测的服务；限定到单个资源和类别后，可用于发现注入载荷或异常参数。

requestSize_d.description: Name-derived real field likely measuring the size of a request handled by the logging resource; interpretation and units are unspecified, so verify by category and resource before comparing or aggregating values.
requestSize_d.description_zh: 名称推断的实数字段，可能度量所记录资源处理的请求大小；单位与语义未说明，比较或聚合前应按类别和资源核实。

requestUri_s.description: String recording the request URI reported by the logging resource for the operation; a key pivot for identifying targeted paths, endpoints, or resources during investigations once scoped by ResourceId and Category.
requestUri_s.description_zh: 字符串，记录该操作对应的请求 URI；按 ResourceId 和 Category 限定后，是识别被访问路径、端点或目标资源的关键字段。

resource_actionName_s.description: String naming the action performed within the source workflow or resource that emitted the event; use with resource_workflowName_s, resource_runId_s, and OperationName to trace what a run actually did.
resource_actionName_s.description_zh: 字符串，记录发出事件的工作流或资源内部执行的操作名称；应与 resource_workflowName_s、resource_runId_s 和 OperationName 结合，追踪某次运行具体做了什么。

resource_location_s.description: String giving the Azure region of the source resource named in the resource_ prefixed properties; useful for scoping which regional deployment emitted an event, not a geographic user location.
resource_location_s.description_zh: 字符串，给出 resource_ 前缀属性所指示源资源的 Azure 区域；用于确定是哪个区域部署发出的事件，并非用户地理位置。

resource_originRunId_s.description: String identifying the original run that a later execution was derived from, as recorded in the resource properties; use with resource_runId_s to link child or retried runs back to their source.
resource_originRunId_s.description_zh: 字符串，记录后续执行所源自的初始运行标识；与 resource_runId_s 配合，可把子运行或重试运行关联回其源头。

resource_resourceGroupName_s.description: String naming the resource group of the source resource for this event; useful for quickly filtering activity to one deployment scope when ResourceGroup or ResourceId are not populated on the row.
resource_resourceGroupName_s.description_zh: 字符串，给出该事件源资源所在的资源组；当行上未填充 ResourceGroup 或 ResourceId 时，可用于把活动快速限定到某一部署范围。

resource_runId_s.description: String identifying one execution run of the source workflow or job; the main correlator for grouping all events belonging to a single automated execution for timeline reconstruction.
resource_runId_s.description_zh: 字符串，标识源工作流或作业的一次执行运行；是聚合单次自动化执行全部事件、还原时间线的主要关联键。

resource_sourceTriggerHistoryName_s.description: Name-derived: string likely recording the name of the trigger history entry that initiated the source run; inspect the resource and category context to confirm whether it identifies a trigger or a scheduling record.
resource_sourceTriggerHistoryName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串，可能记录触发源运行的历史条目名称；需结合资源与类别上下文确认它标识的是触发器还是调度记录。

resource_subscriptionId_g.description: String containing the subscription GUID of the source resource as recorded in resource properties; complements the top-level SubscriptionId for scoping activity to one Azure subscription.
resource_subscriptionId_g.description_zh: 字符串，保存资源属性中源资源的订阅 GUID；与顶层 SubscriptionId 互补，用于把活动限定到某个 Azure 订阅。

resource_triggerName_s.description: String naming the trigger that started the source workflow or run recorded in resource properties; use with resource_runId_s and resource_workflowName_s to attribute automated executions to their trigger.
resource_triggerName_s.description_zh: 字符串，记录启动源工作流或运行的触发器名称；与 resource_runId_s、resource_workflowName_s 配合，可将自动化执行归因到具体触发器。

resource_workflowId_g.description: GUID string identifying the source workflow recorded in resource properties; stable across runs, so pair it with resource_runId_s to separate workflow-level identity from single-execution activity.
resource_workflowId_g.description_zh: GUID 字符串，标识资源属性中记录的源工作流；跨运行稳定，可与 resource_runId_s 搭配，区分工作流身份与单次执行活动。

resource_workflowName_s.description: String giving the human-readable name of the source workflow that emitted the event; primary pivot for narrowing AzureDiagnostics rows to one automation definition before analysing its runs.
resource_workflowName_s.description_zh: 字符串，给出发出事件的源工作流可读名称；是先把 AzureDiagnostics 行限定到某个自动化定义、再分析其各次运行的主要依据。

responseBytes_s.description: Name-derived: string field likely reporting bytes returned in a response from the logging resource; verify units and provider meaning through ResourceProvider and Category before using in traffic analysis.
responseBytes_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串字段，可能记录所记录资源返回的响应字节数；用于流量分析前应通过 ResourceProvider 和 Category 核实单位与含义。

responseCode_d.description: Name-derived real field likely holding the response status code returned by the logging resource; treat as an HTTP-style code only after confirming the resource and category, since providers reuse names differently.
responseCode_d.description_zh: 名称推断的实数字段，可能保存所记录资源返回的响应状态码；各提供程序对同名复用不一，须确认资源与类别后再按 HTTP 状态码解读。

responseSize_d.description: Name-derived real field likely measuring the size of a response sent by the logging resource; units and semantics are unspecified, so validate per Category and ResourceId before aggregating or comparing.
responseSize_d.description_zh: 名称推断的实数字段，可能度量所记录资源发出的响应大小；单位与语义未说明，聚合或比较前应按 Category 与 ResourceId 验证。

resultDescription_ChildJobs_s.description: String carrying a child-jobs portion of a job run result description for automation-style services; parse it to enumerate sub-jobs belonging to one parent run and their statuses.
resultDescription_ChildJobs_s.description_zh: 字符串，保存自动化类服务作业运行结果描述中的子作业部分；解析后可列出属于同一父运行的各子作业及其状态。

resultDescription_ErrorJobs_s.description: String carrying an error-jobs portion of a job run result description; parse it to identify which jobs within a run failed, then correlate with resource_runId_s and OperationName for root cause.
resultDescription_ErrorJobs_s.description_zh: 字符串，保存作业运行结果描述中的错误作业部分；解析后可确定一次运行内哪些作业失败，再结合 resource_runId_s 与 OperationName 追查原因。

resultDescription_Summary_DurationInMinu.description: Name-derived real field likely giving the duration in minutes from an update or patch summary result; confirm the reporting resource and category before comparing durations across rows.
resultDescription_Summary_DurationInMinu.description_zh: 名称推断的实数字段，可能取自更新或修补摘要结果的持续分钟数；跨行比较时长前应先确认上报资源与类别。

resultDescription_Summary_DurationInMinu.description: String variant of a summary duration in minutes, likely from the same update or patch summary payload; prefer the matching typed column when populated and treat this as raw text otherwise.
resultDescription_Summary_DurationInMinu.description_zh: 字符串形式的摘要持续分钟数，可能来自同一更新或修补摘要负载；对应类型列有值时优先使用该列，否则再按原始文本处理。

resultDescription_Summary_EndDateTimeUtc.description: String variant recording the UTC end time of a summarised operation; parse it only when the datetime typed counterpart is null, and note that textual time zones are not guaranteed.
resultDescription_Summary_EndDateTimeUtc.description_zh: 字符串形式，记录被汇总操作的 UTC 结束时间；仅在对应 datetime 类型列为空时才解析，并注意文本时区格式并无保证。

resultDescription_Summary_EndDateTimeUtc.description: Datetime giving the UTC end time of a summarised operation in the result description payload; pair with the start time and duration columns to compute or validate elapsed windows.
resultDescription_Summary_EndDateTimeUtc.description_zh: datetime，给出结果描述负载中被汇总操作的 UTC 结束时间；与开始时间和时长列配合，可计算或校验实际耗时。

resultDescription_Summary_InitialRequire.description: Name-derived numeric count in update-summary records: updates initially required before installation. Scope by resource and summary time; treat as name-derived telemetry, inspect category context.
resultDescription_Summary_InitialRequire.description_zh: 名称推断的更新摘要数值，表示安装前初始所需更新数。使用时应结合资源与摘录时间，并视为名称推断字段。

resultDescription_Summary_InstallPercent.description: Name-derived numeric install completion percentage for an update deployment summary row. Use it to gauge rollout progress; confirm meaning via resource/category context.
resultDescription_Summary_InstallPercent.description_zh: 名称推断的更新部署摘要安装完成百分比。可用于评估部署进度；需结合资源、类别上下文确认含义。

resultDescription_Summary_MachineId_s.description: Name-derived string identifying the machine in an update summary record. Join with MachineName_s to correlate a device across update runs; interpretation is name-based.
resultDescription_Summary_MachineId_s.description_zh: 名称推断的更新摘要记录中的计算机标识字符串。可与 MachineName_s 关联以跨更新轮次追踪设备；解释基于名称。

resultDescription_Summary_MachineName_s.description: Name-derived hostname of the machine covered by an update summary record. Useful for device-scoped analysis; pair with MachineId_s and treat as name-derived.
resultDescription_Summary_MachineName_s.description_zh: 名称推断的更新摘要记录所涉计算机名称。适合按设备分析；可与 MachineId_s 配对，视为名称推断。

resultDescription_Summary_RebootRequired.description: Name-derived boolean flag in an update summary indicating whether a reboot is required. Use with deployment status; name-based semantics, verify via category context.
resultDescription_Summary_RebootRequired.description_zh: 名称推断的更新摘要布尔标志，表示是否需要重启。可与部署状态结合；语义基于名称，需按类别上下文核实。

resultDescription_Summary_ScheduleName_s.description: Name-derived string naming the update schedule associated with a summary record. Useful when scoping deployment activity by named schedule; interpretation is name-based.
resultDescription_Summary_ScheduleName_s.description_zh: 名称推断的与更新摘要关联的计划名称。按命名计划限定部署活动时有用；解释基于名称。

resultDescription_Summary_StartDateTimeU.description: Name-derived UTC start time for the summarized update operation. Use with other summary timestamps to order activity; name-based, confirm via resource/category context.
resultDescription_Summary_StartDateTimeU.description_zh: 名称推断的摘要更新操作 UTC 开始时间。可与其他摘要时间戳配合排序活动；基于名称，需按资源、类别核实。

resultDescription_Summary_StatusDescript.description: Name-derived descriptive status text for an update summary row. Use it to read detail beyond Status_s; treat as name-based, not a documented enum.
resultDescription_Summary_StatusDescript.description_zh: 名称推断的更新摘要状态描述文本。用于获取 Status_s 之外的细节；视为名称推断而非文档化枚举。

resultDescription_Summary_Status_s.description: Name-derived status string for an update deployment summary record. Use to filter outcomes, but do not assume fixed values; inspect resource/category context.
resultDescription_Summary_Status_s.description_zh: 名称推断的更新部署摘要状态字符串。可用于筛选结果，但不要假定固定值；应结合资源、类别上下文。

resultDescription_Summary_TotalUpdatesFa.description: Name-derived count of updates that failed in a deployment summary. Use with TotalUpdatesInstalled_d to assess rollout health; treat as name-derived telemetry.
resultDescription_Summary_TotalUpdatesFa.description_zh: 名称推断的部署摘要中失败的更新数量。可与 TotalUpdatesInstalled_d 配合评估部署健康；视为名称推断遥测。

resultDescription_Summary_TotalUpdatesIn.description: Name-derived count of updates successfully installed in a summary record. Pair with TotalUpdatesFailed_d for coverage analysis; interpretation is name-based.
resultDescription_Summary_TotalUpdatesIn.description_zh: 名称推断的摘要记录中成功安装的更新数量。可与 TotalUpdatesFailed_d 配对分析覆盖情况；解释基于名称。

result_s.description: Name-derived short result or status token for the logged operation. Use cautiously as an outcome filter for a resource row; semantics depend on provider.
result_s.description_zh: 名称推断的该操作简短结果或状态标记。可谨慎用作资源行的结果筛选；语义取决于提供程序。

retryHistory_s.description: Name-derived text likely recording retry attempts for the logged operation. Inspect its serialized content to understand transient failures; interpretation is name-based.
retryHistory_s.description_zh: 名称推断的记录该操作重试尝试的文本。可检查其序列化内容以了解瞬时失败；解释基于名称。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

routingRuleName_s.description: Name-derived string naming a routing rule, likely from content-delivery or front-door-style logs. Use to scope requests handled by a specific rule; verify per category.
routingRuleName_s.description_zh: 名称推断的路由规则名称，可能来自内容分发或 Front Door 类日志。用于限定由特定规则处理的请求；需按类别核实。

ruleGroup_s.description: Name-derived string identifying the rule group for a WAF-style rule match. Use with ruleId_s and ruleSetVersion_s; interpretation derives from column name.
ruleGroup_s.description_zh: 名称推断的 WAF 式规则匹配所属规则组标识。可与 ruleId_s、ruleSetVersion_s 配合；解释源自列名。

ruleId_s.description: Name-derived identifier of a rule, likely WAF or routing, that matched or applied. Use for rule-hit analysis; not a documented enum, inspect category.
ruleId_s.description_zh: 名称推断的匹配或应用的规则标识，可能属 WAF 或路由。用于规则命中分析；并非文档化枚举，应检查类别。

ruleName_s.description: Name-derived name of a rule involved in the logged event. Used to pivot rule-triggered activity; confirm which service produces it via Category.
ruleName_s.description_zh: 名称推断的日志事件相关规则名称。可用于透视规则触发活动；通过 Category 确认来源服务。

ruleSetType_s.description: Name-derived type label of a rule set, such as managed or custom in WAF-style records. Use for grouping rules; name-based, verify against provider context.
ruleSetType_s.description_zh: 名称推断的规则集类型标签，如 WAF 记录中的托管或自定义。用于规则分组；基于名称，需结合提供程序上下文。

ruleSetVersion_s.description: Name-derived version string of the rule set that produced a rule match. Useful when comparing rule behavior over time; interpretation is name-based.
ruleSetVersion_s.description_zh: 名称推断的产生规则匹配的规则集版本字符串。可用于比较规则行为随时间变化；解释基于名称。

rulesEngineMatchNames_s.description: Name-derived list or names of rules-engine matches for a request, likely front-door style. Use to see which rules fired; confirm semantics in category context.
rulesEngineMatchNames_s.description_zh: 名称推断的请求规则引擎匹配名称，可能来自 Front Door 类日志。用于查看触发了哪些规则；需在类别上下文中确认语义。

secretProperties_attributes_enabled_b.description: Name-derived boolean indicating whether a secret has attributes enabled, probably from Key Vault logging. Interpret with resource/category; not documented here.
secretProperties_attributes_enabled_b.description_zh: 名称推断的机密属性启用布尔值，可能来自 Key Vault 日志。应结合资源、类别解释；此处未文档化。

secretProperties_attributes_exp_d.description: Name-derived numeric value for secret attributes exp, likely an expiry-related value in Key Vault records. Check units before use; interpretation is name-based.
secretProperties_attributes_exp_d.description_zh: 名称推断的机密属性 exp 数值，可能是 Key Vault 中的过期相关值。使用前需确认单位；解释基于名称。

secretProperties_type_s.description: Name-derived string for the secret's type in key-vault-style records. Use to classify secret objects; semantics not documented, inspect resource context.
secretProperties_type_s.description_zh: 名称推断的密钥保管库式记录中机密类型字符串。用于对机密对象分类；语义未文档化，应检查资源上下文。

securityCipher_s.description: Name-derived: cipher suite negotiated for this front-end or web application firewall connection, reported by the resource emitting the row; inspect resource and category to confirm meaning before relying on it.
securityCipher_s.description_zh: 名称推断：该前端或 Web 应用防火墙连接协商使用的密码套件，由发出该行的资源上报；依赖前请结合 resource 和 category 确认含义。

securityCurves_s.description: Name-derived: elliptic curves or key-exchange groups offered or selected for this connection, reported by the emitting resource; treat as configuration detail and confirm via resource/category context.
securityCurves_s.description_zh: 名称推断：此连接提供或选定的椭圆曲线或密钥交换组，由发出该行的资源上报；应视为配置细节，并通过 resource/category 上下文确认。

securityProtocol_s.description: Name-derived: security protocol label recorded by the emitting resource for this request or connection, such as the transport security version it handled; confirm exact values in the resource and category context.
securityProtocol_s.description_zh: 名称推断：发出该行的资源为此请求或连接记录的安全协议标签，例如其处理的传输安全版本；请在 resource 和 category 上下文中确认具体取值。

sentBytes_d.description: Bytes sent by the resource for the logged operation or connection, paired with receivedBytes_d to profile response size, data transfer and possible exfiltration volume.
sentBytes_d.description_zh: 资源为所记录操作或连接发送的字节数，可与 receivedBytes_d 配合分析响应大小、数据传输量及可能的数据外泄规模。

serverResponseLatency_s.description: Name-derived: latency between routing a request to a server and receiving its response, as reported by the emitting gateway resource; inspect resource and category to confirm which leg it measures.
serverResponseLatency_s.description_zh: 名称推断：请求路由到服务器与收到响应之间的延迟，由发出该行的网关资源上报；请结合 resource 和 category 确认其衡量的具体环节。

serverRouted_s.description: Name-derived: server or backend selected for routing this request, reported by the emitting gateway resource; compare with origin or backend fields to trace request path.
serverRouted_s.description_zh: 名称推断：为路由此请求而选定的服务器或后端，由发出该行的网关资源上报；可与 origin 或 backend 字段比较以追踪请求路径。

serverStatus_s.description: Name-derived: status returned by the backend server for this request, reported by the emitting gateway resource; contrast with other status fields to separate client, gateway and origin outcomes.
serverStatus_s.description_zh: 名称推断：后端服务器为此请求返回的状态，由发出该行的网关资源上报；可与其他状态字段对比，以区分客户端、网关和源站结果。

sni_s.description: Name-derived: server name indication hostname presented in the TLS handshake for this connection, recorded by the emitting resource; useful for mapping requests to hostnames behind shared addresses.
sni_s.description_zh: 名称推断：此连接 TLS 握手中提交的服务器名称指示主机名，由发出该行的资源记录；有助于将共享地址背后的请求映射到主机名。

socketIP_s.description: Name-derived: IP address of the socket endpoint reported by the emitting resource for this connection, often a proxy or front-end peer; inspect resource and category to decide which endpoint it denotes.
socketIP_s.description_zh: 名称推断：发出该行的资源为此连接上报的套接字端点 IP 地址，通常为代理或前端对端；请结合 resource 和 category 判断其表示哪个端点。

socketIp_s.description: Name-derived: alternate spelling of the socket endpoint IP reported by the emitting resource; treat as the same connection endpoint concept and verify meaning per resource and category.
socketIp_s.description_zh: 名称推断：发出该行的资源上报的套接字端点 IP 的另一拼写；应视为同一连接端点概念，并按 resource 和 category 核实含义。

sourcePort_s.description: Name-derived: source port of the network flow reported in this row, recorded by the emitting resource; interpret only with the corresponding source address and direction fields.
sourcePort_s.description_zh: 名称推断：本行所记录网络流的源端口，由发出该行的资源记录；仅应与对应的源地址和 direction 字段结合解读。

sourcePublicIpAddress_s.description: Name-derived: public source IP address for the connection reported in this row, recorded by the emitting resource; use with ports and direction for network-flow or scan analysis.
sourcePublicIpAddress_s.description_zh: 名称推断：本行所记录连接的公共源 IP 地址，由发出该行的资源记录；可与端口和 direction 一起用于网络流或扫描分析。

sqlerrcode_s.description: Name-derived: database error code recorded for a failing statement or session in this row; useful for distinguishing permission, syntax, connection and other database failures.
sqlerrcode_s.description_zh: 名称推断：本行中某条失败语句或会话记录的数据库错误代码；有助于区分权限、语法、连接及其他数据库故障。

sslCipher_s.description: Name-derived: cipher negotiated for this transport connection, recorded by the emitting resource; a weak or unexpected value may warrant investigation of the resource's TLS configuration.
sslCipher_s.description_zh: 名称推断：此传输连接协商使用的密码，由发出该行的资源记录；若取值较弱或异常，可能值得调查该资源的 TLS 配置。

sslClientCertificateFingerprint_s.description: Name-derived: fingerprint of the client certificate presented for this connection, recorded by the emitting resource; use to correlate a client identity across requests within the same resource.
sslClientCertificateFingerprint_s.description_zh: 名称推断：此连接提交的客户端证书指纹，由发出该行的资源记录；可用于在同一资源内关联某客户端身份的多次请求。

sslClientCertificateIssuerName_s.description: Name-derived: issuer name of the client certificate presented for this connection, recorded by the emitting resource; helps judge whether the issuing authority is expected for that client.
sslClientCertificateIssuerName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：此连接提交的客户端证书的颁发者名称，由发出该行的资源记录；有助于判断该颁发机构对该客户端是否预期。

sslClientVerify_s.description: Name-derived: outcome of client certificate verification for this connection, recorded by the emitting resource; inspect resource and category to learn which values indicate success or failure.
sslClientVerify_s.description_zh: 名称推断：此连接客户端证书验证的结果，由发出该行的资源记录；请结合 resource 和 category 了解哪些取值表示成功或失败。

sslEnabled_s.description: Name-derived: indicator of whether transport security was enabled for the logged database or service connection; check resource and category to confirm the exact value set used.
sslEnabled_s.description_zh: 名称推断：所记录数据库或服务连接是否启用传输安全的指示值；请检查 resource 和 category 以确认使用的具体取值集合。

sslProtocol_s.description: Name-derived: transport security protocol version used for this connection, recorded by the emitting resource; helps identify outdated protocol versions in use.
sslProtocol_s.description_zh: 名称推断：此连接使用的传输安全协议版本，由发出该行的资源记录；有助于识别仍在使用过时协议版本的情况。

startTime_t.description: Start time of the activity summarized in this row, such as an update run or mitigation window, as reported by the emitting resource; scope by resource and category before ordering.
startTime_t.description_zh: 本行所汇总活动（例如更新运行或缓解窗口）的开始时间，由发出该行的资源上报；排序前请先按 resource 和 category 限定范围。

status_s.description: Name-derived: status of the activity recorded in this row, reported by the emitting resource; exact meanings vary by resource and category, so map values before drawing conclusions.
status_s.description_zh: 名称推断：本行所记录活动的状态，由发出该行的资源上报；具体含义随 resource 和 category 变化，得出结论前请先映射取值。

subnetId_s.description: Identifier of the subnet associated with the logged resource event, useful for locating the emitting resource's network placement; note that resource details supplement it, not replace it.
subnetId_s.description_zh: 与所记录资源事件关联的子网标识符，可用于定位发出该行的资源的网络位置；注意它是对资源详情的补充而非替代。

subnetPrefix_s.description: Name-derived: address prefix of the subnet associated with this logged network event, recorded by the emitting resource; inspect resource and category to confirm the prefix notation used.
subnetPrefix_s.description_zh: 名称推断：与此网络事件关联的子网地址前缀，由发出该行的资源记录；请结合 resource 和 category 确认所使用的表示法。

systemId_g.description: Name-derived: GUID-like system identifier recorded by the emitting resource for the logged component or deployment; confirm in resource and category context which component it identifies.
systemId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：发出该行的资源为所记录组件或部署记录的类似 GUID 的系统标识符；请在 resource 和 category 上下文中确认其标识的组件。

tags_CreatedDate_s.description: Name-derived: string tag likely recording when the logged resource or object was created, per the emitting service. Use cautiously for creation-time correlation; confirm semantics against the resource and Category context before relying on it.
tags_CreatedDate_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串标签，可能记录所记录资源或对象的创建时间，由发送服务写入。用于创建时间关联时须谨慎；依赖前应结合资源与 Category 上下文确认其语义。
