tags_Created_By_s.description: Name-derived: string tag likely identifying the principal or process that created the logged resource or object. Treat as name-derived; verify against identity claims and Caller_s rather than assuming it proves authorship.
tags_Created_By_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串标签，可能标识创建所记录资源或对象的主体或进程。属名称推断；应结合身份声明与 Caller_s 验证，不应直接据此认定创建者。

tags_CreatorUPN_s.description: Name-derived: string tag likely holding a user principal name of the resource creator, per the emitting service. Use as a lead only after confirming the resource and Category; pair with identity claims where present.
tags_CreatorUPN_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串标签，可能保存资源创建者的用户主体名称（UPN）。应确认资源与 Category 后再作为线索使用；有身份声明字段时应相互印证。

targetResources_JobId_g.description: Name-derived: GUID-like value identifying a target job referenced by the event, likely from Automation or similar services. Use to join related job records; confirm service context via ResourceProvider and Category.
targetResources_JobId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：类似 GUID 的值，标识事件引用的目标作业，可能来自 Automation 等服务。可用于关联相关作业记录；应通过 ResourceProvider 和 Category 确认服务上下文。

targetResources_JobName_g.description: Name-derived: name of a target job referenced by the event, per emitting service. Useful for grouping job-related activity; interpretation is name-derived, so verify against the resource and Category context.
targetResources_JobName_g.description_zh: 名称推断：事件引用的目标作业名称，由发送服务写入。可用于归组作业相关活动；该解释属名称推断，应结合资源与 Category 上下文核实。

targetResources_ModuleId_g.description: Name-derived: GUID-like identifier of a target module, likely for Automation runbook modules. Use to correlate module-level activity; confirm semantics from the resource and Category before asserting meaning.
targetResources_ModuleId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：目标模块的类 GUID 标识符，可能对应 Automation Runbook 模块。可用于关联模块级活动；在断言其含义前应结合资源与 Category 确认语义。

targetResources_ModuleName_s.description: Name-derived: name of a target module referenced by the event, likely Automation. Useful for grouping module operations; treat as name-derived and verify with ResourceProvider, Category and related target resource fields.
targetResources_ModuleName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：事件引用的目标模块名称，可能属于 Automation。可用于归组模块操作；属名称推断，应结合 ResourceProvider、Category 及相关目标资源字段核实。

targetResources_Resource_s.description: Name-derived: resource identifier or name that the event targeted, per emitting service. Use to scope impact to a specific resource; confirm resource context before treating it as authoritative.
targetResources_Resource_s.description_zh: 名称推断：事件所针对的资源标识符或名称，由发送服务写入。可用于将影响范围限定到具体资源；在将其视为权威前应确认资源上下文。

targetResources_RunbookId_g.description: Name-derived: GUID-like identifier of a target runbook, likely Automation. Use to correlate runbook executions and related job records; verify service context via ResourceProvider and Category.
targetResources_RunbookId_g.description_zh: 名称推断：目标 Runbook 的类 GUID 标识符，可能属于 Automation。可用于关联 Runbook 执行及相关作业记录；应通过 ResourceProvider 和 Category 确认服务上下文。

targetResources_RunbookName_s.description: Name-derived: name of a target runbook referenced by the event, likely Automation. Useful for grouping runbook activity; treat as name-derived and corroborate with job and module fields.
targetResources_RunbookName_s.description_zh: 名称推断：事件引用的目标 Runbook 名称，可能属于 Automation。可用于归组 Runbook 活动；属名称推断，应与作业和模块字段相互印证。

targetResources_Uri_s.description: Name-derived: URI of a target resource referenced by the event, per emitting service. Ambiguous without service context; inspect ResourceProvider, Category and OperationName before using it in investigation.
targetResources_Uri_s.description_zh: 名称推断：事件引用的目标资源 URI，由发送服务写入。缺少服务上下文时含义不明确；使用前应检查 ResourceProvider、Category 和 OperationName。

timeStamp_t.description: Datetime value representing a service-reported timestamp for the event, per the emitting service. Distinct from ingestion time in TimeGenerated; use it to compare provider clock against workspace receipt.
timeStamp_t.description_zh: 日期时间值，表示发送服务上报的事件时间戳。与 TimeGenerated 的引入时间不同；可用于比较提供方时钟与工作区接收时间。

timeTaken_d.description: Numeric duration value for the logged request or operation, likely in milliseconds, per the emitting service. Units are not documented here; use comparatively within one service and confirm with timeTaken_s.
timeTaken_d.description_zh: 数值型时长，表示所记录请求或操作的耗时，可能以毫秒为单位，由发送服务写入。此处未记录单位；宜在同一服务内作相对比较，并与 timeTaken_s 相互确认。

timeTaken_s.description: String-valued duration for the logged request or operation, per the emitting service. String typing means units and formatting vary; prefer timeTaken_d for numeric analysis where both are populated.
timeTaken_s.description_zh: 字符串型时长，表示所记录请求或操作的耗时，由发送服务写入。字符串类型意味着单位和格式可能不一致；两者都存在时，数值分析宜优先使用 timeTaken_d。

timeToFirstByte_s.description: String-valued measure of time to first byte for the logged request, per the emitting service. Units and formatting are not documented; use within a single service for latency comparison, not cross-service.
timeToFirstByte_s.description_zh: 字符串型指标，表示所记录请求的首字节时间，由发送服务写入。单位与格式未记录；宜在同一服务内比较延迟，不宜跨服务直接比较。

timestamp_s.description: Name-derived: string timestamp recorded by the emitting service within its log payload, distinct from TimeGenerated ingestion. Format varies; parse explicitly before comparing timelines across services.
timestamp_s.description_zh: 名称推断：发送服务在其日志负载中记录的字符串时间戳，与 TimeGenerated 引入时间不同。格式各异；跨服务比较时间线前应显式解析。

tlsVersion_s.description: String naming the TLS version used by the logged connection, per the emitting service. Useful for spotting weak or legacy protocol use; absence on a row does not prove TLS was unused.
tlsVersion_s.description_zh: 字符串，表示所记录连接使用的 TLS 版本，由发送服务写入。可用于发现弱协议或旧版协议的使用；某行缺失该值并不能证明未使用 TLS。

totalLatencyMilliseconds_s.description: String-valued total latency in milliseconds for the logged request path, per the emitting service. Useful for latency triage; string typing means validate before numeric comparison or aggregation.
totalLatencyMilliseconds_s.description_zh: 字符串型总延迟（毫秒），表示所记录请求路径的整体延时，由发送服务写入。可用于延迟排查；字符串类型意味着做数值比较或聚合前需先校验。

trackingReference_s.description: String tracking reference assigned by the emitting service for correlating related request records. Use alongside CorrelationId when tracing a transaction across components; uniqueness is not guaranteed or documented.
trackingReference_s.description_zh: 字符串型跟踪引用，由发送服务分配，用于关联相关请求记录。跨组件追踪事务时可与 CorrelationId 配合；其唯一性未有文档保证。

transactionId_g.description: GUID-like identifier grouping records that belong to the same transaction, per the emitting service. Useful for ordering and stitching multi-record operations; treat scope and uniqueness as service-dependent.
transactionId_g.description_zh: 类 GUID 标识符，将由发送服务写入的同属一个事务的记录归组。可用于排序和拼接多记录操作；其作用范围与唯一性因服务而异。

truncated_d.description: Numeric indicator that the logged payload or record was truncated by the emitting service, likely a count or flag. Meaning of specific values is undocumented; inspect alongside Message and detail fields.
truncated_d.description_zh: 数值型指示，表示发送服务所记录负载或记录被截断，可能是计数或标志。各具体取值的含义未记录；应与 Message 及明细字段一同查看。

trustedService_s.description: Name-derived: string indicating a trusted-service relationship or exemption applied to the logged request, per the emitting service. Confirm allowed values from resource context rather than assuming a boolean meaning.
trustedService_s.description_zh: 名称推断：字符串，表示所记录请求适用的受信任服务关系或豁免，由发送服务写入。应从资源上下文确认允许取值，不应假定其含义等同布尔值。

type_s.description: String type discriminator supplied by the emitting service for the logged record or resource. Use to distinguish record kinds within a Category, but confirm allowed values from the service before filtering.
type_s.description_zh: 字符串类型判别值，由发送服务为所记录记录或资源提供。可用于在同一 Category 内区分记录种类；过滤前应先从该服务确认允许取值。

upstreamSourcePort_s.description: String-valued source port of the upstream connection, per the emitting service (for example gateway or proxy logs). String typing weakens numeric comparison; correlate with client IP fields when tracing connections.
upstreamSourcePort_s.description_zh: 字符串型上游连接源端口，由发送服务写入（例如网关或代理日志）。字符串类型不利于数值比较；追踪连接时可与客户端 IP 字段关联。

url_s.description: Name-derived URL string for the operation in this table's Azure Diagnostics records, typically the requested endpoint for API, WAF, or gateway-style rows. Inspect the resource/category context to confirm its meaning before relying on it for analysis.
url_s.description_zh: 名称推断的 URL 字符串，表示本表 Azure Diagnostics 记录中请求的端点，常见于 API、WAF 或网关类行。使用前应结合资源与 Category 上下文确认其含义。

userAgent_s.description: Name-derived user-agent string identifying the requesting client software for this table's request-style rows. Useful with CallerIPAddress and URL to attribute activity, but not proof of user identity. Confirm via the row's resource/category scope.
userAgent_s.description_zh: 名称推断的 user-agent 字符串，标识本表请求类行中发起请求的客户端软件。可与 CallerIPAddress、URL 一起用于归因活动，但不能证明用户身份。应结合行的资源与 Category 范围确认。

vnetResourceGuid_g.description: Name-derived GUID that likely references the virtual network resource associated with a network-flow or NSG-style record. Inspect the resource and category context to confirm its referent before joining; do not assume it identifies an event or user.
vnetResourceGuid_g.description_zh: 名称推断的 GUID，可能引用与网络流或 NSG 类记录关联的虚拟网络资源。连接前应检查资源与类别上下文以确认所指对象；不要假定它标识事件或用户。

workflowId_s.description: Name-derived workflow identifier string for workflow- or automation-style records, grouping activity within one workflow run in this table. Verify against the row's resource provider and category, and avoid treating it as a job or correlation identifier without confirmation.
workflowId_s.description_zh: 名称推断的工作流标识符字符串，用于工作流或自动化类记录，可把一次工作流运行内的活动归为一组。应核对该行的资源提供程序与类别；未确认前不要把它当作作业或关联标识符。

AzureMetrics.description: Azure resource metric records with MetricName, TimeGrain, Average, Minimum, Maximum, Total, Count and resource identifiers. Use these to inspect recorded performance or health trends around an investigation window. The local schema union also includes indicator-related fields such as MaliciousIP, IndicatorThreatType and ReportReferenceLink; inspect operation and resource context before interpreting those rows. It is not a replacement for detailed resource-operation logs in AzureDiagnostics.
AzureMetrics.description_zh: 记录 Azure 资源指标，包含 MetricName、TimeGrain、Average、Minimum、Maximum、Total、Count 和资源标识，可用于查看调查时间段内记录的性能或健康趋势。本地架构并集还包含 MaliciousIP、IndicatorThreatType、ReportReferenceLink 等指标情报字段，解释这些记录前需核对操作与资源上下文。本表不能替代 AzureDiagnostics 中的具体资源操作日志。

AdditionalInformation.description: Extra service-specific detail attached to a metric sample. Its structure is not documented, so treat readings as name-derived and inspect the resource and category context before relying on them.
AdditionalInformation.description_zh: 附加到指标样本的服务特定补充信息。其结构未在文档中说明，因此应将其视为由名称推断，并在依赖前检查资源和类别上下文。

Average.description: Mean value of the metric over the reported time grain, used with Count to normalize comparisons across resources or periods where sample volumes differ.
Average.description_zh: 该指标在报告时间粒度内的平均值，与 Count 配合使用，可在样本量不同的资源或时段之间做归一化比较。

CallerIpAddress.description: Source address associated with the metric emission when the service records one; documented as deprecated, so treat as name-derived and corroborate with activity or diagnostic logs.
CallerIpAddress.description_zh: 当服务记录时，与指标发出关联的源地址；文档标注为弃用，因此应视为由名称推断，并与活动或诊断日志相互印证。

Category.description: Service-defined classification of the metric record; documented as deprecated. Use it to scope which resource or provider metrics share a schema before querying other columns.
Category.description_zh: 指标记录的服务定义分类；文档标注为弃用。可在查询其他列前用它限定哪些资源或提供程序的指标共享同一架构。

Confidence.description: Confidence level attached to threat-indicator style values on this row; deprecated. A value here is evidence metadata, not proof of compromise, so validate independently.
Confidence.description_zh: 附加到该行威胁指示器类数值的置信度；已弃用。此处的值属于证据元数据，并非已遭入侵的证明，因此应独立验证。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier used to correlate related service records; deprecated on this table. Where populated, use it to group metric rows with companion diagnostic entries.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 用于关联相关服务记录的标识符；在本表中已弃用。若已填充，可用它将指标行与配套的诊断条目分组。

Count.description: Number of samples collected during the time range. Use it to judge how many values contributed to the average and to weight or discount noisy metric comparisons.
Count.description_zh: 在时间范围内采集的样本数。可用它判断有多少数值参与了平均值，并对有噪声的指标比较进行加权或折减。

Description.description: Free-text description carried on the metric row; documented as deprecated. Its content is service-defined, so read it only as contextual annotation, not authoritative classification.
Description.description_zh: 指标行上携带的自由文本描述；文档标注为弃用。其内容由服务定义，因此仅作为上下文注释阅读，而非权威分类。

DurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds for the measured operation; deprecated here. When present, use it for latency trend analysis rather than for timing a specific user action.
DurationMs.description_zh: 被测操作的持续时间（毫秒）；在本表中已弃用。若存在，可用于延迟趋势分析，而不用于为某个具体用户操作计时。

FirstReportedDateTime.description: Timestamp when a threat indicator tied to this row was first reported; deprecated. Treat as reference metadata, not as the time the metric itself occurred.
FirstReportedDateTime.description_zh: 与该行关联的威胁指示器首次报告的时间戳；已弃用。应将其视为参考元数据，而非指标本身发生的时间。

IndicatorThreatType.description: Classification of a threat indicator associated with this row; deprecated. A populated value indicates an intelligence match, which alone does not establish compromise.
IndicatorThreatType.description_zh: 与该行关联的威胁指示器分类；已弃用。有值表示情报匹配，但这本身并不能确认已遭入侵。

IsActive.description: Flag indicating whether the associated indicator or record is currently active; deprecated. Use it to filter stale intelligence references, verifying the value's meaning in resource context.
IsActive.description_zh: 指示关联指示器或记录当前是否活跃的标志；已弃用。可用它过滤过期的情报引用，并在资源上下文中核实该值含义。

LastReportedDateTime.description: Timestamp when a threat indicator on this row was most recently reported; deprecated. Compare with FirstReportedDateTime to gauge indicator recency, not metric event time.
LastReportedDateTime.description_zh: 该行威胁指示器最近一次报告的时间戳；已弃用。可与 FirstReportedDateTime 比较以判断指示器新旧，而非指标事件时间。

MaliciousIP.description: Address flagged by threat intelligence in connection with this metric row; deprecated. A match is investigatory evidence only and does not by itself prove compromise or malicious traffic.
MaliciousIP.description_zh: 被威胁情报标记为与该指标行相关地址；已弃用。匹配仅为调查证据，本身不能证明已遭入侵或存在恶意流量。

Maximum.description: Highest value collected during the time range. Useful for spotting peaks, saturation or outliers that an average over the same grain would conceal.
Maximum.description_zh: 在时间范围内采集到的最高值。可用于发现同一粒度下平均值会掩盖的峰值、饱和或离群值。

MetricName.description: Display name of the metric being reported. Use it to select the specific counter, such as latency or CPU percentage, before comparing values across resources.
MetricName.description_zh: 所报告指标的显示名称。可在跨资源比较数值前，用它选择具体的计数器，例如延迟或 CPU 百分比。

Minimum.description: Lowest value collected during the time range. Read alongside Maximum and Average to understand the spread of a metric within its grain.
Minimum.description_zh: 在时间范围内采集到的最低值。与 Maximum 和 Average 一起阅读，可了解指标在其粒度内的分布范围。

OperationName.description: Name of the service operation associated with the metric; deprecated on this table. Where populated, use it to relate metric trends to a specific API or management action.
OperationName.description_zh: 与指标关联的服务操作名称；在本表中已弃用。若已填充，可用它将指标趋势关联到特定 API 或管理操作。

OperationVersion.description: Version of the operation associated with this metric row; deprecated. Interpret as a schema or API version marker for the resource, not as a user or agent version.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 与该指标行关联的操作版本；已弃用。应将其理解为资源的架构或 API 版本标记，而非用户或代理版本。

RemoteIPCountry.description: Country resolved for a remote address recorded on the row; deprecated. Use it only for coarse geographic context, since resolution source and accuracy are undocumented.
RemoteIPCountry.description_zh: 该行记录的远程地址所解析到的国家；已弃用。仅用于粗略地理背景，因为解析来源和准确度均未在文档中说明。

RemoteIPLatitude.description: Latitude resolved for a remote address on the row; deprecated. Treat as approximate geolocation metadata, not a verified location of any user or device.
RemoteIPLatitude.description_zh: 该行远程地址所解析到的纬度；已弃用。应视为近似地理定位元数据，而非任何用户或设备的已验证位置。

RemoteIPLongitude.description: Longitude resolved for a remote address on the row; deprecated. Pair with latitude if needed, acknowledging geolocation is approximate and not proof of origin.
RemoteIPLongitude.description_zh: 该行远程地址所解析到的经度；已弃用。如需可配合纬度使用，但需知地理定位是近似的，不能证明来源。

ReportReferenceLink.description: Reference link to an external report associated with indicator data on the row. Structure is undocumented, so treat as name-derived and validate the linked source before use.
ReportReferenceLink.description_zh: 指向该行指示器数据相关外部报告的参考链接。结构未在文档中说明，因此应视为由名称推断，并在使用前验证链接来源。

Resource.description: Name of the Azure resource reporting the metric. Use it to attribute metric values and trends to the correct resource when investigating service health.
Resource.description_zh: 报告该指标资源的名称。在调查服务健康状况时，可用它将指标值和趋势归属到正确的资源。

ResourceGroup.description: Resource group containing the Azure resource that emitted this metric sample. Use it to scope metric trends to a deployment boundary or compare resources managed together.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 包含上报此指标样本的 Azure 资源的资源组。可用于将指标趋势限定到部署边界，或比较同一管理范围内的资源。

ResourceId.description: Full Azure resource ID of the resource reporting the metric; retained for backward compatibility. Prefer _ResourceId for joins; use this when older queries or exports only carry ResourceId.
ResourceId.description_zh: 上报指标的资源的完整 Azure 资源 ID，为向后兼容保留。关联时优先使用 _ResourceId；当旧查询或导出仅包含 ResourceId 时使用此字段。

ResourceProvider.description: Azure resource provider namespace for the reporting resource, such as Microsoft.Compute. Use it to group metrics by service family or verify that a metric name belongs to the expected provider.
ResourceProvider.description_zh: 上报资源的 Azure 资源提供程序命名空间，例如 Microsoft.Compute。可用于按服务类别分组指标，或验证指标名称是否属于预期的提供程序。

ResultDescription.description: Marked deprecated in AzureMetrics; its presence varies by row. Treat any value as name-derived context only and verify against Resource or Category before relying on it in an investigation.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 在 AzureMetrics 中已标记为弃用，其存在与否因行而异。仅将任何值视为基于名称的上下文，并在调查中依赖前结合 Resource 或 Category 进行验证。

ResultSignature.description: Deprecated in AzureMetrics and not populated consistently. Do not use it for metric analysis; if a value appears, validate its meaning against the row's Resource and Category context.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 在 AzureMetrics 中已弃用，且填充不一致。不要用于指标分析；若出现值，应结合该行的 Resource 和 Category 上下文验证其含义。

ResultType.description: Documented as reducing the collected data set, with allowed syntax depending on the operation. In this metric table, interpret it as name-derived query or result scoping and confirm with Category or Resource context.
ResultType.description_zh: 文档说明用于缩减收集的数据集，允许的语法取决于操作。在此指标表中，将其解释为基于名称的查询或结果范围限定，并结合 Category 或 Resource 上下文确认。

Severity.description: Marked deprecated in AzureMetrics; not a reliable severity for metric samples. Treat any numeric value as name-derived only and inspect Resource, Category, and MetricName to decide whether it is meaningful.
Severity.description_zh: 在 AzureMetrics 中已标记为弃用，并非指标样本的可靠严重性。任何数值仅视为基于名称的字段，并检查 Resource、Category 和 MetricName 以判断其是否有意义。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection path that produced the record, such as Azure for Azure Diagnostics. Use it to separate metrics from different ingestion routes before aggregating across resources.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成记录的代理或收集路径，例如 Azure Diagnostics 的 Azure。在跨资源聚合前，可用它区分不同摄取途径的指标。

SubscriptionId.description: Azure subscription that contains the resource reporting the metric. Use it to scope metric queries to a billing or security boundary, and to correlate with subscription-level resource inventory.
SubscriptionId.description_zh: 包含上报指标资源的 Azure 订阅。可用于将指标查询限定到计费或安全边界，并与订阅级资源清单关联。

TLPLevel.description: Deprecated in AzureMetrics; not a dependable traffic-light-protocol marking for metric rows. Treat any value as name-derived and validate against Description or AdditionalInformation before sharing.
TLPLevel.description_zh: 在 AzureMetrics 中已弃用，并非指标行可靠的 TLP 标记。任何值仅视为基于名称，共享前应结合 Description 或 AdditionalInformation 验证。

TenantId.description: Documented as the workspace ID in this table, not an Azure directory tenant ID. Use it to scope queries to a Log Analytics workspace; do not treat it as an Entra tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 在此表中文档说明为工作区 ID，而非 Azure 目录租户 ID。可用于将查询限定到 Log Analytics 工作区；不要将其视为 Entra 租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the metric record was created in the workspace. Use it with TimeGrain to bound trend windows and align metric spikes with other telemetry timelines.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 指标记录在工作区中创建的日期和时间。结合 TimeGrain 用于限定趋势窗口，并将指标峰值与其他遥测时间线对齐。

TimeGrain.description: Aggregation interval for the metric sample, for example PT1M. Use it to normalize values across resources and to avoid comparing samples with different aggregation windows.
TimeGrain.description_zh: 指标样本的聚合间隔，例如 PT1M。可用于跨资源归一化数值，并避免比较聚合窗口不同的样本。

Total.description: Sum of all metric values in the time range for this resource and metric name. Use it for throughput or count-style metrics, but combine with Count when comparing across uneven time grains.
Total.description_zh: 该资源与指标名称在时间范围内所有指标值的总和。适用于吞吐量或计数类指标，但在时间粒度不均时需结合 Count 进行比较。

Type.description: Name of the table, expected to be AzureMetrics. Use it to filter or union schemas in cross-table queries and to confirm the record came from this metric table.
Type.description_zh: 表的名称，预期为 AzureMetrics。可用于跨表查询中的过滤或架构联合，并确认记录来自此指标表。

UnitName.description: Unit of the metric, such as Seconds, Percent, or Bytes. Use it to interpret Total, Maximum, Minimum, and Average correctly and to avoid mixing incompatible units in comparisons.
UnitName.description_zh: 指标的单位，例如 Seconds、Percent 或 Bytes。可用于正确解释 Total、Maximum、Minimum 和 Average，并避免在比较中混用不兼容的单位。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier for the resource associated with the metric record; preferred join key over ResourceId. Use it to link metrics to resource inventory and other resource-scoped telemetry.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与指标记录关联的资源的唯一标识符，优于 ResourceId 的关联键。可用于将指标关联到资源清单及其他资源范围遥测。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

CloudAppEvents.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps audit records for user and admin activity across connected cloud apps and services. Each row captures one activity event with actor account fields, app, action type, object details, client IP geolocation, and contextual flags. Use it to investigate app activity by user, application, action, object, IP, city/country, proxy use, or admin-operation status, and pivot between actor, target object, network context, and raw JSON. It differs from device inventory or sign-in tables: it records SaaS/cloud-app actions, not logons or endpoint state.
CloudAppEvents.description_zh: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps 审计记录，覆盖已连接云应用和服务中的用户与管理员活动。每行代表一个活动事件，包含执行账户、应用、操作类型、对象详情、客户端 IP 地理位置和上下文标志。可用于按用户、应用、操作、对象、IP、城市/国家、代理使用或管理员操作状态调查应用活动，并在执行者、目标对象、网络上下文与原始 JSON 之间进行关联分析。它与设备清单或登录表不同：记录的是 SaaS/云应用操作，而非登录或终端状态。

AccountDisplayName.description: Address-book display name of the account whose activity is recorded. Use with AccountId/AccountObjectId to confirm actor identity or catch renamed or masquerading accounts.
AccountDisplayName.description_zh: 被记录活动账户的通讯录显示名称。可与 AccountId/AccountObjectId 结合，确认执行者身份或发现改名、冒充账户。

AccountId.description: Cloud App Security identifier for the acting account, often UPN or Entra object ID. Primary actor key for grouping events; verify format before joining to other identity tables.
AccountId.description_zh: Cloud App Security 对执行账户的标识，常为 UPN 或 Entra 对象 ID。作为主要执行者键用于聚合事件；跨身份表关联前需确认格式。

AccountObjectId.description: Entra object ID of the acting account, when available. Join key to directory and identity logs; may be empty for some app event sources, so validate per event.
AccountObjectId.description_zh: 执行账户的 Entra 对象 ID（若可用）。与目录和身份日志关联的键；部分应用事件源可能为空，需逐事件校验。

AccountType.description: General role classification of the acting account, such as regular, admin, system, or application. Useful for prioritizing privileged activity; inspect actual values per source.
AccountType.description_zh: 执行账户的一般角色分类，如普通、管理员、系统或应用。用于优先排查特权活动；具体取值需按来源检查。

ActionType.description: Type of activity that triggered the event, indicating what the actor did in the app. Core filtering and grouping field for building investigation timelines.
ActionType.description_zh: 触发事件的活动类型，表示执行者在应用中做了什么。是构建调查时间线时的核心筛选与分组字段。

ActivityObjects.description: Dynamic list of objects, such as files or folders, involved in the recorded activity. Parse to identify targeted resources; structure varies by app so inspect resource/category context.
ActivityObjects.description_zh: 记录活动中涉及的对象（如文件或文件夹）的动态列表。解析以识别被操作资源；结构因应用而异，需结合资源/类别上下文检查。

ActivityType.description: Activity type that triggered the event, similar in purpose to ActionType. Use to classify app operations when ActionType values are too coarse or absent.
ActivityType.description_zh: 触发事件的活动类型，用途与 ActionType 类似。当 ActionType 取值过粗或缺失时，用于对应用操作进行分类。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic container of extra event or entity attributes not in fixed columns. Inspect keys during hunting; structure is source-specific and name-derived semantics require category context.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 未纳入固定列的额外事件或实体属性的动态容器。排查时需检查其键；结构因来源而异，名称推导语义需结合类别上下文。

AppInstanceId.description: Identifier for a specific instance of an application in the cloud environment. Helps separate activity across multiple app deployments or tenants-pinned instances.
AppInstanceId.description_zh: 云环境中某个应用特定实例的标识。用于区分多个应用部署或绑定实例之间的活动。

Application.description: Name of the cloud application that performed or logged the recorded action. Key scoping field for selecting relevant app events across the heterogeneous dataset.
Application.description_zh: 执行或记录该活动的云应用名称。是在异构数据集中筛选相关应用事件的关键范围字段。

ApplicationId.description: Numeric identifier for the application associated with the event. Use with Application to disambiguate apps sharing similar display names or across locales.
ApplicationId.description_zh: 与该事件关联应用的数字标识。可与 Application 配合，区分名称相似或跨区域的应用。

City.description: Geolocated city for the client IP address of the event. Use with CountryCode and ISP to assess location plausibility during session anomaly review.
City.description_zh: 事件客户端 IP 地理定位的城市。与 CountryCode 和 ISP 结合，可在会话异常审查中评估位置合理性。

CountryCode.description: Two-letter country code geolocated for the client IP. Pivot for impossible-travel or foreign-access triage; correlate with account's normal access regions.
CountryCode.description_zh: 客户端 IP 地理定位的两位国家代码。用于不可能旅行或境外访问初步排查；与账户常规访问地区关联分析。

DeviceType.description: Type of device associated with the activity, based on purpose or platform category. Combine with OSPlatform and UserAgent to characterize the client environment.
DeviceType.description_zh: 与活动关联的设备类型，按用途或平台类别划分。可与 OSPlatform 和 UserAgent 结合，刻画客户端环境。

IPAddress.description: IP address assigned to the client during the recorded communication. Central network pivot for threat intel, proxy checks, and correlation across users or apps.
IPAddress.description_zh: 记录通信期间分配给客户端的 IP 地址。用于威胁情报、代理检查和跨用户或应用关联的核心网络枢纽。

IPCategory.description: Additional classification information about the event IP address. Name-derived interpretation; inspect actual values alongside IPTags and IP reputation context.
IPCategory.description_zh: 关于事件 IP 地址的附加分类信息。属名称推导解释；需结合 IPTags 和 IP 信誉上下文检查实际取值。

IPTags.description: Customer-defined labels applied to specific IP addresses or ranges. Reflects your own tagging scheme, not built-in reputation; use to filter known corporate or suspicious ranges.
IPTags.description_zh: 应用于特定 IP 地址或范围的自定义标签。反映你自己的标记方案而非内置信誉；用于筛选已知企业或可疑范围。

ISP.description: Internet service provider associated with the client IP address. Useful with City/CountryCode to judge whether access origin fits the user's expected network.
ISP.description_zh: 与客户端 IP 地址关联的互联网服务提供商。可与 City/CountryCode 配合，判断访问来源是否符合用户预期网络。

IsAdminOperation.description: Boolean indicating whether the recorded activity was performed by an administrator. Flag privileged actions for priority review; does not by itself prove malicious intent.
IsAdminOperation.description_zh: 布尔值，表示该活动是否由管理员执行。用于标记需优先审查的特权操作；其本身并不能证明恶意意图。

IsAnonymousProxy.description: Boolean indicating whether the event IP belongs to a known anonymous proxy. Risk signal for evasive access; corroborate with other evidence before concluding intent.
IsAnonymousProxy.description_zh: 布尔值，表示事件 IP 是否属于已知匿名代理。属规避访问的风险信号；得出结论前需与其他证据相互印证。

IsExternalUser.description: Boolean indicating a user inside the network who does not belong to the organization's domain. Helps separate guest or partner activity from internal employee actions.
IsExternalUser.description_zh: 布尔值，表示网络内不属于组织域的用户。用于区分访客或合作伙伴活动与内部员工操作。

IsImpersonated.description: Boolean indicating the activity was performed by one user on behalf of another via impersonation. Distinguish true actor from represented identity when attributing actions.
IsImpersonated.description_zh: 布尔值，表示该活动由某用户通过模拟代表另一用户执行。归因操作时需区分真实执行者与被代表身份。

OSPlatform.description: Operating system platform running on the client device, including family variations. Pair with DeviceType and UserAgent to profile the endpoint behind an app action.
OSPlatform.description_zh: 客户端设备运行的操作系统平台，含同族变体。与 DeviceType 和 UserAgent 配合，可刻画应用操作背后的终端。

ObjectId.description: Unique identifier of the object the recorded action was applied to. Join key for tracing which file, message, or resource an actor touched.
ObjectId.description_zh: 被记录操作所作用对象的唯一标识。用于追踪执行者所操作具体文件、邮件或资源的关联键。

ObjectName.description: Name of the object the recorded action targeted, such as a file, folder, or site. Use with ObjectType and ActionType to identify exactly what was accessed, modified, or shared.
ObjectName.description_zh: 被记录操作所针对的对象名称，如文件、文件夹或站点。结合 ObjectType 和 ActionType 可确定具体访问、修改或共享的内容。

ObjectType.description: Category of the object the action applied to, such as file, folder, or user. Pair with ObjectName to scope which resource type was affected by the cloud app activity.
ObjectType.description_zh: 操作所作用对象的类别，如文件、文件夹或用户。与 ObjectName 配合可界定云应用活动影响的资源类型。

RawEventData.description: Raw JSON event payload from the source cloud application or service, as collected by Defender for Cloud Apps. Inspect for provider-specific attributes not surfaced in normalized columns.
RawEventData.description_zh: 来自源云应用或服务的原始 JSON 事件负载，由 Defender for Cloud Apps 收集。可检查其中未在标准化列中体现的特定于提供商的属性。

ReportId.description: Identifier assigned to the activity report or event by the reporting service. Use to group or correlate related records from the same source activity.
ReportId.description_zh: 由报告服务为该活动报告或事件分配的标识符。可用于对同一源活动的相关记录进行分组或关联。

SourceSystem.description: Collector or agent type that ingested the record into the workspace. Indicates the ingestion path and helps validate data provenance when scoping cloud app activity results.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 将记录采集到工作区的收集器或代理类型。指示摄取路径，有助于在筛选云应用活动结果时验证数据来源。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with the record. Used to scope queries to a workspace; it is not a directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。用于将查询限定到某个工作区；它不是目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the record was generated in the log pipeline. Use as the primary time filter for ordering and bounding cloud app activity investigations.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 记录在日志管道中生成时的 UTC 时间戳。用作云应用活动调查的主要时间过滤和排序依据。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table providing the record. Useful in union queries across multiple tables to separate CloudAppEvents rows from other sources.
Type.description_zh: 提供该记录的表的名称。在跨多表的联合查询中，可用于区分 CloudAppEvents 的行与其他来源。

UserAgent.description: User agent string from the browser or client application that performed the activity. Use to fingerprint clients, identify automation or legacy software, and correlate with UserAgentTags.
UserAgent.description_zh: 执行该活动的浏览器或客户端应用的用户代理字符串。可用于对客户端进行指纹识别、发现自动化或旧版软件，并与 UserAgentTags 关联。

UserAgentTags.description: Defender for Cloud Apps tags derived from the user agent, such as indicating native client, outdated browser, outdated operating system, or robot. Use to flag anomalous clients, not as proof of compromise.
UserAgentTags.description_zh: 由用户代理派生的 Defender for Cloud Apps 标签，如指示本机客户端、过时浏览器、过时操作系统或机器人。可用于标记异常客户端，但不能作为失陷的证据。

DeviceEvents.description: Defender for Endpoint advanced-hunting events covering multiple endpoint activity types as reported by the sensor, including security-control and process-related events. Each row is one event on one device, scoped to the workspace via TenantId, with ActionType distinguishing activity. Useful for endpoint timeline reconstruction, process lineage, command-line and file-provenance pivots, and paired local/remote network or registry context when those columns are populated. Because categories are heterogeneous, many columns are empty per row, and a single row does not represent the complete cross-table picture of a process, connection, or logon.
DeviceEvents.description_zh: Defender for Endpoint 高级搜寻事件，覆盖传感器上报的多种终结点活动类型，包括安全控制类与进程相关事件。每行代表一台设备上的一次事件，通过 TenantId 归属工作区，ActionType 区分活动类型。适用于终结点时间线重建、进程血缘、命令行与文件来源追踪，以及在该行字段有值时的本机/远程网络或注册表上下文关联。由于类别异构，同一行中大量字段为空，单行并不代表进程、网络连接或登录的完整跨表全貌。

AccountDomain.description: Domain portion of the account associated with this event row, such as the machine or identity domain of the acted-upon account. Pair with AccountName/AccountSid to identify the account context for this specific ActionType.
AccountDomain.description_zh: 该事件行关联账户的域部分，例如被操作账户所在的机器域或身份域。应与 AccountName/AccountSid 配合，确定该 ActionType 下的账户上下文。

AccountName.description: User name of the account associated with this event on this device, not necessarily the process initiator. Compare with InitiatingProcessAccountName to distinguish the affected account from the account that ran the initiating process.
AccountName.description_zh: 该设备上与本事件关联的账户用户名，不一定是进程发起者。可与 InitiatingProcessAccountName 对比，区分受影响账户与运行发起进程的账户。

AccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account associated with this event, useful when the same name appears in multiple domains or was renamed. Resolve it through identity data rather than assuming a human user.
AccountSid.description_zh: 与本事件关联账户的安全标识符，适用于同名账户存在于多个域或账户已改名的情况。应通过身份数据解析，而不要默认其为真人用户。

ActionType.description: Name-derived activity category that distinguishes the kind of endpoint event recorded on this row, and therefore which optional columns are meaningful. Scope by it before interpreting other fields, recognizing values are not exhaustively listed here.
ActionType.description_zh: 基于名称推断的活动类别，用于区分本行记录的终结点事件类型，进而决定哪些可选字段有意义。解读其他字段前应先按其限定范围，并注意此处并未穷举其取值。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag holding extra, event-type-specific properties not surfaced as dedicated columns. Inspect its keys per ActionType during investigation instead of assuming a fixed schema or documented JSON path.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 动态字段包，存放未作为独立列暴露的、随事件类型而异的附加属性。调查时应按 ActionType 检查其键，不要假定固定结构或已有文档记录的 JSON 路径。

AppGuardContainerId.description: Identifier of the Application Guard virtualized container when browser activity was isolated; populated only for relevant events. Presence indicates containerized browsing context, not by itself malicious activity.
AppGuardContainerId.description_zh: 浏览器活动被隔离时所用的 Application Guard 虚拟化容器标识符，仅相关事件会填充。其存在表示容器化浏览上下文，本身并不能证明恶意活动。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned identifier for the endpoint that produced this event, stable across DeviceName changes. Use it to group a device's events, join other Defender tables, and scope PID interpretation to one machine.
DeviceId.description_zh: 产生本事件的终结点在服务中的标识符，跨 DeviceName 变更保持稳定。可用它归组同一设备事件、连接其他 Defender 表，并将 PID 解读限定到单台机器。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified name of the endpoint reporting this event, convenient for human-readable grouping or filtering. Names can be reused or renamed, so confirm device identity through DeviceId when precision matters.
DeviceName.description_zh: 上报本事件的终结点完全限定名，便于人类可读地分组或过滤。名称可能被重用或更改，需要精确时应用 DeviceId 确认设备身份。

FileName.description: File name associated with the event when the ActionType concerns a file operation or detection; empty for unrelated event types. Use with FolderPath and hash columns to identify the file involved, independent of the initiating process.
FileName.description_zh: 当 ActionType 涉及文件操作或检测时，本事件关联的文件名；无关事件类型为空。应与 FolderPath 及哈希列配合识别所涉文件，与发起进程无关。

FileOriginIP.description: IP address from which the associated file was downloaded, when the event records file provenance. Network addresses may be shared or proxied; treat it as a lead for correlation, not proof of origin.
FileOriginIP.description_zh: 当事件记录文件来源时，关联文件被下载来源的 IP 地址。网络地址可能共享或经代理，应将其视为关联线索，而非来源证明。

FileOriginUrl.description: URL from which the associated file was downloaded, when recorded, supporting download-origin tracing. URL presence indicates the recorded origin, not that a user visited or clicked the link.
FileOriginUrl.description_zh: 当有记录时，关联文件被下载来源的 URL，可用于下载来源溯源。URL 存在仅表示所记录的来源，并不表示用户访问或点击过该链接。

FileSize.description: Size in bytes of the file associated with this event when file context applies; unpopulated otherwise. Compare with InitiatingProcessFileSize to distinguish the acted-upon file from the initiating process image.
FileSize.description_zh: 适用文件上下文时，本事件关联文件的大小（字节），否则未填充。可与 InitiatingProcessFileSize 对比，区分被操作文件与发起进程映像。

FolderPath.description: Directory containing the file associated with this event when file context applies, revealing install, temp, or user-writable locations. Combine with FileName and hashes rather than treating path alone as verdict.
FolderPath.description_zh: 适用文件上下文时，本事件关联文件所在目录，可揭示安装、临时或用户可写位置。应与 FileName 及哈希结合，不要仅凭路径下结论。

InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description: Domain of the user account that ran the initiating process for this event. Pair with InitiatingProcessAccountName and SID to attribute the process to an identity context distinct from the event's AccountName.
InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description_zh: 运行本事件发起进程的用户账户所在域。应与 InitiatingProcessAccountName 和 SID 配合，将该进程归属到区别于事件 AccountName 的身份上下文。

InitiatingProcessAccountName.description: User name of the account that ran the process responsible for this event, the primary attribution field for endpoint activity. Distinguish it from AccountName, which may describe the affected rather than initiating account.
InitiatingProcessAccountName.description_zh: 运行本事件所涉进程的账户用户名，是终结点活动的主要归属字段。应与 AccountName 区分，后者可能描述受影响账户而非发起账户。

InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description: Directory object identifier of the user account that ran the initiating process, useful for joining identity data when names or UPNs change. Absent for local-only or non-directory accounts; verify before assuming a cloud identity.
InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description_zh: 运行发起进程的用户账户的目录对象标识符，在名称或 UPN 变更时便于关联身份数据。仅本地或非目录账户可能为空，假定为云身份前应先核实。

InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account that ran the initiating process, reliable for distinguishing same-named accounts across machines or domains. Use it to confirm attribution alongside the account name and UPN.
InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description_zh: 运行发起进程账户的安全标识符，可可靠地区分跨机器或域的同名账户。应与账户名和 UPN 一起用于确认归属。

InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that ran the initiating process, helpful for pivoting to identity and email telemetry. UPN may reflect the current identity value rather than exactly what was present at event time.
InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description_zh: 运行发起进程账户的用户主体名称，便于转向身份与邮件遥测。UPN 可能反映当前身份值，而非事件发生时的确切值。

InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description: Full command line of the process that initiated this event, often the richest signal for intent such as scripts, encoded arguments, or LOLBin abuse. Interpret arguments in context of the file name and parent process.
InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 发起本事件的进程完整命令行，常是判断意图的最丰富信号，如脚本、编码参数或 LOLBin 滥用。应结合文件名与父进程解读其参数。

InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description: Time the initiating process started, enabling ordering of process starts against this event's timestamp and detection of short-lived or long-dormant processes. Compare with InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime for lineage sanity.
InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 发起进程启动的时间，可用于将该进程启动与本事件时间戳排序，并发现短生命周期或长期潜伏的进程。可与 InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime 对比以校验血缘。

InitiatingProcessFileName.description: Executable file name of the process that initiated this event, such as powershell.exe or a renamed binary. Renaming is common, so corroborate with folder path, hashes, and command line before concluding.
InitiatingProcessFileName.description_zh: 发起本事件进程的可执行文件名，如 powershell.exe 或被改名的二进制文件。改名很常见，得出结论前应结合文件夹路径、哈希与命令行交叉验证。

InitiatingProcessFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the executable image that ran the initiating process, useful to spot unusually small or padded payloads. Distinguish it from FileSize, which describes the file acted upon in this event.
InitiatingProcessFileSize.description_zh: 运行发起进程的可执行映像大小（字节），有助于发现异常小或被填充的载荷。应区别于 FileSize，后者描述本事件中被操作的文件。

InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description: Directory containing the executable that initiated this event, revealing user-writable, temporary, or system locations. Location plus name and hashes together support verdicts; path alone is contextual, not conclusive.
InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description_zh: 发起本事件的可执行文件所在目录，可揭示用户可写、临时或系统位置。位置需与名称、哈希共同支撑结论；仅凭路径只是上下文而非定论。

InitiatingProcessId.description: Process ID of the initiating process as seen on its device at event time. PID values are reused and only meaningful when scoped to a DeviceId and timestamp, so pair them with creation time.
InitiatingProcessId.description_zh: 发起进程在事件发生时于其设备上的进程 ID。PID 会被重用，只有结合 DeviceId 与时间戳才有意义，因此应与创建时间配对使用。

InitiatingProcessLogonId.description: Logon session identifier (valid only on the same machine between reboots) for the process that initiated the event; pair with DeviceId and Timestamp to link activity to a session, not unique across devices.
InitiatingProcessLogonId.description_zh: 发起事件的进程所在登录会话的标识符（仅在同一台设备重启之间唯一）；需与 DeviceId、Timestamp 一起使用以关联会话活动，跨设备不唯一。

InitiatingProcessMD5.description: MD5 hash of the image file of the process that initiated the event; use with file name, path and SHA1 to identify the initiating binary during triage.
InitiatingProcessMD5.description_zh: 发起事件的进程镜像文件的 MD5 哈希；在排查时结合文件名、路径和 SHA1 共同识别发起进程的二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description: Start time of the parent process that spawned the initiating process; compare with InitiatingProcessCreationTime to build process lineage and spot short-lived or orphaned parents.
InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description_zh: 启动发起进程的父进程的创建时间；与 InitiatingProcessCreationTime 对比可构建进程谱系，识别短命或异常的父进程。

InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description: File name of the parent process that spawned the process responsible for the event; use with parent PID and creation time to reconstruct the parent-child chain.
InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description_zh: 启动该事件发起进程的父进程文件名；结合父进程 PID 和创建时间可重建父子进程链。

InitiatingProcessParentId.description: Process ID of the parent process that spawned the initiating process; PID scope is device and time, so join with DeviceId and Timestamp when correlating.
InitiatingProcessParentId.description_zh: 启动发起进程的父进程 PID；PID 仅在特定设备与时间内有意义，关联时需结合 DeviceId 和 Timestamp。

InitiatingProcessSHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the image file of the process that initiated the event; commonly populated, use it as the primary hash for identifying the initiating binary.
InitiatingProcessSHA1.description_zh: 发起事件的进程镜像文件的 SHA1 哈希；通常有值，可作为识别发起进程二进制文件的主要哈希。

InitiatingProcessSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the process image that initiated the event; per documentation this column is usually not populated, so prefer SHA1 when identifying the initiating binary.
InitiatingProcessSHA256.description_zh: 发起事件的进程镜像文件的 SHA256 哈希；根据文档该列通常为空，识别发起进程二进制文件时优先使用 SHA1。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Company name from the version resource of the process image responsible for the event; useful for distinguishing vendor-signed binaries from unexpected or masquerading executables.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 事件发起进程镜像版本资源中的公司名称；可用于区分厂商签名程序与异常或伪装的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description: File description from the version resource of the process image responsible for the event; combine with original file name and product info to confirm the binary's legitimate identity.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description_zh: 事件发起进程镜像版本资源中的文件说明；结合原始文件名和产品信息可确认二进制的合法身份。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description: Internal file name from the version resource of the process image responsible for the event; divergences from the on-disk name can indicate renaming or masquerading.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description_zh: 事件发起进程镜像版本资源中的内部文件名；与磁盘上的文件名不一致时可能表明被重命名或伪装。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description: Original file name recorded in the version resource of the process image responsible for the event; compare with InitiatingProcessFileName to detect renamed or spoofed executables.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description_zh: 事件发起进程镜像版本资源中记录的原始文件名；与 InitiatingProcessFileName 对比可发现被重命名或伪造的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Product name from the version resource of the process image responsible for the event; helps attribute the initiating binary to expected software versus suspicious tooling.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 事件发起进程镜像版本资源中的产品名称；有助于判断发起进程属于预期软件还是可疑工具。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description: Product version from the version resource of the process image responsible for the event; useful for spotting outdated or unusually versioned software tied to the activity.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description_zh: 事件发起进程镜像版本资源中的产品版本；可用于发现与事件相关的老旧或异常版本软件。

LocalIP.description: IP address assigned to the local machine for the communication recorded in this event row; pair with LocalPort and RemoteIP to characterize the endpoint's network activity.
LocalIP.description_zh: 该事件行所记录通信中本地设备使用的 IP 地址；结合 LocalPort 与 RemoteIP 可刻画端点的网络活动。

LocalPort.description: TCP port on the local machine used in the communication recorded by this event; combine with LocalIP and RemoteIP/RemotePort to identify the network flow.
LocalPort.description_zh: 该事件所记录通信中本地设备使用的 TCP 端口；结合 LocalIP 与 RemoteIP/RemotePort 可识别对应的网络流。

LogonId.description: Logon session identifier for the action's target or subject account on this device (unique only between reboots); scope with DeviceId and Timestamp when correlating logon activity.
LogonId.description_zh: 该事件目标或被作用账户在本设备上的登录会话标识符（仅重启之间唯一）；关联登录活动时需结合 DeviceId 和 Timestamp。

MD5.description: MD5 hash of the file that the recorded action was applied to (not necessarily the executing process); use to identify or pivot on the affected file's content hash.
MD5.description_zh: 被记录操作所作用文件的 MD5 哈希（不一定是执行进程本身）；可用于识别或 pivoting 目标文件的内容哈希。

MachineGroup.description: Defender for Endpoint machine group used for role-based access control on the device; useful for scoping results to authorized device sets rather than as a technical indicator.
MachineGroup.description_zh: Defender for Endpoint 中用于设备基于角色访问控制的计算机组；适合用于将结果限定在授权设备范围，而非作为技术指标。

ProcessCommandLine.description: Command line used to create the new process described in this event; extract arguments, paths and encoded payloads to assess intent of the spawned process.
ProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 创建该事件中新进程所使用的命令行；可提取参数、路径和编码载荷以评估被创建进程的意图。

ProcessCreationTime.description: Date and time the new process (the subject of this event) was created; use with ProcessId, parent fields and DeviceId to order process activity on the host.
ProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 该事件中新进程（事件主体）的创建日期和时间；结合 ProcessId、父进程字段和 DeviceId 可对主机上的进程活动排序。

ProcessId.description: Process ID of the newly created process this event describes; PID is meaningful only with DeviceId and Timestamp, so scope joins accordingly.
ProcessId.description_zh: 该事件所描述新建进程的 PID；PID 只有在结合 DeviceId 和 Timestamp 时才有意义，因此关联时需相应限定范围。

ProcessTokenElevation.description: Token elevation status indicating whether UAC privilege elevation is present or absent for the newly created process; use to gauge whether the spawned process runs elevated.
ProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 新建进程的令牌提升状态，表明是否存在 UAC 权限提升；可用于判断被创建进程是否以提升权限运行。

RegistryKey.description: Registry key that the recorded action was applied to; relevant only for registry-related ActionTypes and useful for persistence or configuration-change investigations.
RegistryKey.description_zh: 被记录操作所作用的注册表项；仅适用于注册表相关的 ActionType，可用于持久化或配置变更调查。

RegistryValueData.description: Data written to or read from the registry value targeted by the recorded action; interpret only alongside RegistryKey, RegistryValueName and the event's ActionType.
RegistryValueData.description_zh: 被记录操作所针对的注册表值的数据；应结合 RegistryKey、RegistryValueName 及该事件的 ActionType 一起解读。

RegistryValueName.description: Name of the registry value touched by the recorded action on the device; qualifies registry-related ActionType rows and should be read together with RegistryKey to identify persistence or configuration changes.
RegistryValueName.description_zh: 记录操作在设备上涉及的注册表值名称；用于限定注册表类 ActionType 行，并应与 RegistryKey 一起解读，以识别持久化或配置更改。

RemoteDeviceName.description: Name of the device that performed a remote operation on the affected machine, possibly FQDN, NetBIOS, or short host name; use with RemoteIP for remote-action attribution, not as proof of compromise.
RemoteDeviceName.description_zh: 对受影响计算机执行远程操作的设备名称，可能是 FQDN、NetBIOS 或短主机名；应与 RemoteIP 配合用于远程操作归因，但不能作为入侵证据。

RemoteIP.description: IP address the recorded action connected to, from the perspective of the affected device; pair with RemotePort, RemoteUrl, and Timestamp to profile outbound connections by the initiating process.
RemoteIP.description_zh: 记录操作从受影响设备角度连接的目标 IP 地址；与 RemotePort、RemoteUrl 和 Timestamp 配合，可按发起进程刻画出站连接。

RemotePort.description: TCP port on the remote device connected to during the recorded action; combine with RemoteIP and RemoteUrl to distinguish service endpoints and correlate network activity with other tables.
RemotePort.description_zh: 记录操作所连接远程设备的 TCP 端口；结合 RemoteIP 和 RemoteUrl 可区分服务端点，并与其他表关联网络活动。

RemoteUrl.description: URL or FQDN the recorded action connected to; useful for identifying contacted domains by process, but does not by itself prove payload delivery or user interaction.
RemoteUrl.description_zh: 记录操作所连接的 URL 或 FQDN；有助于按进程识别联系的域名，但其本身不能证明载荷投递或用户交互。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the file the recorded action was applied to; use for file identification and threat-intelligence pivots, noting a hash match alone does not prove malicious intent or compromise.
SHA1.description_zh: 记录操作所作用文件的 SHA-1 哈希；用于文件识别和威胁情报透视，注意仅哈希匹配并不能证明恶意意图或入侵。

SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the file the recorded action was applied to; stronger file identifier for correlating with other tables and reputation lookups; treat matches as leads requiring context.
SHA256.description_zh: 记录操作所作用文件的 SHA-256 哈希；是更可靠的文件标识符，可与其他表和信誉查询关联；匹配结果应视为需要上下文的线索。

SourceSystem.description: The type of agent the event was collected by, indicating collection path for this row; use to filter or segment data when mixing sources, but verify field applicability across heterogeneous rows.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集本行事件的代理类型，指示采集路径；混合来源时可据此过滤或分段，但需注意该字段在异构行中的适用性。

TenantId.description: The Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this record; use for workspace-level scoping and cross-table joins, and do not interpret it as a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 与此记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；用于工作区范围限定和跨表联接，不得将其解释为目录租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the event was recorded by the MDE agent on the endpoint; primary time filter for narrowing activity windows, distinct from other timestamp-like columns of uncertain semantics.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在终结点上记录该事件的日期和时间；用于缩小活动时间窗口的主要时间过滤条件，不同于其他语义不确定的时间戳类列。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: The name of the table, typically DeviceEvents, used for table scoping in queries and unions; verify actual value when combining with other exported tables.
Type.description_zh: 表名称，通常为 DeviceEvents，用于查询和联合中的表范围限定；与其他导出表组合时请核实实际取值。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

DeviceFileCertificateInfo.description: Certificate information for signed files observed by certificate verification events on endpoints, captured per device-event with signer, issuer, trust and validity details. Use it to answer whether a file was signed, who signed it, whether its certificate chain was trusted, when the certificate was created or expires, and which devices carry files signed by a given certificate. Useful pivots include DeviceId/DeviceName, the file SHA1, Signer and Issuer hashes, certificate serial number, trust flags and certificate timestamps. It differs from file, process and device inventory tables: rows describe certificate verification for a file, not file execution, process activity or device configuration.
DeviceFileCertificateInfo.description_zh: 此表记录端点上证书验证事件中发现的已签名文件的证书信息，以设备-事件为粒度，包含签名者、颁发者、信任状态与有效期等细节。可用于回答文件是否已签名、由谁签名、证书链是否受信任、证书创建与过期时间，以及哪些设备上存在由某证书签名的文件。常用分析维度包括 DeviceId/DeviceName、文件 SHA1、Signer 与 Issuer 哈希、证书序列号、信任标志以及证书时间戳。它与文件表、进程表和设备清单表不同：每行描述的是针对某个文件的证书验证结果，而非文件执行、进程活动或设备配置。

CertificateCountersignatureTime.description: Time (UTC) the signing certificate was countersigned, which may indicate when a timestamp authority validated the signature. Compare with creation and observation time to spot unusual signing workflows.
CertificateCountersignatureTime.description_zh: 签名证书获得副签的时间（UTC），可能表明时间戳机构何时验证了签名。可与证书创建时间和事件时间对比，发现异常的签名流程。

CertificateCreationTime.description: Time (UTC) the certificate was issued. Use to assess certificate age and find very recently created signing certificates, which can be suspicious for trusted software.
CertificateCreationTime.description_zh: 证书的颁发时间（UTC）。可用于评估证书年龄，发现非常新近创建的签名证书，对于可信软件可能较为可疑。

CertificateExpirationTime.description: Time (UTC) the certificate expires. Compare with the event time to identify expired certificates still appearing on signed files, indicating stale or tampered artifacts.
CertificateExpirationTime.description_zh: 证书的到期时间（UTC）。可与事件时间比较，识别已过期证书仍出现在已签名文件中，暗示陈旧或被篡改的文件。

CertificateSerialNumber.description: Serial number assigned by the issuing CA, unique within that CA. Group events by serial number to trace all files and devices signed under the same certificate.
CertificateSerialNumber.description_zh: 颁发 CA 分配的证书序列号，在该 CA 内唯一。可按序列号分组事件，追踪由同一证书签名的所有文件和设备。

CrlDistributionPointUrls.description: Network share or URL locations where the certificate revocation lists for this certificate can be retrieved. Review for unusual, internal-only or unreachable endpoints when validating trust.
CrlDistributionPointUrls.description_zh: 可获取该证书吊销列表的网络共享或 URL 地址。在验证信任时，注意是否包含异常、仅内部或不可访问的端点。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned unique identifier of the endpoint where the certificate verification occurred. Use with DeviceName to scope certificate findings to specific devices and correlate with other tables.
DeviceId.description_zh: 证书验证发生端点的服务分配唯一标识。可与 DeviceName 一起将证书发现限定到特定设备，并与其他表关联。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device associated with the certificate verification event. Use for human-readable pivots and grouping when investigating which endpoints share a signer.
DeviceName.description_zh: 与证书验证事件关联设备的完全限定域名。用于可读的分组与透视，调查哪些端点共享同一签名者。

IsRootSignerMicrosoft.description: Boolean indicating whether the root certificate signer is Microsoft. Useful for quickly separating Microsoft-signed system files from third-party or potentially untrusted signatures.
IsRootSignerMicrosoft.description_zh: 布尔值，指示根证书签名者是否为 Microsoft。可快速区分 Microsoft 签名的系统文件与第三方或可能不受信任的签名。

IsSigned.description: Boolean indicating whether the file was signed. Use to filter for unsigned files on endpoints, which are more likely to be suspicious or policy-violating.
IsSigned.description_zh: 布尔值，指示文件是否已签名。可用于筛选端点上未签名的文件，这些文件更可能可疑或违反策略。

IsTrusted.description: Boolean indicating whether the file was trusted based on certificate verification checks such as unknown root, invalid signature or revocation. A false value merits deeper review but does not alone prove maliciousness.
IsTrusted.description_zh: 布尔值，指示基于未知根、无效签名或吊销等证书验证检查后文件是否受信任。为 false 时值得深入审查，但不单独证明文件恶意。

Issuer.description: Identifying information about the certificate authority that issued the certificate. Pivot on this to group files by issuing CA and identify unusual or self-signed issuers.
Issuer.description_zh: 颁发该证书的证书颁发机构的标识信息。可据此分组文件按颁发 CA，识别异常或自签名颁发者。

IssuerHash.description: Hash uniquely identifying the issuing certificate authority. Use instead of or alongside Issuer text for reliable grouping and joins across events with inconsistent issuer strings.
IssuerHash.description_zh: 唯一标识颁发证书颁发机构的哈希值。可在颁发者字符串不一致时，用于可靠分组和跨事件关联，替代或配合 Issuer 文本使用。

MachineGroup.description: Machine group used by role-based access control to determine access to the device. Useful for scoping investigations by administrative or security boundary.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 用于基于角色的访问控制以确定设备访问权限的计算机组。可用于按管理或安全边界限定调查范围。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the file whose signature was evaluated. Use to pivot from a file hash to all devices and certificates associated with that file.
SHA1.description_zh: 被评估签名的文件的 SHA-1 哈希值。可用于从文件哈希关联到该文件涉及的所有设备和证书。

SignatureType.description: Indicates whether signature information was read as embedded content in the file or from an external catalog file. Helps explain trust results and detect catalog vs embedded signature discrepancies.
SignatureType.description_zh: 指示签名信息是作为文件内嵌内容读取还是从外部目录文件读取。有助于解释信任结果，并发现目录签名与内嵌签名的差异。

Signer.description: Identifying information about the entity that signed the file. Pivot on this to find all files and devices signed by the same publisher or signer identity.
Signer.description_zh: 对文件进行签名实体的标识信息。可据此查找由同一发布者或签名者身份签名的所有文件和设备。

SignerHash.description: Hash uniquely identifying the signer. Use for reliable grouping and correlations when signer display names vary or may be spoofed.
SignerHash.description_zh: 唯一标识签名者的哈希值。当签名者显示名称多变或被伪造时，可用于可靠分组和关联。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that produced the record, such as OpsManager or Azure. Use to understand data origin and filter to the relevant ingestion path.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 产生记录的代理或收集渠道，例如 OpsManager 或 Azure。可用于了解数据来源并筛选相关采集路径。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record, as documented. Do not treat this as a directory tenant identifier; use it to scope queries to a workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID（按文档说明）。不要将其视为目录租户标识；可用于将查询限定到某个工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: Time (UTC) the event was recorded by the endpoint agent. Use as the primary time filter and axis for timeline analysis of certificate verification activity.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 端点代理记录该事件的时间（UTC）。可作为主要时间筛选条件和证书验证活动时间线分析的轴。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table that provided the record, typically DeviceFileCertificateInfo. Use to confirm table scope when querying across multiple tables.
Type.description_zh: 提供记录的表的名称，通常为 DeviceFileCertificateInfo。在跨多个表查询时，可用于确认表范围。

DeviceFileEvents.description: Defender for Endpoint file-system telemetry: one row per observed file creation, modification, rename or related file action on managed devices. Use it to trace which process and account wrote, changed or moved a file, where the file came from (download URL or source IP), and to hunt dropped payloads or tampered content. Pivots: DeviceId/DeviceName, FolderPath/FileName, SHA256/MD5, InitiatingProcess* fields, AdditionalFields. Its sibling DeviceProcessEvents covers process execution, not file writes.
DeviceFileEvents.description_zh: Defender for Endpoint 的文件系统遥测：每行表示受管设备上一次观察到的文件创建、修改、重命名或相关文件操作。可用于追踪哪个进程和账户写入、更改或移动了文件，文件来源（下载 URL 或源 IP），并用于狩猎投放的载荷或被篡改的内容。可用关联字段：DeviceId/DeviceName、FolderPath/FileName、SHA256/MD5、InitiatingProcess* 字段、AdditionalFields。其同类的 DeviceProcessEvents 覆盖进程执行，而非文件写入。

ActionType.description: Name-derived activity kind distinguishing the file operation recorded on this row, such as creation, modification or rename. Use it to segment events by operation; resource/category context should be inspected to confirm the precise enumeration.
ActionType.description_zh: 名称推导出的活动类型，用于区分本行记录的文件操作（如创建、修改或重命名）。可用它按操作划分事件；具体枚举应结合 resource/category 上下文确认。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag holding extra name-derived properties for this file event that lack dedicated columns. Inspect its keys per event to recover supplementary context; do not assume a fixed schema or JSON path across rows.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 动态字段集合，存放本文件事件中无独立列值的额外属性（名称推导）。可逐事件查看其键以获取补充上下文；不要假定各行具有固定结构或 JSON 路径。

AppGuardContainerId.description: Identifier of the Application Guard container that isolated the browser activity when this file event was produced. Its presence links the file action to an isolated browsing session on that device and time.
AppGuardContainerId.description_zh: 当本文件事件产生时，用于隔离浏览器活动的 Application Guard 容器标识符。其存在表明该文件操作与某设备、某时间的隔离浏览会话相关。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned identifier of the device on which the file event occurred. Join with other Defender tables to correlate this file action with device inventory, logons or connections from the same machine.
DeviceId.description_zh: 发生本文件事件的设备在服务中的标识符。可与其他 Defender 表关联，把该文件操作与同一设备的清单、登录或网络连接对应起来。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified name of the device where the recorded file action happened. Use for per-host grouping and reporting; pair with DeviceId because names can change or repeat over time.
DeviceName.description_zh: 记录的文件操作所在设备的完全限定名称。用于按主机分组和报告；应与 DeviceId 配合，因为名称可能随时间变化或重复。

FileName.description: Name of the file this event applied to, whether created, changed or renamed. Pivot on it with FolderPath to track the same file across devices and time.
FileName.description_zh: 本事件所作用文件的名称，无论其被创建、更改还是重命名。可与 FolderPath 组合，跨设备、跨时间追踪同一文件。

FileOriginIP.description: IP address from which the file was downloaded, per the data source's origin tracking. Investigate it for external delivery infrastructure; absence does not prove local creation.
FileOriginIP.description_zh: 据数据来源的溯源信息，文件被下载时的来源 IP。可用其调查外部投放基础设施；该字段为空并不证明文件是本地创建的。

FileOriginReferrerUrl.description: URL of the page that linked to the downloaded file, describing referral context for the download. Use with FileOriginUrl to reconstruct the delivery chain, not to prove a user click.
FileOriginReferrerUrl.description_zh: 链接到所下载文件的页面 URL，描述下载的引荐上下文。可与 FileOriginUrl 一起重建投递链，但不能据此证明用户点击。

FileOriginUrl.description: URL the file was downloaded from, indicating web or remote delivery source. Correlate with the initiating process and FileOriginIP when investigating browser or downloader activity.
FileOriginUrl.description_zh: 文件被下载来源的 URL，指示 Web 或远程投放来源。调查浏览器或下载器活动时，可与发起进程及 FileOriginIP 关联。

FileSize.description: Size of the affected file in bytes as recorded for this action. Use to compare file instances across hosts or versions and to flag unusually large or small variants.
FileSize.description_zh: 该操作所涉文件按记录的大小（字节）。可用于比较不同主机或版本上的文件实例，并标记异常偏大或偏小的变体。

FolderPath.description: Directory containing the file this event applied to. Combine with FileName to reconstruct the full path, and check for write locations typical of staging or persistence.
FolderPath.description_zh: 本事件所作用文件所在的目录。可与 FileName 组合还原完整路径，并检查符合暂存或持久化特征的写入位置。

InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that ran the process causing this file event. Use it to separate local, workgroup or directory accounts when attributing file activity to an identity.
InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description_zh: 运行导致本文件事件的进程的账户域。在把文件活动归因到某身份时，可用它区分本地、工作组或目录账户。

InitiatingProcessAccountName.description: User name of the account that ran the process responsible for this file event. Pair with domain, SID or UPN to attribute writes to a specific identity on the device.
InitiatingProcessAccountName.description_zh: 运行对本文件事件负责的进程的账户用户名。可与域、SID 或 UPN 配合，把写入归因到设备上的具体身份。

InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description: Directory object ID of the account that ran the initiating process, when available. Use to bridge file activity to identity records; it identifies the account, not the device.
InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description_zh: 运行发起进程的账户的目录对象 ID（如可用）。可用于把文件活动关联到身份记录；它标识账户而非设备。

InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account that ran the process behind this file event. Useful for deterministic account matching across hosts where names or UPNs vary.
InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description_zh: 运行本文件事件背后进程的账户安全标识符。在名称或 UPN 有差异的主机间进行确定性账户匹配时很有用。

InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that ran the initiating process. Use for identity-centric pivots and to join file activity with sign-in or email-related telemetry.
InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description_zh: 运行发起进程的账户的用户主体名称。可用于以身份为中心的关联，并将文件活动与登录或邮件相关遥测连接。

InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description: Command line that launched the process causing this file event. Inspect for script interpreters, download utilities or encoded arguments that explain how the file was produced.
InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 启动导致本文件事件进程的命令行。可检查脚本解释器、下载工具或编码参数，以解释文件是如何产生的。

InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description: When the process responsible for this file event started. Compare with the event timestamp to judge how soon after launch the file action occurred, supporting causal ordering.
InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 对本文件事件负责的进程启动的时间。可与事件时间戳比较，判断启动后多久发生该文件操作，从而支持因果排序。

InitiatingProcessFileName.description: Name of the process that initiated this file event. Pivot on it to find other files written by the same executable; check folder path and hashes for full identity.
InitiatingProcessFileName.description_zh: 发起本文件事件的进程名称。可据此查找同一可执行文件写入的其他文件；结合文件夹路径和哈希确认完整身份。

InitiatingProcessFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the initiating process image file. Use as a weak fingerprint when comparing process binaries across devices; it does not identify the process by itself.
InitiatingProcessFileSize.description_zh: 发起进程映像文件的大小（字节）。在跨设备比较进程二进制时可用作弱指纹；它本身不能唯一标识该进程。

InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description: Directory containing the image of the process that caused this file event. Use with InitiatingProcessFileName to judge whether the binary ran from a suspicious or user-writable location.
InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description_zh: 导致本文件事件的进程映像所在目录。与 InitiatingProcessFileName 结合，可判断该二进制是否从可疑或用户可写位置运行。

InitiatingProcessId.description: Process ID of the process that initiated this file event. Scope by device and timestamp, since PIDs are reused; correlate with process events on the same host and time.
InitiatingProcessId.description_zh: 发起本文件事件的进程 ID。由于 PID 会被复用，应按设备和时间限定范围；并与同主机、同时间的进程事件关联。

InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description: Integrity level assigned to the initiating process, influencing its permissions. Interpret relative to device and context; a high level indicates elevated trust, not by itself malicious behavior.
InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description_zh: 分配给发起进程的完整性级别，影响其权限。应结合设备和上下文解读；高完整性级别表示较高信任，本身并不代表恶意行为。

InitiatingProcessMD5.description: MD5 hash of the initiating process image, a legacy fingerprint for identifying the executable across hosts and for threat-intelligence lookups; collisions are possible.
InitiatingProcessMD5.description_zh: 发起进程映像的 MD5 哈希，用于跨主机识别该可执行文件的传统指纹及威胁情报查询；存在碰撞可能。

InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description: Start time of the parent of the process that performed this file action, useful to correlate the parent chain's timeline against the file event and other device activity.
InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description_zh: 执行该文件操作的进程其父进程的启动时间，可将父进程时间线与该文件事件及其他设备活动进行关联。

InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description: File name of the parent process that spawned the process performing this file action on this device, helping establish process lineage around a suspicious file write.
InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description_zh: 在此设备上生成执行该文件操作进程的父进程文件名，有助于建立围绕可疑文件写入的进程谱系。

InitiatingProcessParentId.description: Process ID of the parent process that spawned the initiating process for this file event; scope with DeviceId and event time because PIDs are reused.
InitiatingProcessParentId.description_zh: 生成该文件事件发起进程的父进程 PID；PID 会被重用，需结合 DeviceId 与事件时间进行限定。

InitiatingProcessSHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the process image that performed this file action, supporting reputation checks and cross-device correlation of the same executable.
InitiatingProcessSHA1.description_zh: 执行该文件操作的进程映像 SHA-1 哈希，可用于信誉查询以及同一可执行文件跨设备关联。

InitiatingProcessSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the process image initiating this file action; often unpopulated, so prefer the SHA1 column when linking activity.
InitiatingProcessSHA256.description_zh: 发起该文件操作的进程映像 SHA-256 哈希；该字段通常为空，关联活动时优先使用 SHA1 列。

InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description: Token elevation state (for example elevated versus non-elevated) of the process that initiated this file operation, indicating whether it acted with elevated privileges.
InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 发起该文件操作的进程令牌提升状态（如已提升与未提升），用于判断其是否以提升权限执行。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Company name from the version resource of the executable that initiated this file action, useful for spotting unsigned or masqueraded binaries via metadata mismatch.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 发起该文件操作的可执行文件版本资源中的公司名称，可通过元数据不匹配发现未签名或伪装的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description: Description string embedded in the version resource of the process that initiated this file action on the device; corroborate alongside file name and signer details.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description_zh: 设备上发起该文件操作的进程版本资源中嵌入的描述字符串；应与文件名及签名者信息相互印证。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description: Internal file name recorded in the version resource of the initiating process for this file event, a metadata attribute useful for detecting renamed or spoofed binaries.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description_zh: 该文件事件发起进程版本资源中记录的内部文件名，这一元数据属性有助于发现被重命名或伪造的二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description: Original file name declared in the version resource of the process that initiated this file action, often differing from the on-disk name for renamed binaries.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description_zh: 发起该文件操作进程版本资源中声明的原始文件名，对于被重命名的二进制文件常与磁盘上的名称不同。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Product name from the version resource of the process that initiated this file event, supporting vendor identification and anomaly detection against expected software.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 发起该文件事件的进程版本资源中的产品名称，可用于供应商识别以及与预期软件进行异常检测。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description: Product version recorded for the process image that initiated this file action, useful for spotting outdated or unexpected software versions tied to suspicious file writes.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description_zh: 发起该文件操作的进程映像所记录的产品版本，可用于发现与可疑文件写入相关的过时或异常软件版本。

IsAzureInfoProtectionApplied.description: Boolean indicating whether Azure Information Protection encryption was applied to the file at the time of this recorded file action.
IsAzureInfoProtectionApplied.description_zh: 布尔值，指示在此次记录的文件操作时该文件是否应用了 Azure 信息保护加密。

MD5.description: MD5 hash of the file that this recorded file action was applied to, enabling lookup and correlation of the same content across devices and events.
MD5.description_zh: 该记录文件操作所作用文件的 MD5 哈希，可用于跨设备、跨事件查找并关联相同内容。

MachineGroup.description: Machine group assigned to the device, used by role-based access control to scope which analyst roles can view this device's file activity.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 分配给设备的计算机组，用于基于角色的访问控制限定哪些分析人员角色可查看该设备的文件活动。

PreviousFileName.description: Name the file held before a rename recorded in this row, paired with PreviousFolderPath to reconstruct the source path of a move or rename.
PreviousFileName.description_zh: 本行记录的重命名操作之前该文件使用的名称，与 PreviousFolderPath 配合可重建移动或重命名的源路径。

PreviousFolderPath.description: Folder that contained the file prior to this recorded action, letting you compare source and destination paths for moves or renames on the device.
PreviousFolderPath.description_zh: 在此次记录操作之前存放该文件的文件夹，可用于在设备上对比移动或重命名的源路径与目标路径。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

RequestAccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that remotely initiated this file activity (for example over a share); supports tracing remote actors separate from the local initiating process.
RequestAccountDomain.description_zh: 远程发起该文件活动（例如通过共享）的账户域；有助于将远程操作者与本地发起进程区分开来加以追踪。

RequestAccountName.description: User name of the account used to remotely initiate this file activity; correlate with RequestSourceIP to attribute remote file operations on the device.
RequestAccountName.description_zh: 用于远程发起该文件活动的账户用户名；可与 RequestSourceIP 关联，以归属设备上的远程文件操作。

RequestAccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account used to remotely initiate this file activity, a stable account key for attributing remote writes and correlating across devices.
RequestAccountSid.description_zh: 用于远程发起该文件活动的账户安全标识符，是归属远程写入并跨设备关联的稳定账户键值。

RequestProtocol.description: Network protocol through which this file activity was remotely initiated when applicable, such as local, SMB or NFS, indicating the access path used.
RequestProtocol.description_zh: 在适用情况下远程发起该文件活动所使用的网络协议，例如 Local、SMB 或 NFS，用于指示所采用的访问路径。

RequestSourceIP.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of the remote device that initiated this file activity; pair with RequestAccountName to attribute remote access to the affected file.
RequestSourceIP.description_zh: 远程发起该文件活动的设备的 IPv4 或 IPv6 地址；与 RequestAccountName 配合可归属对受影响文件的远程访问。

RequestSourcePort.description: Source port on the remote device that initiated this file activity, supplementing the source IP when reconstructing the remote connection behind the operation.
RequestSourcePort.description_zh: 远程发起该文件活动的设备上的源端口，在重建该操作背后的远程连接时作为源 IP 的补充信息。

SHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the file this event acted on, identifying the affected file's content across devices and paths; note it is the target file hash, not the initiating process hash.
SHA1.description_zh: 本事件所操作文件的 SHA-1 哈希，可跨设备与路径识别受影响文件的内容；注意这是目标文件哈希，不是发起进程的哈希。

SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the file this event acted on; strongest content identifier for the affected file, useful for threat intelligence matching and deduplicating the same file across paths.
SHA256.description_zh: 本事件所操作文件的 SHA-256 哈希；受影响文件内容的最强标识符，适合威胁情报匹配以及在多个路径间去重同一文件。

SensitivityLabel.description: Information-protection label assigned to the file at the time of this event, indicating data classification; use with SensitivitySubLabel to spot labelled sensitive files being moved, renamed or copied unexpectedly.
SensitivityLabel.description_zh: 本事件发生时赋予该文件的信息保护标签，表示数据分类；可结合 SensitivitySubLabel 发现被标记为敏感的标密文件遭异常移动、重命名或复制的情况。

SensitivitySubLabel.description: Sublabel grouped under the file's sensitivity label, refining the data classification for this event's file; treated independently of the parent label, so investigate both together when assessing exposed content.
SensitivitySubLabel.description_zh: 归属于该文件敏感度标签下的子标签，细化本事件文件的数据分类；其独立于父标签处理，评估内容暴露时应将二者一并排查。

ShareName.description: Name of the network share or shared folder holding the file in this event; only meaningful when file activity occurs on a share, so use it to scope SMB or share-based file access investigations.
ShareName.description_zh: 本事件中保存该文件的网络共享或共享文件夹名称；仅当文件活动发生在共享上时才有意义，可用于界定基于 SMB 或共享的文件访问调查范围。

SourceSystem.description: Collection agent or source system that ingested this file event into the workspace; helps separate connector origins and filter rows when comparing data from different onboarding paths.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 将该文件事件采集到工作区的收集代理或源系统；有助于区分不同连接器来源，并在比较不同接入路径数据时筛选行。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier where this file event record resides; documented as workspace ID, not a directory tenant ID. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 本文件事件记录所在的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符；文档定义为工作区 ID，而非目录租户 ID。用于将查询限定到正确的工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the MDE agent recorded this file event on the endpoint; primary time axis for ordering file activity and building timelines around a device or file.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在终结点上记录本文件事件的日期和时间；是排序文件活动和围绕设备或文件构建时间线的主要时间轴。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table this row came from, used to scope queries and confirm a row is DeviceFileEvents data; do not treat it as an event-type or action classification value.
Type.description_zh: 此行来源的表名称，用于限定查询范围并确认该行属于 DeviceFileEvents 数据；不要将其视为事件类型或操作分类值。
