rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

DeviceImageLoadEvents.description: Endpoint DLL/image load telemetry from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, forwarded into Microsoft Sentinel. Each row records one module load event on a device, naming the loaded image and the initiating process, its account lineage, and hashes. Use it to hunt suspicious module loads or side-loading, pivot from a process to the modules it loads, and correlate with device process, file, and network tables. Because it captures loads rather than executions, distinguish it from process-creation and file-event tables when building timelines. Scope by device and time.
DeviceImageLoadEvents.description_zh: 来自 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 并转发到 Microsoft Sentinel 的终结点 DLL/镜像加载遥测。每行记录设备上的一次模块加载事件，包含被加载镜像名称、发起进程及其账户链路和哈希。可用于排查可疑模块加载或侧加载，从进程下钻到其加载的模块，并与设备进程、文件和网络表关联。由于记录的是加载而非执行，构建时间线时应与进程创建表和文件事件表区分。查询时需限定设备和时间范围。

ActionType.description: Category of activity recorded for this load event; use it to filter or group the table by the kind of action the endpoint sensor reported.
ActionType.description_zh: 该加载事件记录的活动类别；可用于按终结点传感器报告的操作类型筛选或分组。

AppGuardContainerId.description: Identifier of the Application Guard virtualized container that hosted the loading process, when browser isolation was in effect; otherwise empty. Use to isolate containerized activity.
AppGuardContainerId.description_zh: 当浏览器隔离生效时，承载发起加载进程的 Application Guard 虚拟化容器标识符，否则为空。用于隔离容器内的活动。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned device identifier for the machine where the module load occurred. Join to other device tables and use with time scoping when correlating activity.
DeviceId.description_zh: 发生模块加载的设备由服务分配的设备标识符。可与其他设备表关联，并在关联活动时配合时间范围限定。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device reporting the load event. Use for human-readable host pivots and grouping across devices in an investigation.
DeviceName.description_zh: 报告该加载事件的设备的完全限定域名。用于可读的主机下钻和跨设备分组分析。

FileName.description: Name of the module/image that was loaded, as reported for this event. Pivot on it to find devices or processes loading the same module.
FileName.description_zh: 本次事件中报告的被加载模块/镜像名称。可据此下钻查找加载同一模块的设备或进程。

FileSize.description: Size in bytes of the loaded module image. Use as a weak signal when triaging unusual or mismatched modules, alongside hashes and folder path.
FileSize.description_zh: 被加载模块镜像的字节大小。可与哈希和文件夹路径一起，在排查异常或不匹配模块时作为辅助信号。

FolderPath.description: Directory path where the loaded module resides on the device. Use to detect loads from writable or user-profile locations suggestive of sideloading.
FolderPath.description_zh: 被加载模块在设备上的目录路径。用于发现从可写位置或用户目录加载、可能提示侧加载的情况。

InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that ran the process responsible for this load. Combine with account name and SID to scope which identity's activity is being traced.
InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description_zh: 运行本次加载发起进程的账户域。可与账户名和 SID 结合，限定正在追踪的身份活动范围。

InitiatingProcessAccountName.description: User name of the account that ran the process responsible for this load. Pivot to see what modules a given user context caused to load.
InitiatingProcessAccountName.description_zh: 运行本次加载发起进程的账户用户名。可据此查看特定用户上下文导致了哪些模块加载。

InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description: Directory object identifier of the account behind the loading process. Use for stable identity correlation across devices and tables, not for host scoping.
InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description_zh: 发起加载进程的账户的目录对象标识符。用于跨设备和跨表的稳定身份关联，而非主机范围限定。

InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account that ran the loading process. Use to distinguish local or system identities from named users in load activity.
InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description_zh: 运行加载进程的账户安全标识符。用于区分加载活动中的本地或系统身份与具名用户。

InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that ran the loading process. Useful for identity-centric pivots and joining to sign-in or alert data.
InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description_zh: 运行加载进程的账户用户主体名称。适用于以身份为中心的下钻，以及与登录或告警数据关联。

InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description: Command line of the process that caused this module load. Inspect for suspicious arguments, script hosts, or encoded content when triaging loading behavior.
InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 导致本次模块加载的进程命令行。排查加载行为时可检查可疑参数、脚本宿主或编码内容。

InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description: When the process that initiated the load started. Use with event time and parent creation time to order process lineage during an investigation.
InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 发起加载的进程启动时间。可与事件时间和父进程创建时间一起，在调查中梳理进程先后顺序。

InitiatingProcessFileName.description: File name of the process that initiated the load. Pivot on it to find other modules loaded by the same executable across the environment.
InitiatingProcessFileName.description_zh: 发起加载的进程文件名。可据此查找同一可执行文件在环境中加载的其他模块。

InitiatingProcessFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the executable image of the initiating process. A secondary signal when comparing known-good or suspicious binaries that load modules.
InitiatingProcessFileSize.description_zh: 发起进程可执行镜像的字节大小。在比较加载模块的已知正常或可疑二进制文件时作为辅助信号。

InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description: Directory containing the executable of the initiating process. Use to spot loads driven by binaries running from unusual or user-writable paths.
InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description_zh: 发起进程可执行文件所在目录。用于发现由异常或用户可写路径中的二进制文件驱动的加载。

InitiatingProcessId.description: Process identifier of the process that initiated the load. Scope by device and time before linking it to process events, since PIDs are reused.
InitiatingProcessId.description_zh: 发起加载的进程标识符。由于 PID 会被复用，关联进程事件前需按设备和时间限定。

InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description: Windows integrity level assigned to the initiating process, reflecting trust and launch origin. Use to assess whether elevated or low-integrity code caused the load.
InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description_zh: 分配给发起进程的 Windows 完整性级别，反映信任与启动来源。用于评估是高权限还是低完整性代码触发了加载。

InitiatingProcessMD5.description: MD5 hash of the executable image of the loading process. Use for threat-intelligence lookups and deduplication of the initiator across devices.
InitiatingProcessMD5.description_zh: 发起加载进程可执行镜像的 MD5 哈希。用于威胁情报查询和跨设备去重发起进程。

InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description: When the parent of the initiating process started. Combine with other timestamps to reconstruct process ancestry around suspicious module loads.
InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description_zh: 发起进程的父进程启动时间。可与其他时间戳结合，围绕可疑模块加载重建进程祖先关系。

InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description: File name of the parent that spawned the loading process. Use to trace who launched the loader, e.g. office or script hosts spawning binaries.
InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description_zh: 生成该加载进程的父进程文件名。用于追踪谁启动了加载器，例如办公软件或脚本宿主生成二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessParentId.description: Process identifier of the parent that spawned the loading process. Scope by device and time before joining to parent process events.
InitiatingProcessParentId.description_zh: 生成该加载进程的父进程标识符。关联父进程事件前需按设备和时间限定，因为 PID 会复用。

InitiatingProcessSHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the executable image of the loading process. Use for identity resolution of the initiator and threat-intelligence matching.
InitiatingProcessSHA1.description_zh: 发起加载进程可执行镜像的 SHA-1 哈希。用于解析发起进程身份及威胁情报匹配。

InitiatingProcessSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the process image that triggered this load event; often unpopulated, so fall back to InitiatingProcessSHA1 when correlating that process across devices.
InitiatingProcessSHA256.description_zh: 触发本次加载事件的进程映像的 SHA-256 哈希；该字段常为空，跨设备关联该进程时请回退使用 InitiatingProcessSHA1。

InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description: Describes whether the initiating process token had UAC elevation, indicating privileged versus standard context for the process that loaded the module.
InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 描述发起进程令牌是否具有 UAC 提升，用于判断加载该模块的进程处于特权还是普通上下文。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Version-info company name embedded in the initiating process image; helps confirm the publishing vendor behind a loader rather than trusting its file name alone.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 发起进程映像中嵌入的版本信息公司名称；有助于确认加载进程背后的发布厂商，而不是仅凭文件名判断。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description: Version-info description of the initiating process image; useful for identifying what that loader claims to be during process triage.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description_zh: 发起进程映像的版本信息描述；在排查进程用途时可辅助判断该加载程序自称的功能。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description: Internal file name recorded in the initiating process version info; can expose mismatches with the on-disk name, a common masquerading signal.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description_zh: 发起进程版本信息中记录的内部文件名；可暴露与磁盘实际文件名不一致的情况，是常见的伪装线索。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description: Original file name from the initiating process version info; comparing it to InitiatingProcessFileName helps detect renamed or masqueraded loader binaries.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description_zh: 发起进程版本信息中的原始文件名；与 InitiatingProcessFileName 对比可发现被改名或伪装的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Product name stated in the initiating process version info; supports attributing the loader to a known software product during investigation.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 发起进程版本信息中声明的产品名称；有助于在调查中将该加载程序归因到已知软件产品。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description: Product version from the initiating process version info; useful for spotting outdated or unexpected loader versions on the device.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description_zh: 发起进程版本信息中的产品版本；可用于发现设备上过时或异常的加载程序版本。

MD5.description: MD5 hash of the module/ image that was loaded in this event; use with the other hashes to pivot across devices or compare to known-file reputation.
MD5.description_zh: 本次事件中加载的模块/映像的 MD5 哈希；可与其他哈希配合跨设备关联，或用于与已知文件信誉比对。

MachineGroup.description: RBAC machine group tag of the device, used to scope access and to group devices by role or sensitivity; useful for limiting results to a relevant device population.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 设备的 RBAC 计算机组标签，用于控制访问权限并按角色或敏感度对设备分组；可用于把结果限定在相关设备范围内。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the loaded module image; typically the most populated hash for the file, so prefer it when correlating the same library across devices.
SHA1.description_zh: 被加载模块映像的 SHA-1 哈希；通常是该文件中最常填充的哈希，跨设备关联同一库时优先使用它。

SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the loaded module image; strongest identifier for the library, useful when checking reputation or hunting the same file elsewhere.
SHA256.description_zh: 被加载模块映像的 SHA-256 哈希；是该库最强的标识符，适合查询信誉或在其他位置搜索同一文件时使用。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or connector type that collected the record, distinguishing collection paths; helps confirm data provenance when results from multiple onboarded sources appear together.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集该记录的代理或连接器类型，用于区分采集路径；当多个接入源的数据同时出现时，有助于确认数据来源。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID for the record; used to scope queries to a workspace, not as a directory/Azure AD tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 该记录的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；用于将查询限定到某个工作区，而不是目录或 Azure AD 租户标识。

TimeGenerated.description: Time the MDE agent recorded this module load on the endpoint; primary time field for filtering and ordering load events relative to other activity.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在终结点上记录本次模块加载的时间；是过滤并将加载事件与其他活动按时间排序的主要时间字段。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Table name for the record, here DeviceImageLoadEvents; useful for filtering when a union query mixes several Defender for Endpoint tables.
Type.description_zh: 记录所属的表名，此处为 DeviceImageLoadEvents；当联合查询混合多个 Defender for Endpoint 表时可用于过滤。

DeviceInfo.description: Device inventory snapshot from Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, one row per endpoint record reporting machine identity, OS, agent, and exposure metadata. Use it to answer which devices exist, their OS/agent build, group or tag membership, internet exposure, and logged-on user context, then pivot by DeviceId, DeviceName, or AadDeviceId to alerts, logons, or connections. This is asset inventory, not event telemetry: it holds no process or network activity, and rows for other resource types belong to other tables.
DeviceInfo.description_zh: 该表来自 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint，是设备资产清单快照，每行代表一条终结点记录，包含设备标识、操作系统、代理版本和暴露面元数据。可用于回答存在哪些设备、其操作系统与代理构建版本、设备组或标签归属、互联网暴露情况以及登录用户上下文，随后可用 DeviceId、DeviceName 或 AadDeviceId 关联到告警、登录或连接事件。它是资产清单而非事件遥测：不包含进程或网络活动，其他资源类型的记录属于其他表。

AadDeviceId.description: Microsoft Entra ID device identifier for the endpoint this row describes. Use to correlate the machine with Entra-joined identity objects, sign-in or conditional-access context; it may be empty for non-Entra devices and does not itself prove active use.
AadDeviceId.description_zh: 本行所描述终结点在 Microsoft Entra ID 中的设备标识符。可用于将设备与 Entra 已加入的身份对象、登录或条件访问上下文关联；非 Entra 设备可能为空，该字段本身不能证明设备在使用中。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag of extra attributes for this device record, beyond the standard columns. Inspect its keys to discover service-specific properties; contents vary by record and are name-derived, so validate against resource and category context before relying on them.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 该设备记录中标准列之外的动态扩展属性集合。可检查其键以发现服务特定的属性；各记录内容不同且为按名称推断，使用前应结合资源与类别上下文验证。

AssetValue.description: Business or user-assigned value rating for the device in this row, used to prioritize investigation and response. It reflects asset classification, not device health or compromise status; combine with exposure and activity evidence.
AssetValue.description_zh: 本行设备的业务价值或用户分配的价值等级，用于确定调查与响应优先级。它反映资产分类，不代表设备健康状况或是否被攻陷；应结合暴露面和活动证据使用。

ClientVersion.description: Version of the endpoint agent or sensor reporting this device row. Compare against expected versions to spot outdated or missing agent coverage; a value proves agent version only, not that the device is actively healthy or online now.
ClientVersion.description_zh: 上报该设备行的终结点代理或传感器版本。可与预期版本对比，发现代理过期或覆盖缺失；该值只证明代理版本，不能说明设备当前健康或在线。

DeviceCategory.description: Broad category grouping for the device in this row, such as endpoint, network device, IoT, or unknown. Use it to scope queries to the asset class you care about and to filter out unrelated device populations during investigation.
DeviceCategory.description_zh: 本行设备所属的宽泛类别，例如终结点、网络设备、IoT 或未知。可用于将查询限定到目标资产类别，并在调查中过滤掉无关设备群体。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned unique identifier for the device this row describes. Primary join key to alerts, logons and other endpoint tables; use it to scope device-level queries and detect identity merges via related merge fields.
DeviceId.description_zh: 服务为本行所描述设备分配的唯一标识符。是关联告警、登录及其他终结点表的主要连接键；可用于限定设备级查询，并借助相关合并字段发现设备标识合并。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the machine represented by this row. Use for human-readable identification, filtering by hostname, and cross-referencing log or alert text; names can be reused or ambiguous, so confirm with DeviceId.
DeviceName.description_zh: 本行所代表计算机的完全限定域名。可用于人类可读的识别、按主机名过滤以及交叉引用日志或告警文本；名称可能重复或被重用，应结合 DeviceId 确认。

DeviceObjectId.description: Directory object identifier for the device in Microsoft Entra ID, as recorded on this inventory row. Use to map the machine to directory objects; it is an object ID, not the workspace tenant ID, and may be absent for unjoined devices.
DeviceObjectId.description_zh: 本资产行记录的设备在 Microsoft Entra ID 中的目录对象标识符。可用于将计算机映射到目录对象；它是对象 ID 而非工作区租户 ID，未加入域的设备可能缺失。

DeviceSubtype.description: Additional modifier for this device's type, for example tablet versus smartphone for mobile devices. It is populated only when discovery gathered enough detail; treat blanks as unknown, not as a specific subtype, and interpret alongside device type and category.
DeviceSubtype.description_zh: 本设备类型的附加修饰，例如移动设备的平板与智能手机之别。仅当发现流程收集到足够信息时才填充；空白应视为未知而非特定子类型，并需结合设备类型和类别解读。

DeviceType.description: Functional classification of the device in this row, such as workstation, server, mobile, network device, gaming console, or printer. Use to select relevant hosts and tailor investigation; classification depends on discovery coverage and may be incomplete.
DeviceType.description_zh: 本行设备按功能划分的类型，例如工作站、服务器、移动设备、网络设备、游戏主机或打印机。可用于筛选相关主机并调整调查方向；分类依赖发现覆盖范围，可能不完整。

ExclusionReason.description: Free-text explanation for why this device is excluded from Defender vulnerability management experiences, when it is. Use to explain missing scan or recommendation coverage; an exclusion is an administrative state and does not indicate device safety.
ExclusionReason.description_zh: 当设备被排除在 Defender 漏洞管理体验之外时，说明排除原因的文本。可用于解释扫描或建议覆盖缺失；排除是管理状态，并不表示设备安全。

ExposureLevel.description: Assessed exposure level for the device in this row, summarizing how exposed it is to threats. Use to prioritize hardening and triage; it is a risk signal, not proof of compromise, and should be corroborated with alerts or activity.
ExposureLevel.description_zh: 本行设备的暴露等级评估，概括其受威胁暴露程度。可用于确定加固与排查优先级；它是风险信号而非被攻陷证据，应结合告警或活动加以印证。

IsAzureADJoined.description: Boolean indicating whether the machine this row describes is joined to Microsoft Entra ID. Use to separate cloud-joined from other devices when investigating identity and access paths; join state does not imply the device is compliant or trusted.
IsAzureADJoined.description_zh: 指示本行所描述计算机是否已加入 Microsoft Entra ID 的布尔值。调查身份与访问路径时，可用于区分云加入设备与其他设备；加入状态并不代表设备合规或可信。

IsExcluded.description: Boolean showing whether this device is currently excluded from Defender vulnerability management experiences. Use to filter out excluded assets when enumerating scanned or managed coverage; exclusion reflects configuration, not device risk.
IsExcluded.description_zh: 布尔值，表示该设备当前是否被排除在 Defender 漏洞管理体验之外。统计扫描或受管覆盖时可用于过滤被排除资产；排除反映配置状态，而非设备风险。

IsInternetFacing.description: Boolean indicating whether the device this row describes is internet-facing. Use to prioritize externally exposed assets for review; it is an exposure attribute of the device record, not evidence of an active attack or compromise.
IsInternetFacing.description_zh: 指示本行所描述设备是否面向互联网的布尔值。可用于优先审查对外暴露资产；它是设备记录的暴露属性，不是正在遭受攻击或被攻陷的证据。

JoinType.description: The device's Microsoft Entra ID join type as recorded in this inventory row. Use to distinguish hybrid, registered or cloud-joined machines when tracing sign-in and policy behavior; interpret values with the join flag and directory context.
JoinType.description_zh: 本资产行记录的设备 Microsoft Entra ID 加入类型。追踪登录与策略行为时，可用于区分混合加入、已注册或云加入的计算机；解读时应结合加入标志和目录上下文。

LoggedOnUsers.description: Dynamic list of users logged on to the machine at the time this record was captured, in JSON array form. Use to associate accounts with hosts; it is a snapshot, so absence does not prove no past logons, and each entry should be validated.
LoggedOnUsers.description_zh: 捕获该记录时登录到计算机的用户动态列表，采用 JSON 数组形式。可用于将账户与主机关联；这只是快照，缺失不能证明从未登录，每个条目都应验证。

MachineGroup.description: Machine group used to determine access to the device and apply group-specific settings, as recorded in this row. Use to understand management scope and group policy targeting; it describes configuration assignment, not device health or user identity.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 本行记录的机器组，用于确定对设备的访问并应用组特定设置。可用于了解管理范围和组策略目标；它描述配置分配，不代表设备健康状况或用户身份。

MergedDeviceIds.description: Previous device identifiers that have been assigned to the same physical device represented by this row. Use to resolve duplicate or legacy IDs when joining historic data; this helps consolidate identity but does not itself confirm device trust or compromise.
MergedDeviceIds.description_zh: 曾分配给本行所代表同一物理设备的先前设备标识符。关联历史数据时可用于解析重复或旧标识；这有助于合并身份，但本身不能确认设备可信或已被攻陷。

MergedToDeviceId.description: The most recent device identifier assigned to the device described by this row, after any merge. Use it to normalize queries onto the current DeviceId when old identifiers appear in historic telemetry; verify merges before trusting them.
MergedToDeviceId.description_zh: 合并后分配给本行所描述设备的最新设备标识符。当历史遥测中出现旧标识时，可用它将查询规范化到当前 DeviceId；使用前应验证合并关系。

Model.description: Model name or number reported by the vendor or manufacturer for the device in this row. Use for hardware inventory, anomaly spotting, or scoping firmware issues; available only when discovery gathered enough detail, and blanks mean unknown.
Model.description_zh: 本行设备来自厂商或制造商的型号名称或编号。可用于硬件盘点、发现异常或界定固件问题；仅当发现流程收集到足够详情时才可用，空白表示未知。

OSArchitecture.description: Architecture of the operating system running on the machine described by this row, such as 64-bit or ARM. Use to scope patch, driver or exploitability questions to compatible hosts; it describes the OS, not the application binaries present.
OSArchitecture.description_zh: 本行所描述计算机操作系统的架构，例如 64 位或 ARM。可用于将补丁、驱动程序或可利用性问题限定到兼容主机；它描述操作系统，而非已安装的应用程序二进制。

OSBuild.description: Numeric build version of the operating system running on the machine in this row. Use to compare against patch baselines and find outdated hosts; the number is provider-specific, so interpret against known build mappings for the platform.
OSBuild.description_zh: 本行计算机所运行操作系统的数字构建版本。可用于与补丁基线比较并发现过时主机；该编号因提供方而异，应结合平台已知构建映射进行解读。

OSDistribution.description: Operating system distribution for the platform, such as Ubuntu or RedHat on Linux, as recorded for this device row. Use to scope Linux queries and package or vulnerability research; blanks indicate an unknown or non-applicable distribution.
OSDistribution.description_zh: 本设备行记录的操作系统发行版，例如 Linux 上的 Ubuntu 或 RedHat。可用于限定 Linux 查询以及软件包或漏洞研究；空白表示发行版未知或不适用。

OSPlatform.description: Platform family of the operating system reported for this device asset, useful for grouping devices when hunting and filtering irrelevant OS families during scoping.
OSPlatform.description_zh: 该设备资产所报告的操作系统平台系列，用于在狩猎时按设备分组，并在限定范围时过滤无关操作系统系列。

OSVersion.description: Operating system version string of this device asset, used to identify outdated or vulnerable builds when correlating device inventory with patching or exploitation hunts.
OSVersion.description_zh: 该设备资产的操作系统版本字符串，用于在将设备清单与补丁或漏洞利用狩猎关联时识别过时或易受攻击的版本。

OSVersionInfo.description: Supplementary operating system version detail for this device, such as a marketing name or build descriptor, helpful when OSVersion alone is too terse for reporting.
OSVersionInfo.description_zh: 该设备的操作系统版本补充详情，如市场名称或内部版本描述，当 OSVersion 过于简略、不便于报告时使用。

OnboardingStatus.description: State of this device's enrollment with Defender for Endpoint, used to judge whether the asset is actively monitored and whether telemetry gaps could explain missing events.
OnboardingStatus.description_zh: 该设备与 Defender for Endpoint 的载入状态，用于判断资产是否受主动监控，以及遥测缺失是否可能解释事件缺失。

PublicIP.description: Public-facing IP observed for this device reaching the Defender service, possibly the device, a NAT, or a proxy; use for network correlation, not as a fixed identity.
PublicIP.description_zh: 观察到的该设备连接 Defender 服务所用的公网 IP，可能属于设备本身、NAT 或代理；用于网络关联，不应视为固定标识。

RegistryDeviceTag.description: Device tag placed via registry on this asset, useful for grouping or filtering by custom organizational labels during inventory and triage scoping.
RegistryDeviceTag.description_zh: 通过注册表放置在该资产上的设备标记，用于在清单和分类限定期间按自定义组织标签分组或过滤。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SensorHealthState.description: Health status of the EDR sensor on this onboarded device, used to explain telemetry gaps or degraded visibility when validating coverage before hunting.
SensorHealthState.description_zh: 该已载入设备上 EDR 传感器的健康状态，用于在狩猎前验证覆盖范围时解释遥测缺失或可见性下降。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or pipeline that collected this row, such as Operations Manager or Azure; use to understand ingestion path and filter records by collection origin.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集该行的代理或管道（如 Operations Manager 或 Azure）；用于了解数据接入路径并按采集来源过滤记录。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with this record, not a directory tenant ID; use to scope queries to the correct workspace when combining tables.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符，而非目录租户 ID；在组合表查询时用它限定到正确的工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: Time the MDE agent recorded this device event on the endpoint; use as the primary time filter for current device state in this table.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在终结点上记录此设备事件的时间；作为该表中当前设备状态的主要时间过滤条件。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, allowing queries that union multiple tables to isolate DeviceInfo rows from other Sentinel sources.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属的表名，允许联合多个表的查询将 DeviceInfo 行与其他 Sentinel 来源区分开。

Vendor.description: Product vendor or manufacturer of this device when discovery supplied enough detail, useful for inventory grouping and identifying unmanaged hardware families.
Vendor.description_zh: 当发现过程提供足够细节时，该设备的产品供应商或制造商，用于清单分组并识别未受管理的硬件系列。

DeviceLogonEvents.description: This Defender for Endpoint table records sign-in and other authentication events observed on monitored devices, with one row per logon attempt or session. It answers who authenticated to which device, from where, using what logon type and protocol, and with what outcome, pivoting on DeviceName, AccountName, LogonType, RemoteIP, ActionType, and FailureReason. For each row it also carries the initiating process that performed or mediated the authentication, including hashes, path, command line, parent, and PID. Use it for device authentication and lateral-movement questions; it is not a device inventory, network connection, or cloud directory table. TenantId is the workspace ID.
DeviceLogonEvents.description_zh: 该表来自 Defender for Endpoint，记录受监控设备上的登录及其他身份验证事件，每一行对应一次登录尝试或会话。它可回答谁在何时登录了哪台设备、来源地址、使用的登录类型和协议以及结果，并可按 DeviceName、AccountName、LogonType、RemoteIP、ActionType、FailureReason 等字段进行透视。每行还包含执行或促成该认证的发起进程信息，包括哈希、路径、命令行、父进程和 PID。该表适合分析设备认证与横向移动，它不是设备清单、网络连接或云目录表。TenantId 为工作区 ID。

AccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that performed the authentication, as recorded on this device event. Use with AccountName and AccountSid to identify whether a logon was local, machine, or domain-based.
AccountDomain.description_zh: 执行该认证的账户所在域，记录于该设备事件中。结合 AccountName 和 AccountSid 可判断该登录是本地、计算机还是域账户。

AccountName.description: User name of the account involved in this device authentication event. Pivot to group logons by account and correlate with AccountSid, AccountDomain, and LogonType across devices.
AccountName.description_zh: 参与该设备认证事件的账户用户名。可据此按账户汇总登录，并与 AccountSid、AccountDomain、LogonType 跨设备关联。

AccountSid.description: Security identifier of the authenticated account for this logon event. Use it to resolve ambiguous or duplicate account names and to correlate the same principal across devices.
AccountSid.description_zh: 该登录事件中通过认证的账户安全标识符。用于消解重名或歧义账户名，并跨设备关联同一主体。

ActionType.description: Name-derived activity category for this authentication row, typically distinguishing logon attempts or their outcome; inspect surrounding context before assuming specific values. Group counts by it to profile event types.
ActionType.description_zh: 该认证行的活动类别（名称推断，通常区分登录尝试及其结果，具体取值需结合上下文确认）。可按其分组统计以了解事件类型分布。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag of extra properties attached to this logon event, whose JSON contents are not documented here. Inspect it per event for service-specific context not exposed in fixed columns.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 附加于该登录事件的动态属性集合，其 JSON 内容本文未记录。可逐事件检查，以获取固定列中未提供的服务特定上下文。

AppGuardContainerId.description: Identifier of the Application Guard virtualized container associated with this authentication event, when browser isolation was involved. Use to tie logons to isolated browser sessions on the device.
AppGuardContainerId.description_zh: 与本次认证事件关联的 Application Guard 虚拟化容器标识符（涉及浏览器隔离时）。用于将登录与设备上的隔离浏览器会话关联。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned unique identifier of the device on which this logon event occurred. Use as the stable join key across Defender tables when correlating authentication with process and alert data.
DeviceId.description_zh: 发生该登录事件的设备在服务中的唯一标识。作为跨 Defender 各表关联认证、进程和告警数据的稳定连接键。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device targeted by this logon event. Pivot remote logons by destination host and correlate with RemoteDeviceName and RemoteIP to trace access patterns.
DeviceName.description_zh: 该登录事件目标设备的完全限定域名。可按目标主机透视远程登录，并与 RemoteDeviceName、RemoteIP 关联以追踪访问模式。

FailureReason.description: Explanation of why the recorded logon action failed, present on unsuccessful authentication rows. Use to distinguish invalid credentials, disabled accounts, and similar failure causes during investigation.
FailureReason.description_zh: 记录登录操作失败的原因，出现在不成功的认证行上。用于在调查中区分无效凭据、账户禁用等失败原因。

InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that ran the process responsible for this authentication event on the device. Use with the other initiating-process account fields to attribute the logon to a specific principal.
InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description_zh: 在设备上运行发起该认证事件的进程所用账户所在域。结合其他发起进程账户字段，可将该登录归因到具体主体。

InitiatingProcessAccountName.description: User name of the account that ran the process responsible for this logon event. Compare with AccountName to see whether the same or a different principal initiated the authentication.
InitiatingProcessAccountName.description_zh: 运行发起该登录事件的进程所用账户的用户名。可与 AccountName 对比，判断认证由同一还是不同主体发起。

InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description: Azure AD object ID of the user account that ran the process responsible for this logon event. Provides a directory-stable identifier for that initiating principal.
InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description_zh: 运行发起该登录事件的进程所用用户账户的 Azure AD 对象 ID。为该发起主体提供目录级稳定标识。

InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account that ran the process responsible for this authentication event. Use to resolve ambiguous initiating account names and compare against AccountSid.
InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description_zh: 运行发起该认证事件的进程所用账户的安全标识符。用于消解发起账户名的歧义，并与 AccountSid 比较。

InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that ran the process responsible for this logon event. Useful for matching the initiating principal to directory identities in cloud-focused investigations.
InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description_zh: 运行发起该登录事件的进程所用账户的用户主体名称。便于在云相关调查中将发起主体匹配到目录身份。

InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description: Command line that launched the process responsible for this authentication event, including arguments at process start. Inspect for suspicious tooling or scripted logon activity.
InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 启动发起该认证事件的进程所用的命令行，包含进程启动时的参数。可用于发现可疑工具或脚本化登录活动。

InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description: Date and time the process that initiated this logon event started on the device. Compare with the event timestamp to establish how long the initiating process had been running.
InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 发起该登录事件的进程在设备上启动的日期和时间。与事件时间戳比较，可确定发起进程已运行多久。

InitiatingProcessFileName.description: File name of the process that initiated this authentication event, such as an executable or system binary. Use with its folder path and hashes to identify or verify the binary.
InitiatingProcessFileName.description_zh: 发起该认证事件的进程文件名，如可执行文件或系统二进制。结合其文件夹路径和哈希可识别或校验该二进制。

InitiatingProcessFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the image file of the process that initiated this logon event. A supporting attribute for identifying the binary alongside its name, path, and hashes.
InitiatingProcessFileSize.description_zh: 发起该登录事件的进程映像文件大小（字节）。作为辅助属性，配合名称、路径和哈希识别该二进制。

InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description: Folder containing the image file of the process that initiated this authentication event. Its location helps judge whether the initiating binary is legitimate or suspicious.
InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description_zh: 包含发起该认证事件的进程映像文件的文件夹。其位置有助于判断发起二进制是否合法或可疑。

InitiatingProcessId.description: Process ID of the process that initiated this logon event. Scope PID to the specific device and time before joining, since identifiers are reused across sessions.
InitiatingProcessId.description_zh: 发起该登录事件的进程 ID。由于标识符会在不同会话间复用，连接前需限定到具体设备和时间。

InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description: Integrity level Windows assigned to the process that initiated this authentication event, such as low or high, reflecting launch origin and resource permissions. Supports suspicion assessment of the initiator.
InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description_zh: Windows 为发起该认证事件的进程分配的完整性级别（如低或高），反映启动来源和资源权限。有助于评估发起进程的可疑程度。

InitiatingProcessMD5.description: MD5 hash of the image file of the process that initiated this logon event. Use with other hashes to identify the binary and compare against known-good or malicious samples.
InitiatingProcessMD5.description_zh: 发起该登录事件的进程映像文件的 MD5 哈希。可与其他哈希一起识别该二进制，并与已知良性或恶意样本比对。

InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description: Date and time the parent of the process responsible for this authentication event started on the device. Helps establish process ancestry timing during logon investigations.
InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description_zh: 发起该认证事件的进程之父进程在设备上启动的日期和时间。有助于在登录调查中确定进程祖先关系的时间线。

InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description: File name of the parent process that spawned the process responsible for this logon event. Use with the parent PID to trace process ancestry of authentication activity.
InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description_zh: 生成发起该登录事件的进程的父进程文件名。结合父进程 PID 可追踪认证活动的进程祖先关系。

InitiatingProcessParentId.description: Numeric PID of the parent process that spawned the process responsible for this logon event on the device. Name-derived; scope by DeviceId and time before correlating parent-child process trees.
InitiatingProcessParentId.description_zh: 在设备上生成引发此登录事件的进程的父进程数字 PID。该解释由字段名推导；关联父子进程树前需按 DeviceId 和时间限定。

InitiatingProcessSHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the image file of the process that initiated the logon event on the device. Use to pivot to known-good or known-malicious process hashes across endpoints.
InitiatingProcessSHA1.description_zh: 在设备上发起登录事件的进程映像文件的 SHA-1 哈希。可用于在各终结点之间按已知良性或恶意进程哈希进行透视。

InitiatingProcessSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the image file of the process that initiated the logon event. Per official notes this field is usually not populated; prefer InitiatingProcessSHA1 when correlating hashes.
InitiatingProcessSHA256.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程映像文件的 SHA-256 哈希。官方说明指出该字段通常未填充；关联哈希时应优先使用 InitiatingProcessSHA1。

InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description: Token elevation state of the process that initiated the logon event, indicating whether User Access Control elevation was applied. Use with account and process identity to assess privilege context.
InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程的令牌提升状态，指示是否应用了用户访问控制提升。结合账户和进程身份评估权限上下文。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Company name embedded in the version information of the image file of the process that initiated the logon event. Use to corroborate process identity and spot masquerading executables.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程映像文件版本信息中的公司名称。用于佐证进程身份并发现伪装的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description: File description from the version information of the image file of the process that initiated the logon event. Helps validate what the initiating process claims to be.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程映像文件版本信息中的文件描述。有助于验证发起进程声称的身份。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description: Internal file name recorded in version information for the image file of the process that initiated the logon event. Useful for detecting renamed binaries that retain original internal names.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程映像文件版本信息中记录的内部文件名。有助于发现保留原始内部名称的重命名二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description: Original file name from version information of the image file of the process that initiated the logon event. Compare with the on-disk file name to detect masquerading.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程映像文件版本信息中的原始文件名。与磁盘上的文件名比较可发现伪装行为。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Product name from version information of the image file of the process that initiated the logon event. Use with other version fields to identify the expected software product.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程映像文件版本信息中的产品名称。与其他版本字段一起用于识别预期软件产品。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description: Product version from version information of the image file of the process that initiated the logon event. Helps identify vulnerable or unexpected software versions tied to the logon.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description_zh: 发起登录事件的进程映像文件版本信息中的产品版本。有助于识别与该登录相关的易受攻击或异常软件版本。

IsLocalAdmin.description: Boolean indicating whether the account associated with this logon event is a local administrator on the affected device. Use to prioritize privileged account activity during investigation.
IsLocalAdmin.description_zh: 布尔值，指示与此登录事件关联的账户在受影响设备上是否为本地管理员。用于调查期间优先关注特权账户活动。

LogonId.description: Identifier for the logon session this event belongs to, unique only on the same machine between restarts. Use with DeviceId and time to group events within one session.
LogonId.description_zh: 此事件所属登录会话的标识符，仅在同一台机器重启之间唯一。结合 DeviceId 和时间将事件归入同一会话。

LogonType.description: Type of logon session for this event, such as interactive, remote interactive (RDP), network, batch, or service. Use to distinguish credential use patterns and remote access.
LogonType.description_zh: 此事件的登录会话类型，例如交互式、远程交互式（RDP）、网络、批处理或服务。用于区分凭据使用模式和远程访问。

MachineGroup.description: Role-based access control machine group assigned to the device in this logon event. Use to scope or filter investigation queries by administrative grouping of endpoints.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 此登录事件中分配给设备的基于角色的访问控制机器组。用于按终结点的管理分组限定或过滤调查查询。

Protocol.description: Communication protocol used during this logon event. Use with RemoteIP and RemotePort to characterize how the authentication attempt reached the device.
Protocol.description_zh: 此登录事件期间使用的通信协议。结合 RemoteIP 和 RemotePort 描述身份验证尝试如何到达设备。

RemoteDeviceName.description: Name of the device that performed the remote operation in this logon event; may be FQDN, NetBIOS, or host name. Use to identify the source host behind a logon.
RemoteDeviceName.description_zh: 此登录事件中执行远程操作的设备的名称；可能是 FQDN、NetBIOS 或主机名。用于识别登录背后的源主机。

RemoteIP.description: IP address connected to or associated with the remote side in this logon event. Use with RemoteIPType and time to trace external or internal authentication sources.
RemoteIP.description_zh: 此登录事件中连接到的或与远程端关联的 IP 地址。结合 RemoteIPType 和时间追踪外部或内部身份验证来源。

RemoteIPType.description: Classification of the remote IP address for this logon event, such as Public, Private, Reserved, Loopback, Teredo, FourToSixMapping, or Broadcast. Guides source classification.
RemoteIPType.description_zh: 此登录事件中远程 IP 地址的分类，例如公共、专用、保留、环回、Teredo、FourToSixMapping 或广播。用于指导来源分类。

RemotePort.description: TCP port on the remote device involved in this logon event. Use with RemoteIP and Protocol to characterize the connection that carried the authentication attempt.
RemotePort.description_zh: 此登录事件中涉及的远程设备上的 TCP 端口。结合 RemoteIP 和 Protocol 描述承载身份验证尝试的连接。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent that collected this logon event, such as OpsManager for Windows agent or Azure for Azure Diagnostics. Use to understand collection path and data origin.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集此登录事件的代理类型，例如 Windows 代理的 OpsManager 或 Azure Diagnostics 的 Azure。用于了解收集路径和数据来源。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this logon event. This is a workspace identifier, not a directory tenant ID; use it to scope queries to a workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 与此登录事件关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。这是工作区标识符，不是目录租户 ID；用于将查询限定到某个工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the logon event was recorded by the MDE agent on the endpoint. Use as the primary time filter and for correlating with other endpoint events.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在终结点上记录此登录事件的日期和时间。用作主要时间过滤条件并与其他终结点事件关联。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: String giving the table name this row came from, in this table DeviceLogonEvents. Use it to filter or union this table with other Sentinel tables; combined with TimeGenerated it confirms logon-event source.
Type.description_zh: 字符串，表示该行来源的表名，此表中为 DeviceLogonEvents。可用于过滤或与其他 Sentinel 表联合查询；结合 TimeGenerated 可确认登录事件来源。

DeviceNetworkEvents.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint network-connection telemetry: each row records a network event (typically a connection attempt) observed on an endpoint, attributed to the initiating process and its account. Use it to trace outbound/inbound connections, remote URLs and IPs, listening or blocked behavior, and process-to-network pivots (DeviceId plus InitiatingProcessId/time). Pivot to device inventory via DeviceId and to process/logon activity in other tables; it is not a device inventory or logon table.
DeviceNetworkEvents.description_zh: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的网络连接遥测：每行记录在终结点上观测到的一次网络事件（通常是连接尝试），并关联到发起进程及其账户。可用于追踪出站/入站连接、远程 URL 与 IP、监听或被阻止行为，以及进程到网络活动的关联（DeviceId 配合 InitiatingProcessId 和时间）。可通过 DeviceId 关联设备清单、通过进程/登录表关联其他活动；该表不是设备清单表，也不是登录表。

ActionType.description: Name-derived event action category for this network event, describing what activity occurred (e.g. connection-related action). Use to filter event kinds, but verify values against your workspace rather than assuming an enumeration.
ActionType.description_zh: 该网络事件的名称派生动作类别，说明发生的活动类型（如连接相关动作）。可用于筛选事件类型，但应结合实际数据核实取值，不要预设枚举。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag holding provider/connector-specific extra attributes for the network event; schema is not documented here. Inspect its keys per row and treat contents as name-derived context only, not guaranteed fields.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 动态字段包，存放此网络事件的服务/连接器特定附加属性；此处未记录其结构。需逐行查看键值，仅视为名称派生的上下文，不保证存在固定字段。

AppGuardContainerId.description: Identifier of the Application Guard virtualized container when the initiating process ran inside it, indicating isolated browser activity. Empty for normal host processes; use to distinguish containerized browsing from host network events.
AppGuardContainerId.description_zh: 当发起进程运行于 Application Guard 虚拟化容器内时，标识该容器，表示隔离的浏览器活动。普通主机进程此列为空；可用于区分容器化浏览与主机网络事件。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned unique identifier for the endpoint that generated this network event. Stable pivot for joining device inventory, other Device* tables, and grouping connections per machine across time.
DeviceId.description_zh: 生成此网络事件的终结点的服务唯一标识。可稳定关联设备清单及其他 Device* 表，并按机器跨时间聚合连接。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the endpoint reporting this network event, as known to the service. Useful for human-readable scoping, but prefer DeviceId for joins since names can change or repeat.
DeviceName.description_zh: 上报此网络事件的终结点的完全限定域名，由服务提供。便于人工识别范围，但关联时优先使用 DeviceId，因为名称可能变更或重复。

InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description: Domain portion of the account that ran the process initiating this network connection. Combine with InitiatingProcessAccountName to identify the acting user context on the endpoint.
InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description_zh: 发起此网络连接的进程所属账户的域部分。可与 InitiatingProcessAccountName 结合，确定终结点上实际操作用户的上下文。

InitiatingProcessAccountName.description: User name of the account under which the process that initiated this network event ran. Pivot for per-user connection review; pair with domain/SID/UPN for full identity resolution.
InitiatingProcessAccountName.description_zh: 发起此网络事件的进程所运行账户的用户名。可按用户审查连接；与域、SID 或 UPN 配合可完整解析身份。

InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description: Directory object identifier of the user account that ran the initiating process, when available. Name-derived cloud identity link for correlating this endpoint network activity with directory-side user records.
InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description_zh: 运行发起进程的用户账户的目录对象标识（若有）。属名称派生的云身份关联，用于将此终结点网络活动与目录侧用户记录对应。

InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description: Windows security identifier of the account that ran the initiating process. Useful for disambiguating same-named local accounts and matching security events; scope with device and time.
InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description_zh: 运行发起进程的账户的 Windows 安全标识符。适合区分同名本地账户并匹配安全事件；需结合设备与时间范围使用。

InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that ran the initiating process, typically for cloud/domain identities. Convenient identity pivot for linking endpoint connections to sign-in and directory activity.
InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description_zh: 运行发起进程的账户的用户主体名称，通常用于云或域身份。便于将终结点连接与登录及目录活动关联。

InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description: Command line that launched the process responsible for this network event, revealing arguments, scripts, or URLs passed at start. Powerful for spotting suspicious executions, but can be long or truncated.
InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 启动此网络事件对应进程的命令行，可揭示启动参数、脚本或 URL。对发现可疑执行很有价值，但内容可能较长或被截断。

InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description: Timestamp when the process initiating this network event started. Scope this PID to device and time; compare with event time to judge whether the process was newly spawned before connecting.
InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 发起此网络事件的进程启动时间。应结合设备与时间限定该 PID；与事件时间比较，可判断进程是否在连接前刚启动。

InitiatingProcessFileName.description: File name of the process image that initiated this network event (e.g. executable name). Primary process pivot; combine with folder path and hashes to distinguish legitimate from masquerading binaries.
InitiatingProcessFileName.description_zh: 发起此网络事件的进程映像文件名（如可执行文件名）。主要的进程关联点；结合路径与哈希可区分合法程序与伪装程序。

InitiatingProcessFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the executable file that ran the initiating process. Minor corroborating attribute for binary identification; not a security signal on its own.
InitiatingProcessFileSize.description_zh: 运行发起进程的可执行文件大小（字节）。用于二进制识别的辅助属性，本身不构成安全信号。

InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description: Directory containing the executable image of the initiating process. Reveals whether it ran from system, user, temp, or unusual locations; useful with file name and hashes to flag suspicious paths.
InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description_zh: 发起进程可执行映像所在目录。可判断其来自系统、用户、临时或异常位置；配合文件名与哈希可标记可疑路径。

InitiatingProcessId.description: Operating system process ID of the process that initiated this network event. Must be scoped with DeviceId and time because PIDs are reused; use to group all connections made by one process instance.
InitiatingProcessId.description_zh: 发起此网络事件的进程的操作系统进程 ID。由于 PID 会复用，必须结合 DeviceId 与时间限定；可用于聚合同一进程实例发出的所有连接。

InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description: Integrity level label assigned to the initiating process, reflecting trust characteristics such as internet origin. Helps judge privilege context of the connection; interpret values only as documented by the platform.
InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description_zh: 分配给发起进程的完整性级别标签，反映下载来源等信任特征。有助于判断连接的权限上下文；取值应仅按平台文档解释。

InitiatingProcessMD5.description: MD5 hash of the initiating process image file. Quick binary identifier for correlation and threat-intel lookups, though weaker than SHA-1/SHA-256 for uniqueness.
InitiatingProcessMD5.description_zh: 发起进程映像文件的 MD5 哈希。可用于快速关联与威胁情报查询，但唯一性弱于 SHA-1/SHA-256。

InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description: Timestamp when the parent of the process initiating this network event was started. Helps reconstruct process ancestry timelines and spot short-lived or unusual parent-child execution chains.
InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description_zh: 发起此网络事件的进程之父进程的启动时间。有助于还原进程血缘时间线，发现短命或异常的父子执行链。

InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description: File name of the parent process that spawned the process initiating this network event. Key for parent-child analysis, e.g. distinguishing user-launched browsers from service- or script-spawned connections.
InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description_zh: 生成发起此网络事件的进程的父进程文件名。父子关系分析的关键，例如区分用户启动的浏览器与会话或脚本生成的连接。

InitiatingProcessParentId.description: Process ID of the parent that spawned the initiating process. Scope with DeviceId and time before interpreting due to PID reuse; supports building execution lineage for the connection.
InitiatingProcessParentId.description_zh: 生成发起进程的父进程的进程 ID。因 PID 复用，解读前需结合 DeviceId 与时间限定；可用于构建连接的执行血缘。

InitiatingProcessSHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the initiating process image file. Reliable binary pivot for threat-intelligence matching and cross-device process correlation when SHA-256 is absent.
InitiatingProcessSHA1.description_zh: 发起进程映像文件的 SHA-1 哈希。当缺少 SHA-256 时，是威胁情报匹配与跨设备进程关联的可靠二进制关联点。

InitiatingProcessSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the initiating process image file, when populated. Preferred strong identifier for binary reputation and threat-intel joins; fall back to SHA-1 if empty.
InitiatingProcessSHA256.description_zh: 发起进程映像文件的 SHA-256 哈希（若有填充）。二进制信誉与威胁情报关联的首选强标识；为空时回退到 SHA-1。

InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description: Token elevation indicator for the initiating process, showing whether UAC elevation was applied. Aids distinguishing elevated versus non-elevated network activity; do not treat elevation alone as malicious.
InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 发起进程的令牌提升指示，显示是否应用了 UAC 提升。有助于区分提权与非提权的网络活动；不应仅凭提升判定恶意。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Version-info company name of the image of the process that initiated the connection. Use to attribute the binary to a vendor, flag unsigned or untrusted publishers, and compare with expected software on the endpoint.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 发起连接进程映像的版本信息公司名。用于将二进制归属到厂商、标记未签名或不可信发布者，并与终端预期软件比对。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description: Version-info file description of the image of the process that initiated the connection. Helps distinguish benign tooling from suspicious binaries when the file name is generic or masqueraded.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description_zh: 发起连接进程映像的版本信息文件描述。当文件名通用或被伪装时，有助于区分正常工具与可疑二进制。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description: Version-info internal file name of the image of the process that initiated the connection. Investigators compare it with the visible file name to detect renamed or spoofed executables.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description_zh: 发起连接进程映像的版本信息内部文件名。调查人员将其与可见文件名比对，以发现被重命名或伪造的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description: Version-info original file name of the image of the process that initiated the connection. Useful for recognizing renamed binaries during connection timeline reviews.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description_zh: 发起连接进程映像的版本信息原始文件名。在连接时间线审查中用于识别被重命名的二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Version-info product name of the image of the process that initiated the connection. Groups connections by product to separate expected application traffic from unknown executables.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 发起连接进程映像的版本信息产品名。按产品对连接分组，以区分预期应用流量与未知可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description: Version-info product version of the image of the process that initiated the connection. Pivot to find outdated vulnerable software making outbound connections.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description_zh: 发起连接进程映像的版本信息产品版本。可用于查找发起外连的过期易受攻击软件。

LocalIP.description: Local machine IP address used in the connection. Scope connections to a host IP during investigations and correlate with device identity and neighboring network events.
LocalIP.description_zh: 连接中使用的本地机器 IP 地址。调查时可将连接限定到主机 IP，并与设备身份及相邻网络事件关联。

LocalIPType.description: Classification of the local IP address, such as private, public, loopback, or reserved. Interpret as a category label for the local endpoint, not proof of external exposure.
LocalIPType.description_zh: 本地 IP 地址的分类，如私有、公共、环回或保留。应视为本地端点的类别标签，并不证明外部暴露。

LocalPort.description: TCP port on the local machine used in the connection. Helps distinguish client-side ephemeral ports from listening or service ports during connection analysis.
LocalPort.description_zh: 连接中使用的本地机器 TCP 端口。在连接分析中帮助区分客户端临时端口与监听或服务端口。

MachineGroup.description: Machine group used by role-based access control to determine access to the machine. Useful for scoping investigations or queries to a managed group of endpoints.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 基于角色的访问控制用于确定机器访问权限的机器组。可用于将调查或查询限定到一组受管终端。

Protocol.description: IP protocol used for the connection, such as TCP or UDP. Scope or filter connection events by transport before analyzing destination ports and payload behavior.
Protocol.description_zh: 连接使用的 IP 协议，如 TCP 或 UDP。在分析目标端口和载荷行为前，可按传输协议限定或筛选连接事件。

RemoteIP.description: Remote IP address that the endpoint connected to. Pivot to identify external infrastructure, internal lateral targets, or repeat destinations across devices and times.
RemoteIP.description_zh: 端点连接到的远程 IP 地址。可用于识别外部基础设施、内部横向目标或跨设备与时间的重复目标。

RemoteIPType.description: Classification of the remote IP address, such as private, public, loopback, or reserved. Use to separate internal versus external destinations, while noting it is a category label only.
RemoteIPType.description_zh: 远程 IP 地址的分类，如私有、公共、环回或保留。用于区分内部与外部目标，注意它仅为类别标签。

RemotePort.description: TCP port on the remote device being connected to. Pivot by destination port to surface common services, unusual high ports, or anomalies across endpoints.
RemotePort.description_zh: 所连接远程设备的 TCP 端口。按目标端口透视，可发现常见服务、异常高位端口或跨终端异常。

RemoteUrl.description: URL or fully qualified domain name connected to. Use for domain and URL pivots in network investigations; presence here indicates a connection destination, not a confirmed user click.
RemoteUrl.description_zh: 所连接的 URL 或完全限定域名。在网络调查中用于域名和 URL 透视；此处出现表示连接目标，而非确认用户点击。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SourceSystem.description: Agent type that collected the event, such as OpsManager or Azure. Helps understand ingestion path and can support filtering, but does not itself describe the connection semantics.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集事件的代理类型，如 OpsManager 或 Azure。有助于理解摄取路径并可用于筛选，但本身不描述连接语义。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID for the record. Use for workspace scoping; do not interpret as a directory tenant identifier. Important when querying across multiple workspaces or access boundaries.
TenantId.description_zh: 记录的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。用于工作区范围限定；不要解释为目录租户标识符。跨多工作区或访问边界查询时很重要。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the event was recorded by the MDE agent on the endpoint. Primary time pivot for connection timelines, correlation, and scoping to an investigation window.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在端点上记录该事件的日期和时间。是连接时间线、关联及限定调查窗口的主要时间透视。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: The name of the table. Used to scope queries to this specific table; not an event attribute, so avoid treating its value as connection or device metadata.
Type.description_zh: 表的名称。用于将查询限定到本表；不是事件属性，不要将其值当作连接或设备元数据。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

DeviceNetworkInfo.description: Defender for Endpoint device network inventory from MDE agents: each row describes the network properties of one adapter on one device at a collection time, including adapters, IP/MAC addresses, DNS and gateways, connected networks and tunnel types. Use it to answer what network adapters, addresses, DNS servers or gateways a device had, which networks it was connected to, and to pivot from a device to its adapter-level network configuration. It is inventory, not traffic: connections and logons live elsewhere, and a single device yields multiple rows, so scope by DeviceId and TimeGenerated.
DeviceNetworkInfo.description_zh: Defender for Endpoint 设备网络信息表，来自 MDE 代理：每行描述某设备某网络适配器在某一采集时间的网络属性，包括适配器、IP/MAC 地址、DNS 与网关、连接的网络及隧道类型。可用于回答设备曾有哪些适配器、地址、DNS 服务器或网关，连接过哪些网络，并从设备下钻到适配器级网络配置。它是清单数据而非流量：连接和登录记录在其他表中；同一设备会产生多行，应按 DeviceId 与 TimeGenerated 限定范围。

ConnectedNetworks.description: Dynamic array of networks the adapter is connected to, with name, category (public/private/domain), description and internet-facing flag. Shows which network context a device was on; use with TimeGenerated to trace exposure changes, not proof of activity.
ConnectedNetworks.description_zh: 适配器所连接网络的动态数组，包含网络名称、类别（公用/专用/域）、描述及是否面向 Internet 的标志。用于查看设备当时所处的网络环境，配合 TimeGenerated 追踪暴露面变化，不能作为活动发生的证据。

DefaultGateways.description: Dynamic array of default gateway addresses for this adapter. Helps identify the network segment or gateway a device routed through, supporting scoping of lateral movement or anomalous routing; correlate with other address fields on the same row.
DefaultGateways.description_zh: 该适配器的默认网关地址动态数组。有助于识别设备经过的网段或网关，用于横向移动或异常路由的范围界定；应与同一行其他地址字段关联分析。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned unique identifier for the device, stable across tables. Primary pivot to correlate this adapter inventory with other MDE tables and to group all adapters of a device; combine with TimeGenerated when querying.
DeviceId.description_zh: 服务为设备分配的唯一标识，跨表稳定。是与其他 MDE 表关联、并聚合某设备所有适配器的主要枢纽；查询时应结合 TimeGenerated 使用。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device owning this adapter record. Use for human-readable identification and grouping with ReportId or Timestamp to distinguish rows; verify naming conventions when correlating across tenants.
DeviceName.description_zh: 拥有该适配器记录的设备的完全限定域名。用于可读识别，并与 ReportId 或 Timestamp 组合区分行；跨租户关联时需核实命名规范。

DnsAddresses.description: Dynamic array of DNS server addresses configured for this adapter. Useful to detect rogue or unexpected DNS resolvers indicating tampering or misconfiguration; interpret alongside ConnectedNetworks and gateway addresses on the same row.
DnsAddresses.description_zh: 该适配器配置的 DNS 服务器地址动态数组。可用于发现可能表明篡改或配置错误的异常 DNS 解析器；应结合同一行的 ConnectedNetworks 和网关地址解读。

IPAddresses.description: Dynamic array of IP addresses assigned to this adapter, with subnet prefix and IP class (RFC 1918/RFC 4291). Identifies device addressing and network class; multiple rows per device mean correlate with adapter and time.
IPAddresses.description_zh: 分配给该适配器的 IP 地址动态数组，含子网前缀和 IP 类别（RFC 1918/RFC 4291）。用于识别设备寻址与网络类别；同一设备多行，需结合适配器和时间关联。

IPv4Dhcp.description: IPv4 address of the DHCP server configured for this adapter, if any. Helps recognize DHCP scope or server changes that could indicate network reconfiguration; absence may mean static or no DHCP, not an error.
IPv4Dhcp.description_zh: 该适配器配置的 DHCP 服务器的 IPv4 地址（如有）。有助于识别可能反映网络重配置的 DHCP 作用域或服务器变更；为空可能表示静态或未使用 DHCP，并非错误。

IPv6Dhcp.description: IPv6 address of the DHCP server configured for this adapter, if any. Complements IPv4Dhcp when assessing address assignment; treat empty values as possibly static configuration rather than evidence of compromise.
IPv6Dhcp.description_zh: 该适配器配置的 DHCP 服务器的 IPv6 地址（如有）。在评估地址分配时补充 IPv4Dhcp；空值可能表示静态配置，而非失陷证据。

MacAddress.description: MAC address of the network adapter. Supports adapter-level identification and correlation with other device or network telemetry; because MAC addresses can be spoofed or changed, treat as an identifier, not proof of identity.
MacAddress.description_zh: 网络适配器的 MAC 地址。支持适配器级识别，并与其他设备或网络遥测关联；MAC 可被伪造或更改，应作为标识而非身份证明。

MachineGroup.description: Machine group associated with the device, used by role-based access control to determine access to the machine. Relevant when scoping which analyst or team can see the device; not a security classification of the device itself.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 与设备关联的计算机组，用于基于角色的访问控制以确定对设备的访问权限。适用于界定哪些分析员或团队可查看该设备；并非设备本身的安全分级。

NetworkAdapterName.description: Name of the network adapter as reported on the device. Distinguishes multiple adapters within a device row set; combine with DeviceId and TimeGenerated when tracking a specific interface over time.
NetworkAdapterName.description_zh: 设备上报告的网络适配器名称。用于区分同一设备多行记录中的不同适配器；在跟踪特定接口随时间变化时，应与 DeviceId 和 TimeGenerated 组合。

NetworkAdapterStatus.description: Operational status of the network adapter. Helps determine whether an interface was active or disconnected at collection time; interpret with adapter name and time, as status reflects a moment, not a guarantee.
NetworkAdapterStatus.description_zh: 网络适配器的运行状态。有助于判断采集时接口是否启用或断开；应结合适配器名称和时间解读，因为状态反映的是某一时刻，而非保证。

NetworkAdapterType.description: Type of the network adapter. Provides context for adapter capabilities or virtualization; use with vendor and name, and cross-check against expected hardware baselines rather than treating as definitive inventory.
NetworkAdapterType.description_zh: 网络适配器类型。为适配器能力或虚拟化提供上下文；应与厂商和名称一起使用，并与预期硬件基线比对，而非视为权威清单。

NetworkAdapterVendor.description: Manufacturer or vendor of the network adapter. Aids in spotting unexpected or virtual adapters that may indicate tunneling or virtualization; interpret alongside adapter type, name and status on the same row.
NetworkAdapterVendor.description_zh: 网络适配器的制造商或厂商。有助于发现可能表明隧道或虚拟化的异常或虚拟适配器；应与同一行的适配器类型、名称和状态一起解读。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent that collected the event, such as OpsManager or Azure. Helps understand ingestion path and filtering; for this MDE network inventory it typically reflects the collector, not the device operating system itself.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集该事件的代理类型，例如 OpsManager 或 Azure。有助于理解采集路径并进行筛选；对于本 MDE 网络清单，通常反映采集器而非设备操作系统本身。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID per official documentation, not a directory tenant ID. Use to scope queries to the correct workspace; do not describe as an Azure AD tenant identifier in reports or correlations.
TenantId.description_zh: 官方文档中为 Log Analytics 工作区 ID，并非目录租户 ID。用于将查询限定到正确的工作区；在报告或关联中不要将其描述为 Azure AD 租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the event was recorded by the MDE agent on the endpoint. Primary time filter for scoping adapter inventory snapshots; always constrain queries with it because the same device yields many rows over time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在端点上记录事件的时间和日期。是限定适配器清单快照的主要时间过滤条件；由于同一设备随时间产生多行，查询务必用它限定。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

TunnelType.description: Tunneling protocol when the interface is used for that purpose, for example 6to4, Teredo, ISATAP, PPTP, SSTP, SSH. Flags tunnel-capable adapters that may warrant inspection for covert channels or remote access; treat as a lead, not proof.
TunnelType.description_zh: 当接口用于隧道时使用的隧道协议，例如 6to4、Teredo、ISATAP、PPTP、SSTP、SSH。标记可能需要检查隐蔽信道或远程访问的隧道适配器；应作为线索，而非证据。

Type.description: The name of the table, here DeviceNetworkInfo. Use to confirm table identity in union or cross-table queries and to filter ingestion; in AzureDiagnostics it distinguishes resource categories.
Type.description_zh: 表名，此处为 DeviceNetworkInfo。用于在联合或跨表查询中确认表身份并筛选数据；在 AzureDiagnostics 中用于区分资源类别。

DeviceProcessEvents.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process creation and related events. Use it to determine which command ran on a device, under which account, and which process launched it; investigate suspicious scripts, binaries and parent-child process chains. ProcessId and ProcessCommandLine describe the target process, while InitiatingProcess fields describe its initiator. Correlate PIDs with DeviceId and creation time. Use DeviceNetworkEvents for connections and DeviceFileEvents for file changes.
DeviceProcessEvents.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的进程创建及相关事件。用于调查设备上执行了什么命令、使用哪个账户、由哪个进程启动，并追踪可疑脚本、程序和父子进程链。ProcessId、ProcessCommandLine 描述目标进程，InitiatingProcess 系列字段描述发起进程。关联 PID 时需结合 DeviceId 和创建时间；网络连接查 DeviceNetworkEvents，文件变更查 DeviceFileEvents。

AccountDomain.description: Domain of the account associated with this process event. Use with AccountName to identify the user context on the endpoint, but do not assume the domain is a directory tenant name.
AccountDomain.description_zh: 与此进程事件关联的账户域。可与 AccountName 一起确定端点上的用户上下文，但不要假定该域就是目录租户名称。

AccountName.description: User name of the account tied to this process event. Combine with AccountDomain, AccountSid, or AccountUpn to attribute process activity to a specific identity during investigation.
AccountName.description_zh: 与此进程事件关联的账户用户名。调查时可与 AccountDomain、AccountSid 或 AccountUpn 组合，将进程活动归属到特定身份。

AccountObjectId.description: Azure AD object identifier for the account associated with this event, when available. Use to correlate the account across services; absence does not prove the account is local or non-existent.
AccountObjectId.description_zh: 与此事件关联账户的 Azure AD 对象标识符（若可用）。可用于跨服务关联该账户；字段缺失并不证明账户是本地账户或不存在。

AccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account tied to this process event. Useful for stable Windows-side account correlation when names are ambiguous; SID formats are not values to invent or assume.
AccountSid.description_zh: 与此进程事件关联账户的安全标识符。当名称有歧义时，可用于在 Windows 侧稳定关联账户；不要臆造或假定 SID 格式。

AccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account associated with this process event, when present. Use for identity pivots alongside AccountName and AccountSid; empty values may occur on system or local contexts.
AccountUpn.description_zh: 与此进程事件关联账户的用户主体名称（若存在）。可与 AccountName 和 AccountSid 一起进行身份透视；系统或本地上下文可能为空值。

ActionType.description: Type of activity that triggered this recorded event, such as process-related actions. Use to filter or partition process events; inspect distinct values in the dataset rather than assuming a full enumeration.
ActionType.description_zh: 触发此记录的活动的类型，例如与进程相关的操作。可用于筛选或划分进程事件；应检查数据集中的不同值，而不要假定完整枚举。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag of extra entity or event details not present in the fixed schema. Inspect per-row keys during investigation; do not assume specific JSON paths, types, or that all rows populate it.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 包含固定架构中未列出的额外实体或事件详细信息的动态包。调查时应逐行检查键；不要假定特定 JSON 路径、类型，也不要假定所有行都会填充。

AppGuardContainerId.description: Identifier for an Application Guard virtualized container that isolated browser activity related to this event. Interpret as name-derived container context, and inspect resource or category context rather than assuming behavior.
AppGuardContainerId.description_zh: 与此事件相关、用于隔离浏览器活动的 Application Guard 虚拟化容器的标识符。应视为根据名称推导的容器上下文，并检查资源或类别上下文，而不要假定其行为。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned identifier for the device that produced this process event. Use as the stable device key when joining to other Defender tables; DeviceName can change and is less reliable for correlation.
DeviceId.description_zh: 生成此进程事件的设备的服务分配标识符。与其他 Defender 表连接时，应使用此稳定设备键；DeviceName 可能变化，关联可靠性较低。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the endpoint that reported this process event. Use for human-readable scoping and reporting, but pivot on DeviceId for exact joins across tables.
DeviceName.description_zh: 报告此进程事件的端点的完全限定域名。可用于人工可读的范围限定和报告，但跨表精确连接时应以 DeviceId 为透视键。

FileName.description: Name of the file acted upon in the recorded process event. Distinguish it from InitiatingProcessFileName, which names the process responsible for the event.
FileName.description_zh: 在此记录的进程事件中所操作文件的名称。应与 InitiatingProcessFileName 区分，后者表示导致该事件的进程名称。

FileSize.description: Size in bytes of the file acted upon in this event. Use cautiously for triage or anomaly comparison; absence or zero values may occur and the unit should not be reinterpreted.
FileSize.description_zh: 此事件中所操作文件的大小（字节）。可用于分类或异常比较，但需谨慎；可能出现缺失或零值，不应重新解释单位。

FolderPath.description: Folder containing the file acted upon in this process event. Use to locate suspicious directories or script locations; pair with FileName and hashes to identify the target binary.
FolderPath.description_zh: 此进程事件中所操作文件所在文件夹。可用于定位可疑目录或脚本位置；与 FileName 和哈希配合以识别目标二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that ran the process responsible for this event. Use to distinguish the initiator identity from the target or primary process account context on the row.
InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description_zh: 运行导致此事件的进程的账户域。可用于区分发起者身份与该行目标或主进程的账户上下文。

InitiatingProcessAccountName.description: User name of the account that ran the process responsible for this event. Combine with other initiator account fields to attribute the action to a user during process-tree analysis.
InitiatingProcessAccountName.description_zh: 运行导致此事件的进程的账户用户名。在进程树分析中，可与其他发起者账户字段组合，将操作归属到某个用户。

InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description: Azure AD object identifier for the account that ran the process responsible for this event, when present. Use as an identity pivot for the initiating side; absence is not proof of a local-only account.
InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description_zh: 运行导致此事件的进程的账户的 Azure AD 对象标识符（若存在）。可作为发起侧的身份透视键；缺失并不证明账户仅为本地账户。

InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account that ran the process responsible for this event. Useful for stable correlation of the initiating identity across Windows telemetry.
InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description_zh: 运行导致此事件的进程的账户的安全标识符。可用于在 Windows 遥测中稳定关联发起者身份。

InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that ran the process responsible for this event, when present. Use with other initiator identity fields for identity-based pivots.
InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description_zh: 运行导致此事件的进程的账户的用户主体名称（若存在）。可与其他发起者身份字段一起用于基于身份的透视。

InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description: Command line used to launch the process that initiated this event. Central for detecting suspicious arguments, encoded scripts, or LOLBin abuse; always pair with its parent and target process context.
InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 启动导致此事件的进程所用的命令行。是检测可疑参数、编码脚本或 LOLBin 滥用的核心，应始终结合其父进程和目标进程上下文。

InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description: Time when the process that initiated this event started. Compare with ProcessCreationTime and parent creation time to order events in the process tree.
InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 导致此事件的进程的启动时间。可与 ProcessCreationTime 及父进程创建时间比较，以确定进程树中的事件顺序。

InitiatingProcessFileName.description: Name of the process that initiated this event. Use with its command line, folder path, and hashes to identify the responsible executable and not the target file.
InitiatingProcessFileName.description_zh: 导致此事件的进程名称。应结合其命令行、文件夹路径和哈希来识别负责的可执行文件，而不是目标文件。

InitiatingProcessFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the image file that ran the process responsible for this event. Use for triage and comparison alongside initiator hashes and version information.
InitiatingProcessFileSize.description_zh: 运行导致此事件的进程的映像文件大小（字节）。可与发起者哈希和版本信息一起用于分类和比较。

InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description: Folder containing the image file of the process that initiated this event. Use to spot execution from temporary, user-writable, or unusual directories during investigation.
InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description_zh: 导致此事件的进程映像文件所在文件夹。调查时可用于发现从临时目录、用户可写目录或异常目录执行的情况。

InitiatingProcessId.description: Process ID of the process that initiated this event. PIDs are reusable, so scope by device and time; pair with creation time or parent ID when reconstructing process trees.
InitiatingProcessId.description_zh: 导致此事件的进程的进程 ID。PID 可复用，因此应结合设备和时间限定范围；重建进程树时与创建时间或父 ID 配合使用。

InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description: Integrity level of the process that launched the recorded action on this endpoint. Low/medium/high values help assess whether an unusual parent could write to sensitive locations or elevate.
InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description_zh: 在此端点上发起所记录操作的进程的完整性级别。低/中/高值有助于评估异常父进程是否可能写入敏感位置或提权。

InitiatingProcessLogonId.description: Logon session identifier of the process that initiated the event. Unique per machine only between restarts; scope by DeviceId and time to correlate the session that launched suspicious processes.
InitiatingProcessLogonId.description_zh: 发起事件的进程的登录会话标识符。仅在重启前对同一机器唯一；需结合 DeviceId 与时间限定，以关联启动可疑进程的会话。

InitiatingProcessMD5.description: MD5 hash of the initiating process image file for this event. Use with DeviceId to identify the launcher binary across endpoints, though MD5 alone is weaker than SHA256 for threat matching.
InitiatingProcessMD5.description_zh: 此事件中发起进程映像文件的 MD5 哈希。结合 DeviceId 可跨终结点识别启动程序二进制，但用于威胁匹配时 MD5 弱于 SHA256。

InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description: Creation timestamp of the parent of the process that initiated the event. Compare with InitiatingProcessCreationTime and ProcessCreationTime to spot rapid or suspicious parent-child launch sequences on a device.
InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description_zh: 发起事件的进程之母进程的创建时间戳。与 InitiatingProcessCreationTime 及 ProcessCreationTime 比较，可发现设备上过快或可疑的父子启动顺序。

InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description: File name of the parent process that spawned the initiating process. Use to reconstruct grandparent lineage and detect unusual spawners like script hosts or office applications launching command shells.
InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description_zh: 生成发起进程的父进程文件名。用于重建祖父级谱系，识别异常生成者，如脚本宿主或办公应用启动命令 shell。

InitiatingProcessParentId.description: Process ID of the parent that spawned the initiating process. Scope with DeviceId and time because PIDs are reused; pair with InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime to join lineage accurately.
InitiatingProcessParentId.description_zh: 生成发起进程的父进程 ID。由于 PID 会复用，需结合 DeviceId 与时间限定；配合 InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime 可准确关联谱系。

InitiatingProcessSHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the initiating process image file. Use as a fallback when SHA256 is missing, scoping by DeviceId to identify the launcher across telemetry and threat intel.
InitiatingProcessSHA1.description_zh: 发起进程映像文件的 SHA-1 哈希。当 SHA256 缺失时可用作回退，结合 DeviceId 在遥测与威胁情报中识别启动程序。

InitiatingProcessSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the initiating process image file for this event. Not always populated; if absent use InitiatingProcessSHA1. Useful for precise threat matching and reputation lookups.
InitiatingProcessSHA256.description_zh: 此事件中发起进程映像文件的 SHA-256 哈希。并非总是填充；缺失时可用 InitiatingProcessSHA1。适用于精确威胁匹配与信誉查询。

InitiatingProcessSignatureStatus.description: Signature status of the initiating process image reported for this event. Indicates whether the launcher was signed, unsigned, or otherwise unusual; inspect alongside InitiatingProcessSignerType and hashes.
InitiatingProcessSignatureStatus.description_zh: 此事件中报告的发起进程映像的签名状态。指示启动程序已签名、未签名或其他异常；应与 InitiatingProcessSignerType 及哈希一同检查。

InitiatingProcessSignerType.description: Type of signer for the initiating process image. Helps distinguish trusted publisher signers from untrusted or unsigned binaries when assessing whether a launcher is expected or suspicious.
InitiatingProcessSignerType.description_zh: 发起进程映像的签名者类型。有助于区分受信任发布者签名与不受信任或未签名二进制，以评估启动程序是否预期或可疑。

InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description: Whether the initiating process token indicates UAC elevation or not. Use with InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel to judge if an unusual launcher executed with elevated privileges during the event.
InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 发起进程令牌是否表明 UAC 提权。结合 InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel 可判断异常启动程序是否以提升权限执行了该事件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Company name recorded in version information of the initiating process image. Use to spot mismatches versus expected vendor or to flag binaries impersonating legitimate software.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 发起进程映像版本信息中记录的公司名称。用于发现与预期厂商不符之处，或标记冒充合法软件的二进制。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description: File description from version information of the initiating process image. Compare with InitiatingProcessFileName and FolderPath to detect masquerading binaries with misleading descriptions on endpoints.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description_zh: 发起进程映像版本信息中的文件描述。与 InitiatingProcessFileName 及 FolderPath 比较，可检测端点上具有误导性描述的伪装二进制。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description: Internal file name from version information of the initiating process image. Useful for identifying known tools even when the on-disk name was changed to evade detection.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description_zh: 发起进程映像版本信息中的内部文件名。即使磁盘上的名称被更改以规避检测，也有助于识别已知工具。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description: Original file name from version information of the initiating process image. Often matches the developer's build name and helps detect renamed binaries in process lineage investigations.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description_zh: 发起进程映像版本信息中的原始文件名。通常匹配开发者构建名称，有助于在进程谱系调查中发现被重命名的二进制。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Product name from version information of the initiating process image. Use with company and file description fields to attribute an unusual launcher to a specific software product.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 发起进程映像版本信息中的产品名称。与公司及文件描述字段配合，可将异常启动程序归因于特定软件产品。
