InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description: Product version from version information of the initiating process image. Helps distinguish vulnerable or outdated launcher versions from patched ones during endpoint investigations.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description_zh: 发起进程映像版本信息中的产品版本。有助于在端点调查中区分易受攻击或过期的启动程序版本与已修补版本。

LogonId.description: Logon session identifier for the newly created process; unique per machine only between restarts. Scope by DeviceId and time, and compare with InitiatingProcessLogonId to see session changes during execution.
LogonId.description_zh: 新建进程的登录会话标识符；仅在重启前对同一机器唯一。需结合 DeviceId 与时间限定，并与 InitiatingProcessLogonId 比较，观察执行期间会话变化。

MD5.description: MD5 hash of the file the recorded action was applied to, typically the newly created process image. Use for reputation checks, preferring SHA256 where available for stronger matching.
MD5.description_zh: 所记录操作作用于的文件（通常为新建进程映像）的 MD5 哈希。用于信誉检查，在有 SHA256 时优先使用以增强匹配。

MachineGroup.description: Machine group used by role-based access control to determine machine access. Not an asset tag; helps scope results by administrative grouping when filtering device scope for an investigation.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 用于基于角色访问控制确定机器访问权限的机器组。并非资产标签；在调查中筛选设备范围时，有助于按管理分组限定结果。

ProcessCommandLine.description: Command line used to create the new process. Central for spotting suspicious arguments, encoded scripts, or LOLBins; combine with process and initiating-process file names and paths.
ProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 用于创建新进程的命令行。对发现可疑参数、编码脚本或 LOLBins 至关重要；应与进程及发起进程的文件名和路径结合分析。

ProcessCreationTime.description: Date and time the newly created process started. Use with TimeGenerated and InitiatingProcessCreationTime to order execution events and measure parent-child timing on a device.
ProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 新建进程启动的日期和时间。与 TimeGenerated 及 InitiatingProcessCreationTime 结合，可对设备上的执行事件排序并衡量父子时间间隔。

ProcessId.description: Process ID of the newly created process. PIDs are reused and unique per machine only while running; scope by DeviceId and ProcessCreationTime, and join on InitiatingProcessId for lineage.
ProcessId.description_zh: 新建进程的进程 ID。PID 会复用且仅运行期间对同一机器唯一；需结合 DeviceId 与 ProcessCreationTime 限定，并与 InitiatingProcessId 关联谱系。

ProcessIntegrityLevel.description: Integrity level of the newly created process. Use with ProcessTokenElevation to assess whether suspicious child processes ran with elevated or restricted rights on the endpoint.
ProcessIntegrityLevel.description_zh: 新建进程的完整性级别。结合 ProcessTokenElevation 可评估可疑子进程是否以提升或受限权限在端点运行。

ProcessTokenElevation.description: Token elevation status of the newly created process, indicating whether UAC elevation applies to it. Use with process identity and integrity level to judge whether an action ran with elevated rights.
ProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 新建进程的令牌提升状态，表示是否应用了 UAC 提升。结合进程身份与完整性级别，判断某操作是否以提升权限运行。

ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Company name embedded in version information of the newly created process's image. Helps attribute the executable to a vendor and spot masquerading binaries with mismatched or missing company names.
ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 新建进程映像版本信息中的公司名称。有助于将可执行文件归属到厂商，并识别公司名称不匹配或缺失的伪装二进制文件。

ProcessVersionInfoFileDescription.description: File description from version information of the newly created process's image. Useful for judging what the executable claims to be and for flagging descriptions inconsistent with its name or path.
ProcessVersionInfoFileDescription.description_zh: 新建进程映像版本信息中的文件描述。可用于判断可执行文件声称的身份，并标记与其名称或路径不一致的描述。

ProcessVersionInfoInternalFileName.description: Internal file name recorded in version information of the newly created process's image. Compare against FileName and path to detect renamed or impersonating binaries executing on the device.
ProcessVersionInfoInternalFileName.description_zh: 新建进程映像版本信息中记录的内部文件名。与 FileName 和路径比较，可发现设备上运行的重命名或冒充的二进制文件。

ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName.description: Original file name from version information of the newly created process's image. Divergence from the on-disk FileName is a common masquerading indicator worth correlating with hash and signer data.
ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName.description_zh: 新建进程映像版本信息中的原始文件名。与磁盘上的 FileName 不一致常是伪装迹象，值得结合哈希与签名数据关联分析。

ProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Product name declared in version information of the newly created process's image. Supports distinguishing legitimate product components from similarly named suspicious executables observed in the same device context.
ProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 新建进程映像版本信息中声明的产品名称。有助于区分合法产品组件与同一设备上下文中出现的同名可疑可执行文件。

ProcessVersionInfoProductVersion.description: Product version from version information of the newly created process's image. Use to assess known-vulnerable or unexpected versions of software executing, alongside hashes and signer fields.
ProcessVersionInfoProductVersion.description_zh: 新建进程映像版本信息中的产品版本。结合哈希与签名字段，可评估正在运行的软件是否为已知存在漏洞或异常版本。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the file the recorded action applied to, typically the process image. Use for hash-based pivoting and comparison; prefer SHA256 for stronger identification when available.
SHA1.description_zh: 所记录操作作用文件的 SHA-1 哈希，通常是进程映像。可用于基于哈希的关联与比对；条件允许时优先使用 SHA256 以增强识别可靠性。

SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the file the recorded action applied to, typically the process image. Strong identifier for pivoting across devices and for matching known-good or malicious file intelligence.
SHA256.description_zh: 所记录操作作用文件的 SHA-256 哈希，通常是进程映像。是跨设备关联以及匹配已知良性或恶意文件情报的强标识。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection path that delivered this process event, such as a Windows agent or Azure Diagnostics. Helps scope expectations about which columns are populated for the row.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 传送此进程事件的代理或采集路径，例如 Windows 代理或 Azure Diagnostics。有助于限定该行哪些列可能已填充。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record, as documented. Do not interpret it as a directory tenant identifier; use for scoping queries to one workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档说明，为与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。不要将其解释为目录租户标识；可用于将查询限定到单个工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the MDE agent recorded the event on the endpoint. Primary time bound for process investigations; compare with process and parent creation times to understand execution order.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在终端上记录该事件的日期和时间。是进程调查的主要时间界限；与进程及父进程创建时间比较可了解执行顺序。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table providing the row, used to scope queries when multiple log types are combined. Confirm it matches the expected process event table before interpreting columns.
Type.description_zh: 提供该行的表名，用于结合多种日志类型查询时限定范围。解读列之前应确认其与预期的进程事件表一致。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

DeviceRegistryEvents.description: Endpoint registry operations with affected keys and values, previous values when recorded, and the initiating process and account. Use it to investigate persistence-related configuration changes and reconstruct who modified a registry location and what changed. Pivot on DeviceId, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName and process identity, respecting ActionType and timestamps. These are registry events; process execution, file changes and network activity require the corresponding endpoint tables.
DeviceRegistryEvents.description_zh: 记录终端注册表操作，包括受影响的键和值、日志中保留的旧值、发起进程及账户。用于调查与持久化相关的配置变更，追踪谁修改了某个注册表位置及具体改动；可通过 DeviceId、RegistryKey、RegistryValueName 和进程身份关联，并核对 ActionType 与时间。进程执行、文件变更和网络活动需查询对应终端表。

ActionType.description: The activity that produced this row, typically a registry key or value creation versus modification. Use it to separate newly planted registry artifacts from edits to existing ones.
ActionType.description_zh: 产生该行的活动，通常是注册表项或值的创建与修改。用它区分新植入的注册表项与对已有项的编辑。

AppGuardContainerId.description: When present, the Application Guard virtualized container that isolated the browser session whose activity caused this registry event. Empty for normal host activity.
AppGuardContainerId.description_zh: 当存在时，表示隔离浏览器会话的 Application Guard 虚拟化容器，该会话活动引发了此注册表事件。普通主机活动时为空。

DeviceId.description: Service-assigned identifier of the endpoint where this registry change occurred. Use it to join across MDE tables and to scope events to one machine.
DeviceId.description_zh: 发生此注册表更改的终结点的服务分配标识符。用它跨 MDE 各表关联，并将事件限定到单台机器。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the endpoint that reported this registry event. Use it for host-level pivots and triage when the identifier is unknown.
DeviceName.description_zh: 报告此注册表事件的终结点的完全限定域名。当标识符未知时，用它进行主机级透视和初步排查。

InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that ran the process modifying this registry entry. Pair with the account name to distinguish local from domain identities.
InitiatingProcessAccountDomain.description_zh: 运行修改此注册表项的进程所用账户的域。与账户名配合可区分本地身份与域身份。

InitiatingProcessAccountName.description: User name of the account that ran the process which created or modified this registry entry. Use it to attribute registry changes to a user context.
InitiatingProcessAccountName.description_zh: 运行创建或修改此注册表项的进程所用账户的用户名。用它把注册表更改归因到某个用户上下文。

InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description: Azure AD object ID of the user account behind the process that changed this registry entry. Useful for resolving identity across directory-aware investigations.
InitiatingProcessAccountObjectId.description_zh: 更改此注册表项的进程背后用户账户的 Azure AD 对象 ID。适合在涉及目录的身份调查中解析身份。

InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account that ran the process making this registry change. Use it to identify precise local or domain principals on Windows hosts.
InitiatingProcessAccountSid.description_zh: 运行进行此注册表更改的进程所用账户的安全标识符。用它精确识别 Windows 主机上的本地或域主体。

InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that ran the process modifying this registry entry. Convenient for linking registry activity to sign-in identity data.
InitiatingProcessAccountUpn.description_zh: 运行修改此注册表项进程所用账户的用户主体名称。便于将注册表活动与登录身份数据关联。

InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description: Full command line of the process that created or modified this registry entry. Inspect it for suspicious arguments such as hidden reg.exe or PowerShell writes.
InitiatingProcessCommandLine.description_zh: 创建或修改此注册表项的进程的完整命令行。可从中检查可疑参数，例如隐蔽的 reg.exe 或 PowerShell 写入。

InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description: Timestamp when the process that changed this registry entry started. Compare with the event time to gauge how soon after launch the modification occurred.
InitiatingProcessCreationTime.description_zh: 更改此注册表项的进程启动时的时间戳。与事件时间比较，可判断修改在进程启动后多久发生。

InitiatingProcessFileName.description: Image name of the process responsible for this registry change, such as reg.exe or explorer.exe. Use it to spot unexpected writers to sensitive keys.
InitiatingProcessFileName.description_zh: 负责此注册表更改的进程的映像名称，例如 reg.exe 或 explorer.exe。用它发现对敏感键的异常写入者。

InitiatingProcessFileSize.description: Size in bytes of the image file that ran the process responsible for this registry event. Unusually small binaries writing to autorun keys warrant scrutiny.
InitiatingProcessFileSize.description_zh: 运行负责此注册表事件的进程的映像文件大小（字节）。体积异常小却写入自启动键的二进制文件值得审查。

InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description: Directory path of the image file that performed this registry modification. Executables running from temp or user-writable paths are worth correlating.
InitiatingProcessFolderPath.description_zh: 执行此注册表修改的映像文件所在目录路径。从临时目录或用户可写路径运行的执行文件值得关联分析。

InitiatingProcessId.description: Process ID of the process that made this registry change at event time. Scope PID analysis to the same DeviceId and creation time, since PIDs are reused.
InitiatingProcessId.description_zh: 事件发生时进行此注册表更改的进程 ID。由于 PID 会被复用，PID 分析需限定在相同的 DeviceId 和创建时间内。

InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description: Integrity level assigned to the process that changed this registry entry, reflecting trust such as high or medium. Elevated levels suggest privileged registry writes.
InitiatingProcessIntegrityLevel.description_zh: 分配给更改此注册表项的进程的完整性级别，反映高或中等等信任度。级别提升提示存在特权注册表写入。

InitiatingProcessMD5.description: MD5 hash of the image file that performed this registry change. Use it for malware-reputation lookups and matching across endpoints, noting MD5 is weaker evidence.
InitiatingProcessMD5.description_zh: 执行此注册表更改的映像文件的 MD5 哈希。可用于恶意软件信誉查询和跨终结点匹配，但注意 MD5 证据强度较弱。

InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description: Timestamp when the parent of the registry-modifying process started. Helps reconstruct the process chain and detect delayed or unusual spawning patterns.
InitiatingProcessParentCreationTime.description_zh: 修改注册表进程的父进程启动时的时间戳。有助于重建进程链并发现延迟或异常的衍生模式。

InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description: Image name of the parent process that spawned the process making this registry change. Use it to identify the launcher, for example a script host or office application.
InitiatingProcessParentFileName.description_zh: 衍生出进行此注册表更改进程的父进程映像名称。用它识别启动者，例如脚本宿主或 Office 应用。

InitiatingProcessParentId.description: Process ID of the parent that spawned the process modifying this registry entry. Requires device and time scoping before relating it to other process events.
InitiatingProcessParentId.description_zh: 衍生出修改注册表项进程的父进程的进程 ID。与其他进程事件关联前，需配合设备和时间范围限定。

InitiatingProcessSHA1.description: SHA-1 hash of the image file that made this registry change. Useful for identifying the binary across hosts when stronger hashes are unavailable.
InitiatingProcessSHA1.description_zh: 进行此注册表更改的映像文件的 SHA-1 哈希。当缺少更强哈希时，可用于跨主机识别该二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessSHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the image file responsible for this registry event; may be unpopulated in some cases, so fall back to SHA-1. Prefer it for precise binary identification.
InitiatingProcessSHA256.description_zh: 负责此注册表事件的映像文件的 SHA-256 哈希；某些情况下可能为空，此时改用 SHA-1。优先用它精确识别二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description: Token elevation state of the process that modified this registry entry, indicating whether User Access Control elevation was applied. Elevated writes carry more risk.
InitiatingProcessTokenElevation.description_zh: 修改此注册表项的进程的令牌提升状态，表明是否应用了用户访问控制提升。提升后的写入风险更高。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description: Company name from version resources of the image that changed this registry entry. Non-empty trusted vendor values help separate signed software from masquerading binaries.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoCompanyName.description_zh: 更改此注册表项的映像版本信息资源中的公司名称。可信厂商的非空值有助于区分已签名软件与伪装二进制文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description: Human-readable description embedded in the initiating process image's version information, identifying what that executable is. Use it to sanity-check suspicious initiators, since attackers can forge version strings.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoFileDescript.description_zh: 发起进程映像版本信息中嵌入的可读描述，用于识别该可执行文件是什么。可用于对可疑发起进程做基本判断，但攻击者可伪造版本字符串。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description: Internal file name from the version resource of the process that initiated the registry change. Helps recognize known tooling or masquerading binaries when the on-disk file name is misleading.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoInternalFile.description_zh: 发起注册表修改的进程版本资源中的内部文件名。当磁盘文件名具有误导性时，可用于识别已知工具或被伪装的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description: Original compiled file name recorded in the initiating process's version information, often the vendor's build name. Compare with InitiatingProcessFileName to detect renamed or masqueraded binaries.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoOriginalFile.description_zh: 发起进程版本信息中记录的原始编译文件名，通常是厂商构建名称。可与 InitiatingProcessFileName 对比，以发现被重命名或伪装的可执行文件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description: Product name declared in the version information of the process that modified the registry. Useful for attributing the action to a vendor product versus unrecognized software.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductName.description_zh: 修改注册表的进程在版本信息中声明的产品名称。可用于将该操作归因于某厂商产品，或识别为未知软件。

InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description: Product version string from the initiating process's version resource. Supports patch-level comparisons and flagging outdated or unexpected builds performing registry changes.
InitiatingProcessVersionInfoProductVersi.description_zh: 发起进程版本资源中的产品版本字符串。可用于比较补丁级别，并标记执行注册表修改的过时或异常版本。

MachineGroup.description: Role-based access control machine group tag for the endpoint reporting the registry event. Use it to filter scope by administrative grouping, not as a security verdict about the device.
MachineGroup.description_zh: 上报该注册表事件的终结点所属的基于角色的访问控制机器组标签。可用于按管理分组限定查询范围，并不代表对设备安全性的判断。

PreviousRegistryKey.description: Registry key path held before the recorded modification. Pair with RegistryKey to detect value relocation or key renames that hide persistence changes.
PreviousRegistryKey.description_zh: 记录修改之前所处的注册表项路径。与 RegistryKey 配合可发现值被迁移或项被重命名等用于隐藏持久化的改动。

PreviousRegistryValueData.description: Value data present before the modification occurred. Diffing it against RegistryValueData reveals exactly what an attacker or installer changed.
PreviousRegistryValueData.description_zh: 修改发生之前存在的值数据。将其与 RegistryValueData 做差异对比，可准确看出攻击者或安装程序改动了什么。

PreviousRegistryValueName.description: Name of the registry value before the modification. Compare with RegistryValueName to spot value renames, a common way to obscure autostart entries.
PreviousRegistryValueName.description_zh: 修改之前的注册表值名称。与 RegistryValueName 对比可发现值被重命名，这是混淆自启动项的常见手法。

RegistryKey.description: Registry key path the recorded action applied to, such as an autostart or service location. Central pivot for persistence hunting; pair with ActionType and device/time scope.
RegistryKey.description_zh: 所记录操作作用于的注册表项路径，例如自启动或服务位置。是持久化排查的核心关联点；需结合 ActionType 及设备与时间范围使用。

RegistryValueData.description: Data written to the registry value by the recorded action. Resolve with RegistryValueType to see the actual payload, such as a command line or binary blob.
RegistryValueData.description_zh: 所记录操作写入注册表值的数据。结合 RegistryValueType 解析可看到实际载荷，例如命令行或二进制数据块。

RegistryValueName.description: Name of the registry value targeted by the action. Identifies which specific setting changed within the key, useful for tracing autostart value names.
RegistryValueName.description_zh: 操作所针对的注册表值名称。用于确定该项内具体哪个设置被更改，有助于追踪自启动相关的值名。

RegistryValueType.description: Declared data type of the affected registry value, such as string or binary. Determines how RegistryValueData should be interpreted when reviewing changes.
RegistryValueType.description_zh: 受影响注册表值声明的数据类型，例如字符串或二进制。在审查改动时决定应如何解析 RegistryValueData。

ReportId.description: Source report counter for this endpoint record. It can repeat; combine it with DeviceName and Timestamp when identifying records rather than treating ReportId alone as a globally unique event key.
ReportId.description_zh: 该终端记录的来源报告计数标识，可能重复。识别记录时应结合 DeviceName 和 Timestamp，不应把 ReportId 单独当作全局唯一事件键。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection pipeline that delivered the row, such as the Defender agent or Azure Diagnostics. Use to distinguish ingestion paths, not to characterize the registry change itself.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 传递该行的代理或收集管道，例如 Defender 代理或 Azure Diagnostics。用于区分数据接入路径，而非描述注册表改动本身。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier that holds this table. Use it to scope queries to a workspace; it is not a directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 存放该表的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。用于将查询限定到某个工作区；它并非目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the MDE agent recorded the registry event on the endpoint. Primary time filter for ordering and correlating registry changes with process activity.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: MDE 代理在终结点上记录该注册表事件的日期和时间。是排序注册表改动并与进程活动关联的主要时间过滤字段。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table the record came from. In this table it should read DeviceRegistryEvents; use it to filter out rows from other tables in shared queries.
Type.description_zh: 记录来源的表名。在本表中应为 DeviceRegistryEvents；在跨表查询时可用它过滤其他表的行。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

EmailAttachmentInfo.description: Attachments associated with emails processed by Microsoft Defender for Office 365, including file name, type, size, SHA256, sender, recipient and threat-detection metadata. Use it to find messages carrying a suspicious file or enumerate attachments delivered to a recipient. Pivot through NetworkMessageId and RecipientEmailAddress to EmailEvents for delivery context. An attachment record does not establish that the file was opened or executed on an endpoint.
EmailAttachmentInfo.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Defender for Office 365 处理的邮件关联附件，包括文件名、类型、大小、SHA256、发件人、收件人及威胁检测元数据。用于查找携带可疑文件的邮件，或列出发给某收件人的附件；可通过 NetworkMessageId 与 RecipientEmailAddress 关联 EmailEvents 获取投递上下文。存在附件记录不代表附件已在终端上打开或执行。

DetectionMethods.description: Filtering technique(s) that produced the threat verdict for this attachment, such as signature, reputation or sandbox detection. Use it to judge detection confidence and whether a threat event was engine-driven.
DetectionMethods.description_zh: 产生该附件威胁判定的过滤技术（如特征、信誉或沙箱检测）。用于判断检测置信度以及威胁事件是否由引擎驱动。

FileName.description: Name of the attached file as recorded for this email. Pivot on it to find other messages carrying the same filename, but treat it as attacker-controllable, not a unique identifier.
FileName.description_zh: 为该邮件记录的附件文件名。可用它检索携带相同文件名的其他邮件，但该名称可被攻击者控制，并非唯一标识。

FileSize.description: Size of this attachment in bytes as reported by the filtering stack. Use with FileType and SHA256 to describe or cluster the payload; it does not by itself indicate maliciousness.
FileSize.description_zh: 过滤堆栈报告的该附件大小（字节）。可结合 FileType 和 SHA256 描述或聚类载荷；其本身不能说明是否恶意。

FileType.description: Attachment file extension or type recorded for this email. Use it to filter high-risk formats and to group attachments; note that extensions can be spoofed or double-extensioned.
FileType.description_zh: 为该邮件记录的附件扩展名或类型。可用于筛选高风险格式并对附件分组；注意扩展名可能被伪造或使用双扩展名。

NetworkMessageId.description: Office 365-generated identifier for the email this attachment belongs to. Use it to join to EmailEvents and EmailUrlInfo and to group all attachments of one message.
NetworkMessageId.description_zh: Office 365 为附件所属邮件生成的标识符。可用它连接 EmailEvents 和 EmailUrlInfo，并对同一邮件的所有附件分组。

RecipientEmailAddress.description: Email address of the recipient of the message carrying this attachment, after distribution list expansion. Use it to scope impact to specific mailboxes; one message may appear as several rows.
RecipientEmailAddress.description_zh: 携带该附件的邮件收件人电子邮件地址（通讯组列表展开后）。用于将影响范围限定到具体邮箱；同一邮件可能出现多行。

RecipientObjectId.description: Azure AD object identifier of the recipient mailbox for this email. Use it to correlate with directory or sign-in data for the affected account, rather than relying on the address string.
RecipientObjectId.description_zh: 该邮件收件人邮箱的 Azure AD 对象标识符。可用它与受影响账户的目录或登录数据关联，而非仅依赖地址字符串。

ReportId.description: Unique identifier for the event record per official documentation. Practically it identifies the email event; use alongside NetworkMessageId when tracing a specific attachment record.
ReportId.description_zh: 官方文档中该事件记录的唯一标识符。实际使用中用于标识邮件事件；追踪具体附件记录时可与 NetworkMessageId 配合使用。

SHA256.description: SHA-256 hash of the attached file as recorded by the filtering stack. Pivot on it to find the same payload across messages and to check file reputation; hash equality alone does not prove execution or compromise.
SHA256.description_zh: 过滤堆栈记录的附件文件 SHA-256 哈希。可用它跨邮件查找同一载荷并检查文件信誉；哈希相同本身不证明文件被执行或系统被入侵。

SenderDisplayName.description: Display name shown for the sender of the message carrying this attachment. It is attacker-chosen and not identity proof; use with SenderFromAddress to spot impersonation attempts.
SenderDisplayName.description_zh: 携带该附件的邮件发件人的显示名称。该名称由发件人自行设置，不能作为身份凭证；可结合 SenderFromAddress 识别冒用行为。

SenderFromAddress.description: From-header address of the sender for the email carrying this attachment, as visible to recipients. Treat as spoofable; use it to group campaigns and to compare against authenticated sender data elsewhere.
SenderFromAddress.description_zh: 携带该附件的邮件 From 头中收件人可见的发件人地址。该值可被伪造；可用它对活动分组，并与别处的已认证发件人数据比对。

SenderObjectId.description: Object identifier for the sender associated with this email, where the filtering stack resolved one. Use it to link to directory context for the sending account; absence does not mean external origin.
SenderObjectId.description_zh: 过滤堆栈解析出的该邮件发件人对象标识符。可用它关联发件人账户的目录上下文；缺失并不表示发件方为外部。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that delivered this record into the workspace, for example the connector type. Use it for data-quality scoping and ingestion troubleshooting, not as sender or threat information.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 将该记录送入工作区的代理或采集通道，例如连接器类型。可用于数据质量范围界定和摄取排查，而非发件人或威胁信息。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier that received this record, per official documentation. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace; it is not an Azure AD directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 根据官方文档，接收该记录的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。可用于将查询范围限定到正确的工作区；它不是 Azure AD 目录租户标识符。

ThreatNames.description: Specific threat or malware family names assigned to this attachment by the filtering stack. Use it to group related payloads and name campaigns; a listed name is a detection, not proof of compromise.
ThreatNames.description_zh: 过滤堆栈为该附件分配的具体威胁或恶意软件家族名称。可用于对相关载荷分组并命名活动；列出名称仅是检测结果，不证明系统已被入侵。

ThreatTypes.description: Verdict from the email filtering stack on whether this email carries malware, phishing or other threats. Use it to triage attachments; a verdict reflects filtering judgment, not confirmed compromise.
ThreatTypes.description_zh: 电子邮件过滤堆栈对该邮件是否携带恶意软件、钓鱼或其他威胁的判定。可用于对附件分级处置；该判定反映过滤判断，并不代表已确认的入侵。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when this attachment record was generated. Use it for time-bounded queries and timeline construction around the email event; correlate with message delivery timestamps elsewhere.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该附件记录生成的 UTC 日期和时间。可用于按时间范围查询并围绕邮件事件构建时间线；可与别处的邮件投递时间戳关联。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table that produced the row, reflecting the table's value for this record. Use it to filter when querying across multiple tables in the same workspace.
Type.description_zh: 产生该行的表名称，反映该记录所属的表值。在同一工作区跨多个表查询时可用于筛选。

EmailEvents.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 message-processing records with sender, recipient, authentication results, threat verdicts and delivery actions or locations. Use it to establish who sent a suspicious message, who received it, and how it was handled. Pivot on NetworkMessageId with RecipientEmailAddress; use EmailUrlInfo for embedded links, EmailAttachmentInfo for attachment hashes, EmailPostDeliveryEvents for later remediation, and UrlClickEvents for observed clicks.
EmailEvents.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Defender for Office 365 的邮件处理信息，包括发件人、收件人、身份验证结果、威胁判定、投递操作及位置。用于确认可疑邮件由谁发送、谁接收以及如何被处理；可通过 NetworkMessageId 与 RecipientEmailAddress 关联。邮件内链接查 EmailUrlInfo，附件哈希查 EmailAttachmentInfo，后续修复查 EmailPostDeliveryEvents，实际点击查 UrlClickEvents。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag holding extra provider-defined properties not surfaced as columns in this table. Contents vary by event; inspect keys in email/resource context before relying on them rather than assuming fixed paths or values.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 动态字段，保存本表中未作为列呈现的额外提供商自定义属性。内容随事件变化；使用前请在邮件/资源上下文中检查键名，不要假设固定路径或取值。

AttachmentCount.description: Count of attachments on the email event for that recipient. Nonzero indicates attachments existed, but presence alone does not prove a user opened or executed anything.
AttachmentCount.description_zh: 该收件人邮件事件中的附件数量。大于零表示存在附件，但仅凭此不能证明用户打开或执行了附件。

AuthenticationDetails.description: Pass/fail authentication verdicts for this email, such as SPF, DKIM, DMARC and composite authentication. Use to assess sender legitimacy for the message event; a pass does not by itself prove the email is benign.
AuthenticationDetails.description_zh: 该邮件的身份验证通过/失败结论，例如 SPF、DKIM、DMARC 及复合身份验证。可用于评估该邮件事件的发件人可信度；通过并不单独证明邮件安全。

BulkComplaintLevel.description: Bulk complaint level (BCL) threshold assigned to this email event, higher meaning more likely to generate complaints and thus more spam-like. Use alongside spam verdict fields, not as a standalone compromise indicator.
BulkComplaintLevel.description_zh: 分配给该邮件事件的批量投诉级别（BCL）阈值，越高越可能引发投诉、越具垃圾邮件特征。应结合垃圾邮件判定字段使用，不能单独作为失陷指标。

ConfidenceLevel.description: Confidence of spam or phishing verdicts for this email event, e.g. spam confidence level values or phishing confidence High/Low. Interpret with the corresponding threat and action fields for this row.
ConfidenceLevel.description_zh: 该邮件事件垃圾邮件或钓鱼判定的置信度，例如垃圾邮件置信级别取值或钓鱼置信度 High/Low。需结合本行相应威胁与操作字段解读。

Connectors.description: Custom mail-flow instructions or connectors that routed this email event. Describes routing configuration applied to the message, useful when delivery path differs from expected organizational mail flow.
Connectors.description_zh: 路由该邮件事件的自定义邮件流指令或连接器。描述应用于该邮件的路由配置，当投递路径与预期组织邮件流不一致时有用。

DeliveryAction.description: Action applied when this email was delivered, such as delivered, junked, blocked or replaced. Use with DeliveryLocation to understand what happened to the message; action does not equal user interaction.
DeliveryAction.description_zh: 该邮件投递时所执行的操作，如已投递、移入垃圾邮件、已阻止或已替换。结合 DeliveryLocation 了解邮件去向；该操作不等于用户交互。

DeliveryLocation.description: Message location associated with the recorded delivery event. Use with DeliveryAction and RecipientEmailAddress to understand initial handling; consult LatestDeliveryLocation or post-delivery events for subsequent changes.
DeliveryLocation.description_zh: 本次投递事件记录的邮件位置。结合 DeliveryAction 和 RecipientEmailAddress 可了解初始处理情况；后续位置变化应查看 LatestDeliveryLocation 或投递后事件。

DetectionMethods.description: Detection mechanisms that produced the verdict for this email event, distinct from the resulting delivery action. Use to see which filtering technology flagged the message and how it was classified.
DetectionMethods.description_zh: 对该邮件事件产生判定的检测机制，区别于由此得出的投递操作。可用于查看是哪种过滤技术标记了该邮件及其分类方式。

EmailAction.description: Final action taken on this email based on filter verdict, policy and user actions, such as junking, header changes, redirect, delete or quarantine. Describes message handling, not proof a user acted on content.
EmailAction.description_zh: 基于过滤判定、策略与用户操作对该邮件采取的最终操作，如移入垃圾邮件、修改标头、重定向、删除或隔离。描述邮件处理结果，不代表用户对内容采取了操作。

EmailActionPolicy.description: Name of the action policy that took effect on this email event, such as antispam, anti-phishing, anti-malware or transport rule categories. Use to attribute the outcome to a specific protection policy.
EmailActionPolicy.description_zh: 对该邮件事件生效的操作策略名称，例如反垃圾邮件、反钓鱼、反恶意软件或传输规则类别。可用于将结果归因到具体防护策略。

EmailActionPolicyGuid.description: Unique identifier of the policy that took effect on this email event. Use to correlate multiple emails handled by the same policy or to join with policy configuration context.
EmailActionPolicyGuid.description_zh: 对该邮件事件生效的策略唯一标识符。可用于关联由同一策略处理的多个邮件，或与策略配置上下文进行连接。

EmailClusterId.description: Identifier grouping this email with others by heuristic content analysis. Use to pivot from one message event to related clustered emails, for example similar campaigns; clustering is heuristic, not proof of common origin.
EmailClusterId.description_zh: 通过内容启发式分析将该邮件与其他邮件分组的标识符。可从单个邮件事件关联到同一簇的相关邮件（如相似活动）；聚类为启发式结果，不证明来源相同。

EmailDirection.description: Direction of this email event, such as inbound, outbound or intra-org. Use to scope investigation to messages entering, leaving or internal to the organization before analyzing sender and recipient sets.
EmailDirection.description_zh: 该邮件事件的方向，如入站、出站或组织内。可用于在分析发件人与收件人集合前，将调查范围限定为进入、离开或组织内部的邮件。

EmailLanguage.description: Language detected in this email event's content. Useful for spotting messages whose language is unusual for the recipient or organization, as part of triage rather than as a verdict.
EmailLanguage.description_zh: 在该邮件事件内容中检测到的语言。可用于发现语言对收件人或组织而言异常的邮件，作为分诊线索而非判定结论。

InternetMessageId.description: Public-facing identifier set by the sending email system for this message. Use to correlate the same message across mail systems or external reports; it is not generated by Office 365.
InternetMessageId.description_zh: 由发送方邮件系统为该邮件设置的对外可见标识符。可用于在邮件系统或外部报告间关联同一邮件；该标识符并非 Office 365 生成。

LatestDeliveryAction.description: Last known action attempted on this email by the service or an admin through manual remediation. Compare with DeliveryAction to see whether remediation changed the message's handling after delivery.
LatestDeliveryAction.description_zh: 服务或管理员通过手动修复对该邮件尝试的最后已知操作。可与 DeliveryAction 比较，判断投递后的修复是否改变了邮件的处理结果。

LatestDeliveryLocation.description: Last known location of this email after any service or manual remediation. Use with LatestDeliveryAction to track where the message ended up following later intervention.
LatestDeliveryLocation.description_zh: 经过任何服务或手动修复后该邮件的最后已知位置。结合 LatestDeliveryAction，可追踪后续干预后该邮件的最终去向。

NetworkMessageId.description: Unique identifier for this email generated by Office 365. Primary correlation key for message-level pivots across related email tables and events; generated by the service rather than the sender.
NetworkMessageId.description_zh: Office 365 为该邮件生成的唯一标识符。是跨相关邮件表与事件进行消息级关联的主要键；由服务生成，而非发件人。

OrgLevelAction.description: Action taken on this email event in response to matches with an organization-level policy. Use with OrgLevelPolicy to attribute outcomes to organizational configuration rather than per-user settings.
OrgLevelAction.description_zh: 因匹配组织级策略而对该邮件事件采取的操作。结合 OrgLevelPolicy，可将结果归因于组织配置而非每用户设置。

OrgLevelPolicy.description: Name of the organizational policy that triggered the action recorded for this email event. Use with OrgLevelAction to identify which organizational rule influenced message handling.
OrgLevelPolicy.description_zh: 触发该邮件事件所记录操作的组织策略名称。结合 OrgLevelAction，可识别是哪条组织规则影响了邮件处理。

RecipientEmailAddress.description: Recipient email address for this email event, after distribution list expansion if applicable. Identifies the mailbox targeted; a row indicates an email event for that address, not user interaction.
RecipientEmailAddress.description_zh: 该邮件事件的收件人电子邮件地址，如适用则为通讯组展开后的地址。用于标识目标邮箱；一行代表该地址的邮件事件，不代表用户交互。

RecipientObjectId.description: Directory object identifier of the email recipient for this event. Use to correlate the recipient with directory-based identity context when scope and permissions allow; it is an object ID, not an email address.
RecipientObjectId.description_zh: 该事件中邮件收件人的目录对象标识符。在范围与权限允许时，可用于将收件人与基于目录的身份上下文关联；它是对象 ID，不是邮件地址。

ReportId.description: Unique identifier for this event record. Use for referencing a specific email event or joining with other reports that cite the same identifier, rather than for message-level correlation.
ReportId.description_zh: 该事件记录的唯一标识符。可用于引用特定邮件事件，或与引用同一标识符的其他报告关联，而非用于消息级关联。

SenderDisplayName.description: Display name shown for the sender in the message, representing the visible From identity. Use with SenderFromAddress to spot spoofed or misleading sender names, noting names are attacker-controlled.
SenderDisplayName.description_zh: 邮件中显示的发件人显示名称，代表可见的 From 身份。可与 SenderFromAddress 一起识别伪造或误导性发件人名称，注意该名称由发件方控制。

SenderFromAddress.description: Sender address shown in the message From header. Compare it with the envelope sender and authentication results when assessing impersonation; an address mismatch alone does not prove spoofing.
SenderFromAddress.description_zh: 邮件 From 信头中显示的发件人地址。评估身份冒用时可与信封发件人及身份验证结果比较；地址不一致本身不能证明欺骗。

SenderFromDomain.description: Domain portion of the From header address for the message. Use to aggregate senders by domain, assess lookalike domains, and pivot to related messages from the same From domain.
SenderFromDomain.description_zh: 该邮件 From 信头地址的域部分。可用于按域聚合发件人、评估仿冒域，并关联同一 From 域的相关邮件。

SenderIPv4.description: IPv4 address of the last detected mail server that relayed this message. Use with sender and message identifiers to trace sending infrastructure; it is relay metadata, not proof of actor identity.
SenderIPv4.description_zh: 最后检测到的中继该邮件的邮件服务器 IPv4 地址。可与发件人和邮件标识符一起追踪发送基础设施；它只是中继元数据，不能证明行为者身份。

SenderIPv6.description: IPv6 address of the last detected mail server that relayed this message. Use alongside SenderIPv4 and message identifiers to trace sending infrastructure; absence does not indicate benign mail.
SenderIPv6.description_zh: 最后检测到的中继该邮件的邮件服务器 IPv6 地址。可与 SenderIPv4 和邮件标识符一起追踪发送基础设施；缺失并不表示邮件无害。

SenderMailFromAddress.description: Envelope sender address used for message transport. Compare with SenderFromAddress and authentication results to assess sender identity; forwarding and mailing services can also produce legitimate differences.
SenderMailFromAddress.description_zh: 用于邮件传输的信封发件人地址。可结合 SenderFromAddress 和身份验证结果评估发送者身份；转发及邮件服务也可能造成正常的地址差异。

SenderMailFromDomain.description: Domain portion of the envelope sender for the message. Use with SenderFromDomain and authentication results to assess domain alignment and identify mismatched sending domains.
SenderMailFromDomain.description_zh: 该邮件信封发件人的域部分。可与 SenderFromDomain 及身份验证结果一起评估域对齐情况并识别不匹配的发送域。

SenderObjectId.description: Directory object identifier for the sender when the sender is an internal identity; otherwise it may be empty. Use it to scope mail sent by a specific account, distinct from address columns.
SenderObjectId.description_zh: 当发件人为内部身份时，表示发件人的目录对象标识符；否则可能为空。可用于限定特定账户发送的邮件，与地址列不同。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection system that produced the record, such as Operations Manager or Azure. Use to understand ingestion provenance and filter records when correlating this table with other log sources.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成该记录的代理或收集系统，例如 Operations Manager 或 Azure。可用于了解数据接入来源，并在与其他日志源关联时筛选记录。

Subject.description: Subject line of the message for this delivery event. Use for keyword or campaign clustering, lure identification, and correlating related messages with the same subject.
Subject.description_zh: 该投递事件中邮件的主题行。可用于关键词或活动聚类、识别诱饵，并关联具有相同主题的相关邮件。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with the record, not the directory tenant ID. Use to scope queries to the correct workspace and to group results across workspace-scoped data.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符，并非目录租户 ID。可用于将查询限定到正确的工作区，并按工作区范围对数据分组。

ThreatNames.description: Specific threat family or malware names assigned by filtering detections for this message. Use to group related campaigns and enrich verdicts, but a match alone does not prove recipient compromise.
ThreatNames.description_zh: 过滤检测为该邮件指定的具体威胁家族或恶意软件名称。可用于分组相关活动并丰富判定，但仅凭匹配并不能证明收件人已失陷。

ThreatTypes.description: Verdict categories from the email filtering stack indicating whether the message contained malware, phishing, or other threats. Use with action and location columns to interpret filtering outcomes; a verdict is not proof of user interaction.
ThreatTypes.description_zh: 电子邮件过滤堆栈给出的判定类别，说明邮件包含恶意软件、钓鱼或其他威胁。可与处置和位置列一起解读过滤结果；判定并不证明用户交互。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when the record was generated. Use as the primary time boundary for delivery, blocking, and post-delivery action timelines and for ordering related message events.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 记录生成时的 UTC 日期和时间。可作为投递、拦截与投递后处置时间线的主要时间边界，并用于对相关邮件事件排序。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table that contains the record, useful for filtering this table when querying across multiple Log Analytics tables in the workspace.
Type.description_zh: 包含该记录的表的名称，在查询工作区中多个 Log Analytics 表时可用于筛选此表。

UrlCount.description: Count of embedded URLs in the message for this event. Use to triage messages with links, but URL presence or count does not prove that any URL was clicked.
UrlCount.description_zh: 该事件中邮件内嵌 URL 的数量。可用于对含链接邮件进行分流，但 URL 存在或数量并不能证明任何 URL 被点击。

UserLevelAction.description: Action taken on the message based on a mailbox policy defined by the recipient, such as user-level filtering outcomes. Use to distinguish user-configured handling from org-level actions.
UserLevelAction.description_zh: 基于收件人定义的邮箱策略对该邮件采取的处置，例如用户级过滤结果。可用于区分用户配置的处理与组织级处置。

UserLevelPolicy.description: End-user mailbox policy that triggered the user-level action on this message. Pair with UserLevelAction to attribute handling to a specific user policy rather than organizational rules.
UserLevelPolicy.description_zh: 触发该邮件用户级处置的最终用户邮箱策略。可与 UserLevelAction 配合，将处理归因于特定用户策略而非组织规则。

EmailPostDeliveryEvents.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 security actions taken after email delivery, with the action, trigger, result, location and recipient. Use it to determine whether a suspicious message was later moved, quarantined or otherwise remediated and whether the recorded action succeeded. Pivot on NetworkMessageId or InternetMessageId together with RecipientEmailAddress and time. EmailEvents provides delivery context; UrlClickEvents provides observed link-click activity.
EmailPostDeliveryEvents.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Defender for Office 365 在邮件投递后执行的安全操作，包括操作、触发来源、结果、位置和收件人。用于调查可疑邮件后续是否被移动、隔离或采取其他修复措施，以及日志记录的操作是否成功；可通过 NetworkMessageId 或 InternetMessageId，结合 RecipientEmailAddress 和时间关联。投递上下文查 EmailEvents，链接点击行为查 UrlClickEvents。

Action.description: The post-delivery action applied to the message (for example quarantine, delete, or move), scoped to this remediation record. Use with ActionResult to see what was attempted and whether it took effect.
Action.description_zh: 该投递后处置记录中对邮件执行的操作（如隔离、删除或移动）。结合 ActionResult 判断尝试了什么以及是否生效。

ActionResult.description: Outcome of the Action on this post-delivery event, indicating success or failure of the remediation. Pair with Action and TimeGenerated to confirm whether the message was actually affected.
ActionResult.description_zh: 此投递后事件中 Action 的执行结果，表明修复是否成功。结合 Action 与 TimeGenerated 确认邮件是否确实被处置。

ActionTrigger.description: Reports what initiated the post-delivery action, such as an administrator decision or an automated mechanism. Distinguishes manual intervention from automatic remediation for this message event.
ActionTrigger.description_zh: 说明是什么触发了该投递后操作，例如管理员决定或自动机制。用于区分针对此邮件事件的人工干预与自动修复。

ActionType.description: Name-derived: category of activity this post-delivery event represents. Interpretation is based on the field name; inspect the event's action context rather than assuming fixed values, and avoid treating it as a guaranteed enum.
ActionType.description_zh: 名称推断：表示此投递后事件所属的活动类别。该解释仅基于字段名，应结合事件的操作上下文判断，不要假定为固定枚举值。

DeliveryLocation.description: Where the message ended up after delivery, such as inbox, junk, quarantine, or deleted items. Helps determine whether a recipient could have accessed the email before remediation.
DeliveryLocation.description_zh: 邮件投递后所在的位置，如收件箱、垃圾邮件、隔离区或已删除邮件。用于判断在修复之前收件人是否可能接触到该邮件。

DetectionMethods.description: Detection techniques that flagged the message as malicious in the filtering stack. Use with ThreatTypes to understand why this post-delivery action occurred on the email.
DetectionMethods.description_zh: 过滤堆栈中将该邮件判定为恶意的检测技术。结合 ThreatTypes 理解为何对该邮件执行此投递后操作。

InternetMessageId.description: Sender-assigned public identifier for the email involved in this post-delivery event. Use to correlate the same message across mail systems and other security tables.
InternetMessageId.description_zh: 此投递后事件所涉邮件的发送方公开标识符。用于在不同邮件系统及其他安全表之间关联同一封邮件。

NetworkMessageId.description: Office 365-generated unique identifier for the email tied to this post-delivery event. Primary pivot when joining this table to email delivery, threat, or click telemetry for the same message.
NetworkMessageId.description_zh: 与此投递后事件关联邮件的 Office 365 生成唯一标识符。将本表与同一封邮件的投递、威胁或点击遥测关联时的主要关联键。

RecipientEmailAddress.description: Mailbox that received the message for this post-delivery event, after any distribution list expansion. Scope analysis to a specific user when assessing exposure to the remediated email.
RecipientEmailAddress.description_zh: 此投递后事件中接收该邮件的邮箱（经过通讯组扩展后）。评估收件人是否接触过被处置邮件时，可用它限定到具体用户。

ReportId.description: Identifier for the post-delivery event record itself, per official documentation. Use for referencing a specific remediation event, not for correlating across other tables.
ReportId.description_zh: 官方文档称其为该投递后事件记录的唯一标识符。用于引用某个具体的修复事件，而非跨表关联。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that ingested the record, such as Operations Manager or Azure. Metadata about ingestion provenance; limited investigative value beyond confirming data origin.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集该记录的代理或收集通道，例如 Operations Manager 或 Azure。属于采集来源元数据，除确认数据来源外调查价值有限。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier for this record, per documentation, not an Entra directory tenant ID. Scope queries to a workspace; do not use it to identify a directory tenant.
TenantId.description_zh: 文档所述为记录所属的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID，而非 Entra 目录租户 ID。用于限定查询的工作区，不要用它识别目录租户。

ThreatTypes.description: Filtering-stack verdict on whether the email contained malware, phishing, or other threats. Evidence of a suspicious verdict, not proof of compromise; corroborate before concluding impact.
ThreatTypes.description_zh: 过滤堆栈对邮件是否含恶意软件、钓鱼或其他威胁的判定。属于可疑判定证据，并非已遭入侵的证明，结论前应交叉验证。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when this post-delivery event record was generated. Use to place remediation actions in sequence and bound queries to the relevant investigation window.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 此投递后事件记录的生成时间（UTC）。用于按顺序排列修复操作，并将查询限定在相关调查时间窗口内。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table that stores this record. Informational metadata for query construction rather than an investigative attribute.
Type.description_zh: 存储此记录的表名称。属于构造查询用的信息性元数据，而非调查属性。

EmailUrlInfo.description: URLs extracted from email messages, with their domain and location within the message. Use it to find which messages contained a suspicious URL or domain and enumerate the links in a known message. Join through NetworkMessageId to EmailEvents for sender, recipient and delivery context. URL presence is not a click event or a threat verdict; use UrlClickEvents to investigate observed user clicks.
EmailUrlInfo.description_zh: 记录从邮件中提取的 URL、域名及其在邮件中的位置。用于定位哪些邮件包含可疑 URL 或域名，或列出某封邮件中的链接；可通过 NetworkMessageId 关联 EmailEvents 获取发件人、收件人和投递上下文。链接存在不代表发生点击，也不等同于威胁判定；实际用户点击应查 UrlClickEvents。

NetworkMessageId.description: Office 365-generated identifier for the email message containing this URL. Use it to group all URLs from the same message and to join to other email tables; it is not a URL-level identifier.
NetworkMessageId.description_zh: Office 365 生成的、包含此 URL 的电子邮件消息标识符。可用于将同一邮件中的所有 URL 归组，并与其他邮件表关联；它不是 URL 级别的标识符。

ReportId.description: Identifier for the event or report record that carried this URL. Use it to correlate this URL row with the corresponding report entry; do not assume it uniquely identifies the email message itself.
ReportId.description_zh: 承载此 URL 的事件或报告记录的标识符。可用于将此 URL 行与对应的报告条目关联；不要假定它唯一标识电子邮件消息本身。

SourceSystem.description: Name of the collection agent or connector that ingested this URL record, such as the Office 365 management agent. Use it to distinguish ingestion pathways when combining data from multiple sources or workspaces.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 采集此 URL 记录的代理或连接器名称，例如 Office 365 管理代理。可用于在合并多个来源或工作区数据时区分采集途径。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with this URL record. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace; per documentation it is a workspace ID, not an Azure directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 与此 URL 记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。可用于将查询限定到正确的工作区；根据文档，它是工作区 ID，而非 Azure 目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when this URL record was generated. Use it as the primary time filter for investigations and to place URL findings on a timeline relative to other email events.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 此 URL 记录生成时的 UTC 日期和时间。可用作调查的主要时间过滤条件，并将 URL 发现相对于其他邮件事件放到时间线上。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, conventionally EmailUrlInfo. Use it to filter or union tables when querying multiple email-related datasets in the same workspace.
Type.description_zh: 此记录所属表的名称，通常为 EmailUrlInfo。可用于在同一工作区中查询多个邮件相关数据集时进行过滤或联合。

Url.description: The actual URL string found within an Office 365 email message. Use it to inspect full link targets, compare against known-malicious indicators, and pivot to UrlDomain for grouping; presence alone does not prove a click.
Url.description_zh: 在 Office 365 电子邮件消息中发现的完整 URL 字符串。可用于检查完整链接目标、与已知恶意指标比对，并透视到 UrlDomain 进行分组；仅出现并不证明被点击。

UrlDomain.description: Domain portion extracted from the URL found in the email. Use it to aggregate or hunt by domain, spot look-alike or newly seen domains, and pivot from a suspicious domain to all related messages.
UrlDomain.description_zh: 从邮件中发现的 URL 提取出的域名部分。可用于按域聚合或狩猎、发现仿冒或新出现的域，并从可疑域透视到所有相关邮件。

UrlLocation.description: Indicates which part of the email the URL appeared in, such as body or header context as recorded by the source. Use it to prioritize links in clickable regions over less actionable placements during triage.
UrlLocation.description_zh: 指示 URL 出现在邮件的哪个部分，例如来源记录的正文或标头上下文。可用于在分类处置时优先关注可点击区域中的链接，而非可利用性较低的放置位置。

Heartbeat.description: Heartbeat records are emitted roughly once per minute by Log Analytics agents to report agent health. Each row describes one agent host's heartbeat at TimeGenerated, enabling questions about which computers report, when they last checked in, agent version and OS, and Azure or non-Azure placement. Useful pivots include Computer, SourceComputerId, Category, SCAgentChannel, ResourceId and Solutions. Boundaries: this is agent health, not logon, process or network telemetry; other tables hold those events. Row-level Azure resource fields may be empty for non-Azure hosts.
Heartbeat.description_zh: Heartbeat 记录由 Log Analytics 代理约每分钟发出一次，用于报告代理运行状况。每行描述一台代理主机在 TimeGenerated 的一次心跳，可回答哪些计算机在上报、最后签到时间、代理版本与操作系统、以及位于 Azure 还是非 Azure 环境。可用 Computer、SourceComputerId、Category、SCAgentChannel、ResourceId 和 Solutions 等字段进行关联。边界：这是代理健康数据，不是登录、进程或网络事件；那些事件在其他表中。非 Azure 主机的 Azure 资源字段可能为空。

Category.description: Name-derived channel classification for the agent's heartbeat, such as Direct Agent, SCOM Agent or SCOM Management Server. Use to separate directly connected agents from SCOM-managed ones when scoping agent health.
Category.description_zh: 根据名称推断的心跳通道分类，如 Direct Agent、SCOM Agent 或 SCOM Management Server。用于在排查代理健康时区分直接连接与 SCOM 管理的代理。

Computer.description: Name of the computer that emitted this heartbeat, the primary host pivot. Use to group heartbeats per host when checking reporting continuity or correlating with other tables' machine names.
Computer.description_zh: 发出此次心跳的计算机名称，是主要的主机关联字段。可按主机分组心跳以检查上报连续性，或与其他表中的机器名关联。

ComputerEnvironment.description: Documents whether the heartbeat-emitting computer is hosted in Azure or Non-Azure. Use to split agent coverage and health questions by cloud versus on-premises estate.
ComputerEnvironment.description_zh: 记录发出心跳的计算机托管在 Azure 还是非 Azure 环境。用于按云与本地资产划分代理覆盖率和健康问题。

ComputerIP.description: IP address recorded for the heartbeat computer, with the public address used per documentation. Use for network placement checks, and treat as a per-heartbeat observation rather than fixed host identity.
ComputerIP.description_zh: 心跳计算机记录的 IP 地址，按文档说明使用公网地址。可用于网络位置核查，但应视为每次心跳的观测值而非固定的主机标识。

ComputerPrivateIPs.description: Dynamic list of private IP addresses associated with the reporting computer. Use to identify internal addresses for host correlation; inspect the array contents rather than assuming a scalar for cross-table joins.
ComputerPrivateIPs.description_zh: 上报计算机关联的私有 IP 地址动态列表。可用于识别内部地址以关联主机；需检查数组内容，不要当作标量进行跨表连接。

IsGatewayInstalled.description: Boolean saying whether a Log Analytics gateway is installed for this computer at heartbeat time. Use to identify hosts that may relay other agents' traffic when assessing data-collection paths.
IsGatewayInstalled.description_zh: 布尔值，表示心跳时该计算机是否安装了 Log Analytics 网关。用于识别可能中转其他代理流量的主机，以评估数据收集路径。

MG.description: Name-derived abbreviation likely denoting the management group associated with the agent heartbeat. Interpretation is name-derived: inspect the row's Category and ManagementGroupName context before relying on it.
MG.description_zh: 根据名称推断可能表示与代理心跳相关的管理组。此解释仅为名称推断：使用前请结合该行的 Category 与 ManagementGroupName 上下文核实。

ManagementGroupName.description: Name of the Operations Manager management group the agent belongs to. Use to distinguish SCOM-managed heartbeats from directly connected and standalone agents.
ManagementGroupName.description_zh: 代理所属 Operations Manager 管理组的名称。用于区分 SCOM 管理的心跳与直接连接或独立代理的心跳。

OSMajorVersion.description: Major version of the operating system on the heartbeat computer. Use with OSName and OSMinorVersion to assess patch and platform coverage across reporting agents.
OSMajorVersion.description_zh: 心跳计算机操作系统的主版本号。可与 OSName、OSMinorVersion 一起评估上报代理的补丁与平台覆盖情况。

OSMinorVersion.description: Minor version of the operating system on the heartbeat computer. Use with OSMajorVersion and OSName to fingerprint and compare agent host platforms.
OSMinorVersion.description_zh: 心跳计算机操作系统的次版本号。可与 OSMajorVersion、OSName 一起识别和比较代理主机平台。

OSName.description: Name of the operating system running on the reporting computer. Use to group and filter agent heartbeats by platform when investigating coverage or compatibility questions.
OSName.description_zh: 上报计算机运行的操作系统名称。用于在排查覆盖率或兼容性问题时按平台对代理心跳进行分组和筛选。

OSType.description: Operating system type for the heartbeat computer, documented as Windows or Linux. Use to segment agent health and logs by platform family.
OSType.description_zh: 心跳计算机的操作系统类型，文档标注为 Windows 或 Linux。用于按平台类别划分代理健康与日志。

RemoteIPCountry.description: Geographic country associated with the computer's recorded IP location. Use as approximate placement context for agent inventories; do not treat as precise host geolocation.
RemoteIPCountry.description_zh: 与计算机所记录 IP 位置关联的国家。可作为代理资产的粗略位置上下文，不要当作精确的主机地理位置。

RemoteIPLatitude.description: Latitude of the computer's approximate geographic location derived from its IP. Use with RemoteIPLongitude for coarse placement mapping, not precise tracking.
RemoteIPLatitude.description_zh: 由 IP 推导的计算机近似地理纬度。可与 RemoteIPLongitude 一起用于粗略位置映射，不用于精确定位。

RemoteIPLongitude.description: Longitude of the computer's approximate geographic location derived from its IP. Pair with RemoteIPLatitude when mapping agent hosts to regions.
RemoteIPLongitude.description_zh: 由 IP 推导的计算机近似地理经度。与 RemoteIPLatitude 配对可将代理主机映射到区域。

Resource.description: Azure resource name of the resource running the agent, per documentation text. Use to link heartbeats to a specific cloud resource, noting official descriptions may be reversed with ResourceGroup.
Resource.description_zh: 按文档说明是运行代理的 Azure 资源名称。用于将心跳关联到具体云资源，注意官方描述可能与 ResourceGroup 互换。

ResourceGroup.description: Azure resource group name for the resource running the agent, per documentation text. Use to scope agent health by resource group, noting official descriptions may be reversed with Resource.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 按文档说明是运行代理资源所在的 Azure 资源组名称。可用资源组限定代理健康范围，注意官方描述可能与 Resource 互换。

ResourceId.description: Azure resource ID for the resource running the agent, retained for backward compatibility; documentation prefers _ResourceId. Use for cross-table joins to Azure resources.
ResourceId.description_zh: 运行代理的 Azure 资源 ID，为向后兼容而保留；文档推荐使用 _ResourceId。用于与 Azure 资源进行跨表连接。

ResourceProvider.description: Azure resource provider namespace of the resource running the agent, such as Microsoft.Compute. Use to filter or group agent hosts by provider when scoping Azure resources.
ResourceProvider.description_zh: 运行代理资源的 Azure 资源提供程序命名空间，如 Microsoft.Compute。可用于按提供程序筛选或分组代理主机，限定 Azure 资源范围。

ResourceType.description: Azure resource type of the resource running the agent, with examples like virtualmachines or managedclusters. Use to distinguish agent hosting contexts when inventorying coverage.
ResourceType.description_zh: 运行代理资源的 Azure 资源类型，例如 virtualmachines 或 managedclusters。可用于在盘点覆盖率时区分代理的托管上下文。

SCAgentChannel.description: Documents how the agent connects to the workspace, with possible values Direct or SCManagementServer. Use to separate direct-connected agents from management-server-routed ones in agent health analysis.
SCAgentChannel.description_zh: 记录代理如何连接到工作区，可能值为 Direct 或 SCManagementServer。用于在代理健康分析中区分直接连接与经管理服务器路由的代理。

Solutions.description: List of solutions deployed on the agent at the time the heartbeat was issued. Use to see which monitoring or security solutions a reporting host was running at that moment.
Solutions.description_zh: 发出心跳时该代理已部署的解决方案列表。用于查看该时刻上报主机正在运行的监视或安全解决方案。

SourceComputerId.description: Name-derived identifier for the source computer that produced the heartbeat; documentation lacks an official column description. Use as a stable-looking host key, but inspect context before asserting uniqueness.
SourceComputerId.description_zh: 根据名称推断是产生心跳的源计算机标识符；文档缺少官方列说明。可作为看似稳定的主机键使用，但断言唯一性前请检查上下文。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent that collected the heartbeat, such as OpsManager for Windows agents, Linux for Linux agents, or Azure for Azure Diagnostics. Use to scope ingestion paths.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集心跳的代理类型，例如 Windows 代理的 OpsManager、Linux 代理的 Linux，或 Azure Diagnostics 的 Azure。用于限定数据接入路径。

SubscriptionId.description: Identifier of the Azure subscription owning the resource whose agent emitted this heartbeat. Use to scope liveness and agent-version checks to a subscription, not as a user or directory tenant identifier.
SubscriptionId.description_zh: 拥有发出此心跳的资源的 Azure 订阅标识符。用于将存活状态和代理版本检查限定到某个订阅，它并非用户或目录租户标识符。

TenantId.description: Per official documentation this is the workspace ID associated with the record, not an Azure AD directory tenant ID. Use for workspace scoping; if investigating directory identity, rely on identity tables instead.
TenantId.description_zh: 根据官方文档，这是与该记录关联的工作区 ID，而非 Azure AD 目录租户 ID。用于工作区范围限定；若调查目录身份，应依赖身份相关的表。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when the heartbeat record was created, marking the minute the agent reported in. Use to measure last-seen time, reporting gaps, and agent silence per computer; it is not a security event time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 心跳记录创建时的时间戳，标记代理上报的分钟。用于衡量每台计算机的最后可见时间、上报缺口和代理静默；它不是安全事件时间。

Type.description: Table name value, here Heartbeat, identifying the record's origin. Use in unions or filters to distinguish agent health rows from other Log Analytics tables when correlating across the workspace.
Type.description_zh: 表名值，此处为 Heartbeat，标识记录来源。在联合查询或过滤中使用，以在工作区关联分析时把代理健康行与其他 Log Analytics 表区分开。

VMUUID.description: Unique identifier of the virtual machine associated with this heartbeat, useful for tracking a VM across hostname or IP changes. Not guaranteed populated for non-VM sources and not an agent or user ID.
VMUUID.description_zh: 与此心跳关联的虚拟机的唯一标识符，可用于在主机名或 IP 变化时跟踪该 VM。对于非 VM 来源不保证有值，也不是代理或用户 ID。

Version.description: Version of the Log Analytics agent reporting this heartbeat. Use to find outdated or inconsistent agents across computers during health checks or remediation planning; it is not an OS version.
Version.description_zh: 上报此心跳的 Log Analytics 代理版本。用于在健康检查或修复规划中查找各计算机上过时或不一致的代理；它不是操作系统版本。

_ResourceId.description: Unique Azure resource identifier for the resource associated with this heartbeat record. Use to pivot to the resource or join with Azure resource logs; may be empty for non-Azure-connected sources.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与此心跳记录关联的资源的唯一 Azure 资源标识符。用于关联到该资源或与 Azure 资源日志连接；对于非 Azure 连接的来源可能为空。

IdentityDirectoryEvents.description: IdentityDirectoryEvents records identity- and directory-related activity such as password changes or expirations and user principal name changes, sourced from identity directory telemetry into Log Analytics. Each row is one reported identity event with an Account (actor) and optional TargetAccount/TargetDevice objects. Use it to answer who changed an identity object, when, from which application, protocol, IP, port, or location. Pivots: AccountUpn/AccountObjectId/AccountSid to the actor identity, TargetAccountUpn for the affected identity, DeviceName/TargetDeviceName for endpoints. Boundary: it holds identity directory events, not general device process, network connection, or logon tables.
IdentityDirectoryEvents.description_zh: IdentityDirectoryEvents 记录身份与目录相关活动，例如密码更改或过期以及用户主体名称变更，来自身份目录遥测并写入 Log Analytics。每行表示一个上报的身份事件，包含 Account（操作者）以及可选的 TargetAccount/TargetDevice 对象。可用它回答：谁在何时、通过哪个应用、协议、IP、端口或位置更改了某个身份对象。可用关联：AccountUpn/AccountObjectId/AccountSid 关联操作者身份，TargetAccountUpn 关联受影响身份，DeviceName/TargetDeviceName 关联端点。边界：它承载身份目录事件，而不是通用设备进程、网络连接或登录表。

AccountDisplayName.description: Display or address-book name of the account initiating the recorded identity directory action. Use with AccountUpn or AccountObjectId to resolve the actor identity when only a friendly name is known; inspect source context for uniqueness.
AccountDisplayName.description_zh: 发起所记录身份目录操作账户的显示名或通讯簿名称。当仅知友好名称时，可与 AccountUpn 或 AccountObjectId 一起解析操作者身份；其唯一性需结合来源上下文判断。

AccountDomain.description: Domain portion of the account that initiated the recorded identity directory action. Use to distinguish same-named accounts across domains and to scope actor lookups by directory or domain.
AccountDomain.description_zh: 发起所记录身份目录操作账户的域部分。用于区分不同域中同名账户，并按目录或域限定操作者查询范围。

AccountName.description: User name of the account that initiated the recorded identity directory action. Use to pivot to activity by the acting identity, paired with AccountDomain or AccountUpn for disambiguation.
AccountName.description_zh: 发起所记录身份目录操作账户的用户名。用于按操作身份关联活动，并与 AccountDomain 或 AccountUpn 配合消除歧义。

AccountObjectId.description: Directory object identifier for the account that initiated the recorded identity directory action. Use as a stable pivot when correlating the actor identity across events, instead of relying on display names.
AccountObjectId.description_zh: 发起所记录身份目录操作账户的目录对象标识符。用于跨事件关联操作者身份时作为稳定关联键，而不是依赖显示名。

AccountSid.description: Security identifier of the account that initiated the recorded identity directory action. Use to pivot actor activity to Windows security context, especially when correlating directory events with other Windows telemetry.
AccountSid.description_zh: 发起所记录身份目录操作账户的安全标识符。用于将操作者活动关联到 Windows 安全上下文，尤其在与其它 Windows 遥测关联时。

AccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that initiated the recorded identity directory action. Use as the primary actor identity pivot for identity directory events and to link actor activity to sign-in or directory data.
AccountUpn.description_zh: 发起所记录身份目录操作账户的用户主体名称。作为身份目录事件中操作者身份的主要关联键，并将操作者活动链接到登录或目录数据。

ActionType.description: Type of identity directory activity that triggered the event, such as a password or UPN change. Use to filter and categorize events before pivoting to actor, target, device, or location.
ActionType.description_zh: 触发该事件的身份目录活动类型，例如密码或 UPN 更改。用于在关联操作者、目标、设备或位置之前筛选并归类事件。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag holding extra event or entity attributes not exposed as top-level columns. Name-derived: inspect its contents and resource/category context rather than assuming specific keys, units, or guaranteed fields before projecting values.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 动态包，保存未作为顶级列公开的额外事件或实体属性。基于名称推断：查看其内容及资源/类别上下文，不要假定具体键、单位或保证存在的字段，再投影取值。

Application.description: Application associated with the recorded identity directory action. Use to identify which application performed or mediated the change, and to separate administrative or automated activity from other sources.
Application.description_zh: 与所记录身份目录操作关联的应用程序。用于识别执行或中介该变更的应用，并区分管理或自动化活动与其他来源。

DestinationDeviceName.description: Name of the destination device acting as the server for the recorded identity directory action. Use when a named server is involved, and treat as target-side context rather than the actor endpoint.
DestinationDeviceName.description_zh: 在所记录身份目录操作中作为服务端的目标设备名称。当涉及具名服务器时使用；应视为目标侧上下文，而非操作者端点。

DestinationIPAddress.description: IP address of the destination device that processed the recorded identity directory action. Use for target-side network pivots and enrichment; scope by time because address assignment can change.
DestinationIPAddress.description_zh: 处理所记录身份目录操作的目标设备 IP 地址。用于目标侧网络关联与富化；由于地址分配会变化，应按时间限定范围。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port of network communication related to the recorded identity directory action. Use with the destination IP and protocol to characterize the target service endpoint.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 与所记录身份目录操作相关的网络通信目标端口。与目标 IP 和协议一起用于刻画目标服务端点。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device associated with the recorded identity directory action. Use to scope activity to an endpoint, and distinguish it from TargetDeviceName when both appear.
DeviceName.description_zh: 与所记录身份目录操作关联设备的完全限定域名。用于将活动限定到某个端点，并在同时出现时与 TargetDeviceName 区分。

IPAddress.description: IP address assigned to the endpoint during related network communications for the recorded identity directory action. Use to pivot to network or sign-in activity, scoped by time because addresses change.
IPAddress.description_zh: 所记录身份目录操作相关网络通信中分配给端点的 IP 地址。用于关联网络或登录活动；由于地址会变化，应按时间限定范围。

ISP.description: Internet service provider associated with the endpoint IP address for the recorded identity directory action. Use as enrichment when assessing whether activity originates from an expected network provider.
ISP.description_zh: 与所记录身份目录操作的端点 IP 地址关联的互联网服务提供商。用于在评估活动是否来自预期网络提供商时进行富化。

Location.description: Geographic location, such as city or country, associated with the recorded identity directory action. Use to compare where the actor or target activity occurred against expected user locations.
Location.description_zh: 与所记录身份目录操作关联的地理位置，例如城市或国家。用于将操作者或目标活动的发生地点与预期用户位置进行比较。

Port.description: TCP port used during communication associated with the recorded identity directory action. Use with IPAddress and Protocol to characterize the source-side connection.
Port.description_zh: 与所记录身份目录操作相关通信使用的 TCP 端口。与 IPAddress 和 Protocol 一起用于刻画源侧连接。

Protocol.description: Protocol used during communication associated with the recorded identity directory action. Use to identify the transport or application protocol and to filter events by expected protocol for the environment.
Protocol.description_zh: 与所记录身份目录操作相关通信所使用的协议。用于识别传输或应用协议，并按环境预期协议筛选事件。

ReportId.description: Unique identifier for the reported identity directory event. Use to correlate or deduplicate repeated references to the same event; per official documentation it is unique for the event, not an account or device.
ReportId.description_zh: 所报告身份目录事件的唯一标识符。用于关联或去重对同一事件的重复引用；按官方文档它对事件唯一，而非对账户或设备。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent or collection source that provided the event, for example OpsManager, Linux, or Azure. Use for provenance and filtering, and to understand collection-path differences affecting field population.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 提供该事件的代理或收集来源类型，例如 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure。用于溯源和筛选，并理解影响字段填充情况的收集路径差异。

TargetAccountDisplayName.description: Display name of the account that the recorded identity directory action was applied to. Use to identify the affected identity alongside TargetAccountUpn, and avoid confusing it with the acting Account fields.
TargetAccountDisplayName.description_zh: 所记录身份目录操作所应用到的账户显示名。用于结合 TargetAccountUpn 识别受影响身份，避免与操作者 Account 字段混淆。

TargetAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account the recorded identity directory action was applied to. Use to pivot to the affected identity and to separate it from the initiating account in the same event.
TargetAccountUpn.description_zh: 所记录身份目录操作所应用到账户的用户主体名称。用于关联受影响身份，并在同一事件中与发起账户区分开。

TargetDeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device the recorded identity directory action was applied to. Use for target-side device pivots, distinct from DeviceName which describes the associated endpoint context.
TargetDeviceName.description_zh: 所记录身份目录操作所应用到设备的完全限定域名。用于目标侧设备关联，区别于描述关联端点上下文的 DeviceName。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with the event, per official documentation. Use for workspace scoping in queries; do not treat it as a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 按官方文档，为与该事件关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。用于查询中的工作区范围限定；不要将其视为目录租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC datetime the directory event record was generated by the reporting pipeline, used to order and correlate identity changes; compare with Timestamp to check collection lag.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 上报管道生成该目录事件记录的 UTC 时间，用于排序和关联身份变更；可与 Timestamp 对比以检查采集延迟。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table supplying the row, used to scope queries when combining this directory event data with other tables in the same workspace.
Type.description_zh: 提供该行的表名，用于在同一工作区中与其他表联合查询时限定本目录事件数据的范围。

IdentityLogonEvents.description: IdentityLogonEvents holds authentication activity records collected from on-premises Active Directory and related identity sources, one row per logon, logon attempt, or authentication action event. Use it to answer who authenticated where, from which IP or device, with what protocol and logon type, and which attempts failed. Pivots include account identifiers (AccountName, AccountUpn, AccountSid), source IPAddress/Port, DeviceName, ActionType, LogonType, and FailureReason. It differs from device inventory and network connection tables because each row is a logon event, not a device or a session connection.
IdentityLogonEvents.description_zh: IdentityLogonEvents 保存来自本地 Active Directory 及相关身份源的认证活动记录，每行对应一次登录、登录尝试或认证操作事件。可用于回答谁在哪里、从哪个 IP 或设备、使用何种协议和登录类型完成认证，以及哪些尝试失败。可用透视包括账户标识（AccountName、AccountUpn、AccountSid）、源 IPAddress/Port、DeviceName、ActionType、LogonType 和 FailureReason。它与设备清单和网络连接表的区别在于：每行是登录事件，而不是设备或会话连接。

AccountDisplayName.description: Display name of the account involved in this logon event, useful for human-readable triage and entity mapping, but not for reliable identity joins because display names may not be unique.
AccountDisplayName.description_zh: 此登录事件中账户的显示名称，便于人工研判和实体映射；但显示名可能不唯一，不能作为可靠的账户关联键。

AccountDomain.description: Domain or directory domain of the account that performed or attempted this logon. Use it to scope identity queries, remembering it names an account namespace, not the Microsoft Entra tenant.
AccountDomain.description_zh: 执行或尝试本次登录的账户所属域或目录域。可用于限定身份查询范围；它表示账户命名空间，并非 Microsoft Entra 租户。

AccountName.description: User name of the account in this logon event, typically without domain. Pair with AccountDomain or AccountUpn to identify the account uniquely during investigation.
AccountName.description_zh: 本次登录事件中的账户用户名，通常不含域。调查时应配合 AccountDomain 或 AccountUpn 才能唯一识别账户。

AccountObjectId.description: Unique identifier for the account object associated with this logon event. Use it to correlate the same identity across events when names are ambiguous or change.
AccountObjectId.description_zh: 与本次登录事件关联的账户对象的唯一标识符。当账户名称有歧义或发生变化时，可用它在事件间关联同一身份。

AccountSid.description: Security Identifier of the account in this authentication event. Use it to resolve the Windows identity precisely, especially when the account name alone is ambiguous.
AccountSid.description_zh: 本次认证事件中账户的安全标识符（SID）。用于精确解析 Windows 身份，尤其在仅凭账户名有歧义时。

AccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that performed or attempted this logon. Useful for correlating identity activity across services, but verify it against account identifiers.
AccountUpn.description_zh: 执行或尝试本次登录的账户的用户主体名称（UPN）。可用于跨服务关联身份活动，但应与账户标识符交叉验证。

ActionType.description: The category or kind of identity activity this row records, such as a logon attempt or related authentication action. Inspect distinct values to scope queries before filtering.
ActionType.description_zh: 本行记录的身份活动类别或操作类型，例如登录尝试或相关认证操作。应先查看不同取值再筛选，以正确限定查询范围。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag of extra properties for this logon event that are not covered by the fixed columns. Inspect its keys per event type before relying on any nested value in queries.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 本登录事件中固定列未涵盖的额外属性的动态集合。在查询中依赖任何嵌套值之前，应按事件类型检查其键结构。

Application.description: Application that performed or was associated with the recorded authentication action in this row. Helps separate identity activity by client or service, but not all event types populate it.
Application.description_zh: 执行或与本次记录的认证操作关联的应用程序。有助于按客户端或服务区分身份活动，但并非所有事件类型都会填充此字段。

DestinationDeviceName.description: Name of the server-side or destination device that processed this authentication action. Use it to identify the target system the logon reached, not the initiating client.
DestinationDeviceName.description_zh: 处理本次认证操作的服务端或目标设备名称。可用于识别登录所到达的目标系统，而不是发起方的客户端设备。

DestinationIPAddress.description: IP address of the destination or server-side device for this event. Helps identify where an authentication attempt was directed, complementing the source IPAddress in this table.
DestinationIPAddress.description_zh: 此事件的目标或服务端设备的 IP 地址。可用于识别认证尝试所指向的位置，与本表中的源 IPAddress 互为补充。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port associated with the logged authentication communication. Treat as a string and use it with protocol and destination address to characterize the service targeted.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 所记录的认证通信关联的目标端口。按字符串处理，并结合协议和目标地址刻画所访问的服务。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device associated with this logon event, typically the source or initiating endpoint. Used to scope identity activity to a specific device and time window.
DeviceName.description_zh: 与本次登录事件关联的设备的完全限定域名，通常是源设备或发起端点。用于将身份活动限定到特定设备和时间窗口。

DeviceType.description: Type of device associated with this logon event, for example a category of endpoint. Interpret cautiously as values depend on source, and use only for grouping or filtering.
DeviceType.description_zh: 与本次登录事件关联的设备类型，例如某种端点类别。取值取决于数据源，应谨慎解释，仅用于分组或筛选。

FailureReason.description: Explanation of why the recorded authentication action failed, when applicable. Use it to distinguish invalid credentials, policy blocks, or other causes in failed logon investigations.
FailureReason.description_zh: 所记录的认证操作失败时的原因说明（如适用）。在调查失败登录时用于区分凭据错误、策略阻止或其他原因。

IPAddress.description: IP address assigned to the endpoint associated with this logon event, usually the source of the attempt. Use it with time bounds to group activity by network origin.
IPAddress.description_zh: 与本次登录事件关联的端点 IP 地址，通常是尝试的源地址。应结合时间边界，按网络来源对活动进行分组分析。

ISP.description: Internet service provider associated with the IP address in this event, useful as network context for an authentication source. It is contextual enrichment and does not by itself indicate maliciousness.
ISP.description_zh: 与本事件中 IP 地址关联的互联网服务提供商，可作为认证来源的网络背景信息。它只是上下文补充，本身并不表示恶意。

Location.description: Geographic location, such as city or country, associated with this event's network origin. Use for anomaly triage only, since geolocation is approximate and not proof of physical presence.
Location.description_zh: 与本事件网络来源关联的地理位置，如城市或国家。仅用于异常研判；地理位置为近似值，不能证明实际所在地。

LogonType.description: Type of logon session recorded for this authentication event, distinguishing interactive, network, service, or similar logon categories. Useful for scoping suspicious remote versus local logons.
LogonType.description_zh: 本次认证事件所记录的登录会话类型，用于区分交互式、网络、服务等登录类别。有助于区分可疑的远程登录与本地登录。

OSPlatform.description: Operating system platform of the machine associated with this logon event. Treat as descriptive context for the endpoint and not as a device inventory field.
OSPlatform.description_zh: 与本次登录事件关联的机器的操作系统平台。应视为端点的描述性上下文，而不是设备清单字段。

Port.description: TCP port used during communication for this authentication event, typically the source port. Treat as a string and combine with IPAddress to characterize client-side connectivity.
Port.description_zh: 本次认证事件通信中使用的 TCP 端口，通常是源端口。按字符串处理，并结合 IPAddress 刻画客户端侧连接特征。

Protocol.description: Network protocol used for this authentication communication, such as a specific logon protocol. Use it to separate authentication mechanisms and to scope queries to relevant logon paths.
Protocol.description_zh: 本次认证通信使用的网络协议，例如某种登录协议。用于区分认证机制，并将查询限定到相关登录路径。

ReportId.description: Identifier associated with this event record or report. Use it for retrieving or correlating the specific record, but do not assume it uniquely identifies a logon session across sources.
ReportId.description_zh: 与本事件记录或报告关联的标识符。可用于检索或关联特定记录，但不要假设它能跨数据源唯一标识一次登录会话。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that produced this event row, such as a Windows agent or Azure Diagnostics. Use it to understand provenance and filter before cross-table correlation.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成本事件行的代理或采集通道，例如 Windows 代理或 Azure 诊断。用于理解数据来源，并在跨表关联前进行筛选。

TargetAccountDisplayName.description: Display name of the account the recorded logon action was applied to in this row. Use to link the action to the targeted identity and to investigate which account an attempt or access concerned.
TargetAccountDisplayName.description_zh: 本行记录的登录操作所作用账户的显示名称。用于将操作关联到目标身份，调查某次尝试或访问涉及哪个账户。
