TargetDeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device the recorded action was applied to. Use to identify the accessed target device and pivot between initiating and target devices during investigation.
TargetDeviceName.description_zh: 本行记录的操作所作用设备的完全限定域名。用于识别被访问的目标设备，并在调查中在发起设备与目标设备之间转换视角。

TenantId.description: The Log Analytics workspace ID for this record. Use to scope queries to the correct workspace; it is not the directory tenant ID and does not identify the AD domain.
TenantId.description_zh: 该记录的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。用于将查询限定到正确的工作区；它不是目录租户 ID，也不标识 AD 域。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time the record was generated in the workspace. Use as the primary time filter for logon activity windows and to correlate attempts with surrounding events.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 记录在工作区中生成的 UTC 日期和时间。用作登录活动时间窗口的主要过滤条件，并与前后事件进行关联。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: The name of the table for this record, used to distinguish this logon event source from other tables in the same workspace when querying across tables.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属的表名称，用于在同一工作区跨表查询时区分此登录事件来源与其他表。

IdentityQueryEvents.description: Directory-service query telemetry from Microsoft Defender for Identity, one row per query a tracked account or device issues against Active Directory objects such as users, groups, devices or domains. Use it to profile enumeration and reconnaissance (who queried what, from which device/IP, over which protocol), pivot on Account*, QueryTarget, DeviceName and IPAddress, and correlate with identity logons or device inventory. It records directory queries, not authentication or endpoint process execution; treat target fields as the queried object, not a compromised asset.
IdentityQueryEvents.description_zh: 该表来自 Microsoft Defender for Identity，记录对 Active Directory 对象（如用户、组、设备、域）执行的目录查询，每行一次查询事件。可用于分析账户或设备发起的枚举与侦察行为：谁查询了什么、来自哪台设备/IP、使用何种协议，并可围绕 Account*、QueryTarget、DeviceName、IPAddress 等字段下钻，与身份登录日志或设备清单关联。它记录的是目录查询，而非身份验证或终端进程执行；目标字段表示被查询对象，并不代表该对象已被入侵。

AccountDisplayName.description: Display name of the account that performed the directory query in this event; helps attribute enumeration activity to a person when AccountName or AccountUpn are ambiguous.
AccountDisplayName.description_zh: 在本事件中执行目录查询的账户显示名；当 AccountName 或 AccountUpn 不明确时，可用于将枚举行为归属到具体人员。

AccountDomain.description: Domain of the account that issued the query, useful for separating on-premises or federated identities from cloud-only ones during enumeration investigations.
AccountDomain.description_zh: 发起查询账户所属的域，在调查枚举行为时可用于区分本地/联合身份与仅云端身份。

AccountName.description: User name of the account performing the query in this event; the primary actor identifier for grouping directory enumeration or reconnaissance activity by account.
AccountName.description_zh: 本事件中执行查询的账户用户名；是主要的操作者标识，用于按账户汇总目录枚举或侦察活动。

AccountObjectId.description: Unique identifier for the querying account in Azure AD (per official description); correlates this query row with identity records when names are reused or renamed.
AccountObjectId.description_zh: 按官方说明为发起查询账户在 Azure AD 中的唯一标识；当账户名重复或变更时，可用它将此查询行与其他身份记录关联。

AccountSid.description: Security Identifier of the account that performed the query; stable across renames, so it helps trace the same on-premises identity across multiple directory query events.
AccountSid.description_zh: 执行查询账户的安全标识符（SID）；在账户改名后仍保持稳定，有助于在多个目录查询事件中追踪同一本地身份。

AccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that issued the query; convenient pivot for joining this query event with sign-in, mailbox or identity-related tables.
AccountUpn.description_zh: 发起查询账户的用户主体名称（UPN）；便于将此查询事件与登录、邮箱或身份相关表进行关联。

ActionType.description: Type of activity that triggered this directory query event; use it to filter or group query records by action category when triaging identity reconnaissance.
ActionType.description_zh: 触发此目录查询事件的活动类型；在排查身份侦察行为时，可用于按操作类别筛选或分组查询记录。

AdditionalFields.description: Dynamic bag of extra entity or event properties for this query row; inspect it for provider-specific details not promoted to top-level columns, and treat contents as name-derived until parsed.
AdditionalFields.description_zh: 此查询行的动态附加实体或事件属性集合；可检查其中未提升为顶层列的提供商特有详情，其内容需按名称推断，解析前不宜断言语义。

Application.description: Application that performed the recorded directory query action; helps distinguish queries from a directory tool or service versus queries attributable to a user session.
Application.description_zh: 执行所记录目录查询操作的应用；有助于区分来自目录工具或服务的查询与来自用户会话的查询。

DestinationDeviceName.description: Name of the device running the server-side application that processed this query; indicates which directory or responder host handled the request for service-side pivoting.
DestinationDeviceName.description_zh: 处理此查询的服务端应用所在设备名称；表明由哪台目录或响应主机处理该请求，便于从服务端视角下钻。

DestinationIPAddress.description: IP address of the device running the server-side application that processed this query; use to identify the responding directory host behind a client's enumeration.
DestinationIPAddress.description_zh: 处理此查询的服务端应用所在设备的 IP 地址；用于识别客户端枚举行为背后的响应目录主机。

DestinationPort.description: Destination port involved in network communications related to this query; helps characterize the service endpoint contacted during the directory query.
DestinationPort.description_zh: 与此查询相关的网络通信目标端口；有助于刻画目录查询期间所联系的服务端点。

DeviceName.description: Fully qualified domain name of the device associated with this query event; identifies the endpoint or host from which the directory query originated.
DeviceName.description_zh: 与此查询事件关联的设备的完全限定域名（FQDN）；用于识别发起该目录查询的终端或主机。

IPAddress.description: IP address assigned to the endpoint and used during the query-related network communication; helps attribute directory queries to a source host or network location.
IPAddress.description_zh: 分配给终端并在查询相关网络通信中使用的 IP 地址；有助于将目录查询归属到源主机或网络位置。

Location.description: City, country, or other geographic location associated with this query event; useful for spotting enumeration from unusual locations relative to normal account activity.
Location.description_zh: 与此查询事件关联的城市、国家或其他地理位置；有助于发现相对账户正常活动而言异常的来源地枚举。

Port.description: TCP port used during communication related to this query event; a connection detail for characterizing how the directory query was transmitted.
Port.description_zh: 与此查询事件相关的通信中所用 TCP 端口；用于刻画该目录查询的传输方式的连接细节。

Protocol.description: Protocol used during the communication for this query; distinguishes directory access methods when profiling how enumeration was performed against Active Directory.
Protocol.description_zh: 此查询通信所使用的协议；在分析对 Active Directory 执行枚举的方式时，可用于区分不同的目录访问方法。

Query.description: String used to run the query; the literal directory request text, valuable for understanding exactly what objects or attributes the actor attempted to enumerate.
Query.description_zh: 用于运行查询的字符串；即目录请求的字面内容，有助于了解操作者究竟尝试枚举哪些对象或属性。

QueryTarget.description: Name of the user, group, device, domain, or other entity type being queried; identifies the directory object a given query event targeted, not the compromised asset.
QueryTarget.description_zh: 被查询的用户、组、设备、域或其他实体类型的名称；标识该查询事件针对的目录对象，而非被入侵资产。

QueryType.description: Category of query such as QueryGroup, QueryUser, or EnumerateUsers (per official description); classification key for detecting bulk or targeted directory enumeration patterns.
QueryType.description_zh: 查询类别，如 QueryGroup、QueryUser 或 EnumerateUsers（依官方说明）；是识别批量或定向目录枚举模式的关键分类字段。

ReportId.description: Unique identifier for this event row; use it to reference or de-duplicate individual query records when correlating with other Defender for Identity telemetry.
ReportId.description_zh: 此事件行的唯一标识符；在与其他 Defender for Identity 遥测关联时，用于引用或去重单条查询记录。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent that collected the event, e.g., OpsManager for Windows agent, Linux, or Azure (per official description); note this table is Defender for Identity data, so verify scoping.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集该事件的代理类型，如 Windows 代理的 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure（依官方说明）；注意本表为 Defender for Identity 数据，使用前应确认其作用域。

TargetAccountDisplayName.description: Display name of the account that the recorded query action was applied to; the queried account's human-readable label, useful when QueryTarget is an account object.
TargetAccountDisplayName.description_zh: 所记录查询操作作用到的账户显示名；即被查询账户的可读标签，适用于 QueryTarget 为账户对象的情形。

TargetAccountUpn.description: User principal name of the account that the recorded query action was applied to; pivot for enriching a queried identity with sign-in or identity context.
TargetAccountUpn.description_zh: 所记录查询操作作用到的账户的用户主体名称（UPN）；可用于为被查询身份补充登录或身份上下文。

TargetDeviceName.description: Device name or FQDN that the query action targeted in this table; compare with DeviceName (initiating device) and DestinationDeviceName when tracing which endpoint was queried.
TargetDeviceName.description_zh: 此表中被查询操作所针对的设备名称或 FQDN；与 DeviceName（发起设备）和 DestinationDeviceName 对比，可追踪被查询的终端。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record; as documented, it is not a directory tenant ID. Use it to scope the workspace when queries span multiple tenants or workspaces.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；按文档说明并非目录租户 ID。用于在跨租户或跨工作区查询时限定工作区范围。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when the record was generated; primary time axis for ordering and correlating identity query activity with other events from the same account or device.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 生成该记录的 UTC 日期和时间；是排序并将身份查询活动与同一账户或设备的其他事件关联的主要时间轴。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: Name of the table, typically 'IdentityQueryEvents'; use it to scope queries when combining this dataset with other identity or security tables in the same workspace.
Type.description_zh: 表名，通常为 'IdentityQueryEvents'；在同一工作区中与其他身份或安全表联合查询时，用它来限定数据集。

IntuneAuditLogs.description: Intune audit records capturing administrative and service actions in the Intune device-management plane, exported into the workspace. Each row is one audited operation (policy, app, device, role, or tenant change) reported at the time it occurred, with the acting identity, operation name, and result. Use it to answer who changed what in Intune, when, and whether the operation succeeded. Pivot on Identity, OperationName, Category, ResultType, CorrelationId for timelines. Boundary: this is Intune control-plane auditing, not device-level telemetry such as device inventory, network connections, or logon events; those belong to other tables.
IntuneAuditLogs.description_zh: Intune 审核日志记录 Intune 设备管理平面中的管理性和服务性操作，并导出到工作区。每一行代表一次被审核的操作（策略、应用、设备、角色或租户变更），记录操作发生时间、执行身份、操作名称与结果。可用于回答谁在 Intune 中做了哪些更改、何时发生、是否成功。调查时可按 Identity、OperationName、Category、ResultType、CorrelationId 进行时间线与关联分析。边界：本表属于 Intune 控制平面审核，而非设备侧遥测（如设备清单、网络连接或登录事件），后者属于其他表。

Category.description: Category of the audited Intune operation as reported by the service, useful for filtering audit activity by functional area before pivoting on OperationName and Identity; treat exact values as service-defined.
Category.description_zh: 服务上报的 Intune 被审核操作类别，可用于先按功能领域筛选审核活动，再结合 OperationName 与 Identity 深入分析；具体取值以服务定义为准。

CorrelationId.description: Correlation identifier linking related Intune audit operations within a single workflow; use it to group multi-step actions by an identity or service and reconstruct the sequence of a change.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 关联标识符，用于串联同一次工作流内相关的 Intune 审核操作；可按身份或服务对多步操作分组，重建一次变更的执行顺序。

Identity.description: Identity credited with the audited Intune operation, typically the admin or service principal initiating a change; use it to attribute actions, but verify account scope since display strings may vary.
Identity.description_zh: 被记录为执行该 Intune 操作的标识（通常是发起变更的管理员或服务主体）；可用于归因操作，但显示字符串可能不一致，需核实账号范围。

OperationName.description: Name of the Intune operation that was performed, such as a policy, app, device, or role action; use it to filter for specific change types and build activity timelines per identity.
OperationName.description_zh: 已执行的 Intune 操作名称，如策略、应用、设备或角色操作；可用于筛选特定变更类型，并按身份构建活动时间线。

Properties.description: Structured string carrying operation-specific details for the audit record; inspect it selectively to understand what changed, treating its internal schema as name-derived and not guaranteed across operations.
Properties.description_zh: 承载该审核记录操作专属细节的结构化字符串；可有选择地查看以了解变更内容，其内部结构属于依据名称推断，且不同操作间不保证一致。

ResultDescription.description: Human-readable description of the operation outcome or failure reason for this Intune audit record; use it to explain why an action succeeded or failed when triaging admin changes.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 该 Intune 审核记录操作结果的文本说明或失败原因；在排查管理员变更时可用于解释操作成功或失败的原因。

ResultType.description: Outcome status of the audited Intune operation (for example success or failure); use it to separate completed changes from denied or failed attempts before analyzing identity behavior.
ResultType.description_zh: 被审核 Intune 操作的结果状态（例如成功或失败）；可在分析身份行为前，将有完成的变更与被拒绝或失败的尝试区分开。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent or collection source that produced the event, per the documented example values; use it to confirm the record arrived via the expected pipeline rather than as evidence about the operation itself.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 产生该事件的代理或采集源类型（参见文档示例值）；可用于确认记录经由预期管道进入，而不应把它当作操作本身证据。

TenantId.description: Workspace identifier associated with this exported Intune audit record; use it to scope queries across workspaces, and do not interpret it as an Entra directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该导出的 Intune 审核记录关联的工作区标识符；可用于跨工作区限定查询范围，不应将其解释为 Entra 目录租户标识。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when the audited Intune operation was reported; use it to order events, correlate with identity activity, and constrain investigations to a relevant window.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 被审核 Intune 操作被上报的时间戳；可用于排序事件、关联身份活动，并将调查限定在相关时间窗口内。

Type.description: Name of the table that stores this record; use it to scope queries to the Intune audit table when building cross-table hunting queries.
Type.description_zh: 存储该记录的表名称；在构建跨表狩猎查询时，可用于将查询范围限定到 Intune 审核表。

IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg.description: Microsoft Intune device compliance reports with compliance state, device health threat level, ownership, operating system, user and last-contact information. Use it to identify noncompliant devices and examine their reported posture around an investigation time, scoped by tenant, device and BatchId. This is reported device state rather than behavioral evidence; IntuneDevices offers broader inventory, and IntuneAuditLogs records management changes.
IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Intune 设备合规报告，包含合规状态、设备健康威胁等级、所有权、操作系统、用户及最近联系时间。用于筛选不合规设备并查看调查时间附近上报的安全状态，需按租户、设备和 BatchId 限定范围。本表属于设备状态报告，不是行为证据；更完整的设备清单查 IntuneDevices，管理变更查 IntuneAuditLogs。

AADTenantId.description: Identifier of the Microsoft Entra tenant associated with the Intune account, name-derived since no official description exists. Use it to confirm which directory tenant a device report belongs to, distinct from TenantId (workspace ID).
AADTenantId.description_zh: 与 Intune 账户关联的 Microsoft Entra 租户标识符，因无官方描述而依据字段名推断。用于确认设备报告所属的目录租户，区别于 TenantId（工作区 ID）。

BatchId.description: Identifier grouping this compliance report with others generated in the same batch or reporting run, name-derived. Use to correlate devices reported together in one collection cycle.
BatchId.description_zh: 将本合规报告与同批次或同次报告运行中生成的其他报告归组的标识符，依据字段名推断。用于关联同一次采集周期内一并上报的设备。

ComplianceState.description: Compliance posture of this managed device at report time, such as compliant or noncompliant. Use it to isolate risky devices and pivot to owner, OS and last contact for remediation prioritization.
ComplianceState.description_zh: 报告时该受管设备的合规状态，如合规或不合规。用于筛出高风险设备，并透视其所有者、操作系统和最近联系时间以确定修复优先级。

DeviceHealthThreatLevel.description: Threat level reported by device health attestation for this device. Elevated values are risk evidence only, not proof of compromise, so corroborate with other endpoint telemetry before concluding.
DeviceHealthThreatLevel.description_zh: 该设备健康证明上报的威胁级别。升高值仅为风险证据，并非已遭入侵的证明，因此下结论前应结合其他端点遥测进行佐证。

DeviceId.description: Device identifier associated with this Intune compliance report. Correlate with matching Intune inventory identifiers, and verify cross-service identifier mappings before joining Defender or directory device records.
DeviceId.description_zh: 该 Intune 合规报告关联的设备标识。可与相同命名空间的 Intune 清单标识关联；连接 Defender 或目录设备记录前，应验证跨服务标识映射。

DeviceName.description: Display name of the managed device in this compliance report. Useful for analyst-facing identification and searching; names may repeat, so pair with DeviceId for certainty.
DeviceName.description_zh: 本合规报告中受管设备的显示名称。便于分析人员识别和搜索；名称可能重复，因此应结合 DeviceId 以确保准确。

DeviceType.description: Category of the managed device, such as phone, tablet or desktop, as recorded in this report. Use it to segment compliance results by device class.
DeviceType.description_zh: 本报告中记录的受管设备类别，如手机、平板或台式机。用于按设备类别细分合规结果。

IMEI.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity of the device, typically present for mobile hardware. Use for physical device identification and carrier or theft investigations; not available for all device types.
IMEI.description_zh: 设备的国际移动设备识别码，通常存在于移动硬件上。用于物理设备识别及运营商或失窃调查；并非所有设备类型都有此值。

InGracePeriodUntil.description: End of the compliance grace period granted to this device, after which noncompliance may trigger enforcement. Use to distinguish devices still within grace from those past it.
InGracePeriodUntil.description_zh: 授予该设备的合规宽限期结束时间，超过后不合规可能触发强制措施。用于区分仍在宽限期内和已超期的设备。

IntuneAccountId.description: Identifier of the Intune account or enrollment this device report belongs to, name-derived. Use to scope results to a specific Intune tenant configuration or account context.
IntuneAccountId.description_zh: 该设备报告所属的 Intune 账户或注册标识符，依据字段名推断。用于将结果限定到特定 Intune 租户配置或账户上下文。

LastContact.description: Time the device last checked in with the service as recorded in this report. Use to find stale or inactive devices and to gauge how current a compliance state is.
LastContact.description_zh: 本报告中记录的设备最后一次与服务签入的时间。用于发现长期未活动或失联的设备，并判断合规状态的时效性。

ManagementAgents.description: Management agent or agents managing this device, name-derived. Use to understand which MDM or agent stack reported the compliance data; interpret with device and category context.
ManagementAgents.description_zh: 管理该设备的代理信息，依据字段名推断。用于了解哪一 MDM 或代理栈上报了合规数据；应结合设备和类别上下文解读。

OS.description: Operating system platform of the device in this report. Use to group compliance and threat results by platform when prioritizing patching or policy changes.
OS.description_zh: 本报告中的设备操作系统平台。用于在确定补丁或策略变更优先级时按平台归组合规与威胁结果。

OSDescription.description: Descriptive form of the device operating system, complementing the OS column. Use when the abbreviated platform value is insufficient for reporting or triage.
OSDescription.description_zh: 设备操作系统的描述性形式，补充 OS 列。当简写平台值不足以支持报告或研判时使用。

OSVersion.description: Version of the device operating system at report time. Use to identify outdated or vulnerable builds among devices and correlate with known vulnerability exposure.
OSVersion.description_zh: 报告时设备操作系统的版本。用于识别设备中过时或存在漏洞的版本，并与已知漏洞暴露情况关联。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation or activity recorded for this row, name-derived since no official description exists. Inspect the row's category and resource context to confirm what it denotes.
OperationName.description_zh: 本行记录的操作或活动名称，因无官方描述而依据字段名推断。应检查该行的类别和资源上下文以确认其含义。

OwnerType.description: Whether the device is corporate or personally owned, as recorded in this report. Use to separate BYOD from company devices when assessing exposure and applying policy.
OwnerType.description_zh: 本报告中记录的设备是公司所有还是个人所有。用于在评估暴露风险和适用策略时区分 BYOD 与公司设备。

Result.description: Outcome of the operation reported for this row, complementing OperationName. Use to filter successful versus failed compliance-related operations.
Result.description_zh: 本行所报操作的结果，与 OperationName 互补。用于筛选成功与失败的合规相关操作。

RetireAfterDatetime.description: Time after which the device is scheduled for retirement or removal, name-derived from this report. Use to anticipate devices leaving management and adjust coverage expectations.
RetireAfterDatetime.description_zh: 设备计划退役或移除的时间，依据本报告字段名推断。用于预判设备将脱离管理并调整覆盖预期。

SerialNumber.description: Hardware serial number of the device in this report. Use for physical asset identification and correlation with inventory or asset management records.
SerialNumber.description_zh: 本报告中设备的硬件序列号。用于物理资产识别，并与资产清单或资产管理记录关联。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection source that produced this record, such as Azure for Azure Diagnostics. Use to understand ingestion provenance; per official docs this is generic collector metadata, not an Intune-specific field.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成此记录的代理或采集来源，如 Azure 表示 Azure Diagnostics。用于了解数据摄取来源；官方文档说明这是通用采集器元数据，而非 Intune 专有字段。

Stats.description: Dynamic property bag carrying additional statistics or counters for this report, name-derived since no official description exists. Inspect its contents at query time and treat its shape as unspecified.
Stats.description_zh: 承载本报告额外统计或计数的动态属性包，因无官方描述而依据字段名推断。查询时应检查其内容，并将其结构视为未指定。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier for this record, not a directory tenant ID. Use to scope queries to a workspace; use AADTenantId when the Entra directory tenant is intended.
TenantId.description_zh: 此记录的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符，并非目录租户 ID。用于将查询限定到某工作区；若指 Entra 目录租户，应使用 AADTenantId。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when this compliance report was generated, per official documentation. Use as the primary time filter and for trend analysis of device compliance over time.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 依据官方文档，此合规报告生成的时戳。用作主要时间过滤条件，并用于分析设备合规性随时间的变化趋势。

Type.description: Name of the exported table, typically 'IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg'. Use it to filter this table after a union or workspace-wide search to isolate compliance rows from other Intune diagnostics.
Type.description_zh: 导出表的名称，通常为 'IntuneDeviceComplianceOrg'。在联合查询或整个工作区搜索后可用它筛选本表，将合规记录与其他 Intune 诊断数据区分开。

UPN.description: User principal name of the device owner as reported by Intune in this compliance row. Use alongside UserId/UserEmail to attribute a device's compliance state to a specific user account.
UPN.description_zh: 此合规行中 Intune 报告的设备所有者用户主体名称。可与 UserId/UserEmail 配合，将设备的合规状态归因到具体用户账户。

UserEmail.description: Email address associated with the device owner in this compliance record. Useful for correlating a noncompliant device to a mailbox or contact, though it is not evidence the user took any action.
UserEmail.description_zh: 此合规记录中与设备所有者关联的电子邮件地址。可用于将不合规设备关联到邮箱或联系人，但不代表用户采取了任何操作。

UserId.description: Identifier of the user tied to this device compliance row. Use it to join or group devices per account when correlating with identity, sign-in, or device inventory data.
UserId.description_zh: 与此设备合规行相关联的用户标识符。在关联身份、登录或设备清单数据时，可用它按账户连接或分组设备。

UserName.description: Display name of the user owning the device in this compliance snapshot. Helpful for readable reporting, but names are not unique; confirm identity via UserId or UPN.
UserName.description_zh: 此合规快照中拥有设备的用户显示名。便于生成可读报表，但名称并不唯一；应通过 UserId 或 UPN 确认身份。

_ResourceId.description: Azure resource identifier for the resource associated with this record, typically the Intune/Log Analytics scope exporting the row. Use to scope queries by resource when multiple sources feed the same workspace.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与此记录关联的 Azure 资源标识符，通常是导出该行的 Intune/Log Analytics 范围。当多个来源写入同一工作区时，可用它按资源限定查询。

IntuneDevices.description: IntuneDevices holds exported Microsoft Intune managed-device inventory records, one row per device snapshot, ingested from Intune reporting into Log Analytics. Use it to answer questions about device identity, enrollment and join type, compliance and encryption posture, OS and hardware details, ownership, and last check-in time. Pivots include DeviceId, DeviceName, UPN, ManagedDeviceName, IntuneAccountId and BatchId. It describes device state, not user activity or network traffic; pair with sign-in or process tables for behavioral investigation, and scope results by AADTenantId and batch.
IntuneDevices.description_zh: IntuneDevices 保存从 Microsoft Intune 导出并采集到 Log Analytics 的托管设备清单记录，每行对应一台设备的快照。可用于查询设备身份、注册与加入类型、合规与加密状态、操作系统与硬件信息、所有权及最后签入时间。可用 DeviceId、DeviceName、UPN、ManagedDeviceName、IntuneAccountId 和 BatchId 等字段进行关联。它描述的是设备状态，而不是用户活动或网络流量；行为调查应结合登录或进程表，并按 AADTenantId 和批次限定查询范围。

AADTenantId.description: Identifier of the Microsoft Entra tenant that owns the Intune device record. Use it to scope device inventory to one tenant; distinct from TenantId, which identifies the Log Analytics workspace.
AADTenantId.description_zh: 拥有该 Intune 设备记录的 Microsoft Entra 租户标识。用于将设备清单限定到特定租户；与标识 Log Analytics 工作区的 TenantId 不同。

AndroidPatchLevel.description: Android security patch level reported for an Android device in the Intune inventory. Use to spot devices missing recent patches; only meaningful for Android rows, so verify OS before comparing.
AndroidPatchLevel.description_zh: Intune 清单中 Android 设备报告的安全补丁级别。可用于发现缺少最新补丁的设备；仅对 Android 行有意义，比较前应先确认 OS。

BatchId.description: Identifier for the Intune export report batch that produced the row. Use to group or isolate devices from one inventory ingestion run; not a device identifier and not unique per device.
BatchId.description_zh: 生成该行的 Intune 导出报表批次标识。用于按一次清单采集分组或筛选设备；它不是设备标识，也不保证每台设备唯一。

CategoryName.description: Intune-assigned device category label for the managed device. Use to group inventory by organizational category during triage; categories are administrator-defined, so treat values as environment-specific.
CategoryName.description_zh: 分配给该托管设备的 Intune 设备类别标签。可用于在排查时按组织类别分组清单；类别由管理员定义，因此应将其视为环境特定值。

CompliantState.description: Compliance state recorded for the device in Intune. Use to find noncompliant devices and prioritize remediation; a noncompliant label indicates policy status, not proof of compromise.
CompliantState.description_zh: Intune 记录的该设备合规状态。可用于查找不合规设备并安排修复；不合规标签表示策略状态，并不能证明设备已被攻陷。

CreatedDate.description: Date and time when the device entry was created in Intune. Use to establish enrollment age and spot newly registered devices; stored as string, so normalize before time comparisons.
CreatedDate.description_zh: 该设备条目在 Intune 中创建的日期和时间。可用于判断注册时长并发现新注册设备；字段为字符串，时间比较前需先规范化。

DeviceId.description: Device identifier reported by Intune. Use it to follow records within the same identifier namespace; verify its mapping before joining identically named device fields from Defender or sign-in sources.
DeviceId.description_zh: Intune 上报的设备标识。用于跟踪同一标识命名空间内的记录；与 Defender 或登录来源中的同名设备字段关联前，应先验证标识映射。

DeviceName.description: Display name of the managed device as recorded by Intune. Use for human-readable identification and searching; names can be renamed or reused, so correlate with DeviceId rather than relying on name alone.
DeviceName.description_zh: Intune 记录的托管设备显示名称。用于可读性识别和搜索；名称可能被重命名或重复使用，因此应结合 DeviceId 关联，而不要仅依赖名称。

DeviceRegistrationState.description: Registration state of the device in Intune. Use to distinguish enrolled, pending, or otherwise registered devices when auditing inventory coverage; interpret values within your tenant's Intune enrollment context.
DeviceRegistrationState.description_zh: 设备在 Intune 中的注册状态。可用于在审计清单覆盖范围时区分已注册、待处理或其他注册状态的设备；应结合租户的 Intune 注册环境理解取值。

DeviceState.description: State of the managed device in Intune inventory. Use to filter active versus inactive or retired devices during cleanup and investigation; verify meaning against current Intune documentation for your tenant.
DeviceState.description_zh: 该托管设备在 Intune 清单中的状态。可用于在清理和调查时筛选活跃与不活跃或已退役设备；其具体含义应参照当前 Intune 文档核实。

EasID.description: Exchange ActiveSync identifier associated with the device. Use to tie an Intune device to its EAS partnership when investigating mobile email access; name-derived acronym, so inspect account context before relying on it.
EasID.description_zh: 与该设备关联的 Exchange ActiveSync 标识。调查移动邮件访问时，可用于将 Intune 设备与其 EAS 合作关系关联；该缩写由名称推断，使用前应检查账户上下文。

EncryptionStatusString.description: Text describing whether the device is encrypted. Use to identify unencrypted managed devices as a compliance risk; it reports encryption posture at export time, not whether data was accessed.
EncryptionStatusString.description_zh: 描述设备是否加密的文本。可用于识别未加密的托管设备这一合规风险；它反映导出时的加密状态，并不表示数据是否被访问。

GraphDeviceIsManaged.description: Boolean indicating whether the associated Microsoft Graph device object is managed. Use to reconcile Intune management with directory device records; a true value is management metadata, not evidence of good security posture.
GraphDeviceIsManaged.description_zh: 指示关联的 Microsoft Graph 设备对象是否受管理的布尔值。可用于将 Intune 管理与目录设备记录核对；真值属于管理元数据，并不代表安全状况良好。

IMEI.description: International Mobile Equipment Identity reported for a mobile device. Use to uniquely identify cellular hardware during device investigations; sensitive identifier, and only populated for devices that report it.
IMEI.description_zh: 移动设备报告的移动设备国际身份码。调查设备时可用来唯一标识蜂窝硬件；属于敏感标识，且只有上报该信息的设备才有值。

InGracePeriodUntil.description: Date and time until which the device is in a grace period, stored as string. Use to find devices temporarily exempt from compliance enforcement; indicates policy timing, not a security assurance.
InGracePeriodUntil.description_zh: 设备处于宽限期的截止日期和时间，以字符串存储。可用于查找暂时免于合规强制执行的设备；它表示策略时间安排，并非安全保证。

IntuneAccountId.description: Identifier of the Intune account that owns the device record. Use to separate inventory from different Intune accounts or environments; complements AADTenantId when scoping multi-account data.
IntuneAccountId.description_zh: 拥有该设备记录的 Intune 账户标识。可用于区分不同 Intune 账户或环境的清单；在多账户数据中与 AADTenantId 配合限定范围。

JailBroken.description: Text describing whether the device is jailbroken or rooted. Use to flag devices with weakened platform integrity in compliance reviews; values reflect Intune detection and are not proof of malicious activity.
JailBroken.description_zh: 描述设备是否已越狱或获取 root 权限的文本。合规审查中可用于标记平台完整性被削弱的设备；取值反映 Intune 的检测结果，并不能证明存在恶意活动。

JoinType.description: Enrollment or join type of the device, such as how it was joined to the organization. Use to segment inventory by management model when assessing policy coverage; interpret values within your Intune environment.
JoinType.description_zh: 设备的注册或加入类型，例如其加入组织的方式。评估策略覆盖时可据此划分管理模式的清单；应结合自身 Intune 环境理解取值。

LastContact.description: Date and time the device last checked in with Intune, stored as string. Use to spot stale or missing devices and order recency of check-ins; normalize before comparing because values are textual.
LastContact.description_zh: 设备上次与 Intune 签入的日期和时间，以字符串存储。可用于发现长期未签入或缺失的设备并按签入新旧排序；由于是文本值，比较前需规范化。

MEID.description: Mobile Equipment Identifier reported for a CDMA-capable device. Use as an alternative hardware identifier when IMEI is absent; sensitive identifier, populated only for devices that report it.
MEID.description_zh: 支持 CDMA 的设备报告的移动设备标识。当中没有 IMEI 时可用作硬件替代标识；属于敏感标识，仅在上报该信息的设备上有值。

ManagedBy.description: Authority that manages the device, as recorded by Intune. Use to determine whether a device is under MDM, EAS, or another management channel when assessing control coverage; values are environment-specific.
ManagedBy.description_zh: Intune 记录的设备管理方。评估管控覆盖时可用于判断设备处于 MDM、EAS 还是其他管理通道；取值为环境特定值。

ManagedDeviceName.description: Intune managed-device name, which may differ from the display DeviceName. Use to match records against Intune portal and policy views; treat it as a management label, not a hostname guarantee.
ManagedDeviceName.description_zh: Intune 的托管设备名称，可能与显示的 DeviceName 不同。可用于将记录与 Intune 门户及策略视图匹配；应将其视为管理标签，而非主机名保证。

Manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of the device hardware. Use with Model to profile device fleet composition and identify unexpected hardware in inventory; it describes the physical device, not its owner.
Manufacturer.description_zh: 设备硬件的制造商。可与 Model 一起分析设备群构成并发现清单中异常硬件；它描述物理设备，而非其所有者。

Model.description: Model of the device hardware as reported in Intune inventory. Use with Manufacturer to identify device types and outliers during fleet review; hardware descriptor, not a device identifier.
Model.description_zh: Intune 清单中报告的设备硬件型号。可与 Manufacturer 一起在设备群审查中识别设备类型和异常；属于硬件描述，不是设备标识。

OS.description: Operating system family of the enrolled device in this inventory snapshot (for example Windows, iOS, Android); use with OSVersion when scoping vulnerable or unsupported platforms.
OS.description_zh: 此清单快照中已注册设备所属的操作系统系列（如 Windows、iOS、Android）；与 OSVersion 一起用于筛选存在漏洞或不受支持的平台。

OSVersion.description: Reported operating-system version for the device at export time; use to identify outdated, unpatched, or below-baseline builds during device risk triage.
OSVersion.description_zh: 导出时设备报告的操作系统版本；用于在设备风险排查中识别过时、未修补或低于基线的版本。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation associated with this Intune export row; helps clarify which Intune reporting or export activity produced the device record.
OperationName.description_zh: 与此 Intune 导出行关联的操作名称；有助于判断是哪项 Intune 报告或导出活动生成了该设备记录。

Ownership.description: Whether the device is corporate or personal per Intune; use to separate company-managed assets from BYOD endpoints when scoping investigations and policy gaps.
Ownership.description_zh: 按 Intune 标记设备为公司所有还是个人所有；用于在调查与策略缺口排查中区分公司管理资产与 BYOD 终端。

PhoneNumber.description: Phone number associated with the device or its subscriber in this inventory record; useful for mobile device attribution and contact, not proof of device activity.
PhoneNumber.description_zh: 此清单记录中与设备或其订户关联的电话号码；有助于移动设备归属与联络，但不能证明设备活动。

PrimaryUser.description: Identifier of the primary user assigned to the device according to Intune; pivot to correlate device inventory with user-centric logons and activity.
PrimaryUser.description_zh: 根据 Intune 分配给设备的主要用户标识；可作为关联设备清单与以用户为中心的登录和活动的透视点。

ReferenceId.description: Documented as the Azure AD device ID for the managed device; use to join Intune inventory with directory device objects and sign-in logs.
ReferenceId.description_zh: 文档说明为托管设备的 Azure AD 设备 ID；用于将 Intune 清单与目录设备对象和登录日志关联。

Result.description: Outcome of the operation associated with this Intune export row; indicates success or failure of the reporting/export action, not the device's compliance verdict.
Result.description_zh: 与此 Intune 导出行关联的操作结果；表示报告/导出操作成功或失败，而不是设备的合规判定。

SerialNumber.description: Hardware serial number of the managed device; use for physical asset identification, warranty or theft checks, and deduplicating device records across exports.
SerialNumber.description_zh: 托管设备的硬件序列号；用于物理资产识别、保修或失窃核查，以及在多次导出间去重设备记录。

SkuFamily.description: Stock-keeping unit family of the device as reported in this inventory row; helps group device models by platform edition when analyzing fleet composition.
SkuFamily.description_zh: 此清单行中报告的设备 SKU 系列；用于在分析设备群构成时按平台版本对设备型号进行分组。

SourceSystem.description: Collector or agent that produced the record, such as Azure for Azure Diagnostics or OpsManager; use to understand ingestion path and filter heterogeneous workspace data.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成该记录的收集器或代理，例如 Azure Diagnostics 的 Azure 或 OpsManager；用于了解摄取路径并筛选异构工作区数据。

Stats.description: Dynamic statistics about the export, including per-export record counts; use to validate export completeness and detect truncated or partial Intune inventory batches.
Stats.description_zh: 有关导出的动态统计信息，包括每次导出的记录数；用于验证导出完整性并发现被截断或不完整的 Intune 清单批次。

StorageFree.description: Free storage size reported for the device in this snapshot; units are not documented here, so verify before comparisons; useful for capacity and low-space triage.
StorageFree.description_zh: 此快照中报告的设备可用存储大小；此处未说明单位，比较前需核实；可用于容量与低空间排查。

StorageTotal.description: Total storage size reported for the device in this snapshot; units are not documented here, so verify before deriving usage percentages from it and StorageFree.
StorageTotal.description_zh: 此快照中报告的设备总存储大小；此处未说明单位，从此字段与 StorageFree 推导使用率前需核实。

SubscriberCarrierNetwork.description: Mobile carrier network associated with the device subscriber in this inventory row; use for mobile fleet attribution and carrier-based filtering, not for network connection evidence.
SubscriberCarrierNetwork.description_zh: 此清单行中与设备订户关联的移动运营商网络；用于移动设备群归属和按运营商筛选，不能作为网络连接证据。

SupervisedStatusString.description: Text describing whether the device is supervised, typically relevant to Apple platforms; use to assess management control level over the endpoint.
SupervisedStatusString.description_zh: 描述设备是否受监督的文本，通常与 Apple 平台相关；用于评估对终端的管理控制级别。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID for this record, not a directory tenant ID; use to scope queries to the workspace holding the Intune device export.
TenantId.description_zh: 此记录的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID，不是目录租户 ID；用于将查询范围限定到保存 Intune 设备导出的工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when the report row was generated; use as the primary time bound when reviewing device state at a given export or correlating with other logs.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 生成该报告行的 UTC 日期和时间；可作为查看特定导出时点设备状态或与其他日志关联时的主要时间限定。

Type.description: Name of the table this record belongs to, here IntuneDevices; use in unions or filters to separate Intune inventory rows from other workspace tables.
Type.description_zh: 此记录所属表的名称，此处为 IntuneDevices；用于在联合查询或筛选中将 Intune 清单行与其他工作区表区分开。

UPN.description: User principal name of the user associated with the device in this inventory row; pivot for linking device inventory to identity-based sign-in and activity data.
UPN.description_zh: 此清单行中与设备关联用户的用户主体名称；可作为将设备清单关联到基于身份的登录与活动数据的透视点。

UserEmail.description: Email address of the user associated with the device; useful for attribution and contacting the owner, but its presence does not indicate any email activity occurred.
UserEmail.description_zh: 与设备关联用户的电子邮件地址；有助于归属和联系设备所有者，但其存在并不表示发生过任何电子邮件活动。

UserName.description: User name of the user associated with the device in this row; use with UPN or PrimaryUser for readable attribution during device investigations.
UserName.description_zh: 此行中与设备关联用户的用户名；在设备调查中可与 UPN 或 PrimaryUser 一起用于可读的归属。

WifiMacAddress.description: Wi-Fi MAC address reported for the device; note modern devices may randomize it, so treat as a weak identifier when pivoting across records.
WifiMacAddress.description_zh: 设备报告的 Wi-Fi MAC 地址；注意现代设备可能随机化该地址，因此跨记录关联时应视为弱标识符。

IntuneOperationalLogs.description: IntuneOperationalLogs records operational events emitted by Microsoft Intune services and collected into a Log Analytics workspace, typically one row per operation performed by or against an Intune tenant. Use it to trace device and policy management activity such as configuration, compliance, enrollment-adjacent or app operations, and to see which operations succeeded or failed. Useful pivots are OperationName, Category, Result and the free-form Properties payload, scoped by TimeGenerated. It differs from device inventory, network connection and sign-in tables, which cover assets, traffic and authentication rather than Intune service operations.
IntuneOperationalLogs.description_zh: IntuneOperationalLogs 记录 Microsoft Intune 服务发出并采集到 Log Analytics 工作区的操作事件，通常每个针对 Intune 租户执行的操作对应一行。可用于追踪设备与策略管理活动（如配置、合规、与应用或注册相关的操作），并判断操作成功或失败。常用维度包括 OperationName、Category、Result 以及自由格式的 Properties 负载，并按 TimeGenerated 限定时间范围。它与设备清单、网络连接和登录类表不同，后者分别描述资产、流量和身份验证，而非 Intune 服务操作。

Category.description: Category of the Intune operational event, indicating which service area or operation group produced the row. Use it to scope investigations to a workload before drilling into OperationName and Result.
Category.description_zh: Intune 操作事件的类别，表示产生该行的服务领域或操作分组。可先按它把调查范围限定到某个工作负载，再结合 OperationName 和 Result 深入分析。

OperationName.description: Name of the Intune operation this row records, i.e. the action taken by or against the service. Pivot on it to find repeated, unusual or failed administrative and device management operations.
OperationName.description_zh: 该行记录的 Intune 操作名称，即对服务执行或被服务执行的动作。可用它查找重复、异常或失败的管理与设备管理操作。

Properties.description: Free-form payload holding operation-specific details for this event. Parse it for target objects, settings and identifiers; because structure is not documented, inspect actual values before relying on any field inside.
Properties.description_zh: 保存该事件操作相关细节的自由格式负载。可解析其中目标对象、设置和标识符；由于结构未文档化，使用前应先查看实际取值，不要预设内部字段。

Result.description: Outcome reported for the operation in this row, distinguishing success from failure or other states. Use it to filter failed Intune operations and prioritize potentially impactful administrative actions.
Result.description_zh: 该行操作报告的结果，用于区分成功、失败或其他状态。可用它筛选失败的 Intune 操作，并优先关注可能产生影响的管理动作。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection channel that delivered the event, per this schema's SourceSystem semantics. Helps confirm data origin and pipeline when correlating Intune operations with other workspace tables.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 按本模式中 SourceSystem 的语义，表示投递该事件的代理或采集通道。在与工作区其他表关联 Intune 操作时，可用于确认数据来源和采集链路。

TenantId.description: Workspace identifier for the Log Analytics workspace where the record resides, not a directory tenant ID. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace when multiple workspaces are queried.
TenantId.description_zh: 该记录所在 Log Analytics 工作区的工作区标识，并非目录租户 ID。查询多个工作区时，可用它把查询限定到正确的工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when the Intune operational event was generated. Use it as the primary time filter and for ordering operations when reconstructing an activity sequence.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: Intune 操作事件生成的时间戳。可作为主要时间过滤条件，并在还原操作活动顺序时用于排序。

Type.description: Name of the table this row belongs to. Useful for confirming the record came from IntuneOperationalLogs when unioning several tables in a query.
Type.description_zh: 该行所属表的名称。在查询中合并多张表时，可用于确认记录来自 IntuneOperationalLogs。

LAQueryLogs.description: Log Analytics query audit records identifying the caller, submitted QueryText, requested time range, target workspaces and execution statistics. Use it to investigate who searched which data and whether a query failed, scanned substantial data or returned results. Pivot on AADObjectId, AADEmail, AADClientId and CorrelationId. The stored query may be KQL from the source service; querying this local export uses SQL. These rows audit queries, not the events those queries returned.
LAQueryLogs.description_zh: 记录 Log Analytics 查询审计，包括调用者、提交的 QueryText、请求时间范围、目标工作区和执行统计。用于调查谁搜索了哪些数据，以及查询是否失败、扫描了大量数据或返回了结果；可通过 AADObjectId、AADEmail、AADClientId 和 CorrelationId 关联。QueryText 可能保存源服务的 KQL，查询本地导出表仍使用 SQL。这些行记录查询行为，不是查询返回的原始事件。

AADClientId.description: AAD client (application) ID of the caller that submitted the query, as used by the audit context. Use with AADEmail/AADObjectId to attribute query activity to a specific app registration or automated tool.
AADClientId.description_zh: 提交查询的调用者所使用的 AAD 客户端（应用）ID，取自审计上下文。可与 AADEmail、AADObjectId 结合，将查询活动归因到特定的应用注册或自动化工具。

AADEmail.description: AAD email identifying the caller who issued the query. Use to pivot query activity to a specific user and correlate with other audit tables; absence may indicate non-user or service-initiated calls.
AADEmail.description_zh: 标识提交查询的调用者的 AAD 电子邮件地址。可用于将查询活动关联到特定用户并与其他审计表关联；若为空则可能表示非用户或服务发起的调用。

AADObjectId.description: AAD object ID of the caller, or the 'aai' claim for GDAP scenarios per official docs. Use as the stable caller identifier when correlating query audit events across workspaces or joins.
AADObjectId.description_zh: 调用者的 AAD 对象 ID；根据官方文档，在 GDAP 场景中也可为 'aai' 声明。在跨工作区关联查询审计事件或进行联接时，可将其用作稳定的调用者标识。

AADTenantId.description: AAD tenant ID of the caller who submitted the query, per official docs. Use to separate query activity originating from different identity tenants when hunts span multiple organizations.
AADTenantId.description_zh: 根据官方文档，提交查询的调用者所在的 AAD 租户 ID。当调查涉及多个组织时，可用它区分来自不同身份租户的查询活动。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier for correlated events associated with the query request. Use to group related audit entries (e.g., other tables sharing the same ID) and trace a single query's lifecycle across records.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 与查询请求相关联的事件关联 ID。可用于对相关审计条目进行分组（例如其他表中共享同一 ID 的记录），并跨记录追踪单个查询的生命周期。

IsBillableQuery.description: Boolean indicating whether execution of the query is billed, per official docs. Use to focus cost-impact analysis when reviewing expensive or unexpected queries during an investigation.
IsBillableQuery.description_zh: 根据官方文档，布尔值，表示该查询的执行是否计费。在调查期间分析昂贵或异常查询时，可用于聚焦成本影响分析。

IsWorkspaceInFailover.description: Boolean indicating whether the queried workspace was in failover mode, per official docs. Use to interpret unusual latency, region, or data availability when reviewing a query event.
IsWorkspaceInFailover.description_zh: 根据官方文档，布尔值，表示被查询的工作区是否处于故障转移模式。在审查查询事件时，可用以解释异常的延迟、区域或数据可用性。

QueryText.description: Full body of the KQL query as submitted by the user, per official docs. Use to inspect what data was accessed or exfiltrated and to identify suspicious patterns such as broad wildcards.
QueryText.description_zh: 根据官方文档，用户提交的 KQL 查询完整正文。可用于检查访问或导出了哪些数据，并识别诸如大范围通配符等可疑模式。

QueryTimeRangeEnd.description: UTC end time of the time range requested by the caller for the query, per official docs. Pair with QueryTimeRangeStart to see what historical window the caller asked to scan.
QueryTimeRangeEnd.description_zh: 根据官方文档，调用者为该查询请求的时间范围的 UTC 结束时间。与 QueryTimeRangeStart 搭配，可查看调用者请求扫描的历史时间窗口。

QueryTimeRangeStart.description: UTC start time of the time range requested by the caller for the query, per official docs. Use to detect lookbacks far beyond normal operations, which may indicate broad data harvesting.
QueryTimeRangeStart.description_zh: 根据官方文档，调用者为该查询请求的时间范围的 UTC 开始时间。可用于发现远超正常运营的回溯范围，这可能表明存在广泛的数据搜集行为。

RequestClientApp.description: ClientApp string from the request header (x-ms-app), per official docs, identifying the app used to submit the query. Use to distinguish portal, CLI, SDK, or automation-driven query activity.
RequestClientApp.description_zh: 根据官方文档，请求头 (x-ms-app) 中的 ClientApp 字符串，标识提交查询所用的应用。可用于区分门户、CLI、SDK 或自动化驱动的查询活动。

RequestContext.description: Dynamic field containing resource IDs of all referenced workspaces, applications, and resources across which the query was requested, per official docs. Inspect it to see the full scope of each query request.
RequestContext.description_zh: 根据官方文档，此动态字段包含查询请求所涉及的所有被引用工作区、应用程序和资源的资源 ID。检查该字段可了解每个查询请求的完整范围。

RequestContextFilters.description: Dynamic field with filters applied to the request context per official docs. Interpretation is name-derived; inspect its structure to understand narrowing applied to the queried scope during investigation.
RequestContextFilters.description_zh: 根据官方文档，此动态字段包含应用于请求上下文的筛选器。其解释基于名称推断；在调查中应检查其结构以了解对查询范围施加的收窄条件。

RequestTarget.description: Resource ID of the request URL per official docs, identifying the API endpoint or workspace targeted by the query. Use to determine which workspace or resource received the query request.
RequestTarget.description_zh: 根据官方文档，请求 URL 的资源 ID，标识查询所指向的 API 端点或工作区。可用于确定哪个工作区或资源接收了该查询请求。

ResponseCode.description: HTTP response code for the query request per official docs. Use to distinguish successful queries from denied, throttled, or failed attempts when tracing suspicious or repeated submissions.
ResponseCode.description_zh: 根据官方文档，查询请求的 HTTP 响应码。在追踪可疑或重复提交时，可用它区分成功查询与被拒绝、被限流或失败的尝试。

ResponseDurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds the query took to execute, per official docs. Use to baseline normal query performance and flag unusually heavy or long-running queries within the audit timeline.
ResponseDurationMs.description_zh: 根据官方文档，查询执行所花费的毫秒数。可用于建立正常查询性能基线，并在审计时间线中标记异常繁重或长时间运行的查询。

ResponseRowCount.description: Number of rows returned by the query per official docs. Use to gauge result volume and flag unusually large result sets that could indicate bulk export attempts.
ResponseRowCount.description_zh: 根据官方文档，查询返回的行数。可用于衡量结果规模，并标记可能表明批量导出尝试的异常大结果集。

ScannedGB.description: For billable queries such as Basic logs queries, total GB of data scanned, per official docs. Use to assess cost and data-volume impact of a specific query during review.
ScannedGB.description_zh: 根据官方文档，对于 Basic 日志等计费查询，表示查询扫描的总数据量（GB）。在审查时可用于评估特定查询的成本与数据量影响。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent that collected the event, e.g., OpsManager, Linux, or Azure per official docs. In this audit table, use cautiously to understand collection provenance of the query log record.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 根据官方文档，收集该事件的代理类型，例如 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure。在此审计表中，请谨慎使用该字段，以了解查询日志记录的采集来源。

StatsCPUTimeMs.description: CPU time in milliseconds used to execute this query, per official docs. Use to spot computationally expensive or repeated queries that may indicate automation or resource abuse.
StatsCPUTimeMs.description_zh: 根据官方文档，执行该查询所用的 CPU 时间（毫秒）。可用于发现计算开销大或重复执行的查询，这可能表明存在自动化滥用或资源滥用。

StatsDataProcessedEnd.description: UTC end time of the time range across which data was processed for the query, per official docs. Pair with StatsDataProcessedStart to see the effective data window actually touched.
StatsDataProcessedEnd.description_zh: 根据官方文档，该查询处理数据所在时间范围的 UTC 结束时间。与 StatsDataProcessedStart 搭配，可查看实际触及的有效数据窗口。

StatsDataProcessedKB.description: Name-derived interpretation: amount of data processed for the query, expressed in KB. Inspect alongside response and scan metrics, and verify meaning against workspace statistics context before relying on it.
StatsDataProcessedKB.description_zh: 基于名称推断：该查询处理的数据量，以 KB 表示。应结合响应与扫描指标一起检查，并在依赖该字段前对照工作区统计上下文核实其含义。

StatsDataProcessedStart.description: UTC start time of the time range across which data was processed for the query, per official docs. Use to compare requested versus actually processed windows for scope anomalies.
StatsDataProcessedStart.description_zh: 根据官方文档，该查询处理数据所在时间范围的 UTC 开始时间。可用于比较请求窗口与实际处理窗口，发现范围异常。

StatsRegionCount.description: Number of regions that the workspaces accessed are spread across, per official docs. Use to flag queries crossing many regions, which may be unusual for routine monitoring.
StatsRegionCount.description_zh: 根据官方文档，所访问工作区分布的区域数量。可用于标记跨越多个区域的查询，这对日常监控而言可能并不寻常。

StatsWorkspaceCount.description: Number of workspaces the query accessed, declared or otherwise. Use to gauge cross-workspace scope of a submitted query and to spot broad multi-workspace reconnaissance-style queries by one identity.
StatsWorkspaceCount.description_zh: 查询访问的工作区数量（显式声明或其他方式）。用于评估所提交查询的跨工作区范围，并识别同一身份发起的、覆盖面较广的疑似多工作区探测式查询。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record, per documentation; not a directory tenant ID. Use to scope audit rows to the workspace whose query activity you are reviewing.
TenantId.description_zh: 根据文档，与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；并不是目录租户 ID。用于将审计记录限定到你正在审查查询活动的工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the query was submitted, describing the audit event time. Use as the primary time axis for query-activity counts, spikes, and correlation with identity sign-in or client-app activity.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 查询提交时的 UTC 时间戳，描述审计事件发生时间。可作为主要时间轴，用于统计查询活动数量、识别峰值，并与身份登录或客户端应用活动进行关联分析。

Type.description: Name of the table for the record, here identifying the query-audit table. Use to restrict or confirm you are analyzing query-audit activity rather than other table data in the same workspace.
Type.description_zh: 记录所属表的名称，在此用于标识查询审计表。可用于限定或确认分析的是查询审计活动，而不是同一工作区中其他表的数据。

WorkspaceRegion.description: Region of the queried workspace, describing where query execution was served. Use to compare activity, latency, and cost across regions or to flag queries against unexpected workspace locations.
WorkspaceRegion.description_zh: 被查询工作区所在的区域，描述查询执行的服务位置。可用于比较不同区域的活动、延迟和成本，或标记针对异常工作区位置发起查询的情况。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the resource associated with the record, typically the queried workspace resource. Use to attribute query-audit rows to a specific workspace or join to resource inventory for ownership context.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的资源的唯一标识符，通常是被查询的工作区资源。可用于将查询审计记录归属到特定工作区，或与资源清单关联以获取归属上下文。

LASummaryLogs.description: Summary Logs records the execution of Log Analytics summary rules, with one row per rule bin execution including status, duration, result counts and errors. Use it to monitor which rules fail, which take longest, and how result volumes vary over time. Pivot by RuleName, Status, BinStartTime or QueryDurationMs. Unlike per-record log tables, this is operational telemetry about summarization jobs, not the summarized log content itself.
LASummaryLogs.description_zh: Summary Logs 记录 Log Analytics 汇总规则的执行情况，每个规则的时间分箱执行产生一行，包含状态、耗时、结果计数和错误信息。可用它监控哪些规则失败、哪些耗时最长以及结果量随时间的变化。可按 RuleName、Status、BinStartTime 或 QueryDurationMs 进行透视。与逐条日志表不同，它记录的是汇总作业的运行遥测，而非被汇总的日志内容本身。

BinSize.description: Length in minutes of the summarization window this execution covers, per name-derived interpretation. Use it to normalize duration and volume comparisons across rules that run on different bin sizes.
BinSize.description_zh: 按名称推断，表示本次执行所覆盖的汇总窗口长度（分钟）。可用它在不同分箱大小的规则之间对耗时和结果量进行归一化比较。

BinStartTime.description: UTC start of the time range being summarized by this execution, so the row describes processed log data rather than when the job ran; compare with TimeGenerated to see processing lag.
BinStartTime.description_zh: 本次执行所汇总数据时间范围的 UTC 起始点，因此该行描述的是被处理的日志数据而非作业运行时刻；可与 TimeGenerated 比较以查看处理延迟。

Message.description: Error or informational text for this rule execution when applicable; inspect it for failed bins and pair with Status and RuleName to determine failure cause and affected rule.
Message.description_zh: 适用时记录本次规则执行的错误或提示信息；检查它以了解失败的时间分箱，并结合 Status 与 RuleName 判断失败原因及受影响规则。

QueryDurationMs.description: Execution duration in milliseconds for this rule bin run; compare across RuleName and BinSize over time to find slow or degrading summary rules that need query optimization.
QueryDurationMs.description_zh: 本次规则分箱运行的执行时长（毫秒）；按 RuleName 与 BinSize 随时间比较，可找出需要查询优化或性能下降的汇总规则。

ResultsRecordCount.description: Number of aggregated records this rule execution returned. Sudden drops may indicate ingestion gaps or query issues, while spikes may reflect unusual activity in summarized source data.
ResultsRecordCount.description_zh: 本次规则执行返回的聚合记录数。数量骤降可能表明数据摄取缺口或查询问题，而激增可能反映被汇总源数据中的异常活动。

RuleLastModifiedTime.description: When the rule definition was last changed, not when this execution occurred. Use it to explain shifts in duration, status or result counts after a rule edit.
RuleLastModifiedTime.description_zh: 规则定义最近一次修改的时间，而非本次执行时间。可用它解释规则修改后耗时、状态或结果计数的变化。

RuleName.description: Name of the summary rule this execution belongs to; group failures, durations and record counts by it to rank which summarization rules are failing or slow.
RuleName.description_zh: 本次执行所属汇总规则的名称；按此字段对失败、耗时和记录数分组，可排出哪些汇总规则失败最多或最慢。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection source that produced the record, such as Azure for Azure Diagnostics; use it to distinguish how summary rule telemetry reached the workspace when mixing sources.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 产生该记录的代理或收集来源，例如 Azure 表示 Azure Diagnostics；当混用多种来源时，可用它区分汇总规则遥测进入工作区的方式。

Status.description: Execution state of this rule bin run, documented as Started, Succeeded or Failed. Filter on Failed to triage rule problems and cross-check counts against BinStartTime completeness.
Status.description_zh: 本次规则分箱运行的执行状态，文档记录为 Started、Succeeded 或 Failed。过滤 Failed 可排查规则问题，并结合 BinStartTime 核对分箱完整性。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the record, documented as the workspace identifier rather than a directory tenant ID; use it to scope queries to one workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID，文档说明为工作区标识而非目录租户 ID；可用它将查询限定到单个工作区。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC time bin processing started for this execution, decoupled from the bin's data range; use with BinStartTime to measure processing lag and order executions.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 本次执行开始处理分箱的 UTC 时间，与分箱数据范围解耦；可与 BinStartTime 配合衡量处理延迟并对执行排序。

Type.description: Name of the table the record belongs to, useful for filtering when querying across multiple tables; for this table it should consistently identify summary rule execution records.
Type.description_zh: 该记录所属表的名称，在跨多表查询时可用于过滤；对本表而言，它应一致地标识汇总规则执行记录。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the resource associated with the record; use it to attribute rule executions to a specific workspace resource when multiple resources report into the same query scope.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的资源的唯一标识；当多个资源向同一查询范围报告时，可用它将规则执行归属到特定工作区资源。

MicrosoftAzureBastionAuditLogs.description: Azure Bastion session audit records emitted by the Bastion service, one row per session lifecycle event (start, end, connect) for browser-based RDP/SSH access to VMs. Answers who connected through which Bastion to which target, from which client IP, using which protocol, and how long sessions lasted. Pivot on TunnelId to trace a session, and on client IP, user or target resource for hunting. Neighboring tables cover the target VM's own security logs, not the Bastion gateway session.
MicrosoftAzureBastionAuditLogs.description_zh: 由 Azure Bastion 服务生成的会话审计记录，每行代表一个会话生命周期事件（开始、结束、连接），用于通过浏览器以 RDP/SSH 访问 VM。可回答谁经由哪个 Bastion 连接到哪个目标、来源客户端 IP、所用协议以及会话持续时间。可用 TunnelId 追踪单个会话，也可按客户端 IP、用户或目标资源进行排查。相邻表记录目标 VM 自身的日志，而非 Bastion 网关会话。

ClientIpAddress.description: Source IP of the browser initiating the Bastion connection; pivot here to find other sessions from the same client host or to flag unusual external origins.
ClientIpAddress.description_zh: 发起 Bastion 连接的浏览器源 IP；可据此查找来自同一客户端主机的其他会话，或标记异常外部来源。

ClientPort.description: Source TCP port on the client browser for this connection; combine with ClientIpAddress and time to correlate a specific session flow, not to identify a user.
ClientPort.description_zh: 客户端浏览器在此连接中使用的源 TCP 端口；与 ClientIpAddress 和时间结合可关联特定会话流，但不能用于识别用户。

Duration.description: Length in milliseconds of a completed Bastion session; populate only once the session ends, so use it to detect unusually long or short interactive sessions.
Duration.description_zh: 已完成 Bastion 会话的持续时长（毫秒）；仅在会话结束后填充，可用于发现异常长或异常短的交互式会话。

Location.description: Azure region that processed the request, per the provider; use to confirm sessions traverse the expected Bastion region, not to geolocate the end user.
Location.description_zh: 按提供方记录的处理该请求的 Azure 区域；用于确认会话经过预期的 Bastion 区域，而非用于定位最终用户地理位置。

Message.description: Free-text detail associated with this Bastion event; inspect for error or status context when session start/end fields alone do not explain an anomaly.
Message.description_zh: 与该 Bastion 事件关联的自由文本详情；当仅有会话开始/结束字段无法解释异常时，可检查其中的错误或状态上下文。

OperationName.description: Name of the Bastion operation recorded for this row; use it to separate session start, end or connect events before aggregating by user or target.
OperationName.description_zh: 该行记录的 Bastion 操作名称；用于在按用户或目标聚合前区分会话开始、结束或连接事件。

Protocol.description: Remote protocol used for the session, such as ssh or rdp (name-derived); use to segment sessions by access method when profiling user behavior or target exposure.
Protocol.description_zh: 会话使用的远程协议，例如 ssh 或 rdp（据名称推断）；用于在分析用户行为或目标暴露面时按访问方式区分会话。

ResourceType.description: Kind of Azure resource reached during the session, such as a VM, VMSS or Bastion-related type; use to focus investigations on specific target classes.
ResourceType.description_zh: 会话期间访问的 Azure 资源类型，例如 VM、VMSS 或与 Bastion 相关的类型；用于将调查聚焦于特定目标类别。

SessionEndTime.description: UTC timestamp when the Bastion session ended; pair with SessionStartTime to reconstruct session windows and spot sessions lacking a clean end.
SessionEndTime.description_zh: Bastion 会话结束的 UTC 时间戳；与 SessionStartTime 配合可重建会话时间窗，并发现缺少正常结束的会话。

SessionStartTime.description: UTC timestamp when the Bastion session began; anchor for ordering sessions per user or tunnel and for comparing against target VM logon activity.
SessionStartTime.description_zh: Bastion 会话开始的 UTC 时间戳；用于按用户或隧道对会话排序，并与目标 VM 的登录活动进行比对。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or pipeline that produced the record, generally Azure for this service; use to separate ingestion paths rather than to describe the session actor.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 生成该记录的代理或采集管道，此服务通常为 Azure；用于区分数据摄入路径，而非描述会话主体。

TargetResourceId.description: Azure resource ID of the VM the Bastion session connected to; pivot here to review all access to one target across users, clients and times.
TargetResourceId.description_zh: Bastion 会话所连接 VM 的 Azure 资源 ID；可据此排查针对单个目标在所有用户、客户端和时间上的访问记录。

TargetVMIPAddress.description: IP address of the target VM reached through Bastion; use alongside TargetResourceId when correlating with other network or host logs, not as a client address.
TargetVMIPAddress.description_zh: 通过 Bastion 访问的目标 VM 的 IP 地址；在与其它网络或主机日志关联时配合 TargetResourceId 使用，而非作为客户端地址。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID for the record, per documentation; use to scope queries to the correct workspace and do not treat it as a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档记录，该记录所属的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；用于将查询限定到正确工作区，切勿将其视为目录租户标识。

Time.description: UTC timestamp of the log event as recorded by the service; use for time-bounded hunting and to sequence events within a single tunnel.
Time.description_zh: 服务记录的日志事件 UTC 时间戳；用于限定时间范围的排查，并对同一隧道内的事件排序。

TimeGenerated.description: Ingestion-time timestamp assigned when the record entered the workspace; compare with Time to gauge reporting latency, not to establish when the session occurred.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 记录进入工作区时分配的摄入时间戳；可与 Time 比较以评估上报延迟，而非用于确定会话发生时间。

TunnelId.description: Internal Bastion connection GUID identifying one session tunnel; use as the primary key to correlate start and end rows and all activity within a single connection.
TunnelId.description_zh: 标识单个会话隧道的内部 Bastion 连接 GUID；作为主键可关联开始与结束行以及单次连接内的全部活动。

Type.description: Name of the table supplying the record; useful for scoping unions and confirming the row came from this Bastion audit table rather than a related log.
Type.description_zh: 提供该记录的表名称；用于限定联合查询范围，并确认该行来自此 Bastion 审计表而非相关日志。

UserAgent.description: Browser user-agent string presented when the connection was made; use to profile client tooling and flag unexpected or automated browsers, not to authenticate the user.
UserAgent.description_zh: 建立连接时提交的浏览器 user-agent 字符串；用于分析客户端工具并标记异常或自动化浏览器，但不能用于认证用户身份。

UserEmail.description: Email account associated with the user who logged in through Bastion; convenient human-readable pivot for attributing sessions, subject to directory naming accuracy.
UserEmail.description_zh: 通过 Bastion 登录的用户所关联的电子邮件账户；便于以可读方式归属会话，但受目录命名准确性影响。

UserName.description: User name used to log into the target VM from Bastion; use to attribute sessions to an operator, remembering it identifies the login identity, not the client host.
UserName.description_zh: 从 Bastion 登录目标 VM 所使用的用户名；用于将会话归属到操作者，但请注意它标识登录身份而非客户端主机。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource this record is associated with; use to scope queries to a specific Bastion or related resource in resource-centric investigations.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 该记录所关联 Azure 资源的唯一标识符；在以资源为中心的调查中用于将查询限定到特定 Bastion 或相关资源。

MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs.description: MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs records Microsoft Graph API requests made against resources in the tenant, one row per Graph request, collected into the workspace. Use it for request-level questions: which identity or application called which Graph endpoint, with what method, scopes and roles, response code, duration and region served. Pivot on UserId, AppId or ServicePrincipalId, RequestUri, ResponseStatusCode and TimeGenerated. Boundary: this is Graph API request telemetry, not directory sign-in events or device/network logs; use sign-in tables for authentication outcomes.
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs.description_zh: MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs 记录针对租户内资源发起的 Microsoft Graph API 请求，每行对应一次 Graph 请求，由工作区收集。可用它回答请求级问题：哪个身份或应用调用了哪个 Graph 端点、使用什么方法、作用域与角色、响应状态码、耗时及服务区域。可按 UserId、AppId 或 ServicePrincipalId、RequestUri、ResponseStatusCode 和 TimeGenerated 做透视。边界：这是 Graph API 请求遥测，不是目录登录事件或设备/网络日志；认证结果应查登录相关表。

ATContent.description: Reserved by Microsoft for future use per documentation; treat as unsupported for investigation unless Microsoft later documents a value. Do not infer access-token content from its name (name-derived); inspect resource/category context before relying on it.
ATContent.description_zh: 根据文档由 Microsoft 保留以备将来使用；在 Microsoft 后续给出说明前应视为不支持调查使用。不要据其名称推断为访问令牌内容（基于名称的推测）；依赖前请结合资源/类别上下文核查。

ATContentH.description: Reserved by Microsoft for future use per documentation; interpretation from the name is name-derived only. Avoid treating it as a header or hash value in queries; inspect resource and category context for any actual semantics.
ATContentH.description_zh: 根据文档由 Microsoft 保留以备将来使用；基于名称的解读仅为推测。查询中不要将其当作请求头或哈希值；若需实际语义，请结合资源与类别上下文核查。

ATContentP.description: Reserved by Microsoft for future use per documentation; its name does not establish a payload or parameter meaning. Do not parse it as token content; verify resource/provider and category context before use in investigation queries.
ATContentP.description_zh: 根据文档由 Microsoft 保留以备将来使用；其名称不能确立负载或参数含义。不要将其解析为令牌内容；在调查查询中使用前请核对资源/提供程序与类别上下文。

AadTenantId.description: The Azure AD tenant identifier associated with the request's authorization context. Use it to confirm which directory tenant the Graph call acted in and to correlate with identity objects; distinct from the workspace-scoped TenantId column.
AadTenantId.description_zh: 与请求授权上下文关联的 Azure AD 租户标识符。可用它确认该 Graph 调用作用于哪个目录租户，并与身份对象关联；与工作区范围的 TenantId 列不同。

ApiVersion.description: Version of the Microsoft Graph API used for this request (for example v1.0 or beta). Useful when triaging endpoint behavior differences and when comparing activity patterns across versions for the same identity or application.
ApiVersion.description_zh: 本次请求使用的 Microsoft Graph API 版本（例如 v1.0 或 beta）。在排查端点行为差异、以及对比同一身份或应用在不同版本下的活动模式时有用。

AppId.description: Identifier of the application making the Graph request, whether a client app or resource application. Pivot here to see which apps access a resource, compare expected versus unexpected apps, and correlate with service principal activity.
AppId.description_zh: 发起该 Graph 请求的应用程序标识符，可能是客户端应用或资源应用。可据此查看哪些应用访问某资源、对比预期与意外应用，并与服务主体活动关联。

ClientAuthMethod.description: Integer indicating how the client was authenticated for this request: 0 public client, 1 client ID and secret, 2 client certificate. Use it to spot requests from confidential clients or certificates versus public clients when scoping app activity.
ClientAuthMethod.description_zh: 指示本次请求的客户端认证方式的整数：0 为公共客户端，1 为客户端 ID 加密码，2 为客户端证书。在限定应用活动范围时，可区分机密客户端或证书客户端与公共客户端。

ClientRequestId.description: Optional client-supplied request identifier; equals OperationId when the caller did not send one. Use it to correlate with caller-side logs or to group retries, but remember absence indicates fallback to the operation identifier.
ClientRequestId.description_zh: 可选的客户端提供的请求标识符；调用方未提供时等于 OperationId。可用它与调用方日志关联或对重试分组，但需注意缺失表示回退为操作标识符。

DurationMs.description: Server-side duration of the Graph request in milliseconds. Use to profile slow calls, detect anomalies for a given identity or endpoint, and compare response times when triaging throttling or unexpected latency.
DurationMs.description_zh: 该 Graph 请求的服务端耗时，单位为毫秒。可用于分析缓慢调用、发现特定身份或端点的异常，并在排查限流或异常延迟时对比响应时间。

IPAddress.description: IP address of the client from which the Graph request originated. Use for geolocation or network scoping, and to compare against known corporate or suspicious ranges when reviewing an identity's or app's activity.
IPAddress.description_zh: 发起该 Graph 请求的客户端 IP 地址。可用于地理定位或网络范围限定，并在审查某身份或应用的活动时与已知企业或可疑网段对比。

IdentityProvider.description: The identity provider that authenticated the subject of the token used by the request, for example a federated provider. Use it to confirm which IdP brokered authentication for the calling identity.
IdentityProvider.description_zh: 对本次请求所用令牌主体进行身份验证的标识提供者，例如联合提供程序。可用它确认对该调用身份进行代理认证的是哪个 IdP。

Location.description: Name of the Azure region that served the Graph request. Use it to see geographic distribution of activity, detect unusual serving regions, or correlate with service deployment and latency patterns.
Location.description_zh: 为该 Graph 请求提供服务的 Azure 区域名称。可用于查看活动的地理分布、发现异常的提供区域，或与服务部署和延迟模式关联。

OperationId.description: Identifier for a batch; unique per request for non-batched calls, and shared across all requests in a batch. Use it to group batched Graph calls and to follow an operation across its constituent requests.
OperationId.description_zh: 用于标识批次；非批处理请求中每次请求唯一，批处理请求中同一批次的所有请求共享。可用它对批量 Graph 调用分组，并沿组成请求追踪一次操作。

RequestId.description: Identifier representing this specific Graph request record. Use it as the join key when correlating a request with other telemetry, support tickets, or when deduplicating entries that describe the same call.
RequestId.description_zh: 代表这条特定 Graph 请求记录的标识符。可将其用作关联请求与其他遥测、支持工单的连接键，或用于对描述同一调用的条目去重。

RequestMethod.description: HTTP method of the Graph request, such as GET, POST, PATCH or DELETE. Use it to separate read-style activity from write-style changes when investigating which operations an identity or app performed.
RequestMethod.description_zh: 该 Graph 请求的 HTTP 方法，例如 GET、POST、PATCH 或 DELETE。在调查某身份或应用执行了哪些操作时，可用它区分读取类活动与写入类更改。

RequestUri.description: URI of the Graph request, indicating the resource and path targeted. Use it to identify accessed resources, compare against expected app permissions, and spot unusual endpoint calls for an identity.
RequestUri.description_zh: 该 Graph 请求的 URI，指示所针对的资源与路径。可用它识别被访问资源、与预期应用权限对比，并发现某身份对异常端点的调用。

ResponseSizeBytes.description: Size of the Graph response in bytes. Use to detect large data exports or unusually large responses tied to an identity or app, complementing request counts when profiling potential bulk read activity.
ResponseSizeBytes.description_zh: 该 Graph 响应的字节大小。可用于发现与某身份或应用相关的大规模数据导出或异常大的响应，在剖析潜在批量读取活动时补充请求计数。

ResponseStatusCode.description: HTTP status code returned for the Graph request. Use to separate successful calls from failures such as authorization denials or throttling, and to surface repeated errors for an identity or endpoint.
ResponseStatusCode.description_zh: 该 Graph 请求返回的 HTTP 状态码。可用于区分成功调用与失败调用（如授权拒绝或限流），并凸显某身份或端点的重复错误。

Roles.description: Roles present in the token claims for this request. Use to understand what role-based permissions the caller held, and to compare requested operations against the role set when reviewing privileged or unexpected access.
Roles.description_zh: 本次请求令牌声明中存在的角色。可用于了解调用方持有的基于角色的权限，并在审查特权或意外访问时将所请求操作与该角色集合对比。

Scopes.description: Scopes present in the token claims for this request. Use to see what delegated or application permissions the caller exercised, and to compare actual scopes against expected least-privilege grants for the identity or app.
Scopes.description_zh: 本次请求令牌声明中存在的作用域。可用于查看调用方实际行使的委派或应用权限，并将实际作用域与该身份或应用预期的最小权限授予对比。

ServicePrincipalId.description: Identifier of the service principal making the Graph request, when the caller is an app identity rather than a user. Use it to attribute app-only activity and to pivot between service principal and application context.
ServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 发起该 Graph 请求的服务主体标识符，在调用方为应用身份而非用户时存在。可用它归属于仅应用的活动，并在服务主体与应用上下文之间进行透视。

SignInActivityId.description: Identifier representing the sign-in activity associated with this Graph request. Use it to link request activity back to sign-in records and to understand which authentication session a call belongs to.
SignInActivityId.description_zh: 代表与该 Graph 请求关联的登录活动的标识符。可用它把请求活动链接回登录记录，并了解该调用属于哪个身份验证会话。

SourceSystem.description: Agent that collected the event, for example OpsManager, Linux, or Azure diagnostics. Use it to understand ingestion origin and to scope queries when the table receives data through multiple collection paths.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集该事件的代理，例如 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure 诊断。可用它了解数据摄取来源，并在该表通过多个收集路径接收数据时限定查询范围。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier that owns this record, as documented. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace; do not interpret it as the Azure AD directory tenant, which is represented by AadTenantId.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档所述，拥有此记录的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。可用它将查询限定到正确的工作区；不要将其解释为 Azure AD 目录租户，后者由 AadTenantId 表示。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp the Graph request was received, per official docs; use to bound the investigation window, order events, and correlate with sign-in or resource logs.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 官方文档说明为 Graph 请求的接收时间；用于限定调查时间窗、排列事件顺序，并与登录或资源日志关联。

TokenIssuedAt.description: Time the access token presented with this request was issued; compare with TimeGenerated to gauge token age and spot unusually long-lived or stale tokens.
TokenIssuedAt.description_zh: 本次请求所用访问令牌的签发时间；与 TimeGenerated 对比可评估令牌年龄，发现异常长久或过期的令牌。

Type.description: Table name stamped on each exported row; here it should identify MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs, useful when unioning tables to keep Graph request rows distinguishable.
Type.description_zh: 每行导出数据上标记的表名；此处应标识 MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs，在联合多表查询时用于区分 Graph 请求记录。

UserAgent.description: User agent string supplied by the calling client in this request; helps fingerprint the client app or script and detect anomalous or attacker-controlled tooling.
UserAgent.description_zh: 本次请求中调用客户端提供的用户代理字符串；有助于识别客户端应用或脚本，并发现异常或攻击者控制的工具。

UserId.description: Identifier of the user who made this Graph request, per official docs; pivot to trace a user's Graph activity, but confirm the identifier type before comparing with other tables.
UserId.description_zh: 官方文档说明为发起本次 Graph 请求的用户标识符；可据此追踪某用户的 Graph 活动，但与其他表比较前需确认标识符类型。

Wids.description: Tenant-wide role identifiers assigned to the requesting user, per official docs; use to judge what administrative privileges backed the request, not to prove malicious intent.
Wids.description_zh: 官方文档说明为授予发起请求用户的租户级角色标识符；用于判断该请求背后的管理权限，但不能据此推断恶意意图。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

OfficeActivity.description: OfficeActivity holds audit records emitted by Microsoft 365 workloads (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams and others) and collected into the workspace. Each row describes one audited user or admin action, with the workload named by OfficeWorkload/RecordType and the action by Operation or Activity. Use it to answer who did what, to which object, from which client or IP, and whether it succeeded. Pivots include UserId, ClientIP, OfficeObjectId, Site_Url and RecordType. It differs from device inventory, network-connection and sign-in tables, which cover endpoint state, traffic and authentication rather than in-service content actions.
OfficeActivity.description_zh: OfficeActivity 保存 Microsoft 365 各工作负载（Exchange、SharePoint、Teams 等）产生并被采集到工作区的审核记录。每行描述一次被审核的用户或管理员操作，工作负载由 OfficeWorkload/RecordType 标识，操作由 Operation 或 Activity 标识。可用于回答谁在何时对哪个对象做了什么、来自哪个客户端或 IP、是否成功。可用 UserId、ClientIP、OfficeObjectId、Site_Url、RecordType 等字段进行关联。它与设备清单、网络连接和登录类表不同，后者记录终端状态、流量与身份验证，而非服务内内容操作。

AADGroupId.description: Microsoft Entra ID group identifier linked to this Office activity, useful when the audited action involves group membership or group-scoped Teams/SharePoint permissions. Correlate with directory group objects to attribute access.
AADGroupId.description_zh: 与该 Office 活动关联的 Microsoft Entra ID 组标识符，适用于涉及组成员身份或组范围 Teams/SharePoint 权限的审核操作。可与目录组对象关联以归属访问权限。

AADTarget.description: The directory user or object the audited Office operation acted upon, as recorded in this row. Compare against Actor to separate who performed the action from whom it affected.
AADTarget.description_zh: 该行中被审核 Office 操作所作用的目标目录用户或对象。可与 Actor 对比，区分操作执行者与受影响对象。

Activity.description: The user-facing activity name recorded for this Office audit event, often a friendlier rendering of Operation. Use it to group or filter rows by the kind of action taken.
Activity.description_zh: 该 Office 审核事件记录的用户可见活动名称，通常是 Operation 的可读形式。可用它按操作类型分组或筛选记录。

Actor.description: Identity credited with performing the audited action in this row; may be a user or service principal depending on the workload. Compare with UserId and AADTarget to establish actor, subject and target.
Actor.description_zh: 该行中被记为执行审核操作的身份，视工作负载可能是用户或服务主体。可与 UserId 和 AADTarget 比较，以确定执行者、主体与目标。

ActorContextId.description: GUID of the organization context the actor belongs to for this event. Use it to separate actions taken across different organizational contexts within the same workspace.
ActorContextId.description_zh: 该事件中执行者所属组织上下文的 GUID。可用于区分同一工作区内不同组织上下文中的操作。

ActorContextId_.description: Name-derived duplicate variant of ActorContextId present in this table's schema; likely an alternate organization context identifier. Inspect neighbouring Actor/ActorContextId values and the resource or category context before relying on it.
ActorContextId_.description_zh: 本表架构中 ActorContextId 的同名派生重复列，可能是备用组织上下文标识。使用前请结合相邻 Actor/ActorContextId 取值以及资源或类别上下文进行核实。

ActorIpAddress.description: IP address recorded for the actor of this Office audit event, in IPv4 or IPv6 form. Pivot for geolocation, impossible-travel or shared-source correlation with ClientIP.
ActorIpAddress.description_zh: 该 Office 审核事件执行者记录的 IP 地址，形式为 IPv4 或 IPv6。可作为地理定位、异常位移或与 ClientIP 关联同源的排查线索。

AddOnGuid.description: Unique identifier of the add-on that generated this Teams/Office event. Join repeated events from the same add-on across users or channels when investigating add-on-driven activity.
AddOnGuid.description_zh: 生成该 Teams/Office 事件的加载项唯一标识符。调查加载项驱动活动时，可据此把同一加载项在不同用户或频道产生的事件关联起来。

AddOnType.description: Category of add-on that emitted this event according to the record. Combine with AddonName and AddOnGuid to characterise which extension produced the audited action.
AddOnType.description_zh: 该记录所示产生此事件的加载项类别。可结合 AddonName 与 AddOnGuid 判断是哪类扩展产生了该审核操作。

AddonName.description: Display name of the add-on responsible for this event. Useful for pivoting on a specific extension's activity across users, teams or channels in the audit trail.
AddonName.description_zh: 对此事件负责的加载项显示名称。可用于在审核记录中按特定扩展跨用户、团队或频道追踪其活动。

AffectedItems.description: Embedded information about items affected by a group or bulk operation in this row. Inspect it to enumerate which mailbox or site items the audited action touched.
AffectedItems.description_zh: 该行中受组操作或批量操作影响的条目内嵌信息。查看它可列举被审核操作涉及的邮箱或站点条目。

AppDistributionMode.description: Distribution mode recorded for the application associated with this event. Helps classify how an app reached its users when reviewing app-related Office activity.
AppDistributionMode.description_zh: 与本事件相关应用的发布/分发模式记录。在审查与应用相关的 Office 活动时，有助于判断该应用如何触达用户。

AppId.description: Application identifier tied to this Office audit event, typically the client or service app involved. Pivot to correlate activity from the same application across users.
AppId.description_zh: 与该 Office 审核事件关联的应用标识符，通常为涉及的客户端或服务应用。可据此关联同一应用在不同用户上的活动。

AppPoolName.description: Name of the application pool associated with this event, mainly relevant to server-hosted workflows. Use as a supporting pivot when tracing service-side Office operations.
