AppPoolName.description_zh: 与本事件关联的应用程序池名称，主要与服务器托管的工作流相关。追踪服务端 Office 操作时，可作为辅助线索。

Application.description: Application name recorded for this audit event, indicating which app context produced the activity. Combine with AppId and UserAgent when attributing the client used.
Application.description_zh: 该审核事件记录的应用名称，表明产生该活动的应用上下文。可与 AppId、UserAgent 结合，以归属所使用的客户端。

ApplicationId.description: SharePoint application identifier associated with this row's activity. Use it to scope site or app-level operations when investigating SharePoint audit records.
ApplicationId.description_zh: 与该行活动关联的 SharePoint 应用标识符。调查 SharePoint 审核记录时，可用它限定站点或应用级操作范围。

AzureADAppId.description: Microsoft Entra ID application identifier for the Teams application involved in this event. Pivot to trace activity by the same registered app across the tenant.
AzureADAppId.description_zh: 本事件涉及的 Teams 应用对应的 Microsoft Entra ID 应用标识符。可据此在租户内追踪同一注册应用的活动。

AzureActiveDirectory_EventType.description: Type of Microsoft Entra ID event represented in this row, typically for identity-related Office operations. Compare with RecordType to see whether the record is directory-oriented.
AzureActiveDirectory_EventType.description_zh: 该行所表示的 Microsoft Entra ID 事件类型，通常用于与身份相关的 Office 操作。可与 RecordType 比较，判断记录是否偏向目录。

ChannelGuid.description: Unique identifier of the Teams channel being audited. Use it to group channel-scoped events when following activity in a specific team conversation space.
ChannelGuid.description_zh: 被审核的 Teams 频道唯一标识符。追踪特定团队会话空间活动时，可用它按频道范围汇总事件。

ChannelName.description: Name of the Teams channel being audited in this row. Pairs with TeamName and ChannelGuid to locate where the audited action occurred.
ChannelName.description_zh: 该行中被审核的 Teams 频道名称。可与 TeamName、ChannelGuid 配合，定位被审核操作发生的位置。

ChannelType.description: Type of Teams channel audited, distinguishing standard from private channels as recorded. Use it to separate activity in more restricted channel spaces.
ChannelType.description_zh: 被审核的 Teams 频道类型，记录区分标准频道与专用频道。可用于区分受限程度更高的频道空间中的活动。

ChatName.description: Name of the Teams or Office chat associated with this event. Helps identify the conversation context of the audited action.
ChatName.description_zh: 与本事件关联的 Teams 或 Office 聊天名称。有助于识别被审核操作的会话上下文。

ChatThreadId.description: Identifier of the chat thread involved in this event. Pivot to reconstruct activity within a specific Teams conversation thread.
ChatThreadId.description_zh: 本事件涉及的聊天线程标识符。可据此重建特定 Teams 会话线程内的活动。

Client.description: Details about the client device, device operating system and browser used for this audited action. Use it alongside ClientIP and UserAgent when profiling how a user connected.
Client.description_zh: 该审核操作所用客户端设备、设备操作系统和浏览器的详细信息。可与 ClientIP、UserAgent 一起用于刻画用户的连接方式。

ClientAppId.description: Identifier for the client application that performed the Office 365 operation described in this row; compare with ClientIP and UserId to attribute activity to a specific app used by the acting user.
ClientAppId.description_zh: 标识执行本行所记录 Office 365 操作的客户端应用程序；可与 ClientIP、UserId 一起比较，将活动归因于特定用户使用的特定应用。

ClientIP.description: IP address of the device or client that initiated the audited Office 365 operation in this row; use with TimeGenerated and UserId to trace where an activity originated.
ClientIP.description_zh: 发起本行所审核 Office 365 操作的设备或客户端 IP 地址；可与 TimeGenerated、UserId 结合，追溯活动来源位置。

ClientIP_.description: Alternate or duplicate client IP column present on some OfficeActivity schemas; name-derived and not officially documented, so inspect the row's workload/category context before treating it as a client address.
ClientIP_.description_zh: 部分 OfficeActivity 架构中存在的备用或重复客户端 IP 列；名称推断，官方未记录，因此在将其视为客户端地址前应检查该行的工作负载/类别上下文。

ClientInfoString.description: Text describing the email client used to perform the Exchange mailbox operation in this row; helps distinguish client software from machine and user when investigating access to mail items.
ClientInfoString.description_zh: 描述执行本行 Exchange 邮箱操作所用电子邮件客户端的文本；在调查邮件项访问时可帮助区分客户端软件、机器和用户。

ClientMachineName.description: Name of the machine hosting the mail client that carried out the operation in this row; pair with ClientIP and UserId to correlate a mailbox action with a device.
ClientMachineName.description_zh: 承载执行本行操作邮件客户端的计算机名称；可与 ClientIP、UserId 配对，将邮箱操作与设备关联。

ClientProcessName.description: Email or client process that accessed the mailbox for the operation in this row; useful for separating Outlook, mobile, or API-driven access from other client types.
ClientProcessName.description_zh: 执行本行操作时访问邮箱的电子邮件或客户端进程；有助于区分 Outlook、移动端或 API 驱动访问与其他客户端类型。

ClientVersion.description: Version string of the email client used for the operation in this row; use alongside ClientProcessName and ClientInfoString to profile anomalous or outdated client access to mailboxes.
ClientVersion.description_zh: 执行本行操作的电子邮件客户端版本字符串；可与 ClientProcessName、ClientInfoString 一起，用于分析异常的或过时的邮箱客户端访问。

Client_IPAddress.description: IP address of the device recorded when the mailbox operation in this row was logged; useful for Exchange-focused pivots and should be scoped by time and user.
Client_IPAddress.description_zh: 记录本行邮箱操作时所用设备的 IP 地址；适用于以 Exchange 为焦点的关联分析，并应按时间和用户限定范围。

CommunicationType.description: Category of communication involved in the Teams or collaboration activity in this row; name-derived, so inspect the workload and operation context to interpret the specific communication mode.
CommunicationType.description_zh: 本行 Teams 或协作活动所涉及通信的类别；名称推断，需检查工作负载和操作上下文以解释具体通信模式。

CrossMailboxOperations.description: Boolean on this row indicating the audited operation involved more than one mailbox; when true, pivot to the DestMailbox* fields to identify the other mailbox involved.
CrossMailboxOperations.description_zh: 本行布尔值，表示所审核操作是否涉及多个邮箱；为 true 时，应关联 DestMailbox* 字段以识别所涉及的其他邮箱。

CustomEvent.description: Optional string carrying event-specific custom data attached to some OfficeActivity records; inspect alongside OfficeWorkload and Operation before treating any content as meaningful.
CustomEvent.description_zh: 部分 OfficeActivity 记录附带的、针对特定事件的可选自定义数据字符串；在将内容视为有意义前，应结合 OfficeWorkload 和 Operation 检查。

DataCenterSecurityEventType.description: Integer labeling the type of data-center or lockbox cmdlet event in this row; name-derived and not officially enumerated, so verify with operation and elevation fields before relying on it.
DataCenterSecurityEventType.description_zh: 本行数据中心或锁箱 cmdlet 事件的类型整数；名称推断且官方未给出枚举，依赖前应结合操作和提权字段核实。

DestFolder.description: Destination mail folder for move or copy operations recorded in this row; use with SourceFolder-like fields and CrossMailboxOperations to reconstruct the mailbox action path.
DestFolder.description_zh: 本行所记录移动或复制操作的目标邮件文件夹；可与源文件夹类字段及 CrossMailboxOperations 一起还原邮箱操作路径。

DestMailboxId.description: Identifier of the destination mailbox when this row involves cross-mailbox operations; appears with CrossMailboxOperations true and helps trace data movement between mailboxes.
DestMailboxId.description_zh: 本行涉及跨邮箱操作时目标邮箱的标识符；在 CrossMailboxOperations 为 true 时出现，有助于追踪邮箱之间的数据移动。

DestMailboxOwnerMasterAccountSid.description: Master account SID of the destination mailbox owner for cross-mailbox rows; use with DestMailboxOwnerSid and DestMailboxOwnerUPN to attribute the receiving mailbox.
DestMailboxOwnerMasterAccountSid.description_zh: 跨邮箱行的目标邮箱所有者的主账户 SID；可与 DestMailboxOwnerSid、DestMailboxOwnerUPN 一起，归属接收方邮箱。

DestMailboxOwnerSid.description: SID of the destination mailbox owner when this row records a cross-mailbox operation; pair with DestMailboxOwnerUPN to resolve the receiving identity.
DestMailboxOwnerSid.description_zh: 本行记录跨邮箱操作时目标邮箱所有者的 SID；可与 DestMailboxOwnerUPN 配对，解析接收方身份。

DestMailboxOwnerUPN.description: User principal name of the destination mailbox owner in cross-mailbox rows; useful for identifying whose mailbox received items moved or copied from another mailbox.
DestMailboxOwnerUPN.description_zh: 跨邮箱行中目标邮箱所有者的用户主体名称；有助于识别接收从其他邮箱移动或复制项目的邮箱所有者。

DestinationFileExtension.description: File extension of a file copied or moved in the SharePoint or OneDrive operation recorded by this row; combine with DestinationFileName to profile the item moved.
DestinationFileExtension.description_zh: 本行所记录 SharePoint 或 OneDrive 操作中复制或移动文件的扩展名；可与 DestinationFileName 结合，分析被移动的项目。

DestinationFileName.description: Name of the file copied or moved in the file operation captured by this row; use with SourceFileName and DestinationRelativeUrl to trace the file's movement.
DestinationFileName.description_zh: 本行捕获的文件操作中复制或移动文件的名称；可与 SourceFileName、DestinationRelativeUrl 一起追踪文件移动。

DestinationRelativeUrl.description: URL of the destination folder where a file was copied or moved in this row; pair with Site_Url and SourceRelativeUrl to reconstruct the path taken.
DestinationRelativeUrl.description_zh: 本行中文件被复制或移动到的目标文件夹 URL；可与 Site_Url、SourceRelativeUrl 配对，还原所经过的路径。

EffectiveOrganization.description: Name of the tenant or organization targeted by the elevation or cmdlet activity in this row; helps scope administrative actions across organizations in multi-tenant audit data.
EffectiveOrganization.description_zh: 本行提权或 cmdlet 活动所针对的租户或组织名称；有助于在多租户审核数据中限定跨组织管理操作的范围。

ElevationApprovedTime.description: Timestamp when the administrative elevation recorded in this row was approved; compare with TimeGenerated and ElevationDuration to assess the elevation window.
ElevationApprovedTime.description_zh: 本行所记录管理提权被批准的时间戳；可与 TimeGenerated、ElevationDuration 比较，评估提权窗口。

ElevationApprover.description: Name of the Microsoft manager who approved the elevation in this row; use with ElevationRequestId and ElevationRole when reviewing privileged access approvals.
ElevationApprover.description_zh: 批准本行提权的 Microsoft 经理姓名；在审查特权访问批准时，可与 ElevationRequestId、ElevationRole 一起使用。

ElevationDuration.description: Duration, in hours per official description, for which the administrative elevation in this row was active; combine with elevation timestamps to assess exposure length.
ElevationDuration.description_zh: 按官方描述以小时计的本行管理提权有效持续时间；可与提权时间戳结合，评估暴露时长。

ElevationRequestId.description: Identifier of the elevation request tied to this row; it links related elevation operations for the same privileged role grant. Use it to group a request's lifecycle, but check Other rows with the same value may span approver and approval events.
ElevationRequestId.description_zh: 本行所关联提权请求的标识符，用于关联同一特权角色授予的相关提权操作。可用它把某次请求的生命周期分组；但同一值可能横跨审批人与批准事件，需核对。

ElevationRole.description: The privileged role that was requested or granted in this elevation event. Compare it against the actor and approver fields on the same row to spot unusual or standing high-privilege access that deserves review.
ElevationRole.description_zh: 本次提权事件中申请或授予的特权角色。可与同一行的操作者及审批人字段比对，以发现值得复核的异常或长期高权限访问。

ElevationTime.description: Start time of the elevation described by this row, which may differ from TimeGenerated. Use the gap between the two to judge when privileged access actually began versus when the record was written.
ElevationTime.description_zh: 本行所述提权的开始时间，可能与 TimeGenerated 不同。可用两者的时间差判断特权访问实际开始时间与记录写入时间的关系。

EventSource.description: SharePoint-side source marker for the event. The official note says possible values are SharePoint or ObjectModel, so treat it as a name-derived hint and confirm the actual value in your workspace data before relying on it.
EventSource.description_zh: 事件在 SharePoint 侧的来源标记。官方说明称可能取值为 SharePoint 或 ObjectModel，故应视为依据名称的推测，并在实际工作区数据中确认取值后再依赖它。

Event_Data.description: Optional payload carried on custom events, typically JSON-like content specific to the operation that produced this row. Inspect it when the standard Operation and object fields are too coarse to explain what happened.
Event_Data.description_zh: 自定义事件上携带的可选负载，通常是产生该行的操作所特有的类 JSON 内容。当常规 Operation 与对象字段不足以说明发生了什么时，可检查该字段。

ExtendedProperties.description: Additional properties attached to a Microsoft Entra related event in this table, holding values outside the standard columns. Parse it when investigating directory-linked activity and the usual fields do not explain the operation.
ExtendedProperties.description_zh: 本表中与 Microsoft Entra 相关事件附带的扩展属性，存放标准列之外的值。调查与目录相关的活动而常规字段无法解释该操作时，可解析该字段。

ExternalAccess.description: Flags whether the cmdlet or operation was run by a user inside your organization or from outside it. Use it to separate internal administrative activity from external or federated access when reviewing tenant changes.
ExternalAccess.description_zh: 标记该 cmdlet 或操作是由组织内用户还是组织外用户执行。在审查租户变更时，可用它区分内部管理活动与外部或联合访问。

ExtraProperties.description: Dynamic collection of additional, workload-specific properties for this event beyond the standard columns. Treat its structure as variable and inspect the resource and category context before assuming which keys are present.
ExtraProperties.description_zh: 本事件在标准列之外附带的、因工作负载而异的动态附加属性集合。其结构并不固定，在假设存在哪些键之前，应先查看资源与类别上下文。

Folder.description: The folder that contained the item acted upon in this row, such as the mailbox or site folder involved. Combine it with the actor, item, and operation fields to reconstruct where an action took place.
Folder.description_zh: 本行所操作项所在的文件夹，例如涉及的邮箱或站点文件夹。可与操作者、项及操作字段结合，还原操作发生的位置。

Folders.description: Aggregated information about the source folders involved in a multi-folder operation on this row. Use it when a single Folder value cannot capture an operation that touched several folders at once.
Folders.description_zh: 本行所涉及多文件夹操作的源文件夹汇总信息。当单个 Folder 值无法涵盖一次同时触及多个文件夹的操作时，可使用该字段。

GenericInfo.description: Free-form supplemental information attached to some operations, used for comments and similar generic detail. Read it for context an operation lacked elsewhere, but do not treat it as structured or guaranteed.
GenericInfo.description_zh: 部分操作附带的自由格式补充信息，用于注释及类似的一般性细节。可读取它获取操作在其他地方缺失的上下文，但不要视其为结构化或必然存在。

InterSystemsId.description: Per official documentation, a GUID tracking actions across components within the Office 365 service. It can help correlate related events from different parts of the service, but confirm correlation on your data rather than assuming uniqueness.
InterSystemsId.description_zh: 据官方文档，这是在 Office 365 服务内部跨组件追踪操作的 GUID。它有助于关联服务不同部分产生的相关事件，但应在自有数据上确认关联性，不要预设其唯一性。

InternalLogonType.description: Integer value the official documentation marks as reserved for internal use, so its meaning and enumerations are not documented. Do not interpret it as a standard logon type; inspect the surrounding event context instead.
InternalLogonType.description_zh: 官方文档标注为内部使用的整数值，其含义与取值枚举均无文档说明。不要将其解读为标准登录类型，应改为查看事件周边上下文。

IntraSystemId.description: Per official documentation, a GUID generated by Microsoft Entra ID to track the action represented by this row, distinct from the service-side InterSystemsId. Use both cautiously to join related events.
IntraSystemId.description_zh: 据官方文档，这是 Microsoft Entra ID 为追踪本行所述操作而生成的 GUID，与服务侧的 InterSystemsId 不同。可谨慎地用两者关联相关事件。

IsManagedDevice.description: Boolean indicating whether the operation was performed from a device managed by the organization. It supports device-trust checks, but a false or missing value alone does not prove an unmanaged or malicious endpoint.
IsManagedDevice.description_zh: 布尔值，表示该操作是否由组织管理的设备执行。可用于设备可信性检查，但仅凭 false 或缺失值并不能证明端点未受管理或属恶意。

Item.description: The item on which the operation in this row was performed, as recorded for that workload. Pair it with ItemType, the user, and the operation to identify what was touched during an investigation.
Item.description_zh: 本行操作所针对的项，按相应工作负载记录。可与 ItemType、用户及操作结合，在调查中识别被触及的具体对象。

ItemName.description: Official documentation describes this as the string in the Subject field of the email message for mail-related rows. Use it to identify message content context, and expect it to be absent on non-mail operations.
ItemName.description_zh: 官方文档称对邮件类行而言，该字段是电子邮件主题字段中的字符串。可用它识别邮件内容上下文，并预期非邮件操作上该字段缺失。

ItemType.description: The kind of object accessed or modified by this operation, per the documented ItemType reference. Use it with the operation and object identifiers to distinguish file, folder, and message activity across workloads.
ItemType.description_zh: 本次操作访问或修改的对象种类，参见文档中的 ItemType 参考。可与操作及对象标识符配合，区分各工作负载中的文件、文件夹和邮件活动。

LoginStatus.description: Integer value documented as taken from OrgIdLogon.LoginStatus, where failures map to various codes. Use it to find failed sign-in-related operations, and verify the code meanings against your data before alerting.
LoginStatus.description_zh: 文档说明取自 OrgIdLogon.LoginStatus 的整数值，不同取值对应不同失败情况。可用它查找与登录失败相关的操作，并在告警前依据自有数据核实各代码含义。

LogonUserDisplayName.description: Friendly display name of the user who performed the operation recorded on this row. Use it alongside the SID and user identifiers to confirm the actor when investigating account activity.
LogonUserDisplayName.description_zh: 执行本行所记录操作的用户的可读显示名。调查账户活动时，可与 SID 及用户标识符配合确认操作者身份。

LogonUserSid.description: Security identifier of the user who performed the operation on this row. Because names can change or be reused, use the SID to tie activity to a specific account during investigation.
LogonUserSid.description_zh: 执行本行操作的用户的安全标识符。由于名称可能变更或被复用，调查中应用 SID 将活动关联到具体账户。

Logon_Type.description: Indicates the type of user who accessed the mailbox and performed the logged operation. Use it to distinguish interactive, delegated, or service-style access when reviewing mailbox activity.
Logon_Type.description_zh: 表示访问邮箱并执行所记录操作的用户类型。在审查邮箱活动时，可用它区分交互式、委派式或服务式访问。

MachineDomainInfo.description: Official documentation describes this as information about device sync operations. Use it as context around synchronization activity, and verify what it actually contains for your workload before drawing conclusions.
MachineDomainInfo.description_zh: 官方文档称其为有关设备同步操作的信息。可将它用作同步活动周边的上下文，并在下结论前核实其在相应工作负载中的实际内容。

MachineId.description: Official documentation also describes this as information about device sync operations, typically identifying the syncing device. Use it to correlate sync activity to a device, checking the surrounding context first.
MachineId.description_zh: 官方文档同样称其为有关设备同步操作的信息，通常用于标识执行同步的设备。可用它将同步活动关联到设备，但应先查看周边上下文。

MailboxGuid.description: Exchange GUID of the mailbox touched by this operation; scopes mailbox activity to a specific mailbox object rather than a named owner, useful alongside mailbox ownership and client IP fields.
MailboxGuid.description_zh: 本次操作所涉及邮箱的 Exchange GUID，将邮箱活动定位到具体的邮箱对象而非具名所有者，常与邮箱归属和客户端 IP 字段配合使用。

MailboxOwnerMasterAccountSid.description: Master account SID of the mailbox owner for this event; helps identify the owning account when resolving aliases or linked mailboxes during Exchange access investigations.
MailboxOwnerMasterAccountSid.description_zh: 本事件中邮箱所有者的主账户 SID；在 Exchange 访问调查中解析别名或链接邮箱时，有助于确定实际归属账户。

MailboxOwnerSid.description: Security identifier of the mailbox owner whose mailbox this activity concerns; supports account-level correlation when UPN naming is ambiguous or duplicated.
MailboxOwnerSid.description_zh: 本次活动所涉邮箱所有者的安全标识符；当 UPN 命名含糊或重复时，可用于账户级别的关联分析。

MailboxOwnerUPN.description: Sign-in name of the person owning the mailbox accessed in this event; distinguishes the mailbox owner from the actor when activity is performed by delegates or administrators.
MailboxOwnerUPN.description_zh: 本事件中被访问邮箱所有者的登录名；当活动由代理人或管理员执行时，可借此区分邮箱所有者与实际操作者。

Members.description: Dynamic list of users associated with a Team in this row, typically on membership add or remove events; compare against TargetUserOrGroupName to identify who was added or removed.
Members.description_zh: 本行中与某个团队关联的用户动态列表，通常出现在成员添加或移除事件中；可与 TargetUserOrGroupName 对比，判断被添加或移除的对象。

MessageId.description: Identifier of a chat or channel message referenced by this record; use it to group related message operations and correlate a message across events.
MessageId.description_zh: 本记录所引用聊天或频道消息的标识符；可用于对相关消息操作分组，并将同一条消息在不同事件间关联起来。

ModifiedObjectResolvedName.description: Friendly name of the object modified by the recorded cmdlet; makes admin or configuration changes readable when the underlying object identifier is opaque.
ModifiedObjectResolvedName.description_zh: 所记录 cmdlet 修改对象的易读名称；当底层对象标识不易理解时，它能让管理员或配置变更更易识别。

ModifiedProperties.description: Structured description of properties changed in admin events, such as group membership or site collection administrators; inspect it to see which attributes changed and to what.
ModifiedProperties.description_zh: 管理员事件中被修改属性的结构化描述，例如组成员资格或网站集管理员；可通过它查看具体哪些属性发生了变更及变更内容。

Name.description: Name of the setting that changed in settings events only; pairs with OldValue and NewValue to show which tenant or workload configuration was altered.
Name.description_zh: 仅在设置事件中出现，表示被更改设置的名称；与 OldValue、NewValue 配合，可显示被修改的是哪项租户或工作负载配置。

NewValue.description: New value assigned to the setting in settings events only; compare with OldValue to determine the direction and impact of a configuration change.
NewValue.description_zh: 仅在设置事件中出现，表示设置被赋予的新值；与 OldValue 比较可判断配置变更的方向及影响。

OfficeId.description: Unique identifier of the audit record in this table, useful for citation and for correlating the same exported event across queries or downstream alerts.
OfficeId.description_zh: 本表中审核记录的唯一标识符，便于引用以及在不同查询或下游告警间关联同一条导出事件。

OfficeObjectId.description: Identifier of the SharePoint or OneDrive for Business object involved; use it to trace a specific file, item or site across related access and sharing events.
OfficeObjectId.description_zh: 所涉 SharePoint 或 OneDrive for Business 对象的标识符；可用于在一系列相关访问与共享事件中追踪同一文件、项目或站点。

OfficeTenantId.description: Office tenant identifier recorded for this event; group by it to separate activity from different tenants sharing the same workspace before scoping user and object analysis.
OfficeTenantId.description_zh: 本事件记录的 Office 租户标识符；按它分组可区分共享同一工作区的不同租户活动，然后再对用户和对象进行分析。

OfficeTenantId_.description: Additional field whose exact semantics are not documented; treat the name as name-derived, inspect the surrounding resource, workload and category context before relying on it.
OfficeTenantId_.description_zh: 该附加字段的确切含义未有文档说明；其名称仅为推断，使用前应检查周边资源、工作负载和类别上下文再作判断。

OfficeWorkload.description: Office 365 service in which the activity occurred, such as Exchange or SharePoint; primary scoping field because many columns exist only for particular workloads.
OfficeWorkload.description_zh: 活动发生的 Office 365 服务，例如 Exchange 或 SharePoint；这是主要的范围限定字段，因为许多列仅对特定工作负载存在。

OldValue.description: Previous value of the setting in settings events only; compare with NewValue to reconstruct what a configuration change replaced before and after.
OldValue.description_zh: 仅在设置事件中出现，表示设置变更前的旧值；与 NewValue 对比可还原配置变更前后的内容。

Operation.description: Name of the action the user or administrator performed in this event; the key field for grouping and filtering activity types during workload-specific investigations.
Operation.description_zh: 本事件中用户或管理员执行操作的名称；在工作负载专项调查中，是按活动类型分组和筛选的关键字段。

OperationProperties.description: Dynamic structure carrying extra properties for this operation; contents vary by Operation and OfficeWorkload, so inspect per activity rather than assuming a fixed schema.
OperationProperties.description_zh: 承载本次操作附加属性的动态结构；其内容随 Operation 和 OfficeWorkload 变化，应逐类活动查看而不可假定固定结构。

OperationScope.description: Scope within which the recorded operation was performed; clarifies whether a change applied to a user, group, site or tenant level object.
OperationScope.description_zh: 所记录操作执行的范围；有助于判断变更作用于用户、组、站点还是租户级别的对象。

OrganizationId.description: GUID identifying the Office 365 tenant organization for this event; stable per organization, it scopes results to one tenant rather than identifying a directory object.
OrganizationId.description_zh: 标识本事件所属 Office 365 租户组织的 GUID；对同一组织保持不变，用于将结果限定在一个租户，而非标识目录对象。

OrganizationId_.description: Additional organization identifier field without documented semantics; treat as name-derived and verify against OrganizationId and the surrounding workload context before use.
OrganizationId_.description_zh: 另一个组织标识字段，其语义未有文档说明；应按推断对待，使用前与 OrganizationId 及周边工作负载上下文核对。

OrganizationName.description: Display name of the tenant organization in this record; helps analysts recognize the tenant when GUIDs are unfamiliar or several tenants are under investigation.
OrganizationName.description_zh: 本记录中租户组织的显示名称；当 GUID 不熟悉或有多个租户待调查时，有助于分析人员识别租户。

OriginatingServer.description: Name of the server from which the recorded cmdlet was executed; often a client or mailbox server, helping place an administrative action on a host.
OriginatingServer.description_zh: 执行所记录 cmdlet 的服务器名称，通常是客户端或邮箱服务器；有助于将管理操作定位到具体主机。

Parameters.description: Names and values of all parameters used with the cmdlet named in Operation; inspect to reconstruct exactly how an administrative action was invoked.
Parameters.description_zh: 与 Operation 中所指 cmdlet 一同使用的全部参数名称和值；查看它可还原管理操作的具体调用方式。

RecordType.description: Categorizes the audit record kind within OfficeActivity, such as Exchange item, SharePoint file or Teams operation. Use it to scope an investigation to a workload's record family before filtering on Operation or UserId.
RecordType.description_zh: 按 OfficeActivity 内的审核记录种类进行分类，例如 Exchange 项、SharePoint 文件或 Teams 操作。调查时可先用它限定某工作负载的记录族，再按 Operation 或 UserId 过滤。

ResultReasonType.description: Gives the reason associated with the outcome reported in ResultStatus for this audited Office operation, such as why a failure occurred. Use it alongside ResultStatus to explain denied or failed actions by a user or client.
ResultReasonType.description_zh: 说明该 Office 审核操作在 ResultStatus 中报告的结果原因，例如失败的原因。可与 ResultStatus 配合，解释某用户或客户端的拒绝或失败操作。

ResultStatus.description: Indicates whether the audited operation described by this row succeeded or failed. Pair it with Operation, UserId and TimeGenerated to isolate failed access, sharing or mailbox actions by a specific actor.
ResultStatus.description_zh: 指示本行所描述审核操作是成功还是失败。可与 Operation、UserId 和 TimeGenerated 配合，定位特定主体失败的访问、共享或邮箱操作。

SRPolicyId.description: Identifier of the policy that matched this OfficeActivity row, generally for Insider Risk or communication compliance scenarios. Use it with SRPolicyName and SRRuleMatchDetails to correlate flagged activity back to a named policy.
SRPolicyId.description_zh: 匹配本 OfficeActivity 行的策略标识符，通常用于内部风险或通信合规场景。可与 SRPolicyName 和 SRRuleMatchDetails 配合，将被标记的活动关联到具名策略。

SRPolicyName.description: Human-readable name of the policy matched for this Office activity. Use it to group rows by policy when reviewing which users or operations triggered compliance or insider-risk policy hits.
SRPolicyName.description_zh: 匹配本 Office 活动的策略可读名称。可按策略分组行，查看哪些用户或操作触发了合规或内部风险策略命中。

SRRuleMatchDetails.description: Dynamic structure carrying rule-level detail for a policy match on this OfficeActivity row. Inspect its contents to see which conditions fired; the exact JSON shape is scenario-dependent and should be examined per record.
SRRuleMatchDetails.description_zh: 动态结构，承载本 OfficeActivity 行策略匹配的规则级细节。可检查其内容了解触发了哪些条件；具体 JSON 结构因场景而异，需按记录查看。

Scope.description: Name-derived field whose semantics are not documented for OfficeActivity; it likely scopes the audited action or object. Inspect surrounding workload, record type and operation context before relying on it.
Scope.description_zh: 名称推断字段，OfficeActivity 未记录其语义，可能用于限定被审核的操作或对象范围。使用前应结合工作负载、记录类型和操作上下文判断。

SendAsUserMailboxGuid.description: Exchange GUID of the mailbox accessed when a user sent mail as another identity in this OfficeActivity record. Correlate with SendAsUserSmtp and LogonUserSid to trace mailbox impersonation.
SendAsUserMailboxGuid.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 记录中用户以他人身份发送邮件时所访问邮箱的 Exchange GUID。可与 SendAsUserSmtp 和 LogonUserSid 关联，追踪邮箱模拟发送。

SendAsUserSmtp.description: SMTP address of the user being impersonated when a SendAs action is audited in OfficeActivity. Use it with SendAsUserMailboxGuid and actor fields to identify whose mailbox identity was assumed.
SendAsUserSmtp.description_zh: OfficeActivity 中审核到 SendAs 操作时，被模拟用户的 SMTP 地址。可与 SendAsUserMailboxGuid 及主体字段配合，识别被冒用的邮箱身份。

SendOnBehalfOfUserSmtp.description: SMTP address of the user on whose behalf mail was sent in this OfficeActivity row. Compare with the acting user and SendOnBehalfOfUserMailboxGuid to distinguish delegated sending from direct SendAs activity.
SendOnBehalfOfUserSmtp.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 行中代表其发送邮件的用户 SMTP 地址。可与实际操作者及 SendOnBehalfOfUserMailboxGuid 比较，区分委派发送与直接 SendAs 活动。

SendonBehalfOfUserMailboxGuid.description: Exchange GUID of the mailbox accessed to send mail on behalf of another user in this OfficeActivity record. Pair it with SendOnBehalfOfUserSmtp when investigating delegated mailbox sending.
SendonBehalfOfUserMailboxGuid.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 记录中代表他人发送邮件时所访问邮箱的 Exchange GUID。调查委派邮箱发送时，可与 SendOnBehalfOfUserSmtp 配合使用。

SharingType.description: Describes the sharing permission level assigned when a resource was shared, applicable to the UserSharedWith recipient in this OfficeActivity record. Use it to assess whether sharing exposed content broadly or narrowly.
SharingType.description_zh: 描述资源被共享时分配的共享权限级别，对应本 OfficeActivity 记录中的 UserSharedWith 接收者。可用于判断共享是广泛暴露还是范围有限。

Site_.description: GUID of the SharePoint or OneDrive site where the file or folder in this OfficeActivity row resides. Useful for grouping user file activity by site when investigating access or exfiltration.
Site_.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 行中文件或文件夹所在 SharePoint 或 OneDrive 站点的 GUID。按站点分组用户文件活动，便于调查访问或数据外泄。

Site_Url.description: URL of the SharePoint or OneDrive site containing the file or folder accessed in this OfficeActivity row. Pivot on it to review activity against a specific site or document library.
Site_Url.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 行中访问的文件或文件夹所在 SharePoint 或 OneDrive 站点的 URL。可据此查看针对特定站点或文档库的活动。

Site_Url_.description: Name-derived field whose documented meaning is unavailable, likely a site URL variant associated with this OfficeActivity row. Inspect the record's workload and site context before interpreting it.
Site_Url_.description_zh: 名称推断字段，官方文档未给出含义，可能是与本 OfficeActivity 行相关的站点 URL 变体。解释前应查看记录的工作负载和站点上下文。

SourceFileExtension.description: Extension of the file accessed by the user in this OfficeActivity row, such as docx or pdf. Use it to filter or profile sensitive file types during SharePoint or OneDrive investigations.
SourceFileExtension.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 行中用户访问文件的扩展名，例如 docx 或 pdf。在 SharePoint 或 OneDrive 调查中可据此过滤或刻画敏感文件类型。

SourceFileName.description: Name of the file or folder accessed by the user in this OfficeActivity record. Combine with Site_Url, UserId and Operation to track who touched a particular document and when.
SourceFileName.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 记录中用户访问的文件或文件夹名称。可与 Site_Url、UserId 和 Operation 结合，追踪谁在何时触碰了特定文档。

SourceFileName_.description: Name-derived field without documented semantics for OfficeActivity, likely a source file name variant on this row. Verify against related file and site fields before using it in analysis.
SourceFileName_.description_zh: 名称推断字段，OfficeActivity 未记录其语义，可能是本行源文件名变体。使用前应结合相关文件与站点字段核实。

SourceRecordId.description: Unique identifier of the audit record in OfficeActivity, useful for referencing or deduplicating a specific event. It is not the export row number and should be used with TimeGenerated for ordering.
SourceRecordId.description_zh: OfficeActivity 中审核记录的唯一标识符，可用于引用或去重特定事件。它不是导出序号，应与 TimeGenerated 一起用于排序。

SourceRelativeUrl.description: URL of the folder containing the file accessed by the user in this OfficeActivity row. Use it with Site_Url and SourceFileName to reconstruct the document path in SharePoint or OneDrive.
SourceRelativeUrl.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 行中用户访问文件所在文件夹的 URL。可与 Site_Url 和 SourceFileName 配合，还原 SharePoint 或 OneDrive 中的文档路径。

SourceRelativeUrl_.description: Name-derived field whose documented meaning is absent, likely a relative URL variant tied to this OfficeActivity row. Inspect site and folder context before drawing conclusions from it.
SourceRelativeUrl_.description_zh: 名称推断字段，官方文档未给出含义，可能是与本 OfficeActivity 行相关的相对 URL 变体。应结合站点和文件夹上下文再下结论。

SourceSystem.description: Identifies the collection agent or pipeline that delivered this OfficeActivity record to the workspace. Use it to understand ingestion provenance when combining or comparing records across sources.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 标识将本 OfficeActivity 记录送入工作区的采集代理或管道。合并或比较不同来源记录时，可用它了解摄取来源。

Source_Name.description: Entity that triggered the audited SharePoint operation, with documented values such as SharePoint or ObjectModel, on this OfficeActivity row. Use it to separate user-driven actions from object-model or service-driven changes.
Source_Name.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 行中触发被审核 SharePoint 操作的实体，官方取值包括 SharePoint 或 ObjectModel。可用于区分用户驱动操作与对象模型或服务驱动变更。

Start_Time.description: Date and time at which the audited cmdlet or operation in this OfficeActivity row was executed. Use it to order events and build timelines alongside TimeGenerated for the same activity.
Start_Time.description_zh: 本 OfficeActivity 行中被审核 cmdlet 或操作的执行日期和时间。可与 TimeGenerated 一起对事件排序，为同一活动构建时间线。

SupportTicketId.description: Customer support ticket identifier recorded when an action was performed on behalf of a user in a support scenario; use to correlate Office 365 admin support activity with an external ticket.
SupportTicketId.description_zh: 在支持场景中代表用户执行操作时记录的客户支持工单标识符；用于将 Office 365 管理员支持活动与外部工单关联。

TabType.description: Type of Teams tab that generated the event; useful when triaging Teams tab add, update or removal operations, and should be read alongside the operation and team context.
TabType.description_zh: 生成该事件的 Teams 选项卡类型；在排查 Teams 选项卡添加、更新或删除操作时有用，应结合操作和团队上下文解读。

TargetContextId.description: GUID of the organization that the targeted user belongs to; use to confirm cross-organization targeting in admin actions, not as the workspace or initiating user's tenant.
TargetContextId.description_zh: 目标用户所属组织的 GUID；用于确认管理员操作中的跨组织目标，而非工作区或发起用户的租户。

TargetUserId.description: Identifier of the user targeted by the recorded operation; pair with the actor fields to distinguish who performed the action from whom it affected.
TargetUserId.description_zh: 被记录操作所针对的目标用户标识符；与操作者字段配合，区分执行动作的人和被影响的人。

TargetUserOrGroupName.description: UPN or name of the user or group a resource was shared with; central for investigating SharePoint, OneDrive or Teams sharing events and their recipients.
TargetUserOrGroupName.description_zh: 资源被共享给的用户或组的 UPN 或名称；是调查 SharePoint、OneDrive 或 Teams 共享事件及其接收者的核心字段。

TargetUserOrGroupType.description: Classifies the sharing target as member, guest, group or partner; inspect it to weigh whether sharing crossed organizational boundaries, but verify against directory data.
TargetUserOrGroupType.description_zh: 将共享目标分类为成员、来宾、组或合作伙伴；可用它评估共享是否跨越组织边界，但应与目录数据相互印证。

TeamGuid.description: Unique identifier of the Microsoft Teams team involved in the audited event; use to group related team activity across operations and correlate with team names.
TeamGuid.description_zh: 被审核事件涉及的 Microsoft Teams 团队的唯一标识符；用于按操作聚合相关团队活动，并与团队名称关联。

TeamName.description: Display name of the Teams team being audited; helpful for readable reporting and pivoting, though names may change and should be paired with TeamGuid.
TeamName.description_zh: 被审核的 Teams 团队显示名称；便于生成可读报告和关联分析，但名称可能变更，应与 TeamGuid 配合使用。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier that stores the record; scope queries by it, and do not treat it as the Microsoft Entra directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 存储该记录的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符；查询时应按它限定范围，不要将其视为 Microsoft Entra 目录租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC date and time when the user activity was performed; primary time filter for scoping Office 365 audit investigations and building activity timelines.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 用户操作执行时的 UTC 日期和时间；是限定 Office 365 审核调查范围和构建活动时间线的主要时间过滤字段。

Type.description: Name of the table the record resides in; on OfficeActivity rows it identifies the source table and helps when writing cross-table unions or filters.
Type.description_zh: 记录所在表的名称；在 OfficeActivity 行中标识来源表，有助于编写跨表联合查询或过滤。

UserAgent.description: Client user agent string supplied with the operation; supports distinguishing browser, native client or automation tooling, though it can be spoofed and is not proof of identity.
UserAgent.description_zh: 操作附带的客户端 User-Agent 字符串；有助于区分浏览器、本机客户端或自动化工具，但可被伪造，不能作为身份证明。

UserDomain.description: Domain portion of the user who performed the activity; useful for grouping activity by domain or organization, and for spotting external or unexpected domains.
UserDomain.description_zh: 执行活动的用户所属域部分；可用于按域或组织汇总活动，并识别外部或异常域。

UserId.description: UPN of the user who performed the logged operation; the main actor field for who-did-what questions and for correlating activity across workloads.
UserId.description_zh: 执行被记录操作的用户的 UPN；是回答“谁做了什么”的主要操作者字段，并用于跨工作负载关联活动。

UserId_.description: Additional user identifier column whose exact semantics are name-derived and not documented here; inspect the record context and workload before relying on it.
UserId_.description_zh: 附加用户标识符列，其确切语义由名称推断且未在此记录；依赖它之前应先检查记录上下文和工作负载。

UserKey.description: Alternative identifier for the user named in UserId; use to join activity when UPN changes or when correlating records across services that report different user keys.
UserKey.description_zh: UserId 中所指用户的替代标识符；当 UPN 变化或需关联报告不同用户键的服务记录时，可用它进行连接。

UserSharedWith.description: User with whom a resource was shared; investigate SharePoint, OneDrive or file sharing events, and validate whether the recipient was authorized for that content.
UserSharedWith.description_zh: 资源被共享给的用户；用于调查 SharePoint、OneDrive 或文件共享事件，并核实该接收者是否被授权访问该内容。

UserType.description: Category of user that performed the operation, such as regular, admin or system account; use to separate administrative actions from ordinary user activity in an investigation.
UserType.description_zh: 执行操作的用户类别，如普通用户、管理员或系统账户；用于在调查中将管理操作与普通用户活动区分开。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier of the Azure resource associated with the record; use for resource-scoped filtering or joins, and note it may be empty for some ingested logs.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该记录关联的 Azure 资源的唯一标识符；可用于按资源过滤或联接，并注意部分引入日志中它可能为空。

Operation.description: Operation records workspace-level operational activities that affect a Log Analytics workspace, from user-initiated changes to service notifications such as data-capping. It answers questions about what happened, when, to which computer or workspace, and whether it succeeded. Use OperationCategory, Solution and SourceSystem to pivot by producing area; Computer, SourceComputerId and _ResourceId to scope assets; OperationStatus for outcomes. It differs from configuration-change or per-agent heartbeat tables by holding workspace-operation notifications rather than continuous machine telemetry.
Operation.description_zh: Operation 记录影响 Log Analytics 工作区的运维活动，既有用户发起的操作，也有数据上限等服务通知。可用于回答发生了什么、何时发生、涉及哪台计算机或工作区、是否成功。可按 OperationCategory、Solution、SourceSystem 透视来源；用 Computer、SourceComputerId、_ResourceId 限定资产；用 OperationStatus 判断结果。它与配置变更表或按代理心跳表不同，保存的是工作区操作通知而非持续机器遥测。

Computer.description: Name of the physical or virtual machine with Log Analytics agent membership that this operation relates to. Use it to pivot operations by host during investigation.
Computer.description_zh: 与此操作相关、具备 Log Analytics 代理成员资格的物理或虚拟机名称。调查中可按主机透视操作记录。

CorrelationId.description: GUID shared with telemetry belonging to the same overarching action. Use it to correlate records across tables and operations that are part of one activity.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 与同一整体操作遥测共享的 GUID。可用于关联同一活动在各表和操作中的记录。

Detail.description: Human-readable text giving further context about the operation. Use it to understand what occurred and to search for specific messages, but treat wording as contextual, not a structured status.
Detail.description_zh: 提供操作更多上下文的可读文本。可用于理解发生了什么并搜索特定消息，但应视为上下文描述而非结构化状态。

ErrorId.description: Deprecated field that may hold an error identifier for failed operations. Do not rely on it for current detection; verify against OperationStatus and Detail before asserting failure causes.
ErrorId.description_zh: 已弃用字段，可能保存失败操作的错误标识符。不应据此进行当前检测；断言失败原因前请结合 OperationStatus 和 Detail 核对。

HelpLink.description: Reference URL pointing to additional contextual documentation for this operation. Use it to find vendor guidance when an operation failed or needs explanation.
HelpLink.description_zh: 指向该操作附加上下文文档的参考 URL。当操作失败或需要解释时，可据此查找厂商指引。

MG.description: Name-derived abbreviation likely indicating a management group or similar scope; official description is absent. Treat as unverified and inspect ManagementGroupName and OperationCategory context before relying on it.
MG.description_zh: 从名称推断可能表示管理组或类似范围，官方无描述。应视为未证实，使用前请结合 ManagementGroupName 和 OperationCategory 上下文核对。

ManagementGroupName.description: Operations Manager management group name for System Center agents reporting this operation. Use it to attribute operations to a specific management group during multi-group investigations.
ManagementGroupName.description_zh: 上报该操作的 System Center 代理所属 Operations Manager 管理组名称。多管理组调查时可用它将操作归属到特定管理组。

OperationCategory.description: Names the area or component that produced this operation record. Use it to group and filter operations by producing subsystem when investigating workspace activity.
OperationCategory.description_zh: 产生此操作记录的区域或组件名称。调查工作区活动时可用它按产生子系统分组和筛选操作。

OperationKey.description: Operation identifier, which can be a GUID or string. Use it to group or trace records for the same operation, recognizing it is not documented as globally unique across the table.
OperationKey.description_zh: 操作标识符，可为 GUID 或字符串。可用于对同一操作的记录分组或追踪，但文档未保证其在表中全局唯一。

OperationStatus.description: Outcome description for the operation, with values such as Succeeded, Failed, Warning or Error. Use it to triage which workspace activities need follow-up or indicate failure.
OperationStatus.description_zh: 操作结果描述，常见值如 Succeeded、Failed、Warning、Error。可用于筛选需要跟进或表明失败的工作区活动。

Solution.description: Managed solution or other source (such as RestAPI) that produced the record. Use it to attribute operations to a solution when separating service-generated notifications from user actions.
Solution.description_zh: 产生该记录的托管解决方案或其他来源（如 RestAPI）。用于把操作归属到某解决方案，并区分服务通知与用户操作。

SourceComputerId.description: Unique GUID for the computer associated with this operation. Use it to link an operation to a machine reliably even if the displayed Computer name is duplicated or changed.
SourceComputerId.description_zh: 与该操作关联的计算机唯一 GUID。即使显示的 Computer 名称重复或变化，也可用它可靠地将操作关联到某台机器。

SourceSystem.description: Names the collection channel that delivered this operation record, such as OpsManager, Linux or Azure. Use it to separate agent types when comparing operation sources.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 标明提供该操作记录的采集通道，如 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure。比较操作来源时可用它区分不同代理类型。

TenantId.description: Workspace identifier associated with the record in this log; use it to scope queries when several workspaces feed the same table, not as a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 此日志记录关联的工作区标识符；当多个工作区写入同一表时用于限定查询范围，不代表目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when the operation record was created. Use it for time-bounding activity around workspace changes or service notifications, correlating with other tables during investigations.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 操作记录创建的时间戳。可用于限定工作区变更或服务通知的时间窗口，并在调查中与其他表关联。

Type.description: Holds the table name for the record. Use it in queries and filters to confirm you are reading the Operation table rather than another type in the same workspace.
Type.description_zh: 保存该记录的表名称。可用于查询和筛选，确认读取的是 Operation 表而非工作区中的其他类型。

_ResourceId.description: Unique identifier for the resource associated with this operation record. Use it to scope or join operations to a specific workspace or resource during investigation.
_ResourceId.description_zh: 与该操作记录关联的资源的唯一标识符。调查中可用于限定范围或将操作联接到特定工作区或资源。

SecurityAlert.description: Microsoft Sentinel security alert records with affected entities, severity, detection context, status and remediation information. Use it to identify the host or account named by an alert and inspect automated investigation, analyst assignment or manually started investigation metadata when supplied in ExtendedProperties. Pivot on SystemAlertId, CompromisedEntity, Entities and the alert time window. Dynamic metadata varies by provider; SecurityIncident contains incident-level ownership and classification instead.
SecurityAlert.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Sentinel 安全告警的受影响实体、严重性、检测上下文、状态及修复信息。用于定位告警涉及的主机或账户，并在 ExtendedProperties 有提供时检查自动调查、分析员分配或手动发起调查的元数据；可通过 SystemAlertId、CompromisedEntity、Entities 和告警时间范围关联。动态元数据因提供方而异；事件级负责人和分类应查 SecurityIncident。

AlertLink.description: URL linking to the alert in the generating security product's console, useful for pivoting to provider-side detail; treat as a reference, not evidence of compromise.
AlertLink.description_zh: 指向生成该警报的安全产品控制台中警报页面的 URL，可用于跳转到提供程序侧详情；应视为参考链接，而非入侵证据。

AlertName.description: Provider-defined identifier or name of the alert rule that fired, useful for grouping, counting, and comparing detections across the environment.
AlertName.description_zh: 触发该警报的规则名称，由提供程序定义，可用于分组、计数以及跨环境比较检测。

AlertSeverity.description: Severity assigned by the reporting provider to this alert; use to prioritize triage, remembering severity is provider judgment rather than confirmed impact.
AlertSeverity.description_zh: 上报提供程序为该警报分配的严重性；可用于确定分诊优先级，但需注意严重性只是提供程序判断，并非已确认影响。

AlertType.description: Provider-specific alert type classification; use to filter or group similar detections, interpreting the value in the context of the reporting provider.
AlertType.description_zh: 提供程序特定的警报类型分类；可用于筛选或分组相似检测，应结合上报提供程序的上下文解释其取值。

CompromisedEntity.description: Primary entity affected by the alert, which may be a hostname for device alerts. Use it to identify the reported host or account, then confirm its type in Entities.
CompromisedEntity.description_zh: 告警报告的主要受影响实体，设备告警中可能是主机名。可用于定位报告的主机或账户，再通过 Entities 确认实体类型。

ConfidenceLevel.description: Provider-assigned confidence category for this detection; use alongside severity when triaging, recognizing it is provider assessment rather than verified fact.
ConfidenceLevel.description_zh: 提供程序为该检测分配的置信度类别；分诊时可与严重性一同参考，但它是提供程序的评估，并非已核实的事实。

ConfidenceScore.description: Numeric confidence score assigned by the reporting provider for this alert; compare values within the same provider since scales may differ across products.
ConfidenceScore.description_zh: 上报提供程序为该警报分配的数值置信度评分；鉴于不同产品的评分范围可能不同，宜在同一提供程序内比较。

Description.description: Provider-written narrative explaining what the alert detected and why it fired; useful for triage context, but it reflects the provider's interpretation, not independent confirmation.
Description.description_zh: 提供程序撰写的说明，解释该警报检测到什么以及为何触发；有助于分诊理解，但反映的是提供程序的解读，并非独立确认。

DisplayName.description: Human-readable display title for the alert, often more descriptive than AlertName; use in reports and for searching similar alerts by name.
DisplayName.description_zh: 警报的易读显示标题，通常比 AlertName 更具描述性；可用于报告以及按名称搜索相似警报。

EndTime.description: Time the alert's underlying activity or detection window ended, as reported by the provider; pair with StartTime to bound the period to investigate.
EndTime.description_zh: 提供程序上报的该警报底层活动或检测窗口的结束时间；与 StartTime 配合可界定需要调查的时间段。

Entities.description: Structured payload listing entities (accounts, hosts, processes, files, IPs) referenced by the alert; parse to pivot into activity logs, treating entities as implicated rather than confirmed malicious.
Entities.description_zh: 列出警报所引用实体（账户、主机、进程、文件、IP）的结构化载荷；可解析后用于跳转至活动日志，实体只是被涉及，并非已确认恶意。

ExtendedLinks.description: Additional provider-supplied links related to this alert, beyond AlertLink; inspect their targets before relying on them as investigative references.
ExtendedLinks.description_zh: 除 AlertLink 之外，提供程序提供的与该警报相关的附加链接；在将其作为调查参考前，应先检查其指向的目标。

ExtendedProperties.description: Provider-specific alert metadata that may include analyst assignment, automated investigation identifiers or state, and remediation details. Inspect available keys before extracting investigation or manually initiated investigation information.
ExtendedProperties.description_zh: 提供方自定义的告警元数据，可能包含分析员分配、自动调查标识或状态以及修复详情。提取调查或手动发起调查信息前，应先检查实际存在的键。

IsIncident.description: Boolean indicating whether this alert was flagged as part of an incident at generation time; interpretation is provider-dependent and should not replace incident correlation yourself.
IsIncident.description_zh: 布尔值，指示该警报在生成时是否被标记为某个事件的一部分；其含义取决于提供程序，不应取代自行进行的事件关联。

ProcessingEndTime.description: Time the provider finished processing this alert; compare with EndTime and TimeGenerated to understand detection-to-ingestion latency.
ProcessingEndTime.description_zh: 提供程序完成处理该警报的时间；与 EndTime 和 TimeGenerated 比较，可了解从检测到写入的延迟。

ProductComponentName.description: Name-derived component within the product that generated the alert; inspect alongside ProductName to identify the originating feature, without assuming fixed component semantics.
ProductComponentName.description_zh: 根据名称推断，生成该警报的产品内部组件；应与 ProductName 结合查看以识别来源功能，不要假定组件含义固定不变。

ProductName.description: Name-derived product that generated the alert; group and filter by it to separate detections from different security products in the same workspace.
ProductName.description_zh: 根据名称推断，生成该警报的产品；可据此分组和筛选，以区分同一工作区内不同安全产品的检测。

ProviderName.description: Name of the security provider that raised the alert; use to scope alert semantics, severity scales, and extended property schemas to one provider.
ProviderName.description_zh: 发出该警报的安全提供程序名称；可据此将警报语义、严重性量表和扩展属性架构限定到单一提供程序。

RemediationSteps.description: Provider-suggested remediation actions for this alert; use as guidance for response, verifying applicability rather than executing blindly.
RemediationSteps.description_zh: 提供程序针对该警报建议的修复步骤；可作为响应指引，但应先核实其适用性，而非盲目执行。

ResourceId.description: Azure resource identifier of the resource the alert pertains to; pivot to resource-scoped logs and inventory, noting some alerts may lack a specific resource.
ResourceId.description_zh: 该警报所涉资源的 Azure 资源标识符；可用于跳转至资源范围日志和清点，但需注意部分警报可能没有具体资源。

SourceComputerId.description: Identifier of the source computer associated with the alert; join to device inventory or agent tables, scoping by time since identifiers relate to reporting agents.
SourceComputerId.description_zh: 与该警报关联的源计算机标识符；可联接设备清点或代理表，并因标识符关联上报代理而需按时间限定范围。

SourceSystem.description: Name-derived system or connector that delivered this alert record to the workspace; inspect to distinguish ingestion paths, since official documentation does not define its values.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 根据名称推断，将该警报记录写入工作区的系统或连接器；可通过检查区分不同摄取路径，因为官方文档未定义其取值。

StartTime.description: Time the alert's underlying activity or detection window began, per the provider; use with EndTime to scope the investigative time range.
StartTime.description_zh: 提供程序给出的该警报底层活动或检测窗口的开始时间；与 EndTime 配合可限定调查时间范围。

Status.description: Current lifecycle state of the alert as maintained in the workspace, such as active or resolved; use to filter open versus closed detections when triaging.
Status.description_zh: 该警报在工作区中维护的当前生命周期状态，例如活动或已解决；分诊时可用于筛选未关闭与已关闭的检测。

SubTechniques.description: Sub-technique identifiers or names mapped to this alert, refining the parent technique. Use with Tactics and Techniques to understand the specific adversary behavior the alert claims to detect; mapping is assertion, not proof.
SubTechniques.description_zh: 映射到该告警的子技术标识或名称，用于细化父技术。可与 Tactics 和 Techniques 一起理解告警声称检测到的具体对手行为；该映射是断言，并非证据。

SystemAlertId.description: Identifier assigned by the security system to this alert record. Use it to correlate the same alert across queries, joins and incident linkage; it identifies the alert, not the underlying event or device.
SystemAlertId.description_zh: 安全系统为该告警记录分配的标识符。可用于跨查询、连接和事件关联中关联同一告警；它标识的是告警，而不是底层事件或设备。

Tactics.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic labels the alert is mapped to, describing the adversary goal at a high level. Useful for triage and grouping; treat as provider mapping, not confirmed adversary activity.
Tactics.description_zh: 该告警映射到的 MITRE ATT&CK 战术标签，从较高层面描述对手目标。适用于研判和分组；应视为提供程序的映射，而非已确认的对手活动。

Techniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique identifiers or names associated with this alert, indicating the specific behavior claimed. Combine with Tactics and SubTechniques for context; the mapping does not by itself prove compromise.
Techniques.description_zh: 与该告警关联的 MITRE ATT&CK 技术标识或名称，表示所声称的具体行为。可与 Tactics 和 SubTechniques 结合获取背景；该映射本身并不能证明系统已被攻陷。

TenantId.description: Workspace identifier associated with this alert record according to documentation. Use it to scope queries to a workspace; it is not a directory tenant ID and should not be treated as an identity tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 根据文档，与该告警记录关联的工作区标识符。可用于将查询限定到某个工作区；它不是目录租户 ID，不应被视为身份租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when this alert row was generated into the table. Scope and order alert queries by it; keep separate from StartTime, EndTime and ProcessingEndTime when reasoning about when the underlying activity occurred.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该告警行生成到表中的时间戳。可用它对告警查询进行范围限定和排序；在推断底层活动发生时间时，应与 StartTime、EndTime 和 ProcessingEndTime 区分开。

Type.description: Name of the table this row belongs to. Use it to confirm the record source and to filter SecurityAlert rows away from other tables when using union or search queries.
Type.description_zh: 该行所属表的名称。可用于确认记录来源，并在联合或搜索查询中把 SecurityAlert 行与其他表区分过滤。

VendorName.description: Vendor that provides the security product generating this alert. Useful for attributing alerts to a source and comparing coverage across vendors; it describes the product source, not the affected asset.
VendorName.description_zh: 提供生成此告警的安全产品的供应商。可用于将告警归因到某个来源并比较不同供应商的覆盖范围；它描述的是产品来源，不是受影响的资产。

VendorOriginalId.description: Identifier assigned by the original vendor for this alert, preserved for cross-referencing back to the vendor's console or API. Use alongside SystemAlertId when correlating with vendor-side records.
VendorOriginalId.description_zh: 原始供应商为该告警分配的标识符，保留用于回查供应商控制台或 API。与供应商侧记录关联时可配合 SystemAlertId 使用。

WorkspaceResourceGroup.description: Azure resource group of the workspace in which this alert record resides. Use it to scope or group alerts by workspace deployment; it describes workspace placement, not the alerted resource's group.
WorkspaceResourceGroup.description_zh: 承载该告警记录的工作区所在的 Azure 资源组。可用于按工作区部署进行范围限定或分组；它描述的是工作区归属，而不是被告警资源所属的资源组。

WorkspaceSubscriptionId.description: Azure subscription identifier of the workspace containing this alert record. Use it to scope queries to a subscription or bill/attribute workspace usage; it is not the subscription of the affected resource.
WorkspaceSubscriptionId.description_zh: 包含该告警记录的工作区所在的 Azure 订阅标识符。可用于将查询限定到某个订阅或对工作区使用进行计费/归因；它不是受影响资源所在的订阅。

SecurityIncident.description: Microsoft Sentinel incident lifecycle records with status, severity, owner, classification, activity window and linked alerts. Use it to follow incident creation, updates, assignment and closure, or identify the alerts grouped into an incident. Pivot on IncidentName or IncidentNumber within the appropriate workspace and use AlertIds for alert-level detail. Multiple records can describe updates to the same incident; distinguish record time from activity time. BookmarkIds refers to investigation bookmarks.
SecurityIncident.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Sentinel 安全事件的生命周期，包括状态、严重性、负责人、分类、活动时间范围及关联告警。用于追踪事件创建、更新、分配与关闭，或查找事件包含的告警；需在对应工作区内按 IncidentName 或 IncidentNumber 定位，并通过 AlertIds 获取告警详情。同一事件可能有多条更新记录，应区分记录时间和活动时间；BookmarkIds 指调查书签。

AdditionalData.description: Dynamic bag of provider-specific incident metadata not surfaced in fixed columns. Its structure varies by source, so inspect alongside ProviderName; do not assume fixed keys or that it is present on every row.
AdditionalData.description_zh: 存放未在固定列中呈现的提供方特定事件元数据的动态字段。其结构随来源不同，应结合 ProviderName 查看；不要预设固定键，也不要假定每行都有值。

AlertIds.description: Dynamic array of alert resource IDs that contributed to this incident. Use to pivot from an incident to underlying alerts; treat as references only, not proof of compromise. Values are provider-defined, not guaranteed unique.
AlertIds.description_zh: 构成该事件的警报资源 ID 动态数组。用于从事件向下钻取到底层警报；仅视为引用，不构成被入侵证据。取值由提供方定义，不保证唯一。

BookmarkIds.description: Dynamic array of bookmark resource IDs linked to this incident. Use to find saved investigative artifacts; presence of a bookmark documents analyst interest, not confirmed malicious activity. Inspect the bookmark table for meaning.
BookmarkIds.description_zh: 链接到该事件的书签资源 ID 动态数组。用于查找已保存的调查工件；存在书签仅说明分析师关注，并非确认恶意活动。其含义需查书签表。

Classification.description: String classification assigned when the incident was closed (for example true/false positive), as recorded in Sentinel. Applies to closure decisions by the owning analyst or automation; empty while open. Use to measure triage outcome.
Classification.description_zh: 事件关闭时赋予的字符串分类（如真/假阳性），由 Sentinel 记录。描述负责分析师或自动化的关闭决策；事件未关闭时为空。用于衡量分诊结果。

ClassificationComment.description: Free-text comment recorded with the closing classification, describing why the incident was closed. Written by the closing analyst or automation at closure time; use to understand rationale and audit decisions.
ClassificationComment.description_zh: 关闭分类时记录的说明事件关闭原因的评论文本。由关闭时的分析师或自动化写入；用于理解判断依据并审计关闭决策。

ClassificationReason.description: String reason code selected during incident closure, more granular than Classification. Set by the closing analyst or automation; empty until closed. Use to aggregate closure patterns across providers.
ClassificationReason.description_zh: 事件关闭时选择的字符串原因代码，比 Classification 更细。由关闭分析师或自动化设置；关闭前为空。用于跨提供方汇总关闭模式。

ClosedTime.description: UTC timestamp when the incident was last closed. Pertains to analyst or automation closure actions; null while open. Use with CreatedTime to compute time-to-close and identify stale incidents.
ClosedTime.description_zh: 事件最后一次关闭的 UTC 时间戳。对应分析师或自动化的关闭操作；未关闭时为 null。与 CreatedTime 配合可计算关闭耗时并识别长期未处理事件。

Comments.description: Dynamic array of comments added to the incident during investigation. Authored by analysts or automation; structure is provider-defined. Use to review collaboration history, but inspect the array format before parsing individual entries.
Comments.description_zh: 调查期间添加到事件的评论文本动态数组。由分析师或自动化撰写；结构由提供方定义。用于查看协作历史，但解析具体条目之前需先检查数组格式。

CreatedTime.description: UTC timestamp when the incident record was created by Sentinel. Describes incident generation, not the first underlying alert activity (see FirstActivityTime). Use for aging and workload analysis.
CreatedTime.description_zh: Sentinel 创建该事件记录的 UTC 时间戳。描述的是事件生成时间，而非底层警报首次活动时间（参见 FirstActivityTime）。用于计算事件账龄和工作量分析。

Description.description: Free-text description of the incident, usually summarizing involved entities and detected behavior. Written by the generating provider or analytic rule; use for triage context, but do not treat narrative text as verified evidence.
Description.description_zh: 事件的自由文本描述，通常概述涉及的实体和检测到的行为。由生成该事件的提供方或分析规则写入；用于分诊上下文，但不要把叙述文本当作已核实证据。

FirstActivityTime.description: UTC timestamp of the earliest activity attributed to this incident, per its source alerts. Set when the incident is created or updated; differs from CreatedTime, which is record generation. Use to bound investigation windows.
FirstActivityTime.description_zh: 该事件所涉最早活动的 UTC 时间戳（依据来源警报）。在事件创建或更新时设置；与表示记录生成时间的 CreatedTime 不同。用于界定调查时间窗口。

FirstModifiedTime.description: UTC timestamp when the incident was first modified after creation, such as status, owner or severity change. Applies to incident management actions; use to measure responsiveness to new incidents.
FirstModifiedTime.description_zh: 事件创建后首次被修改的 UTC 时间戳，例如状态、负责人或严重性变更。对应事件管理操作；用于衡量对新事件的响应速度。

IncidentName.description: Resource name string identifying the incident, typically an internal Sentinel identifier used in queries and URLs. Distinguishes records across the workspace; combine with ProviderName when correlating incidents from multiple providers.
IncidentName.description_zh: 标识事件的资源名称字符串，通常是 Sentinel 内部标识符，用于查询和 URL。可区分工作区内的记录；与多提供方事件关联时需结合 ProviderName。

IncidentNumber.description: Integer sequential number assigned to the incident within the workspace. Useful for ordering and referencing incidents in reports, but provider IDs may differ; correlate via ProviderName and ProviderIncidentId.
IncidentNumber.description_zh: 工作区内分配给该事件的整数序号。便于在报告中排序和引用事件，但提供方 ID 可能不同；应通过 ProviderName 和 ProviderIncidentId 关联。

IncidentUrl.description: String URI linking to the incident in the Microsoft Sentinel portal. Use to direct analysts to the authoritative investigation view; it is a navigation aid, not evidence of incident content or state.
IncidentUrl.description_zh: 指向 Microsoft Sentinel 门户中该事件的 URI 字符串。用于将分析师导向权威调查视图；它是导航辅助，不代表事件内容或状态证据。

Labels.description: Dynamic array of labels (tags) attached to the incident for grouping and filtering. Added by analysts or automation; label vocabulary is workspace-defined, so inspect values before relying on specific tags.
Labels.description_zh: 附加到事件、用于分组和筛选的标签动态数组。由分析师或自动化添加；标签词表由工作区自定义，依赖特定标签前应先检查取值。

LastActivityTime.description: UTC timestamp of the latest activity attributed to this incident across its source alerts. Set as incidents update; use with FirstActivityTime to measure activity span rather than incident handling duration.
LastActivityTime.description_zh: 该事件全部来源警报中最新活动的 UTC 时间戳。随事件更新而设置；与 FirstActivityTime 配合可衡量活动跨度，而非事件处理时长。

LastModifiedTime.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent modification to the incident, such as status, owner, severity or comments. Reflects incident management actions; use to detect active handling or stalled incidents.
LastModifiedTime.description_zh: 事件最近一次修改的 UTC 时间戳，例如状态、负责人、严重性或评论变更。反映事件管理操作；用于识别正在处理或停滞的事件。

ModifiedBy.description: String identifying the source of the most recent incident change, such as an analyst identity or automation. Describes the actor behind management edits; inspect value format per provider, as naming conventions vary.
ModifiedBy.description_zh: 标识最近一次事件变更来源的字符串，如分析师身份或自动化。描述管理编辑背后的操作者；命名约定因提供方而异，使用前应检查取值格式。

Owner.description: Dynamic object describing the user or team the incident is assigned to. Applies to assignment workflow; structure is provider-defined, so inspect keys rather than assuming a fixed email or name field.
Owner.description_zh: 描述事件所分配到的用户或团队的动态对象。对应分配工作流；结构由提供方定义，应检查其键而非预设固定的邮箱或姓名字段。

ProviderIncidentId.description: String incident identifier assigned by the originating provider, which may differ from Sentinel's IncidentNumber. Use with ProviderName to deduplicate or cross-reference the same incident across systems.
ProviderIncidentId.description_zh: 发起提供方分配的事件标识符字符串，可能与 Sentinel 的 IncidentNumber 不同。与 ProviderName 配合可对同一事件跨系统去重或交叉引用。

ProviderName.description: String naming the source provider that generated the incident, for example a Microsoft security product or third-party integration. Use to scope queries and interpret provider-specific fields; not all providers populate every column.
ProviderName.description_zh: 生成该事件的来源提供方名称字符串，例如 Microsoft 安全产品或第三方集成。用于限定查询范围并解读提供方特定字段；并非所有提供方都填充所有列。

RelatedAnalyticRuleIds.description: Dynamic array of analytic rule resource IDs associated with the incident. Use to trace which detections fired; IDs are references, and a match does not by itself prove compromise. Inspect rule definitions for logic.
RelatedAnalyticRuleIds.description_zh: 与该事件关联的分析规则资源 ID 动态数组。用于追溯触发的检测；ID 仅是引用，匹配本身不证明被入侵。需查看规则定义以了解逻辑。

Severity.description: String severity level assigned to the incident by its provider or analytic rule, such as an ordinal risk tier. Use for triage prioritization and workload reporting; the allowed value set is provider-defined and not enumerated here.
Severity.description_zh: 由提供方或分析规则分配给事件的严重性级别字符串，例如分级风险层级。用于分诊优先级排序和工作量报告；允许取值由提供方定义，此处不枚举。

SourceSystem.description: Identifies the agent or collection channel that supplied this incident row (for example Operations Manager or Azure Diagnostics); use it to understand ingestion origin, not the incident's severity or content.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 标识提供该事件行的代理或采集通道（例如 Operations Manager 或 Azure Diagnostics）；用于了解数据来源，而非事件严重性或内容。

Status.description: Workflow state of the incident in this table, such as new, active, or closed; use it to filter open versus resolved incidents and to pivot on triage progress over time.
Status.description_zh: 该表中事件的工作流状态，如新建、活动或已关闭；用于筛选未解决与已解决事件，并按时间分析分诊进展。

Tasks.description: Dynamic collection of task entries attached to this incident's response workflow; inspect its structure in context to see assigned checklist items, not to infer alert-level detail. Name-derived interpretation: inspect resource/category context.
Tasks.description_zh: 附加到该事件响应流程的任务条目的动态集合；请结合上下文检查其结构以查看已分配清单项，而非推断告警级细节。基于名称的解读：请检查资源/类别上下文。

TenantId.description: The Log Analytics workspace ID associated with this incident row, as documented; use it to scope queries and correlate data within the same workspace, not as a directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 按文档说明为该事件行关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；用于限定查询范围并关联同一工作区内的数据，而非目录租户标识符。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when this incident record was ingested into the table; use it for time-window filtering and ingestion-latency analysis, distinct from activity or creation times on the incident.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该事件记录被摄入表的 UTC 时间戳；用于时间窗口筛选和摄入延迟分析，与事件的活动时间或创建时间不同。

Title.description: Human-readable title of the incident as provided by the source; use for quick identification and keyword search during triage, while preferring structured fields for reliable filtering.
Title.description_zh: 来源提供的事件人类可读标题；用于快速识别和分诊时关键词检索，可靠筛选请优先使用结构化字段。

Type.description: The table name value identifying this record as SecurityIncident; use it when unioning multiple tables to preserve provenance and to constrain queries to incident rows only.
Type.description_zh: 标识该记录为 SecurityIncident 的表名值；在联合多个表时用于保留来源并仅将查询限定为事件行。

SentinelAudit.description: Microsoft Sentinel resource audit records with operation, status, resource identity and provider-specific ExtendedProperties. Use it to inspect configuration changes to Sentinel resources, correlate operations with CorrelationId, and investigate actor details when present in the extended payload. Scope by SentinelResourceType, SentinelResourceKind and resource ID. It describes management changes; use SentinelHealth for operational failures and SecurityAlert or SecurityIncident for detection and investigation records.
SentinelAudit.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Sentinel 资源审计，包括操作、状态、资源身份及自定义 ExtendedProperties。用于检查 Sentinel 资源的配置变更，通过 CorrelationId 串联操作，并在扩展数据有提供时调查操作者；需按 SentinelResourceType、SentinelResourceKind 和资源标识限定范围。本表描述管理变更；运行故障查 SentinelHealth，检测与调查记录查 SecurityAlert 或 SecurityIncident。

CorrelationId.description: Identifier tying together related audit records from the same logical operation or request. Use it to group rows when reconstructing a multi-step change across Sentinel resources; a shared value does not by itself prove success or causation.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 将同一次逻辑操作或请求产生的相关审核记录关联起来的标识符。重构跨 Sentinel 资源的多步变更时可用它分组记录；共享同一值本身并不证明操作成功或存在因果关系。

Description.description: Human-readable text describing the audited Sentinel operation, complementing OperationName with detail about what changed. Useful for quickly reviewing the nature of a change, but treat it as narrative context rather than a structured status indicator.
Description.description_zh: 描述被审核的 Sentinel 操作的可读文本，在 OperationName 之外补充变更细节。适合快速了解变更性质，但应将其视为叙述性上下文，而非结构化状态指示。

ExtendedProperties.description: Dynamic property bag holding resource-type-specific extra details for this audited operation. Inspect keys only after identifying SentinelResourceType and SentinelResourceKind, since contents vary by resource and are not guaranteed by schema.
ExtendedProperties.description_zh: 动态属性包，保存此次被审核操作中特定于资源类型的附加细节。应先确定 SentinelResourceType 和 SentinelResourceKind 再查看键值，因为内容随资源而变化，模式并不保证。

OperationName.description: Name of the action that triggered this audit record, indicating what was attempted on the Sentinel resource. Compare across rows to see the sequence of actions on a resource; it names the operation, not the outcome.
OperationName.description_zh: 触发此审核记录的操作名称，表示对 Sentinel 资源尝试执行的动作。可跨行比较以查看某资源的操作序列；它表示操作名称，而非执行结果。

SentinelResourceId.description: Azure resource identifier of the Sentinel resource targeted by this audited operation. Use it to group all audits for one connector, rule or similar resource and to correlate with other Azure resource logs; scope by resource type.
SentinelResourceId.description_zh: 此次被审核操作所针对的 Sentinel 资源的 Azure 资源标识符。可用于汇总某个连接器、规则或类似资源的全部审核记录，并与其他 Azure 资源日志关联；应按资源类型限定范围。

SentinelResourceKind.description: Kind or subtype of the targeted Sentinel resource, such as a connector kind or alert rule kind. Use with SentinelResourceType to narrow audits to comparable resources before comparing properties or ExtendedProperties contents.
SentinelResourceKind.description_zh: 所针对 Sentinel 资源的种类或子类型，例如连接器种类或警报规则种类。应与 SentinelResourceType 一起使用，将审核记录限定到可比资源后再比较属性或 ExtendedProperties 内容。

SentinelResourceName.description: Display name of the Sentinel resource affected by this audited operation, useful for reading results and reports. Names may not be unique across resource types or workspaces, so combine it with SentinelResourceId for precise identification.
SentinelResourceName.description_zh: 此次被审核操作所影响 Sentinel 资源的显示名称，便于阅读结果和报告。名称在不同资源类型或工作区之间可能不唯一，因此应结合 SentinelResourceId 精确识别。

SentinelResourceType.description: Category of the Sentinel resource involved, for example data connector or alert rule. Use it to scope queries to comparable audit records, since ExtendedProperties and applicable resource fields differ by category.
SentinelResourceType.description_zh: 所涉及 Sentinel 资源的类别，例如数据连接器或警报规则。可用它将查询限定到可比的审核记录，因为 ExtendedProperties 及适用的资源字段会因类别而异。

SourceSystem.description: The collection agent or source system recorded for the audit record. For this table it generally reflects collection through Azure diagnostics for Sentinel resource operation logs; treat it as provenance metadata rather than evidence about the audited change.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 记录在该审核记录上的收集代理或来源系统。对该表而言，通常反映通过 Azure 诊断收集 Sentinel 资源操作日志；应将其视为来源元数据，而不是关于被审核变更的证据。

Status.description: Outcome recorded for this audited operation, such as success or failure categories. Use it to separate attempted changes from effective ones, and corroborate failures with Description and ExtendedProperties rather than assuming a specific cause.
Status.description_zh: 此次被审核操作记录的结果，例如成功或失败等类别。可用它区分尝试的变更与生效的变更，并应结合 Description 和 ExtendedProperties 核实失败，而不要假设具体原因。

TenantId.description: Documented as the Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with the audit record. Use it to scope queries to the correct workspace; do not interpret it as an Azure directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 文档中定义为与该审核记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符。可用它将查询限定到正确的工作区；不要将其解释为 Azure 目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when this audit event was generated. Use it for time-bounded review of Sentinel resource changes and for ordering records around a suspected change; collection delay may affect apparent timing.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 此审核事件生成时的 UTC 时间戳。可用于按时间范围审查 Sentinel 资源变更，并围绕可疑变更对记录排序；收集延迟可能影响显示的时间。

Type.description: Name of the table that stored this record. Use it in queries to constrain results to this audit table and to exclude similarly named data from other sources during union or join operations.
Type.description_zh: 存储此记录的表名。可在查询中用它将结果限定到该审核表，并在联合或联接操作中排除来自其他来源的相似数据。

WorkspaceId.description: Identifier of the workspace associated with the audited Sentinel resource record. Use it to limit queries to a particular workspace and disambiguate same-named resources; it is a workspace scope, not a user or resource key.
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 与被审核 Sentinel 资源记录关联的工作区标识符。可用它将查询限定到特定工作区并区分同名资源；它表示工作区范围，而不是用户或资源键。

SentinelHealth.description: Microsoft Sentinel resource-health log recording operations performed by Sentinel resources such as data connectors, analytic rules and automation. Each row is one health or operation event with its status, reason and the Sentinel resource it concerns. Use it for questions about connector or rule failures, degraded or partial health, and which resource kind, type or operation is affected. Pivot by SentinelResourceType, SentinelResourceKind, OperationName and Status, then inspect ExtendedProperties. Boundary: this is Sentinel platform health, not Sentinel incident or hunting tables, and not Azure resource health logs.
SentinelHealth.description_zh: Microsoft Sentinel 资源运行状况日志，记录由数据连接器、分析规则、自动化等 Sentinel 资源执行的操作。每一行是一个运行状况或操作事件，包含状态、原因及其涉及的 Sentinel 资源。可用于排查连接器或规则失败、降级或部分健康状态，以及受影响资源的类型、种类和操作。可按 SentinelResourceType、SentinelResourceKind、OperationName、Status 透视，再检查 ExtendedProperties。边界：这是 Sentinel 平台健康数据，不是 Sentinel 事件（incident）或搜寻表，也不是 Azure 资源运行状况日志。

Description.description: Human-readable description of the logged operation and its outcome for this resource. Read it to understand what happened before pivoting into Reason and ExtendedProperties.
Description.description_zh: 对所记录操作及其结果的文字描述。先阅读它以了解发生了什么，再进一步查看 Reason 和 ExtendedProperties。

ExtendedProperties.description: Dynamic bag of additional resource-type-dependent details attached to the event. Parse it for connector, rule or automation specifics; interpret keys carefully as they are service-specific and name-derived.
ExtendedProperties.description_zh: 附加于事件的、依资源类型而定的动态属性包。可解析以获取连接器、规则或自动化的具体细节；键名依服务而定，需谨慎解读，且基于名称推断。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation that triggered this health event, describing the Sentinel action being performed. Group by it to see which operations succeed or fail most.
OperationName.description_zh: 触发此运行状况事件的操作名称，描述正在执行的 Sentinel 动作。按它分组可查看哪些操作成功或失败最多。

Reason.description: Stated reason the operation reached its status, such as an error or failure cause. Combine with Status and the resource fields to diagnose recurring Sentinel health problems.
Reason.description_zh: 操作达到该状态的原因，例如错误或失败原因。结合 Status 与资源字段可诊断反复出现的 Sentinel 运行状况问题。

RecordId.description: Unique record identifier for the health entry. Use it to deduplicate, reference or retrieve a specific event rather than for ordering.
RecordId.description_zh: 该运行状况条目的唯一记录标识符。可用于去重、引用或检索特定事件，而不是用于排序。

SentinelResourceId.description: Azure resource ID of the Sentinel resource whose operation was logged. Use it for joins or resource-scoped filtering to a specific connector, rule or automation.
SentinelResourceId.description_zh: 记录其操作的 Sentinel 资源的 Azure 资源 ID。可用于连接或按资源筛选，定位到具体连接器、规则或自动化。

SentinelResourceKind.description: Specific kind within the resource type, for example a connector kind or alert rule kind. Interpret values from the schema; inspect resource context since kind strings are service-specific.
SentinelResourceKind.description_zh: 资源类型下的具体种类，例如连接器种类或告警规则种类。取值需结合架构解读；种类字符串依服务而定，应检查资源上下文。

SentinelResourceName.description: Display name of the Sentinel resource involved, such as a connector or analytic rule name. Useful for grouping and for reading failure reports tied to a named resource.
SentinelResourceName.description_zh: 涉及的 Sentinel 资源显示名称，例如连接器或分析规则名称。适用于分组以及查看与具名资源相关的失败报告。

SentinelResourceType.description: Category of the Sentinel resource, such as DataConnector or AlertRule, according to the schema. Group by it to compare health across resource categories.
SentinelResourceType.description_zh: Sentinel 资源的类别，按架构为 DataConnector、AlertRule 等。按它分组可比较各类资源的运行状况。

SourceSystem.description: Agent or collection source that produced the event, such as Azure Diagnostics. Use it to confirm provenance when multiple collection paths report health records.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 产生该事件的代理或收集来源，例如 Azure Diagnostics。当多条收集路径都会上报运行状况记录时，用它确认来源。

Status.description: Outcome of the logged operation, for example success, failure, warning, informational or partial success. Filter on it to isolate failing or degraded Sentinel resources.
Status.description_zh: 所记录操作的结果，例如成功、失败、警告、信息或部分成功。用它筛选以定位失败或降级的 Sentinel 资源。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID associated with the Sentinel health record. Scope queries by workspace; it identifies the monitoring workspace, not a directory tenant ID.
TenantId.description_zh: 与 Sentinel 运行状况记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID。查询时按工作区限定范围；它标识监控工作区，而非目录租户 ID。

TimeGenerated.description: UTC timestamp when the operation or health event was generated. Use it for time-window filtering and to correlate failures with connector or rule changes.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 操作或运行状况事件生成的 UTC 时间戳。用于按时间窗口筛选，并将故障与连接器或规则变更进行关联。

Type.description: Name of the log table for the record, here SentinelHealth. Use it in unions or when filtering across multiple log tables by table name.
Type.description_zh: 该记录的日志表名称，此处为 SentinelHealth。在联合查询或按表名跨多个日志表筛选时使用。

WorkspaceId.description: Workspace identifier recorded on the health event. Scope health queries to one workspace when several workspaces feed the same table.
WorkspaceId.description_zh: 记录在运行状况事件上的工作区标识符。当多个工作区向同一表写入时，用它把健康查询限定到单个工作区。

SigninLogs.description: Microsoft Entra user sign-in records with account, application, source IP, authentication steps, conditional-access decisions and risk context. Use it to investigate suspicious user access, failed authentication or MFA outcomes, and compare locations or devices over time. Pivot on UserId, UserPrincipalName, AppId, CorrelationId and the recorded sign-in time; inspect IsInteractive where needed. Dedicated AAD tables cover non-interactive users, service principals and managed identities; AuditLogs covers directory changes.
SigninLogs.description_zh: 记录 Microsoft Entra 用户登录，包括账户、应用、来源 IP、身份验证步骤、条件访问决策和风险上下文。用于调查可疑用户访问、身份验证失败或 MFA 结果，并比较不同时刻的位置和设备；可通过 UserId、UserPrincipalName、AppId、CorrelationId 和登录时间关联，必要时查看 IsInteractive。非交互用户、服务主体和托管标识另有对应 AAD 表；目录变更查 AuditLogs。

AADTenantId.description: Identifier of the Microsoft Entra tenant that issued the sign-in token; pivot here to separate activity of your tenant from guest or cross-tenant sign-ins appearing in the same workspace.
AADTenantId.description_zh: 颁发该登录令牌的 Microsoft Entra 租户标识；按此列可区分本租户活动与同一工作区中出现的来宾或跨租户登录。

AlternateSignInName.description: The user-supplied identifier typed at sign-in, which may be a UPN, email or other alias; use it to catch sign-ins where the actual account differs from the displayed name.
AlternateSignInName.description_zh: 用户在登录时输入的标识符，可能是 UPN、电子邮件或其他别名；用它可发现实际账号与显示名称不一致的登录。

AppDisplayName.description: Human-readable name of the application targeted by this sign-in attempt; group by it to spot unusual target apps, or correlate with AppId when names are missing or spoofed.
AppDisplayName.description_zh: 本次登录尝试所访问应用的易读名称；按它分组可发现异常的目标应用，或在名称缺失或被伪造时与 AppId 关联核对。

AppId.description: GUID of the target application in Microsoft Entra ID; a stable pivot for filtering one app's sign-in volume, service principals and anomalous app access across users and IPs.
AppId.description_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 中目标应用的 GUID；是筛选单个应用的登录量、服务主体以及跨用户和 IP 的异常访问的稳定维度。

AppliedConditionalAccessPolicies.description: Flattened string of conditional-access policy names applied to this sign-in; use with ConditionalAccessStatus and ConditionalAccessPolicies to see which controls were enforced or bypassed.
AppliedConditionalAccessPolicies.description_zh: 应用于本次登录的条件访问策略名称的展平字符串；结合 ConditionalAccessStatus 与 ConditionalAccessPolicies 可查看哪些控制被强制执行或被绕过。

AppliedEventListeners.description: Structured list of downstream listeners, such as Logic Apps or Functions, fired by this sign-in event; name-derived dynamic field, inspect its JSON contents to map automation and detection pipelines reacting to sign-ins.
AppliedEventListeners.description_zh: 由该登录事件触发的下游监听器（如 Logic Apps 或 Functions）的结构化列表；该字段语义由名称推导，需解析其 JSON 内容以梳理响应登录的自动化与检测流程。
