AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description: Authentication context values bound to the conditional-access policies applied in this sign-in; use to verify whether a stronger context (for example step-up) was requested and satisfied for sensitive apps.
AuthenticationContextClassReferences.description_zh: 本次登录所应用的条件访问策略绑定的身份验证上下文值；用于核实敏感应用是否请求并满足更强的上下文（如提升验证）。

AuthenticationDetails.description: Structured outcome of individual authentication steps and the method used for this sign-in; parse it to see whether password, MFA or another method satisfied each stage, independent of overall ResultType.
AuthenticationDetails.description_zh: 本次登录各身份验证步骤的结果及所用方法的结构化数据；解析它可查看每个阶段由密码、MFA 还是其他方法通过，而不只看整体 ResultType。

AuthenticationMethodsUsed.description: Authentication methods recorded for this sign-in, such as password, Authenticator app, FIDO, PTA or PHS; compare with AuthenticationDetails to confirm which method actually satisfied the requirement.
AuthenticationMethodsUsed.description_zh: 本次登录记录的身份验证方法，如密码、Authenticator 应用、FIDO、PTA 或 PHS；与 AuthenticationDetails 对照可确认实际满足要求的方法。

AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description: Free-text details about how authentication was processed, including PTA agent or federation server names; reveals backend infrastructure involved in a sign-in and can distinguish on-premises federated paths.
AuthenticationProcessingDetails.description_zh: 关于身份验证处理过程的自由文本细节，包括 PTA 代理或联合服务器名称；可揭示本次登录涉及的后端基础设施并区分本地联合路径。

AuthenticationProtocol.description: Protocol or grant type used in this sign-in, such as oAuth2, saml20, wsFederation or deviceCode; name-derived enum, use to spot legacy or device-code flows often abused for token theft.
AuthenticationProtocol.description_zh: 本次登录使用的协议或授权类型，如 oAuth2、saml20、wsFederation 或 deviceCode；该枚举值由名称推导，可用于发现常被用于窃取令牌的旧式或设备代码流。

AuthenticationRequirement.description: Highest level of authentication required across all sign-in steps for this attempt to succeed; compare with AuthenticationMethodsUsed to detect sign-ins that did not meet the requirement.
AuthenticationRequirement.description_zh: 使本次登录成功所需通过全部步骤达到的最高身份验证等级；与 AuthenticationMethodsUsed 对照可发现未满足该要求的登录。

AuthenticationRequirementPolicies.description: Sources that imposed the authentication requirement, such as conditional access, per-user MFA, identity protection or security defaults; shows which control plane enforced MFA for this sign-in.
AuthenticationRequirementPolicies.description_zh: 施加身份验证要求的来源，如条件访问、按用户 MFA、Identity Protection 或安全默认值；显示是哪个控制面为本次登录强制了 MFA。

AutonomousSystemNumber.description: Autonomous System Number of the network the sign-in originated from; numeric ASN pivot for grouping source networks independently of individual IPAddress values and for spotting hosting or proxy infrastructure.
AutonomousSystemNumber.description_zh: 登录来源网络的自治系统号；该数字 ASN 维度可按来源网络分组而不依赖单个 IPAddress，并有助于发现托管或代理基础设施。

Category.description: Log category value carried on this sign-in row; use to scope queries to the sign-in category when the same table or workspace hosts other Azure AD activity types.
Category.description_zh: 该登录行携带的日志类别值；当同一表或工作区中还存在其他 Azure AD 活动类型时，用它可将查询限定到登录类别。

ClientAppUsed.description: Legacy client application used for this sign-in, for example Browser, Exchange ActiveSync, IMAP, MAPI, SMTP or POP; name-derived enum, use to detect legacy authentication clients that bypass modern controls.
ClientAppUsed.description_zh: 本次登录使用的旧式客户端应用，例如 Browser、Exchange ActiveSync、IMAP、MAPI、SMTP 或 POP；该枚举值由名称推导，可用于发现绕过现代控制的旧式身份验证客户端。

ConditionalAccessPolicies.description: Structured list of conditional-access policies triggered by this sign-in, with per-policy results; parse it for detailed evaluation outcomes rather than relying only on the flattened AppliedConditionalAccessPolicies string.
ConditionalAccessPolicies.description_zh: 本次登录触发的条件访问策略结构化列表，含每项策略结果；解析它可获取详细评估结果，而不只是依赖展平的 AppliedConditionalAccessPolicies 字符串。

ConditionalAccessStatus.description: Overall conditional-access outcome for this sign-in: success, failure or notApplied; use to separate blocked or failed policy evaluations from sign-ins where no policy was evaluated at all.
ConditionalAccessStatus.description_zh: 本次登录的条件访问总体结果：success、failure 或 notApplied；用于将被阻止或评估失败的情况与完全未评估任何策略的登录区分开。

CorrelationId.description: Client-supplied identifier for this sign-in initiation; join it to support or other diagnostic data to reconstruct activity around the same authentication request.
CorrelationId.description_zh: 客户端为本次登录发起提供的关联标识；可与支持或其他诊断数据关联，以还原同一身份验证请求周围的活动。

CreatedDateTime.description: Time the sign-in was initiated, in UTC; use as the event timeline anchor and compare with TimeGenerated to see ingestion or export lag for this row.
CreatedDateTime.description_zh: 登录发起的 UTC 时间；作为事件时间线锚点，并与 TimeGenerated 对比以查看该行的摄取或导出延迟。

CrossTenantAccessType.description: Describes the type of cross-tenant access used by the actor for this sign-in; name-derived enum, inspect tenant and resource context to interpret whether inbound, outbound or B2B collaboration was involved.
CrossTenantAccessType.description_zh: 描述本次登录发起者使用的跨租户访问类型；该枚举值由名称推导，需结合租户与资源上下文判断涉及的是入站、出站还是 B2B 协作。

DeviceDetail.description: Structured device information for the sign-in, including deviceId, operating system, browser and compliance or managed state; parse it to distinguish recognized corporate devices from unknown or non-compliant ones.
DeviceDetail.description_zh: 本次登录的设备结构化信息，含 deviceId、操作系统、浏览器及合规或托管状态；解析它可区分已识别的公司设备与未知或不合规设备。

DurationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds recorded for this sign-in operation; use to spot unusually slow authentication requests that may indicate throttling, backend faults or probing activity.
DurationMs.description_zh: 本次登录操作记录的持续毫秒数；用于发现可能表明限流、后端故障或探测活动的异常缓慢的身份验证请求。

FlaggedForReview.description: True when a user themselves flagged this failed sign-in for administrator review in the portal; a user-initiated signal of suspected compromise, useful alongside risk and failure evidence.
FlaggedForReview.description_zh: 当用户本人在门户中标记该失败登录供管理员审查时为 true；这是用户发起的疑似失陷信号，可与风险及失败证据结合使用。

HomeTenantId.description: Identifier of the home tenant of the signing-in user, distinct from the resource tenant. Useful to recognize cross-tenant or guest sign-ins; name-derived, so inspect tenant context before asserting semantics.
HomeTenantId.description_zh: 发起登录用户的归属租户标识符，区别于资源租户。可用于识别跨租户或来宾登录；属于根据名称推断，断言含义前应先检查租户上下文。

IPAddress.description: Client IP address from which the sign-in originated. Use it to geolocate or compare sign-in sources; scoping by time and user is needed since addresses can be shared or spoofed.
IPAddress.description_zh: 登录来源的客户端 IP 地址。可用于定位或比较登录来源；由于地址可能共享或被伪造，需结合时间和用户进行范围限定。

IPAddressFromResourceProvider.description: IP address a user used to reach a resource provider, recorded for some Conditional Access compliance checks and often absent. Treat as supplementary source information, not proof of the client's true location.
IPAddressFromResourceProvider.description_zh: 用户访问资源提供程序时使用的 IP 地址，用于某些条件访问合规检查，且常常为空。应视为补充来源信息，不能证明客户端的真实位置。

Id.description: Identifier representing this sign-in activity. Use it to reference or deduplicate individual sign-in records; it identifies the activity, not the user or the session.
Id.description_zh: 表示本次登录活动的标识符。可用于引用或去重单条登录记录；它标识的是该活动，而不是用户或会话。

Identity.description: Display name of the actor identified in the sign-in. Useful for readable context; correlate with UserPrincipalName or ServicePrincipalName because display names are not unique identifiers.
Identity.description_zh: 登录中被识别主体的显示名称。可用于提供易读的上下文；应与 UserPrincipalName 或 ServicePrincipalName 关联，因为显示名称不是唯一标识符。

IsInteractive.description: Boolean indicating whether the sign-in was interactive, meaning a user supplied an authentication factor, versus non-interactive token or code use. Helps separate user-driven sign-ins from automated client activity.
IsInteractive.description_zh: 布尔值，表示登录是否为交互式，即用户提供了身份验证因素，而非交互式则使用令牌或代码。有助于区分用户驱动的登录与自动化客户端活动。

IsRisky.description: Boolean indicating whether the sign-in was flagged as risky by the identity protection evaluation. Use with RiskLevel and RiskState; a risky flag is risk evidence, not proof of compromise.
IsRisky.description_zh: 布尔值，表示身份保护评估是否将该登录标记为有风险。应与 RiskLevel 和 RiskState 一起使用；风险标记是风险证据，不能证明已遭入侵。

Level.description: Log level of the record as exported to the workspace, often describing severity. Useful for filtering noisy records; the exact allowed values are not documented here, so inspect context before relying on it.
Level.description_zh: 记录导出到工作区时的日志级别，通常表示严重性。可用于过滤噪声记录；此处的具体允许值未记录，依赖前应检查上下文。

Location.description: Two-letter country code derived from the sign-in IP address, intended to indicate where the sign-in occurred. It may not resolve to city or region detail, so use LocationDetails when finer geolocation is needed.
Location.description_zh: 根据登录 IP 地址推导出的两字母国家代码，用于表示登录发生的地点。它可能无法解析到城市或地区级别，因此需要更细的地理位置时应使用 LocationDetails。

LocationDetails.description: Dynamic object providing city, state, country/region, and latitude/longitude derived from the sign-in IP address. Use to enrich geographic investigation; values are geolocation estimates, not guaranteed user locations.
LocationDetails.description_zh: 动态对象，根据登录 IP 地址提供城市、州/省、国家/地区以及经纬度。可用于丰富地理调查；这些值是地理位置估计，不保证是用户真实位置。

MfaDetail.description: Dynamic field documented as deprecated. It may retain legacy MFA information on some rows. Avoid relying on it for current investigations; prefer AuthenticationDetails and AuthenticationMethodsUsed when available.
MfaDetail.description_zh: 动态字段，文档标注为已弃用。部分行可能仍保留旧版 MFA 信息。当前调查中应避免依赖它；可用时优先使用 AuthenticationDetails 和 AuthenticationMethodsUsed。

NetworkLocationDetails.description: Details about the network location, including the type of network and its names, associated with the sign-in. Useful for distinguishing trusted named networks from other locations during investigation.
NetworkLocationDetails.description_zh: 与登录关联的网络位置详细信息，包括网络类型及其名称。可用于在调查中区分受信任的命名网络与其他位置。

OperationName.description: Name of the operation recorded for the sign-in event. Useful to filter or group activity by the action being logged; the exact provider-specific value set is not documented here, so inspect category context.
OperationName.description_zh: 登录事件所记录的操作名称。可用于按被记录的操作进行过滤或分组；此处未记录具体的提供程序相关值集，因此应检查类别上下文。

OperationVersion.description: Version of the operation schema recorded for the sign-in event. Use to understand which schema version produced a row, since field availability can vary across versions.
OperationVersion.description_zh: 登录事件所记录的操作架构版本。可用于了解生成该行的架构版本，因为不同版本的字段可用性可能不同。

OriginalRequestId.description: Request identifier of the first request in an authentication sequence. Use to trace related sign-in steps or chained requests back to the original request during investigation.
OriginalRequestId.description_zh: 身份验证序列中第一个请求的请求标识符。可用于在调查中将相关登录步骤或链式请求追溯到原始请求。

ProcessingTimeInMilliseconds.description: Processing time for the authentication request expressed as text, in milliseconds. Useful for performance or anomaly comparisons; as a string it requires casting before numeric analysis.
ProcessingTimeInMilliseconds.description_zh: 身份验证请求的处理时间，以文本形式表示，单位为毫秒。可用于性能或异常比较；作为字符串，进行数值分析前需要转换类型。

Resource.description: Identifier or reference for the resource involved in the sign-in. Useful for scoping which service or target was accessed; its exact format varies, so inspect alongside ResourceDisplayName and ResourceId.
Resource.description_zh: 登录所涉及资源的标识符或引用。可用于确定访问了哪个服务或目标；其具体格式不一，应结合 ResourceDisplayName 和 ResourceId 一起检查。

ResourceDisplayName.description: Display name of the resource or application the user signed in to. Readable pivot for grouping sign-ins by target app or service during investigation, complementary to AppDisplayName and AppId.
ResourceDisplayName.description_zh: 用户登录的资源或应用程序的显示名称。可按目标应用或服务分组登录，便于调查，与 AppDisplayName 和 AppId 互为补充。

ResourceGroup.description: Azure resource group associated with the exported record or resource context. Useful for scoping where the log data originated; it describes the Azure management grouping, not the signed-in user's group.
ResourceGroup.description_zh: 与导出记录或资源上下文关联的 Azure 资源组。可用于确定日志数据的来源；它描述的是 Azure 管理分组，而不是登录用户所属的组。

ResourceId.description: Identifier of the resource the user signed in to. Use to precisely scope which target resource was accessed, particularly when display names are ambiguous or duplicated.
ResourceId.description_zh: 用户登录目标资源的标识符。可用于精确定位访问了哪个目标资源，特别是在显示名称不明确或重复时。

ResourceIdentity.description: The resource that the user signed in to, expressed as an identity reference. Useful as an additional target-resource pivot; correlate with ResourceServicePrincipalId and ResourceDisplayName for clarity.
ResourceIdentity.description_zh: 用户登录的目标资源，以身份引用形式表示。可作为额外的目标资源分析维度；与 ResourceServicePrincipalId 和 ResourceDisplayName 关联可更清晰。

ResourceProvider.description: The resource provider associated with the exported log record or resource context. Useful for filtering records by provider scope; it does not identify the user or the target application of the sign-in.
ResourceProvider.description_zh: 与导出日志记录或资源上下文关联的资源提供程序。可用于按提供程序范围过滤记录；它不标识登录的用户或目标应用程序。

ResourceServicePrincipalId.description: Identifier of the service principal representing the target resource in the sign-in event. Use to pinpoint which resource-side service principal was accessed, complementing ServicePrincipalId for the caller.
ResourceServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 登录事件中代表目标资源的服务主体标识符。可用于精确定位被访问的资源侧服务主体，与调用方的 ServicePrincipalId 互为补充。

ResourceTenantId.description: Tenant identifier of the resource referenced in the sign-in. Use with HomeTenantId to distinguish resource-side tenancy from user home tenancy in cross-tenant investigation.
ResourceTenantId.description_zh: 登录中引用资源的租户标识符。可与 HomeTenantId 配合，在跨租户调查中区分资源侧租户与用户归属租户。

ResultDescription.description: Human-readable failure reason or error message returned for this sign-in attempt, when ResultType indicates failure. Use it to explain blocked or failed authentications, and pair it with ResultType and Status for investigation.
ResultDescription.description_zh: 当 ResultType 指示失败时，该次登录尝试返回的失败原因或错误信息文本。用于解释被阻止或失败的认证，调查时应与 ResultType、Status 结合使用。

ResultSignature.description: Short signature or status code accompanying the sign-in result for this row; the official wording leaves its exact semantics unspecified, so treat it as a name-derived, supplementary result indicator and correlate with ResultType before drawing conclusions.
ResultSignature.description_zh: 该行登录结果附带的简短签名或状态码；官方文档未明确其确切语义，因此应视为基于名称推导的辅助结果指示，得出结论前请与 ResultType 关联核对。

ResultType.description: Numeric result code of this sign-in attempt: 0 means success, other values indicate errors such as invalid credentials or conditional access blocks. Use it to filter successes versus failures in authentication investigations.
ResultType.description_zh: 该次登录尝试的数字结果代码：0 表示成功，其他值表示凭据错误或条件访问阻止等失败。在认证调查中用于过滤成功与失败事件。

RiskDetail.description: Reason behind the current risk state of this sign-in, such as whether an admin confirmed it safe or dismissed the risk. The value none means no action taken; use it to see how risk detections were handled, not as proof of compromise.
RiskDetail.description_zh: 该次登录当前风险状态背后的原因，例如管理员确认安全或已忽略风险。值 none 表示尚未采取任何处置；用于了解风险检测的处置情况，而非直接证明已遭入侵。

RiskEventTypes.description: Deprecated risk event type list on this sign-in row; documented as deprecated, so prefer RiskEventTypes_V2. If queried, treat values as name-derived and verify coverage against the current column before relying on them.
RiskEventTypes.description_zh: 该登录行上的风险事件类型列表，官方已标记为弃用；应优先使用 RiskEventTypes_V2。若仍需查询，其取值应视为基于名称推导，并在依赖前核对当前列的实际覆盖情况。

RiskEventTypes_V2.description: Risk event types detected for this sign-in, such as anonymized IP, leaked credentials, or malicious IP. Use it to triage which detection drove the risk level; a match is detection evidence, not confirmation that the account was compromised.
RiskEventTypes_V2.description_zh: 本次登录检测到的风险事件类型，如匿名 IP、凭据泄露或恶意 IP。用于判断是哪种检测导致风险等级升高；命中仅为检测证据，并不等于账号已被攻陷。

RiskLevel.description: Risk level recorded for this sign-in row; official wording is absent, so treat as a name-derived summary risk indicator and cross-check with RiskLevelDuringSignIn and RiskLevelAggregated for the detection context you need.
RiskLevel.description_zh: 记录在该登录行上的风险等级；官方未给出具体说明，应视为基于名称推导的汇总风险指示，并结合 RiskLevelDuringSignIn 与 RiskLevelAggregated 核对所需的检测上下文。

RiskLevelAggregated.description: Aggregated risk level computed across detections for this sign-in or user at evaluation time; possible values range none to high, with hidden meaning not enabled for Identity Protection. Use for summarizing overall risk state.
RiskLevelAggregated.description_zh: 评估时针对该次登录或用户跨多种检测计算出的汇总风险等级；取值从 none 到 high，hidden 表示未启用标识保护。用于概括整体风险状态。

RiskLevelDuringSignIn.description: Risk level evaluated specifically at this sign-in moment, which may differ from the aggregated value as detections update. Compare the two to see whether risk escalated before or after token issuance.
RiskLevelDuringSignIn.description_zh: 在该次登录发生时刻评估的风险等级，随着检测结果更新可能与汇总值不同。对比两者可判断风险是在令牌签发前还是之后升级。

RiskState.description: Current disposition of this sign-in's risk, such as atRisk, remediated, dismissed, confirmedSafe, or confirmedCompromised. Use it to track containment and triage progress; it reflects risk handling status, not definitive proof of attacker success.
RiskState.description_zh: 该次登录风险的当前处置状态，如 atRisk、remediated、dismissed、confirmedSafe 或 confirmedCompromised。用于跟踪遏制与研判进展；它反映风险处置状态，而非攻击者得逞的确证。

ServicePrincipalId.description: Identifier of the application or service principal involved when this sign-in is performed by an application. Use it to identify non-interactive workload authentications and correlate them with the application's resource or configuration activity.
ServicePrincipalId.description_zh: 当该次登录由应用程序发起时，涉及的应用或服务主体标识符。用于识别非交互式工作负载认证，并与该应用的资源或配置活动相关联。

ServicePrincipalName.description: Display name of the application or service principal used for this sign-in, populated for application-based authentication. Useful for grouping non-user sign-ins and spotting unexpected or newly seen service identities.
ServicePrincipalName.description_zh: 本次登录所用应用或服务主体的显示名称，仅在基于应用的认证时填充。适用于对非用户登录归类，并识别意外或首次出现的服务身份。

SessionLifetimePolicies.description: Conditional access session lifetime or sign-in frequency policies applied to this sign-in. Use it to check whether session controls, rather than access grants, determined how long this authentication remained valid.
SessionLifetimePolicies.description_zh: 应用于该次登录的条件访问会话生存期或登录频率策略。用于判断是会话控制而非访问授权决定了该认证的有效时长。

SignInIdentifier.description: The identifier the user actually provided when authenticating for this row, which may be a UPN, phone number, or other value. Use it to see the exact input used, especially when it differs from the recorded principal.
SignInIdentifier.description_zh: 该行中用户在认证时实际提供的标识符，可能是 UPN、电话号码或其他值。用于查看确切的输入内容，尤其当其与记录的主体不同时。

SignInIdentifierType.description: Type of the identifier in SignInIdentifier, such as userPrincipalName, phoneNumber, proxyAddress, qrCode, or onPremisesUserPrincipalName. Use it to understand how the user authenticated, including non-UPN or on-premises identities.
SignInIdentifierType.description_zh: SignInIdentifier 中标识符的类型，如 userPrincipalName、phoneNumber、proxyAddress、qrCode 或 onPremisesUserPrincipalName。用于理解用户以何种方式认证，包括非 UPN 或本地身份。

SourceSystem.description: Collection agent that delivered this sign-in record, for example Azure for Azure Diagnostics or an operations manager agent. Use it to understand ingestion path and to scope which platform produced the row.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 投递该登录记录的采集代理，例如 Azure 表示 Azure Diagnostics，或 Operations Manager 代理。用于理解数据摄取路径并界定该行来自哪个平台。

Status.description: Structured sign-in status object for this row, containing the error code and description when the attempt failed. Use it when you need error details in one place instead of the separate ResultType and ResultDescription columns.
Status.description_zh: 该行的结构化登录状态对象，当尝试失败时包含错误代码与描述。当希望在一处获取错误详情而非分别查询 ResultType 与 ResultDescription 时使用。

TenantId.description: Workspace identifier of the Log Analytics workspace that stored this sign-in record, per documentation. It is not the Entra directory tenant ID; scope queries by workspace, not by directory tenant, when using it.
TenantId.description_zh: 根据文档，该字段是存储此登录记录的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符，并非 Entra 目录租户 ID；使用时应按工作区而非目录租户来限定查询范围。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when this sign-in event was generated and available for analysis, used for time-window filtering and sequencing relative to other authentications. Convert and align time zones when correlating with other tables.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 该登录事件生成并可进行分析的时间戳，用于时间窗口过滤以及与其他认证事件排序。与其他表关联时需注意时区换算与对齐。

TokenIssuerName.description: Name of the identity provider that issued the token for this sign-in, for example sts.microsoft.com. Use it to recognize federated or third-party issuers involved in authentication for this row.
TokenIssuerName.description_zh: 为该次登录签发令牌的身份提供程序名称，例如 sts.microsoft.com。用于识别该行认证中涉及的联合或第三方签发者。

TokenIssuerType.description: Type of identity provider that issued the token, such as AzureAD, federation services, backup auth, or extension-based issuers. Use it to distinguish cloud-native from federated authentication paths during investigation.
TokenIssuerType.description_zh: 签发令牌的身份提供程序类型，如 AzureAD、联合服务、备用认证或扩展签发者。用于在调查中区分云原生与联合认证路径。

Type.description: Name of the table this row belongs to, used to distinguish sign-in records from other log tables when queries union multiple sources. Filter on it to keep result sets scoped to sign-in data.
Type.description_zh: 该行所属表的名称，用于在查询联合多个数据源时区分登录记录与其他日志表。通过过滤该字段可将结果集限定为登录数据。

UniqueTokenIdentifier.description: Base64-encoded request identifier that tracks a token issued for this sign-in as it is redeemed at resource providers. Use it to follow a specific token across downstream resource access events.
UniqueTokenIdentifier.description_zh: 用于跟踪本次登录所签发令牌在资源提供程序中兑付过程的 Base64 编码请求标识符。可用于跨下游资源访问事件追踪某个特定令牌。

UserAgent.description: User agent string reported by the client performing this sign-in, indicating browser, operating system, or application type. Use it to fingerprint clients and flag unusual or scripted authentication tools.
UserAgent.description_zh: 执行该次登录的客户端上报的用户代理字符串，可指示浏览器、操作系统或应用类型。用于对客户端进行指纹识别，并标记异常或脚本化认证工具。

UserDisplayName.description: Human-readable display name of the account that attempted this sign-in, useful for reporting and pivoting to related accounts; names can collide, so confirm identity via UserId or UserPrincipalName.
UserDisplayName.description_zh: 本次登录尝试所用账户的可读显示名称，便于报表展示和关联其他账户；名称可能重复，应通过 UserId 或 UserPrincipalName 确认身份。

UserId.description: Stable directory object identifier of the signing-in user for this attempt; use it to reliably group a person's sign-ins across name or UPN changes, since it is a unique ID rather than a display value.
UserId.description_zh: 本次登录用户在目录中的稳定对象标识符；即使显示名或 UPN 变更也可用它可靠聚合同一用户的登录记录，属于唯一 ID 而非显示值。

UserPrincipalName.description: Sign-in name (typically user@domain) presented by the account in this event; primary pivot for per-user sign-in timelines, password-spray targeting, and correlating with mailbox or identity tables.
UserPrincipalName.description_zh: 本次事件中账户使用的登录名（通常为 user@domain）；是构建单用户登录时间线、识别密码喷洒目标以及关联邮箱或身份表的主要透视字段。

UserType.description: Whether the signing-in principal is treated as a member or guest in the tenant for this event; use to separate internal staff sign-ins from external/collaboration accounts during triage and access reviews.
UserType.description_zh: 本次事件中登录主体在该租户内被视为成员还是来宾；用于在排查和访问审查中区分内部员工登录与外部协作账户登录。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

ThreatIntelligenceIndicator.description: Microsoft Sentinel threat intelligence indicator records, each row an indicator imported from a provider or feed with its observables and metadata. Use it to look up known-bad domains, IPs, URLs, file hashes, or email artifacts, to check confidence, severity, kill-chain coverage, and whether an indicator is active before or after expiration. Pivot on IndicatorProvider, ThreatType, Tags, and observables such as NetworkIP or FileHashValue. This is curated intelligence, not raw log telemetry; a match suggests known-bad, not confirmed compromise.
ThreatIntelligenceIndicator.description_zh: Microsoft Sentinel 威胁情报指标记录，每行是从提供程序或情报源导入的一条指标，包含其可观测对象和元数据。可用于查询已知恶意的域、IP、URL、文件哈希或邮件特征，检查置信度、严重性、杀伤链覆盖情况，以及指标在过期前后是否处于活动状态。可按 IndicatorProvider、ThreatType、Tags 及 NetworkIP、FileHashValue 等可观测字段进行关联分析。这是整理过的情报数据而非原始日志遥测；命中仅表示已知恶意，并不等于已确认失陷。

Action.description: Name-derived: the disposition or handling action the provider recommends when this indicator matches, not an observed event. Inspect indicator/provider context before treating values as blocked or allowed.
Action.description_zh: 名称推导：提供程序建议在本指标命中时采取的处置或处理动作，并非已观测事件。将取值视为阻止或允许前，请先检查指标及提供程序上下文。

Active.description: Boolean flag showing whether this indicator is currently enabled in the feed at ingestion time. Use it to include or exclude still-valid indicators; false may mean retired, not disproven.
Active.description_zh: 布尔标志，表示该指标在摄取时于情报源中是否处于启用状态。可用其纳入或排除仍然有效的指标；false 可能表示已停用，而非被证伪。

ActivityGroupNames.description: Named threat activity groups or actors this indicator is attributed to by the provider. Use for actor-based pivoting; attribution is provider opinion, not confirmed evidence of that actor's presence.
ActivityGroupNames.description_zh: 提供程序将该指标归属到的威胁活动组织或行为体名称。可用于按行为体关联；归属仅为提供程序判断，并非该行为体已存在的确证证据。

AdditionalInformation.description: Free-text analyst or provider notes attached to this indicator. Scan for context, caveats, or handling guidance; content is unstructured and varies by feed.
AdditionalInformation.description_zh: 附加在本指标上的分析人员或提供程序自由文本备注。可浏览其中的上下文、注意事项或处置指引；内容非结构化且因情报源而异。

ApplicationId.description: Name-derived, no official column description: likely an application or solution identifier associated with this indicator. Inspect resource/provider context rather than assuming directory or app-registration semantics.
ApplicationId.description_zh: 名称推导，无官方列说明：可能与本指标关联的应用程序或解决方案标识符。应检查资源/提供程序上下文，勿臆断为目录或应用注册语义。

AzureTenantId.description: Name-derived, no official column description: appears to identify an Azure tenant scope for the indicator. Inspect the indicator and provider context; do not conflate with the workspace TenantId column in this table.
AzureTenantId.description_zh: 名称推导，无官方列说明：似为指标所属的 Azure 租户范围。请检查指标与提供程序上下文；勿与本表中的工作区 TenantId 列混为一谈。

ConfidenceScore.description: Provider-assigned confidence rating for this indicator, documented 0 to 100. Higher values mean greater provider confidence; use as weighting, not proof the indicator is accurate or that a match means compromise.
ConfidenceScore.description_zh: 提供程序为本指标赋予的置信度评分，文档说明为 0 至 100。数值越高表示提供程序越确信；应作为权重使用，而非指标准确或命中即失陷的证据。

Description.description: Human-readable summary explaining what this indicator represents, supplied by the provider or curator. Read for intent and scope before acting on matches from this row.
Description.description_zh: 由提供程序或整理者提供的可读摘要，说明本指标代表什么。在依据此行命中采取行动前，请先阅读以了解意图与范围。

DiamondModel.description: Diamond Model classification of this indicator's role, documented as adversary, capability, infrastructure, or victim. Use it to group indicators by analytic function during hunting or campaign mapping.
DiamondModel.description_zh: 本指标角色的钻石模型分类，文档说明为对手、能力、基础设施或受害者。可用于在狩猎或战役分析中按分析功能对指标分组。

DomainName.description: The domain-name observable carried by this indicator row. Match it against DNS, proxy, or email telemetry; a match shows contact with a known-bad domain, not that compromise occurred.
DomainName.description_zh: 本指标行所携带的域名可观测对象。可将其与 DNS、代理或邮件遥测匹配；命中表示接触了已知恶意域，并不代表已发生失陷。

EmailEncoding.description: Email encoding observable recorded for this indicator, describing encoding characteristics of the referenced message. Useful for narrowing email-based indicator hunting; not evidence of delivery or reading.
EmailEncoding.description_zh: 本指标记录的邮件编码可观测对象，描述所引用邮件的编码特征。有助于缩小基于邮件的指标狩猎范围；并非投递或已阅读的证据。

EmailLanguage.description: Email language observable recorded for this indicator, indicating the language of the referenced message. Use to filter email-indicator hunts by locale; presence does not prove any mailbox received it.
EmailLanguage.description_zh: 本指标记录的邮件语言可观测对象，表示所引用邮件的语言。可用于按区域筛选邮件指标狩猎；其存在并不证明任何邮箱已接收该邮件。

EmailRecipient.description: Email recipient observable associated with this indicator, naming a targeted or related mailbox. Pivot on it to find other indicators aimed at the same recipient; it is not proof of successful delivery.
EmailRecipient.description_zh: 与本指标关联的邮件收件人可观测对象，指明被针对或相关的邮箱。可据此关联针对同一收件人的其他指标；它并非成功投递的证据。

EmailSenderAddress.description: Email sender address observable for this indicator, the from-address of the referenced message. Use for sender-based hunting or blocking rules; treat as provider-supplied intelligence, not observed mail flow.
EmailSenderAddress.description_zh: 本指标的邮件发件人地址可观测对象，即所引用邮件的发件地址。可用于基于发件人的狩猎或拦截规则；应视为提供程序给出的情报，而非已观测的邮件流。

EmailSenderName.description: Email sender display-name observable recorded for this indicator. Compare with sender names in mail telemetry during hunting; display names are spoofable and alone do not identify a real actor.
EmailSenderName.description_zh: 本指标记录的邮件发件人显示名称可观测对象。在狩猎时与邮件遥测中的发件人名称比对；显示名称可被伪造，单凭它无法确定真实行为体。

EmailSourceDomain.description: Email source domain observable for this indicator, the domain the referenced message originated from. Pivot against mail gateway headers; it reflects provider intelligence, not confirmed message origin in your environment.
EmailSourceDomain.description_zh: 本指标的邮件来源域可观测对象，即所引用邮件的来源域。可与邮件网关头信息关联；它反映提供程序情报，而非你环境中已确认的邮件来源。

EmailSourceIpAddress.description: Email source IP address observable for this indicator, indicating where the referenced message was sent from. Use for IP correlation; addresses are shared infrastructure and alone do not attribute an actor.
EmailSourceIpAddress.description_zh: 本指标的邮件来源 IP 地址可观测对象，表示所引用邮件的发送位置。可用于 IP 关联；地址属共享基础设施，单凭其无法归属行为体。

EmailSubject.description: Email subject observable for this indicator, the subject line of the referenced message. Use in content-based mail hunting or filtering; treat it as known-bad intelligence, not a message seen in your tenant.
EmailSubject.description_zh: 本指标的邮件主题可观测对象，即所引用邮件的主题行。可用于基于内容的邮件狩猎或过滤；应将其视为已知恶意情报，而非你租户中出现的邮件。

EmailXMailer.description: Email X-Mailer header observable for this indicator, describing the sending mail client of the referenced message. Use to fingerprint phishing tooling; it is provider intelligence, not proof your mail flow contained it.
EmailXMailer.description_zh: 本指标的邮件 X-Mailer 头可观测对象，描述所引用邮件的发信客户端。可用于识别钓鱼工具指纹；它属提供程序情报，并非你的邮件流中确实包含它的证据。

ExpirationDateTime.description: Timestamp when this indicator stops being considered valid, set by the provider or curator. Compare with TimeGenerated and current time to judge freshness; expired indicators may need excluding from detections.
ExpirationDateTime.description_zh: 提供程序或整理者设定的本指标失效时间戳。可与 TimeGenerated 及当前时间比较以判断新鲜度；匹配检测时应考虑排除已过期指标。

ExternalIndicatorId.description: Identifier assigned to this indicator by the submitting or source system. Use to trace the indicator back to its origin feed or ticket; it is not the Sentinel IndicatorId for this record.
ExternalIndicatorId.description_zh: 提交或来源系统为本指标分配的标识符。可用于将指标追溯回原始情报源或工单；它不是本记录的 Sentinel IndicatorId。

FileCompileDateTime.description: File compilation timestamp observable for this indicator, the build time of the referenced file. Compare with file timestamps in endpoint telemetry; it is intelligence about a known-bad file, not a file seen on a device.
FileCompileDateTime.description_zh: 本指标的文件编译时间戳可观测对象，即所引用文件的构建时间。可与终端的文件时间戳比较；它是关于已知恶意文件的情报，而非设备上实际出现的文件。

FileCreatedDateTime.description: File creation timestamp observable recorded for this indicator. Use to correlate with file metadata in endpoint or storage logs; the indicator describes a known-bad file, not one confirmed on your hosts.
FileCreatedDateTime.description_zh: 本指标记录的文件创建时间戳可观测对象。可用于与终端或存储日志中的文件元数据关联；该指标描述已知恶意文件，而非你主机上已确认的文件。

FileHashType.description: The hash algorithm type for the file hash observable in this indicator, such as MD5 or SHA-256. Check it before comparing FileHashValue to hashes in your data to avoid mismatched algorithm comparisons.
FileHashType.description_zh: 本指标中文件哈希可观测对象的哈希算法类型，如 MD5 或 SHA-256。在将 FileHashValue 与你的数据中的哈希比较前先检查它，避免算法不一致的比对。

FileHashValue.description: Hash value of a file named in this indicator. Combine with FileHashType to match against process/file telemetry. Its presence indicates an indicator, not that this hash was observed or malicious in isolation.
FileHashValue.description_zh: 该指示器中文件名的哈希值。结合 FileHashType 与进程/文件遥测匹配。其存在表示它是指示器，并不代表该哈希已被观察到或本身即为恶意。

FileMutexName.description: Name of a mutex associated with the file in this indicator. Use to pivot on mutex names in endpoint telemetry when hunting for the associated activity; a value here is an indicator attribute, not proof of execution.
FileMutexName.description_zh: 与此指示器中文件相关联的互斥体名称。在终端遥测中按互斥体名进行追踪以猎捕关联活动；此处的值是指示器属性，并非执行证据。

FileName.description: File name observable for this indicator. Use with FilePath or FileHashValue to correlate against file creation, process, or malware events; it describes the indicator's file, not a file observed on a host.
FileName.description_zh: 该指示器的文件名可观测项。可与 FilePath 或 FileHashValue 一起关联文件创建、进程或恶意软件事件；它描述的是指示器的文件，而非主机上观察到的文件。

FilePacker.description: Packer associated with the file in this indicator. Use as a hunting or enrichment attribute to group indicators by packing tooling; presence does not by itself indicate maliciousness or observation in your environment.
FilePacker.description_zh: 与此指示器中文件相关联的加壳工具。可作为猎捕或补充属性，按打包工具对指示器分组；其存在本身并不表示恶意或已在你的环境中被观察到。

FilePath.description: File path observable for this indicator. Use with FileName or FileHashValue to match against endpoint file and process paths; it describes the indicator's file location, not a path observed in telemetry.
FilePath.description_zh: 该指示器的文件路径可观测项。可与 FileName 或 FileHashValue 一起匹配终端文件及进程路径；它描述的是指示器的文件位置，而非遥测中观察到的路径。

FileSize.description: Size associated with the file in this indicator. Use as a filtering or grouping attribute when triaging file-based indicators; the unit is not specified by the schema, so verify scale before comparing to observed file sizes.
FileSize.description_zh: 与此指示器中文件相关联的大小。在研判基于文件的指示器时可作为筛选或分组属性；模式未指定单位，与观察到的文件大小比较前需确认量级。

FileType.description: File type observable for this indicator, such as a format or extension. Use to filter or group file-based indicators during hunting; it is an indicator attribute, not a determination that a matching file is malicious.
FileType.description_zh: 该指示器的文件类型可观测项，例如格式或扩展名。在猎捕时可筛选或分组基于文件的指示器；它是指示器属性，并不判定匹配文件即为恶意。

IndicatorId.description: Identifier assigned to this indicator, per documentation calculated by the receiving system. Use for deduplication, tracking, and joins across indicator records; treat uniqueness as not guaranteed by the schema.
IndicatorId.description_zh: 分配给该指示器的标识符，文档说明由接收系统计算。可用于去重、跟踪和跨指示器记录的关联；不应假定模式保证其唯一性。

IndicatorProvider.description: Name of the entity that supplied this indicator. Use to attribute provenance, weight confidence, compare feeds, and filter to trusted sources; it describes the source of the indicator, not the actor or target.
IndicatorProvider.description_zh: 提供该指示器的实体名称。可用于归因来源、权衡置信度、比较情报源并筛选可信来源；它描述的是指示器来源，而非行为者或目标。

KillChainActions.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the kill chain value 'actions' is set for this indicator. Use to filter indicators by intended stage when prioritizing hunts; multiple kill chain flags may be true on one row.
KillChainActions.description_zh: 布尔标志，指示该指示器是否设置杀伤链值“actions”。在制定猎捕优先级时可按预期阶段筛选指示器；同一行可能有多个杀伤链标志为真。

KillChainC2.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the kill chain value 'C2' (command and control) is set for this indicator. Use to isolate infrastructure likely used for command and control; it is a classification of the indicator, not proof of active C2.
KillChainC2.description_zh: 布尔标志，指示该指示器是否设置杀伤链值“C2”（命令与控制）。可用于隔离可能用于命令控制的基础设施；它是指示器的分类，并非活跃 C2 的证据。

KillChainDelivery.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the kill chain value 'delivery' is set for this indicator. Use to prioritize delivery-stage indicators such as malicious senders or URLs; a set flag classifies the indicator, not an observed delivery event.
KillChainDelivery.description_zh: 布尔标志，指示该指示器是否设置杀伤链值“delivery”。可用于优先处理投递阶段指示器（如恶意发件人或 URL）；标志为真只是对指示器分类，并非观察到投递事件。

KillChainExploitation.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the kill chain value 'exploitation' is set for this indicator. Use to filter indicators tied to exploitation activity; the flag is indicator metadata and does not confirm exploitation occurred.
KillChainExploitation.description_zh: 布尔标志，指示该指示器是否设置杀伤链值“exploitation”。可用于筛选与利用活动相关的指示器；该标志是指示器元数据，并不确认已发生利用。

KillChainReconnaissance.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the kill chain value 'reconnaissance' is set for this indicator. Use to focus on indicators tied to early-stage probing; a set flag reflects classification, not confirmed reconnaissance against your environment.
KillChainReconnaissance.description_zh: 布尔标志，指示该指示器是否设置杀伤链值“reconnaissance”。可用于聚焦与早期探测相关的指示器；标志为真反映分类，并非确认对你的环境进行了侦察。

KillChainWeaponization.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the kill chain value 'weaponization' is set for this indicator. Use to identify indicators tied to weaponization stages; it classifies the indicator and does not indicate delivery or compromise.
KillChainWeaponization.description_zh: 布尔标志，指示该指示器是否设置杀伤链值“weaponization”。可用于识别与武器化阶段相关的指示器；它是对指示器的分类，并不表示投递或入侵。

KnownFalsePositives.description: Free-text notes describing situations where this indicator may raise false positives. Use during triage to assess noise and set suppression expectations; it is provider guidance, not a guarantee of benign or malicious outcomes.
KnownFalsePositives.description_zh: 描述该指示器可能产生误报情况的自由文本说明。研判时可用于评估噪声并制定抑制预期；它是提供方指导，并非良性或恶意的保证。

MalwareNames.description: List of malware family or sample names associated with this indicator, per documentation. Use for enrichment, pivoting, and grouping by malware family; association does not prove infection or that the indicator is currently active.
MalwareNames.description_zh: 按文档所述，与该指示器关联的恶意软件家族或样本名称列表。可用于情报补充、追踪和按恶意软件家族分组；关联并不证明感染或指示器当前活跃。

NetworkCidrBlock.description: Network CIDR block observable for this indicator, representing a range rather than a single address. Use to match or aggregate indicators spanning subnets; address scope (source, destination, generic) is not specified by the column name.
NetworkCidrBlock.description_zh: 该指示器的网络 CIDR 块可观测项，表示一个范围而非单一地址。可用于匹配或聚合跨子网的指示器；列名未指定地址范围（源、目的或通用）。

NetworkDestinationAsn.description: Destination autonomous system number observable for this indicator. Use to group or enrich indicators by hosting network; the schema does not document ASN format or mapping source, so verify before relying on it.
NetworkDestinationAsn.description_zh: 该指示器的目的自治系统编号可观测项。可用于按托管网络分组或补充指示器；模式未记录 ASN 格式或映射来源，使用前需核实。

NetworkDestinationCidrBlock.description: Destination network CIDR block observable for this indicator. Use to match traffic ranges in investigations involving outbound connections; it describes the indicator's destination range, not a range observed in your logs.
NetworkDestinationCidrBlock.description_zh: 该指示器的目的网络 CIDR 块可观测项。在涉及出站连接的调查中可用于匹配流量范围；它描述指示器的目的范围，而非日志中观察到的范围。

NetworkDestinationIP.description: Destination IP address observable for this indicator. Use to match outbound connection telemetry to known-bad destinations; presence in this table means it is an indicator, not that it was contacted or is malicious.
NetworkDestinationIP.description_zh: 该指示器的目的 IP 地址可观测项。可用于将出站连接遥测与已知恶意目的匹配；出现在本表中意味着它是指示器，并不表示已被联系或确为恶意。

NetworkDestinationPort.description: Destination port observable for this indicator. Use with NetworkDestinationIP to refine matching of outbound connections during hunting; it is an indicator attribute and not a port observed in your environment.
NetworkDestinationPort.description_zh: 该指示器的目的端口可观测项。可与 NetworkDestinationIP 一起在猎捕时细化出站连接匹配；它是指示器属性，并非你环境中观察到的端口。

NetworkIP.description: Network IP address observable for this indicator without a specified source/destination role. Check accompanying fields and context before treating it as source or destination; it is an indicator value, not proof of contact.
NetworkIP.description_zh: 该指示器的网络 IP 地址可观测项，未指定源/目的角色。在将其视为源或目的之前，应检查伴随字段和上下文；它是指示器值，并非联系证据。

NetworkPort.description: Network port observable for this indicator without a specified source/destination role. Inspect related fields to determine port context; it describes the indicator, not a port observed in network telemetry.
NetworkPort.description_zh: 该指示器的网络端口可观测项，未指定源/目的角色。需检查相关字段以确定端口上下文；它描述指示器，而非网络遥测中观察到的端口。

NetworkProtocol.description: Numeric protocol observable for this indicator's network activity (for example IP protocol number); interpret alongside source/destination IP and port fields and confirm the encoding before using it in pivots.
NetworkProtocol.description_zh: 该指标网络活动的协议数值可观测项（例如 IP 协议号）；使用时应结合源/目标 IP 与端口字段，并在用于关联分析前确认其编码方式。

NetworkSourceAsn.description: Autonomous system number associated with this indicator's source network address; useful for grouping or filtering indicators by originating network operator, and requires confirming the ASN convention when interpreting.
NetworkSourceAsn.description_zh: 与该指标源网络地址关联的自治系统号；可用于按来源网络运营商对指标进行分组或过滤，解读时需确认 ASN 的表示约定。

NetworkSourceCidrBlock.description: CIDR block covering this indicator's source network range; use to match or scope indicators to address ranges rather than single addresses, noting it describes the indicator's observable, not a live connection.
NetworkSourceCidrBlock.description_zh: 覆盖该指标源网络范围的 CIDR 块；可用于将指标匹配或限定到地址段而非单个地址，注意它描述的是指标的可观测项，而不是实时连接。

NetworkSourceIP.description: Source IP address observable recorded for this indicator; use to match indicators against observed network traffic, remembering it is indicator metadata rather than proof that traffic occurred in this tenant.
NetworkSourceIP.description_zh: 为该指标记录的源 IP 地址可观测项；可用于将指标与观察到的网络流量进行匹配，但请记住这只是指标元数据，并不证明本租户中确实发生了流量。

NetworkSourcePort.description: Source port observable associated with this indicator's network context; pair with protocol, source IP and destination fields when scoping matches, and treat a match as intelligence context, not confirmed compromise.
NetworkSourcePort.description_zh: 与该指标网络上下文关联的源端口可观测项；在限定匹配范围时应与协议、源 IP 和目标字段配合使用，并将匹配结果视为情报上下文，而非已确认的失陷。

PassiveOnly.description: Boolean flag on this indicator record indicating whether it should not generate user-visible alerts or triggering events; use when filtering indicators for detection use versus passive enrichment, following the documented indicator semantics.
PassiveOnly.description_zh: 该指标记录上的布尔标志，表明它是否不应生成用户可见的告警或触发事件；在筛选用于检测的指标与用于被动扩充的指标时使用，并遵循已记录的指标语义。

SourceSystem.description: Identifies the agent or collection path that produced this indicator record, such as Operations Manager, Linux, or Azure Diagnostics; use it to separate ingestion routes when indicator metadata appears inconsistent.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 标识产生该指标记录的代理或收集路径，例如 Operations Manager、Linux 或 Azure Diagnostics；当指标元数据出现不一致时，可用它区分不同的摄取路径。

Tags.description: Free-form tags attached to this indicator record; use to filter or group indicators by provider- or analyst-supplied labels, but treat tag content as unvalidated text and inspect values before relying on them.
Tags.description_zh: 附加到该指标记录的自由格式标记；可用于按提供方或分析人员提供的标签筛选或分组指标，但应将标签内容视为未经校验的文本，依赖前先检查其取值。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace identifier associated with this indicator record; use it to scope queries to the correct workspace, and do not interpret it as a Microsoft Entra directory tenant identifier.
TenantId.description_zh: 与该指标记录关联的 Log Analytics 工作区标识符；可用它将查询限定到正确的工作区，请勿将其解释为 Microsoft Entra 目录租户标识符。

ThreatSeverity.description: Numeric severity rating assigned to this indicator, documented as 0 to 5 with higher values indicating greater severity; use for prioritization and sorting of enrichment results, not as proof of compromise.
ThreatSeverity.description_zh: 分配给该指标的数值严重性评级，文档标称为 0 到 5，数值越高表示越严重；可用于对扩充结果进行优先级排序，但不能作为失陷的证据。

ThreatType.description: Category or type assigned to this indicator describing what kind of threat it represents; use to group or filter indicators by threat category, and inspect distinct values rather than assuming a fixed enumeration.
ThreatType.description_zh: 分配给该指标的类型或类别，描述其代表的威胁种类；可用于按威胁类别对指标进行分组或过滤，应检查实际取值而不是假定存在固定枚举。

TimeGenerated.description: Timestamp when this indicator record was ingested into the workspace, per documentation; use for time-window filtering and recency checks, bearing in mind ingestion time may differ from when the indicator was created or last seen.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 根据文档，该指标记录被摄取到工作区的时间戳；可用于时间窗口过滤和新鲜度检查，但需注意摄取时间可能不同于指标创建或最近出现的时间。

TrafficLightProtocolLevel.description: Traffic Light Protocol sharing level documented as white, green, amber, or red for this indicator; use to judge handling and sharing restrictions on the indicator before including it in reports.
TrafficLightProtocolLevel.description_zh: 该指标的 Traffic Light Protocol 共享级别，文档标称为 white、green、amber 或 red；在将指标纳入报告前，可用它判断指标的处理和共享限制。

Type.description: Name of the table that stored this record; typically ThreatIntelligenceIndicator, useful for verifying table scope and for union queries across multiple indicator or log sources.
Type.description_zh: 存储该记录的表名称；通常为 ThreatIntelligenceIndicator，可用于验证表范围以及跨多个指标或日志源执行联合查询。

Url.description: URL observable recorded for this indicator; use to match against web or email URL events, but a matching URL in other logs indicates observed reference, not that anyone clicked or browsed it.
Url.description_zh: 为该指标记录的 URL 可观测项；可用于与 Web 或电子邮件 URL 事件匹配，但其他日志中出现匹配 URL 仅表示被引用，并不代表有人点击或访问过它。

UserAgent.description: User agent string observable associated with this indicator; use to enrich or match HTTP-related telemetry, and be aware user agents are easily spoofed so a match is context, not proof.
UserAgent.description_zh: 与该指标关联的用户代理字符串可观测项；可用于扩充或匹配 HTTP 相关遥测数据，并注意用户代理容易被伪造，因此匹配只是上下文而非证据。

rn.description: Export row-number field rather than a security-event identifier. Its ordering rule is not documented in the source schema; use event timestamps and entity identifiers for investigation timelines.
rn.description_zh: 导出数据中的行编号字段，不是安全事件标识。源架构未说明其排序规则；构建调查时间线应使用事件时间和实体标识。

UrlClickEvents.description: UrlClickEvents records Microsoft Defender for Office 365 URL click events: each row represents a user selecting or requesting a URL from Email, Office, or Teams, generated by the Safe Links/click protection pipeline. Use it to trace who clicked a specific URL, when, from which public IP, what verdict applied, and whether the click was allowed through or blocked. Pivots include AccountUpn, Url, UrlChain, NetworkMessageId, and ReportId for correlating email and click events. Boundary: this is click telemetry, not email delivery or device process activity; an entry here does not by itself prove malware execution or compromise.
UrlClickEvents.description_zh: UrlClickEvents 记录 Microsoft Defender for Office 365 的 URL 点击事件：每行代表用户从 Email、Office 或 Teams 中选择或请求某个 URL，由 Safe Links/点击防护管道生成。可用它追踪谁在何时从哪个公网 IP 点击了特定 URL、当时适用的判定结果，以及点击是被放行还是被阻止。可用 AccountUpn、Url、UrlChain、NetworkMessageId 和 ReportId 关联邮件与点击事件。边界：这是点击遥测，不是邮件投递或设备进程活动；出现该记录本身不能证明恶意软件已执行或系统已失陷。

AccountUpn.description: User Principal Name of the account that clicked the URL, tying the click to a specific identity. Scope by this to answer who interacted with a suspicious link.
AccountUpn.description_zh: 点击该 URL 的账户的用户主体名称，将点击事件与具体身份关联。按此字段限定范围可回答谁与可疑链接发生了交互。

ActionType.description: Whether Safe Links or a tenant policy allowed or blocked the click. Use it to distinguish a permitted click-through from a blocked attempt at click time.
ActionType.description_zh: 表示 Safe Links 或租户策略是允许还是阻止了该点击。可用它区分点击时被放行的点击与被阻止的尝试。

DetectionMethods.description: Detection technology that flagged the threat at click time. Name-derived; string values vary by provider. Use to see which detection engine produced the verdict alongside ThreatTypes.
DetectionMethods.description_zh: 点击时识别出威胁的检测技术。基于名称推断；字符串取值因提供商而异。可结合 ThreatTypes 查看是哪个检测引擎给出的判定。

IPAddress.description: Public IP address of the device from which the user clicked the link. Pivot here for geo or network context; it is client-side public IP, not an internal host address.
IPAddress.description_zh: 用户点击链接所用设备的公网 IP 地址。可按此字段关联地理位置或网络上下文；这是客户端公网 IP，不是内部主机地址。

IsClickedThrough.description: Boolean indicating whether the user reached the original URL or was stopped. Pair with ActionType and ThreatTypes to assess real exposure versus a blocked click.
IsClickedThrough.description_zh: 布尔值，表示用户是否到达原始 URL 还是被拦截。可结合 ActionType 与 ThreatTypes 评估实际暴露情况与被阻止的点击。

NetworkMessageId.description: Microsoft 365-generated identifier of the email containing the clicked link. Use it to join this click back to the originating email message and its delivery events.
NetworkMessageId.description_zh: Microsoft 365 生成的、包含所点击链接的电子邮件标识符。可用它将该次点击关联回原始邮件及其投递事件。

ReportId.description: Unique identifier for the click event; click-through scenarios share the same value. Use it to correlate related click rows for one interaction.
ReportId.description_zh: 点击事件的唯一标识符；点击穿透场景共享相同取值。可用它关联同一次交互产生的相关点击记录。

SourceSystem.description: Agent type that collected the event, for example OpsManager or Azure. Mostly a pipeline artifact; use only to confirm ingestion path, not user behavior.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 收集该事件的代理类型，例如 OpsManager 或 Azure。主要用于确认数据采集管道，并不反映用户行为。

TenantId.description: Log Analytics workspace ID documented for this table; it is a workspace identifier, not the directory tenant ID. Use to scope queries to one workspace.
TenantId.description_zh: 该表文档所述的 Log Analytics 工作区 ID；它是工作区标识符，不是目录租户 ID。可用于将查询限定在单个工作区。

ThreatTypes.description: Verdict at click time saying whether the URL led to malware, phish, or other threats. Combine with ActionType and IsClickedThrough to judge what protection applied.
ThreatTypes.description_zh: 点击时的判定结果，说明该 URL 指向恶意软件、钓鱼或其他威胁。可结合 ActionType 与 IsClickedThrough 判断当时施加了何种防护。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the user clicked the link; documented as identical to Timestamp. Primary time boundary for scoping clicks to an investigation window.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 用户点击链接的日期和时间；文档说明与 Timestamp 相同。是将点击事件限定到调查时间窗口的主要时间边界。

Timestamp.description: Time at which the source service recorded this event or observation. Use it to restrict the investigation window and order records; keep it distinct from process creation or other object-specific timestamps.
Timestamp.description_zh: 源服务记录该事件或观测的时间。用于限定调查时间范围及排列记录；应与进程创建时间或其他对象专属时间区分。

Type.description: The table name, used by log pipelines to identify the source table. Filter on it when combining UrlClickEvents rows with other tables in a union.
Type.description_zh: 表名称，日志管道用它标识来源表。在联合查询中将 UrlClickEvents 记录与其他表合并时可按此字段过滤。

Url.description: The full URL the user clicked. Pivot here to find other users who clicked the same link, and treat clicks as attempts rather than proof of payload delivery.
Url.description_zh: 用户点击的完整 URL。可按此字段查找点击同一链接的其他用户；点击只是尝试，并非载荷已投递的证明。

UrlChain.description: For redirection scenarios, lists the URLs present in the redirection chain. Inspect it to see intermediate hops between the clicked URL and the final destination.
UrlChain.description_zh: 在重定向场景中，列出重定向链中出现的 URL。可检查点击 URL 与最终目的地之间的中间跳转。

Workload.description: Application the user clicked from, with documented values Email, Office and Teams. Use it to separate email-borne clicks from chat or document clicks.
Workload.description_zh: 用户点击链接时所用的应用，文档中取值包括 Email、Office 和 Teams。可用它区分邮件来源的点击与聊天或文档中的点击。

Usage.description: Hourly per-table workspace usage and billing records emitted by Azure Monitor for a Log Analytics workspace. Each row aggregates one hour for one data type, showing ingest quantity, billability, meter, and SLA batch counters, so it answers capacity, cost, and data-growth questions by table, solution, or time. Useful pivots are DataType, Solution, TimeGenerated/StartTime, IsBillable, and MeterId. It is not an event or alert table: it summarizes ingestion rather than security activity, and describes volume, not telemetry content.
Usage.description_zh: 该表记录 Azure Monitor 针对 Log Analytics 工作区按小时、按表的用量与计费数据。每一行汇总某个数据类型在某一小时内的摄取量、可计费性、计量器和 SLA 批次计数，可用于按表、解决方案或时间分析容量、成本与数据增长。可用维度包括 DataType、Solution、TimeGenerated/StartTime、IsBillable 和 MeterId。它不是事件或警报表：汇总的是摄取情况而非安全活动，描述的是数据量而非遥测内容。

AvgLatencyInSeconds.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: average ingestion latency in seconds for the hour's usage record. Inspect historical documentation before relying on it; modern analyses should prefer timing fields such as StartTime and TimeGenerated.
AvgLatencyInSeconds.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：该小时用量记录的平均摄取延迟（秒）。使用前应查阅历史文档；现代分析应优先使用 StartTime 和 TimeGenerated 等时间字段。

BatchesCapped.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: count of usage batches capped during this hourly aggregation. Values are legacy; treat with caution and do not assume current platform behavior from it.
BatchesCapped.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：本次小时聚合期间被截断的用量批次数。该值为历史遗留，使用需谨慎，不能据此推断当前平台行为。

BatchesOutsideSla.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: count of batches outside the service-level agreement for this hourly record. Historical metric only; avoid drawing current SLA conclusions without supporting documentation.
BatchesOutsideSla.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：本次小时记录中超出服务级别协议（SLA）的批次数量。仅为历史指标，若无文档支持不应据此判断当前 SLA。

BatchesWithinSla.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: count of usage batches completed within the service-level agreement for this hour. Legacy field; use alongside documented SLA guidance rather than as sole evidence.
BatchesWithinSla.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：该小时内符合服务级别协议（SLA）完成的用量批次数。属于遗留字段，应与官方 SLA 说明结合使用，不应作为唯一依据。

Computer.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: host associated with the usage record in legacy collection paths. For workspace-level ingestion queries, Computer is commonly unpopulated; inspect row context instead of assuming a device identity.
Computer.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：旧采集路径中与用量记录关联的主机。对于工作区级摄取查询，Computer 通常为空；应检查行上下文，不要假设其代表设备身份。

DataType.description: Identifies which workspace table the reported usage concerns, enabling per-table ingest volume and cost comparisons. Group by DataType with Quantity to find the largest contributing data sources in a period.
DataType.description_zh: 标识所报告用量涉及的工作区哪张表，可用于按表比较摄取量与成本。与 Quantity 一起按 DataType 分组，可找出某时间段内贡献量最大的数据源。

EndTime.description: End timestamp of the one-hour aggregation window that this usage row covers. Use with StartTime for precise window boundaries; it marks the close of the hour, not a security event time.
EndTime.description_zh: 该用量行所覆盖的一小时聚合窗口的结束时间戳。可与 StartTime 配合确定精确窗口边界；它表示该小时结束，而非安全事件时间。

IsBillable.description: Logical flag indicating whether the platform considers this usage record chargeable. Combine with Quantity and MeterId to separate billable ingest volume from free or internal usage.
IsBillable.description_zh: 逻辑标志，表示平台是否将该用量记录视为可计费。可与 Quantity、MeterId 结合，将可计费摄取量与非计费或内部用量区分开。

LinkedMeterId.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: linked billing meter GUID in legacy usage records. Do not treat as active billing data; prefer MeterId and current documentation for cost analysis.
LinkedMeterId.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：旧用量记录中的关联计费计量器 GUID。不应视为当前计费数据；成本分析应优先使用 MeterId 与最新文档。

LinkedResourceUri.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: linked resource URI from older usage schema. Commonly unpopulated in current records; inspect ResourceUri and row context before relying on it.
LinkedResourceUri.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：旧用量架构中的关联资源 URI。当前记录中通常为空；使用前应检查 ResourceUri 和行上下文。

MeterId.description: GUID of the billing meter applied to this hourly usage row, identifying the pricing dimension for the ingested data. Group by MeterId with Quantity and IsBillable to reconcile cost per meter.
MeterId.description_zh: 应用于该小时用量行的计费计量器 GUID，标识所摄取数据的定价维度。可按 MeterId 与 Quantity、IsBillable 分组，核对各计量器的成本。

Quantity.description: Size of data ingested for this hourly usage row in megabytes, per official documentation. Sum it by DataType, Solution, or MeterId to size ingest, project growth, and estimate cost drivers.
Quantity.description_zh: 据官方文档，该小时用量行所摄取的数据量（兆字节）。可按 DataType、Solution 或 MeterId 求和，用于评估摄取规模、预测增长并估算成本驱动因素。

QuantityUnit.description: Unit for the Quantity value; official documentation states the value is always Mbytes. Use it to confirm unit consistency when summing volume across usage rows.
QuantityUnit.description_zh: Quantity 值的单位；官方文档说明该值始终为兆字节（Mbytes）。用于在校验多行用量求和时确认单位一致。

ResourceUri.description: URI identifying the workspace that generated this usage row; official documentation notes it is the same for all rows in a workspace table. Use to confirm workspace scope when correlating multiple workspaces.
ResourceUri.description_zh: 标识生成该用量行的工作区的 URI；官方文档指出同一工作区该表内所有行相同。在关联多个工作区时用于确认工作区范围。

Solution.description: Solution or management pack associated with the reported usage, grouping data types by product family. Group by Solution with Quantity and IsBillable to attribute ingest volume and cost to specific monitoring solutions.
Solution.description_zh: 所报告用量关联的解决方案或管理包，按产品系列对数据类型分组。可按 Solution 与 Quantity、IsBillable 分组，将摄取量和成本归因到具体监视解决方案。

SourceSystem.description: Type of agent or collection channel that reported the record, such as OpsManager, Linux, or Azure per official documentation. Compare SourceSystem with DataType to understand which collection paths contribute usage volume.
SourceSystem.description_zh: 据官方文档，报告该记录的代理或采集通道类型，例如 OpsManager、Linux 或 Azure。可结合 SourceSystem 与 DataType，了解哪些采集路径产生了用量。

StartTime.description: Start timestamp of the one-hour aggregation window, documented as the same as TimeGenerated. Use for precise hourly bucketing; it defines when the usage window opened, not when a security event occurred.
StartTime.description_zh: 一小时聚合窗口的开始时间戳，官方文档说明其与 TimeGenerated 相同。用于精确按小时分桶；它表示用量窗口开始，而非安全事件发生时间。

TenantId.description: Name-derived and not described in the official column reference: interpret as the workspace or tenant scope identifier for usage records, not a directory tenant ID. Confirm meaning against current workspace documentation before filtering on it.
TenantId.description_zh: 根据名称推断，官方列参考未提供说明：应理解为用量记录的工作区或租户范围标识符，而非目录租户 ID。用作筛选前请对照当前工作区文档确认含义。

TimeGenerated.description: Date and time the usage record was created, per official documentation, and aligned with the hourly window start. Use for trend, retention, and period-over-period ingest comparisons in this billing table.
TimeGenerated.description_zh: 据官方文档，用量记录的创建日期和时间，与小时窗口开始时间对齐。可在该计费表中用于趋势、保留期和同比摄取量比较。

TotalBatches.description: Name-derived and deprecated per official notes: total number of usage batches processed in this hourly aggregation. Legacy field; do not assume it reflects current batch processing without documentation.
TotalBatches.description_zh: 根据名称推断且官方标注为已弃用：本次小时聚合处理的用量批次总数。属于遗留字段；若无文档支持，不应假设它反映当前批处理情况。

Type.description: Name of the table that produced the row; for this usage dataset it should read Usage. Filter on Type to isolate usage records when querying similar billing-adjacent tables in a workspace.
Type.description_zh: 产生该行的表名称；对于本用量数据集应显示为 Usage。在查询工作区中类似计费相关表时，可按 Type 筛选出用量记录。
